COLMAN, EUGENE ERNEST.—B.A. Cantab.; cadet, S. Stltlms., Oct., 1902; ag. 4th mag., Sing., Oct., 1903; passed final exam. in Malay, July, 1904; ag. 3rd mag., Sing., Mar., 1906; asst. to res., Malacca, July, 1910; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, and asst. to res., Malacca, 8th July, 1911; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, 1st Jan., 1912; ag. dep. regis., Penang, 23rd Sept., 1912; offr. of cls. IV., 21st Dec., 1914, but continued to act as dep. regis., ag. 1st mag., Penang, 20th Apr., 1915; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, 26th Apr., 1915; on spec. duty in Singapore, 28th Dec., 1915; ag. dep. regular, sup. ct. and asst. offic. assignee, Penang, 27th July, 1916; supervm. offr. of cls. 3, 1st Jan., 1919, continuing as ag. dep. regular, sup. ct. and asst. assignee, Penang; regis., dist. judge and mag., Malacca, June, 1920; temp. 2nd lieut., ag. capt., Malay and S. Stltlms. Volunteer Force (Malacca), 1st Jan., 1922.

COLVILLE, ERNEST FREDERICK.—Ed. Westminster and Christ Church, Oxford; B.A., 1901; asst. res., Nyasaland Prot., Mar., 1905; ag. asst. chief sec., Mar., 1914; ag. priv. sec. and A.D.C. to gov., Sept., 1914; res., 2nd grade, Apr., 1917; prov. comm., 1st June, 1921.

COLVILLE, J. W.—C.I.K., lands dept., Victoria, apptd. 1863; head of registry of that dept., Jan., 1878; sec. cent. bd. of health, May, 1886.

COMBE, SIR RALPH MOLYNEUX, KT. BACH. (1920).—Ed. at Haileybury Coll. and Exeter Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1894; called to the bar, Inner Temp., 1897; Crown advocate, E. Africa Prot., 4th Aug., 1906; mem. of exec. and legis. couns., 1907; atty.-gen., E.A.P., 1912; atty.-gen., Nigeria, 1913; ch. just., Nigeria, 1918.

COMISSIONG, TERENCE BERTRAND.—B. 1893; 3rd clk., col. sec.'s office, Grenada, 1st Apr., 1909; 2nd clk., gov.'s office, 1st June, 1915; 2nd clk., col. sec.'s office, 1st Dec., 1919; ag. ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, clk. of couns., med. regis., and man. govt. printing sub-dept., Feb.-Sept., 1920; seconded for active serv. 19th Sept., 1915 to 25th Oct., 1919; awarded meritorious serv. med. in German E. African campaign, 3rd June, 1916; apptd. J.P., Grenada, in recog. of war serv., 19th July, 1919; ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, clk. to exec. coun., med. regis. and man., govt. printing dept., 1st May, 1921.

COMISSIONG, TYRRELL MILDMAY.—Ed. at S.E. College Ramsgate; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., June, 1896; joined Grenada bar, Oct., 1898; ag. pol. mag. on several occasions, 1898 to 1905; pol. mag., W. Dist., 1st Aug., 1905; unoff. mem., leg. coun., 1923.

CONGREVE, GEN. SIR WALTER NORRIS, V.C., G.C.B., K.C.B. (1917), C.B. (1911), M.V.O. (1903), D.C.—B. 1862; ed. Harrow; ent. E. Brigade, 1885; capt., 1893; major, 1901; lieut. col., 1901; col., 1906; maj.-gen., 1915; lieut. gen., 1918; gen., 1922; served, S. Africa, 1902 (wounded twice ment. in desps.), V. Queen's med., seven clasps, King's med., seven clasps); European war, 1914-18 (deeps.); commandant schol. of musketry, Hythe; G.O.C., troops Palestine; G.O.C.-in-ch., Southern Commd., 1922; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., Malta, 20th Nov., 1924; assumed govt., 29th June, 1924.

CONNOLLY, HON. SIR JAMES DANIEL K. BACH. (1920).—B. 1870; ed. Warwick Pub. Schl. and Catholic Schl.; M.L.C., Western Australia, 1902; col. sec. and min. of com. and lab., 1904; col. sec. and min. of pub. health, 1910; leader, leg. coun. from 1906 to 1911; M.L.A. for Perth, 1914; agt. genl. in London for Western Australia, 1917-23.

CONWAY, WILLIAM EWAN.—B. 1883; ed. High Schl., Dundee; govt. travelling schl. msc., 10th Dec., 1913; 2nd clk., C.S.O., Mar., 1916; 1st clk. and priv. sec. to govt. of Falkland Is., Jun., 1916 to Apr., 1917 and Sept., 1917 to Apr., 1918; collr. of cust., G. Coast, Oct., 1920.

COOK, FREDERICK.—B. 1858; ed. Len Gram. Schl.; in journalism in Canada since 1882; Canadian correspondent of "The Times," London, for 20 years; school trustee and man., Ottawa; mayor of Ottawa, 1902-3; British Columbia Better Terms Commd., 1914; dep. King's printer of Canada, 1st July, 1915; 1st May, 1920; chmn. of editorial comittee, d. ex. govt., 1920-23; supervisor, govt. publications, 1923; author of "Commercial Canada," "The Relations of Ottawa to the Federal authority," edited "Canadian Who's Who," (pub. by "The Times"), 1909.

COOK, Rt. Hon. Sir Joseph, P.C. (1914), G.C.M.G. (1918).—B. 1860; mem. of H. of Commons of Australia, since 1901; pres. gen., N.S. Wales, 1894-1898; min. for mines and agric., 1898-9; min. of defence, C. of A., Jan., 1909; prime minister, C. of A., June, 1913-Sep., 1914; min. for the Navy, 1917; ditto, from 1st Jan., 1918; high commr. in London for C. of A., Nov., 1921.

COOKE, A.—B. 1890; ed. at Stowe Schl., Coll. and Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford (Char. Oldham classical scholar); 2nd cl. class, Eur. Moda, 1910; Goldsmith's exhibn. in Class. Divinity, 1910; 2nd cl. Lit. Hum., 1912; Ed. 1912; apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd cl. c. C.O., 13th Oct., 1913; on military service from 13th Apr., 1917 to 16th March, 1919; asst. sec. to Lord Milner, 17th Mar., 1919; priv. sec. Col. Amery, 1st Jan., 1920; priv., 1st Apr., 1921.

COOKE, EDWARD ROBERT CECIL, M.C., R.C. (Cantab.), M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P.—B. 1888; ed. Cambridge Univ. and Univ. Coll. Hosp., London; temp. comm., R.A.M.C., 2nd Sept., 1914; agt. R.A.M.C. and divnl. anti-malaria offr., 1915; med. offr., F.M.S.R., Jan., 1922.

COOKE, HERBERT SUTTON, O.B.E. (1914), C.M.R., 1893-99; Basutoland mtd. pol., 1898-1900; inspr., native affrs. dept., Transvaal, Dec., 1900; sen. inspr., Mar., 1902; dist. contr., Johannesburg, July, 1903; chief pass offr., July, 1906; asst. dir. of native labour (Union), Apr., 1912; asst. dir. infrn. bureau, dept. of defence, 1914-15; nat. Union Defence Force—political services in E. Africa, 1916-17; inspr., pub. serv. comm., 1918; ch. native commr. and dir., native labour, Johannesburg, 1924.
COOKE, S. V.—Asst. dist. comsnr., E.A.P., Jan., 1917.

COOKE, WILLIAM ERNEST, M.A., F.R.A.S.—Cadet, Adelaide observatory, 1878; B.A., Adel. Univ., 1883; ast. astronomer, Adel. obser., 1884; f.l.A., Adel. Univ., 1889; govt. astronomer, New South Wales, 1912; prof. of astronomy at Sydney Univ.

COOKSON, CLAUDE EDWARD.—Capt., reserve of offrs.; barrister-at-law; educ. at Eton (King's Scholar, 1891-97); served in regular army, 1899-1910; capt., 1908; with Bedfordshire regt. in India, Gibraltar and Bermuda; station staff offr., Aiden, 1907-8; ag. brigade major, 1908; asst. comsnr. of police, Gold Coast, Sept., 1911; extra A.D.C. to Mr. J. J. Thoburn, C.M.G., gov. of G. Coast, Feb. to May, 1912; comsnr. of police, G. Coast, Jan., 1915; asst. col. sec., July, 1915; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, May, 1919; nspr.-gen. of prisons, 28th Feb., 1920.

COOLING, HAROLD GEORGE, B.A.—B. 1899; ed. at Birmingham and Cambridge Unive.; sup't, educ. dept., N. Provs., Nigeria, 7th Sept., 1921.

COOLS-LARTIGUE, THEODORE.—B. 1867; ed. at Mount Saint Mary's Coll., Derbyshire; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1889; admitted to the bar, St. Lucia, 1889; ditto, Leeward Is., 1894; ag. registr., St. Lucia, 1891; ag. mag. in 1903-4; ag. regis., St. Lucia, 1906-7; ag. mag., 1911; elective mem., Castries town bd., 1903-1912; registrar and prov. marshal, Dominica, and also supplementary mag., Roseau, Dominica, Feb., 1912; offl. mem., leg. coun., Dominica, visiting just. of Dominica prison and J.P., 1912; govt. mem., Roseau town bd., 1914; valuation comsnr. for assessing of taxes, 1916; ag. crown atty. and mem., exec. coun., 1916-19; crown atty. and registrar, sup. ct., Oct., 1919.

COOMARASWAMY, CHINNAPPAH.—B. 1887; ed. Hindu Coll., Jaffra, and Royal Coll., Colombo; cadet, local div., Ceylon civ. serv., Apr., 1910; extra office asst. to govt. agt., Batticaloa, Apr., 1910; ag. office asst. to ditto, May, 1912; pol. mag., Matara, May, 1913; pol. mag. and office asst. to govt. agt., Puttalam, June, 1913; pol. mag., Chilaw, Feb., 1914; pol. mag., Point Pedro, June, 1915; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Feb., 1918; ditto, Chilaw and Puttalam, Mar., 1920; addnl. asst. govt. agt., Chilaw and Puttalam, in addn., Aug., 1920; comsnr. of requests, Colombo, May, 1922.

COOMARASWAMY, VALUPILLAI.—B. 1892; Cadet, local division, Ceylon civ. serv., Mar., 1913; attached to Puttalam Kachoheri, Mar., 1913; asst. to Anuradhapura Kachoheri, Nov., 1913; ag. pol. mag., Puttalam, Feb., 1914; extra office asst. to asst. govt. agent, Puttalam and Chilaw, in addition to his own duties, Mar., 1914; pol. mag., Negombo, July, 1917; ditto, Dandagamuwa, July, 1918; office asst. to govt. agt., S. Prov., Feb., 1919; pol. mag., Panadura, Oct., 1920; itg. pol. mag., W. Prov., July, 1923; dist. judge, Kegalla, June, 1924.

COOPE, ARTHUR EGERTON.—B. 1888; ed. Fonthill Schl., St. Edward's Schl., and Keble Coll., Oxford; B.A. Oxon.; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1911; ag. 2nd asst. dist. offr., Tapah, Oct., 1912; passed cadet, June, 1913; ag. asst. dist. offr., lands, Kinta, Dec., 1913; offr., cls. V, Dec., 1914; asst. dist. offr., Ipoh, May, 1915; offr., cls. IV, Jan., 1919; asst. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Apr., 1919; dist. offr., Kuala Selangor, Mar., 1921; dist. offr., Ulu Kelantan, May, 1921; dist. offr., Pasir Puteh, June, 1922; offr., cls. III, Nov., 1923.

COOPER, EVANS GUSTAVUS.—B. 1875; asst. clk. of courts, Jamaica, 1893; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1912; clerk of cts., Hanover, 15th Dec., 1912; J.P., 1913; ag. res. mag. on various occasions; supernny. res. mag., 1st June, 1923; res. mag., 1st June, 1924.

COOPER, PHILIP WARD, O.B.E. (1919).—B. 1877; ed. Marlborough Coll.; col. audit branch, E. and A. Dept., 1st Dec., 1899; asst. local auditor, E. Africa and Uganda Provs., 9th Oct., 1900; ag. local auditor, Uganda, 23rd Dec., 1901 to 16th June, 1902; asst. collr., Uganda, 4th Jan., 1904, with seniority from 31st Mar., 1902; collr., 1st Apr., 1905; ag. prov. comsnr., Western Prov., Uganda, 9th Sept., 1913.

COOPER, HON. SIR THEOPHILUS, KT. BACH. (1921).—B. 1850; puisne judge, sup. ct. of N. Zealand, 1901-20; retired.

COOPER, WILLIAM D.—B. 1902; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 16th Oct., 1920.

COPE, WILLIAM VIVION.—B. 1872; ed. pub. and model schls., Ottawa; clk. and ch. clk. in supt.'s office, C.F.R., Ottawa, 1890-1903; later, divn.-engnr.'s office, Calgary, Alberta, 1903-06; clk., acnt., s.b.r., dept. of rly. and canals, Ottawa, 1st Jan., 1907; asst. deptl. audr., 1st Oct., 1911; deptl. audr., 1st Apr., 1913; finan. comptlr., 1st Apr., 1919.

COPP, HON. ARTHUR BLISS.—B. 1870; ed. pub. schls., prov. normal schl., Mt. Allison Univ., New Brunswick, Dalhouse Law Schl., Halifax, N.S., Harvard Law Schl. (L.L.B. 1894); admitted to bar, N.B. 1895; mem., legis. ass., N.B., 1901-12; el. to H.C., bye-el., Feb., 1915; re-el. g.e., 1917 and 1921; sec. of state of Canada, 29th Dec., 1921.

CORDEAUX, MAJOR SIR HARRY EDWARD SPILLER, K.C.M.G. (1921), C.B. (1904), C.M.G. (1902).—Ed. at Cheltenham Coll., and St. John's Coll., Camb.; minor scholarship, 1889; class. trip, 1892; passed in Hindustani and Persian, 1895; Somali, 1899; B.A., 1892; entd. Indian Army, 1894; probationer, Bombay polit. dept. as 4th asst. polit. res., Aden, Apr., 1898; asst. res., Berbera, July, 1898; vice-consul, Berbera, Oct., 1898; consul, Nov., 1902; admstd. govt. of Somaliland Prot., in 1900, 1902, 1903 and 1904; served in operations against the Somali Mullah 1902-04, as polit. offr. (ment. in desps., medal and 3 clasps); dep. commr., Somaliland Prot., 1904; admstd. govt., June, 1905; comsnr. and comdr-in-chief, 15th May, 1906; gov., Uganda, 1st Feb., 1910; gov., St. Helena, 22nd Nov., 1911; assumed govt., 21st Feb., 1912; gov., Bahamas, 1920.

CORNELL, C. H.—Asst. dist. comsnr., Kenya, Feb., 1921.

CORNEY, LEONARD GEORGE.—B.A. Cantab., classical exhibtr., St. John's Coll., Camb.; class. trip, 1908; examiner, col. audit branch of E. and A. Dept., Feb., 1910; asst. auditor, Gold Coast, Aug., 1910; ag. auditor, July, 1913, July to Dec., 1914, and Apl. to Oct., 1916; ag. asst. col. sec., Dec., 1916, to Jan., 1917; ag. senr. asst. auditor, Jan. to Apl., 1917; seconded to G. Coast Regt., 23rd Apl., 1917, to 6th Jan., 1918; ag. senr. asst. auditor, 7th Jan. to 31st Dec., 1918; senr. asst. auditor, 1st Jan., 1919; ag. auditor, Jan. to Oct., 1919; dep. audr., 1st Jan., 1920.

CORNISH-BOWDEN, ATHELSTAN HALL.—Second asst. surv.-gen., Cape Colony, 16th Jan., 1903; ag. surv.-gen., 15th Dec., 1904; apptmt., confirmed, 1st Jan., 1906; mem., joint comtees for professional exams. constituted under Univ. of S. Africa Act, 1916; trustee, Garden Cities Trust, Cape Town.
CORNWALLIS, COL. K., C.B.E., Mily. (1919), D.S.O. (1917), Commander of the Order of King George I. of Greece, Order of Nahdhabh (2nd cls.), Order of the Nile (3rd cls.), Order of Majidie (4th cls.), three times mentioned in despatches—Sudan civil serv., 1906-14; Egyptian civil serv., 1914; dir., Arab Bureau, Cairo, 1916-19; dep. ch. polit. offr., Egyptian Expidy. Force, 1918; asst. ch. polit. offr., ditto, 1919; attd. to Amir Faisal in London, 1919; attd. to F.O., 1920-21; accompanied Amir Faisal to 'Iraq and seconded to 'Iraq govt. for two years, June, 1921; adviser to min. of interior, 'Iraq, September, 1921.

CORRY, WILFRED CHARLES STEUART.—B. 1900; ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Wadham Coll., Oxford; B.A. 1922; cadet, F.M.S., Dec., 1923; attd. secretariat, Taiping, Perak, Jan., 1924; land office, Johore Bahru, Apr., 1924.

CORSELLIS, ERNEST SHAWE, L.R.C.P.I., L.R.C.S.I., L.M. (Dub.), 1896; house surg., Jervis St. Hosp., Dublin, 1897; dist. med. offr., Cyprus, 1902; ag. ch. med. offr., 28th June to 28th Oct., 1912, 13th June, 1917 to 22nd Jan., 1918, 7th Feb. to 13th June, 1920, 19th Apr. to 17th June, 1921 and 4th Sept., 1921 to 23rd Mar., 1922; ch. med. offr., 24th Mar., 1922.

CORSER, Lieut. E. E.—Ed. Shrewsbury; 2nd lieut., 4th Batt. King's Shropshire Light Infantry (T.), Aug., 1914; lieut., June, 1916; served in France, 1917-18; asst. dist. commr., G. Coast, 3rd Dec., 1919.

CORY, WILLIAM WALLACE, C.M.G. (1909).—B. 1865; entd. civil serv., Canada, 1901; apptd. inspr. Yukon offr., 1901; asst. commr., Dominion lands, 1904; dep. min. of the Interior, 1905; also commr. of Yukon and N.W.T., June, 1919.

COSSER, S. C. A.—B. 1880; ed. Tonbridge; clk., treasy., Transvaal, 8th May, 1901; asst. acctnt., treasy., 1st Dec., 1905; asst. acctnt., treasy., Union of S. Africa, 31st May, 1910; provincial acctnt., Transvaal Prov., 21st Nov., 1910; served in European War, 1915-19 (Gen. Serv., Victory and Mily. Meds.)

COSTELLOE, MATHEW.—B. 1866; detective sub-inspector., Trinidad, 7th June, 1911; detective-insp. of constab., 1916.

COSTLEY-WHITE, ERNEST, O.B.E. (1918).—B.A. Oxon., 1900; clk. to armed forces, B.C. Afric., Apl., 1900; asst. collr., Nyasaland Prot., Mar., 1904; 2nd grade res., Jan., 1911; ag. supt. of native affairs, Sept., 1916, to May, 1919; transport offr. and carrier recruiting offr., Nyasaland Field Force, with temp. rank of major, 1916-18 (ment. in despatches); ag. chief sec. to gov't., May, 1919 to June, 1920; prov. commr., 1st June, 1921; ag. ch. sec., Oct., 1921 to Jan., 1922, and from Apr. to July, 1922; ch. sec., Zanzibar, Aug., 1922; ag. Br. res., 28th Sept., 1923 to 24th Jan., 1924.

COTTLE, HENRY ROSS., M.B.E. (1924).—B. 1887; supt., monotype dept., govt. printing office, Ceylon, June, 1909; ag. 3rd asst. govt. printer, in addition to his own duties, Aug., 1916, to May, 1917; on military duty, 1918; ag. govt. printer, Sept., 1919; govt. printer, Dec., 1919.

COULSON, NORMAN.—B. 1891; ed. Charterhouse and Pembroke Coll., Camb.; B.A. 1913 (2nd cls. hons., class., 1913, 2nd cls. hons., mod. hist., 1914); M.A. 1917; 2nd lieut., 10th Res. Regt. Cav., 12th Sept., 1914; attd. 8th (K.R.I.) Hussars, 20th Sept., 1915; cadet, F.M.S., 1st Apr., 1920; ag. agt., food contr., Kedah, 27th Nov., 1920; ag. sec., sany. bd., Alor Star, 1st Feb., 1921; passed cadet, 14th June, 1922; attd. to treas., Penang on sp. duty, Sept., 1922; dep. collr., land rev. and dep. registr. of deed Penang, Dec., 1922; ag. aud., Penang, Feb., 1923; dist. offr., Dindings, Apr., 1923.

COUSINS, CLARENCE WILFRED.—M.A.; ed. col. sec.'s dept., Cape, 1896; dep. impr. prisons, 1901; prin. clk. and offr. in charge imigrn. and labour, 1905; ch. imigrn. offr., 1906; prin. imigrn. offr. and ch. clk. in charge dept. of interior, Cape Town, 1913; prin. imigrn. offr. and registr. of Asiatics, Pretoria, 1916; ag. of census, Union of S. Africa, 1917; sec. for all, 1924.

COUSINS, HERBERT HENRY, M.A., F.C.S.—Late postmtr., Merton Coll., Oxford; lect. chem., nat. science, 1889; lecturer in chem., S.E. Agric. Coll., Ventnor, 1894; govt. analyst and agric. chemist, Jamaica, 1900; nominee M.L.C., 1907; mem. of bd. of agric.; chem. charge of sugar experimental statn.; auth. publications on chemistry and agriculture.

COUZENS, CHARLES.—B. 1861; apptd. exam., 3rd cl. mess., C.O., 11th Jan., 1892; promoted 2nd cl. mess., Nov., 1899; King's mess., 1st Feb., 1902; asst. office-keeper, 3rd Jun., 1915.

COWAN, J.—Asst. traffic man., Uganda, Aug., 1912.

COWELL, H. RUSSELL, B.A.—B. 1877; Malvern and Cambridge; scholar of Clare, 1894; apptd., after compet. exam., clk., sec. dep. inland revenue, Oct., 1901; 2nd cl. clk., C.O., 27th Mar., 1902; sec. to inter-deptl. comm. on oil fields of W. Indies, 1904; sec. to Roy. Comm. on trade relations between Canada and W. Indies, 1909-1910; priv. sec. to Sir J. Andrews, G.C.M.G., 26th June, 1911; priv. sec. to Lord Emmott, 9th Nov., 1912; priv. sec. to Lord Ilington, 8th Aug., 1914; ag. 1st cl. clk., 12th Oct., 1914; 1st cl. clk., 10th Mar., 1916; prin. clk., 1st Jan., 1920; asst. sec., 1st Apr., 1920.

COWGILL, JOHN VINCENT.—B. 1886; Durham Schol. and All Souls Coll., Oxford (bar. clerk, 1907-11); 3rd cls. moda., 3rd cls. lit. hum., B.A., 1911; Malayan civil serv., 1911; succ. Chinese, 1912-14; 2nd lieut., 4th battn. Sherwood Foresters, Mar., 1916; lieut., 1917; seconded R.E. Signals, 1916; served in France with Sign Service, 1916-19; M.C., 1917; ment. in despatches, 1919; retnd. to Malaya, 1919; ag. rev. audr., Aug., 1919; ag. asst. sec. to rev., Selangor, Sep., 1919; dist. offr., Temerloh, Dec., 1919; ag. pr. of Chinese, Selangor and N. Simbilans, Oct., 1920; ag. asst. prot., Chinese, Perak, Sept., 1920; ag. commr., cust., Johore, Dec., 1921; ag. asst. offr., Kuantan., Sept., 1923; ag. asst. adviser Trengganu, Oct., 1923; asst. adviser Trengganu, Nov., 1923.

COWLEY-BROWN, PATRICK CAMERON, M.B.E. (Civil).—B. 1886; sp. offr. in charge locust destruction, Malacca, Aug., 1914; ag. cable censor and latterly senr. asst. cable censor S. Stiltsm. and F.M.S., Nov., 1915; paspy offr., Apr., 1919 to Dec., 1921; conf. clk., col. sec. office, Dec., 1921.

COWPER, HERBERT WELLESLEY.—B. 1883; ed. at St. Paul's School, London, Hertford Coll., Oxford, and in Germany, France and Italy; asst. res., N. Nigeria, 30th Nov., 1910.
COX, CHARLES EDWARD LANGTON—B. 1889; td. civ. serv., B. Guiana, 1907; 2nd cls. clk., sec.'s office; called to the bar, 1918; stip. lg. for the colony; revising barrister, 1919; served in France as lieu., R.G.A. (S.R.); injured Loos, Sept., 1916; invalided out of army, Nov., 1917; served under Admiralty as A.T.S.O., dining dept., Grangemouth, Mar. to Dec., 1918; tra. A.D.C. to Sir W. Egerton, K.C.M.G., 13-15; lieut., artillery coy., B. Guiana Militia, Dec. 1908.

COX, SIR CHARLES T., K.C.M.G. (1913), M.G. (1903)—B. 1888; Govt. sec.'s office, B. Guiana, July, 1874; sen. clk., 1883; ch. clk. and sec. to the quarantine bd., 1888; sec. to the royal comm. on adminstr.-gen.'s dept. of Br. Guiana, 1882; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., 1899; compiled "Index to Laws of Br. Guiana," 1887; 2nd edition, 1891, also "Some Notes for Govt. officers," 1894; asst. gov't. sec., and clk. to ct. of policy and combined ct., 1889; also clk. of exec. un., 1892; ag. gov't. sec., in 1893, 1894, 1895, and 1898, with seat in exec. coun. and legislature; mn. of comte. on pensions, 1898; ag. audr. mn. on several occasions; admstr. of St. Kitts and Nevis, 1899-1904; ag. gov', Leeward Is., July to Oct., 1903, and May to Sept., 1904; gov't. c. and ag. gov', B. Guiana, Sept., 1904; Apl., Oct., 1906; Apl. to Oct., 1909, and Aug., 1911 Apl., 1912.

COX, E. A.W.—Cadet, Sarawak civ. ser., Mar., 1885; asst. res., May, 1891; of Lundr., June, 1926; res., 2nd class, Mar., 1898, of Trusan ; ain May, 1899; in charge of Lawas, 16th Apl., 1905 in addition to Trusan.

COX, N. B.—Imp. customs serv., Feb., 1906; st. to chief of customs, E. Afric Prot., Nov., 1911; dep. chief of customs, Apl., 1914; ch. of istoma, Zanzibar, Feb., 1919; treas., Nov., 1922.

COX, MAJOR-GEN. SIR PERCY ZACHARIAH, C.M.G. (1922), G.C.I.E. (1917), K.C.S.I. (1915), C.M.G. (1920), K.C.I.E. (1911), C.S.I. (1909), I.E. (1902), F.R.G.S., F.Z.S.—B. 1864; ed. arrow and Sandhurst; joined army 1884; served 2nd batt. Cameronians till 1889; joined indian Staff Corps, 1889; Indian polit. dep., 1890; ice-consul, Zaila, Somali Coast, 1893; Berbers, 1894-5; consul and polit. agt., Muscat, 1899-1904; consul-gen., Bushire, 1904; polit. res., Persian ulf., 1909; sec., foreign dept. gov't. of India, 1914; ch. polit. offr., Indian Expedy. Force "D," 1914; ment. in despa., 1916; ag. British min. to ersia, 1919-20; high commnr., Mesopotamia, 1920, etc., 1923.

COX, WILFRED BERNARD.—B. 1896; ed. Denzone Coll., Staffs.; col. audit dept., May, 1920; st. audr., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1920.

COZENS-HARDY, EDGAR WRIGLEY.—B. 372; asst. survr. of roads, P.W.D., Gold Coast, eb., 1901; asst. engr., G. Coast rly., Aug., 1903; maintenance engr., G. Coast rly., June, 1906; seconded as engrnr.-in-charge, Kofodusa y. extn., 1912-16; gen. man., G. Coast rly., July, 1919.

CRABB, RICHARD BRUCE.—B. 1891; ed. ranleigh Schl.; asst. dist. commnr., Gold Coast 1516-17; E. Surrey Regt., 1916-19; asst. dist. commnr., Gold Coast, 1919; dist. commnr., 5th ug., 1922; asst. col. sec., 8th Mar., 1923.

CRAIG, ERNEST DUNCAN, M.A., B.Sc., F.Z.S.—B. 1888; ed. Aberdeen Univ. and at Exeter coll., Oxford; jnr. supt. educn. dept., N. Nigeria, 17th Jan., 1920.

CRAIG, GEORGE, LL.M. (N.Z.)—B. 1873; ed. Otago Boys. High Schl. and Victoria Univ. Coll., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. cust. dept., 1891; ch. clk., 1910; ast. comptr., 1913; comptr., 1923.

CRAIG, JOHN.—B. 1871; educ. at Glasgow and Glasgow Univ.; trained certif. teacher; principal, Boshof pub. sch., O.R.C., 1905; inspr. of schls., O.R.C., July, 1909.

CRAIG, JOHN.—B. 1884; ed. at Aberdeen Univ.; M.A., 1st cl. hons., Classics; univ. prize in Latin, 1906; and at Christ Church, Oxford; B.A., 2nd cl. hons., lit. hum., 1908; after exam., examr., E. and A. dept., 5th Jan., 1909; ast. auditor, S. Nigeria, May, 1909; temporarily transf'd to N. Nigeria, Aug., 1909; ag. local auditor, N. Nigeria, Nov.-Dec., 1909; joined col. audit dept., Jan., 1910; auditor, Br. Honduras, Nov., 1912; priv. sec. to gov', Sir W. Collett, K.C.M.G., Nov., 1914; priv. sec. and A.D.C. to ag. gov', R. Walter, C.M.G., gov'. W. Hart-Bennett, C.M.G., and gov'. Eyre-Hutton, C.M.G., 1915-19; lieut., B. Honduras Territorial Force; audr., Mauritius, Apr., 1920; col. audit dept., 1st Apr., 1924.

CRAIG, WM.—Supt. of mails, G.P.O., Singapore; ag. supt. money order branch and savings bank, Oct., 1903, to June, 1906; ag. ast. P.M.G., Singapore, Mar., 1907; supt., money order branch and gov't. savings bank, Singapore, Feb., 1908; ag. ast. postmr.-gen., Singapore, June, 1909; ast. postmr.-gen., Singapore, Jan., 1912; ag. postmr.-gen., in addition, Apr., 1918; ag. postmr.-gen., June, 1919.

CRAIGIE-HALKETT, MONTAGU C.—Ag. priv. sec. to gov', Falkland Islds., Mar., 1897; writer, col. sec.'s off., Apr., 1897; priv. sec. to admnr., Apr., 1897; clk., col. sec.'s off., Oct., 1897; ag. priv. sec. to gov', Nov., 1898; treas. clk., 1899; ag. postmr., manager of savings bank, offr. administering intestate estates, as well as performing duties of regiar. sup. ct., shipping master, and clk. to coun., Mar., 1908, to Apr., 1910; ag. auditor and commnr. of currency on various occasions; ag. stip. mag., Oct., 1909; J.P., Nov., 1909; postmaster, manager of savings bank, regiar.-gen., and regiar. of supreme etc., and offr. admnr., 1911; ag. M.L.C., Feb. to Sept., 1911; supt. of census, 1911.

CRAMPTON, DUDLEY RUSSELL.—Ed. at Aldenham Schol., Elstree, and in Germany and Switzerland; ast. collr., E. Africa Prot., 24th May, 1904; dist. commnr., 1909.

CRANSTON, T. D.—M.A. (Glasgow); ast. mast., training institn. for teachers, Accra, G. Coast, 17th Apr., 1912.

CRAWFORD, JOHN GERALD.—B. 1894; ed. King's schl., Chester and Merton Coll., Oxford; M.A., 1920; 2nd lieut., Cheshire Regt., T.F., Aug., 1914; lieut., Nov., 1915; capt., June, 1916; cadet, F.M.S., Mar., 1921; attd. to dist. office, Kuala Selangor, Apr., 1921; attd. to office of conserv. of forests, Jan., 1922; passed cadet, Feb., 1923; supermny. offr., els. V., Feb., 1922; ast. dist. offr., Batang Padang Nov., 1923; 2nd lieut., M.V.I., Dec., 1923; ag. ast. dist. offr., Kroh, May, 1924.

CRAWFORD, O. S.—Ast. treasur., E. Africa Prot., Dec., 1914.

CRAWLEY, PHILIP DANIEL.—B. 1881; served in R.M.L.I., 1898-1910; acctnt. clk., works dept., Admiralty, 1903-1910; inspr. of police and clerical ast., Weihaimei, 1st Apr., 1913; ag. financial ast. 26th July, 1913, to 18th Nov., 1914; financial ast. and ch clk., 20th Nov., 1916.
CRAWSHAY, Lionel Rutledge.—Ed. at Harrow and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; M.A., 1902; studied zoology at Univ. Coll., London, 1903-05; naturalist on the staff of the Marine Lab., Plymouth, 1905-19; biologist to "Scotia" expdn., 1913; on mily. serv., 1915-19; research offr. for sponge fishery investigations in the W. Indies, 26th Mar., 1920.

CREAN, B. A.—Barrister-at-law; dep. regnr. of titles, Kenya, Oct., 1920; res. mag., Apr., 1921.

CREASY, Gerald Hallen.—B. 1897; ed. Rugby and King's Coll., Camb. (scholar 1915); 2nd lieut., R.G.A., Nov., 1916; lieut., May, 1918; capt. and adjutant, Nov., 1918; served in Flanders; apptd. under reconstruction scheme asst. prin., C.O., 26th July, 1920.

CREASY, Harold Thomas., M.Inst.C.E., A.M.I.Mech.E.—B. 1873; dist. engr., P.W.D., Colombo, 1897; Dandagamuwa, 1908; ag. provl. engr., N.C. Prov., 1909; confirmed in apptnt. as provl. engr., 1910; asst. dir. of pub. wks., 1913; ag. depty., D.P.W., 1913-15, and again in 1916; depty., D.P.W., 1917; ag. D.P.W., 1921 and 1923; D.P.W., Hong Kong, 1923.

CREED, Henry.—B. 1871; apptd., after exam., 3rd class messenger in C.O., July, 1900; 2nd class, 1st Feb., 1904; King's mess., 30th Jan., 1911; office keeper, 1924.

CREMER, Arthur Stanley.—B. 1886; ed. Durham schl.; col. audit dept., 23rd Jan., 1911; asst. audr., G. Coast, 1911-13; asst. audr., Nyassaland, 1913-16; asstr. audr., Uganda, 1916-18; asst. audr., provisional admin., G.E.A., 1918-19; senr. asst. audr., Tanganyika Territory, 1st Oct., 1919; audr., Mauritius, 8th July, 1924.

CREMER, John Awdry.—B. 1881; B.A. (Oxon.), 1903; clk., col. audit branch, E. and A.D., 1903; asst. auditor, Lagos, 1905; asst. auditor, Nyassaland, 1908; 2nd cls. clk., cent. office, 1913; auditor, Nyassaland, 1914.

CRESSALL, Paul Ewart Francis, M.C.—B. 1893; ed. Cranleigh Schl.; ent. civ. serv., B. Guiana, 1911; cler. asst., secretariat and sub-inspr., B. Guiana pol., 1912; ag. dist. inspr., 1914-16; 2nd lieut., B. Guiana Militia Infy., 1914; served in B.W.I. Regt. as capt., E. Africa and Palestine, 1915-19; dist. inspr., B. Guiana pol., 1920; ag. county inspr., 1920; passed final law exam., 1921; capt., B. Guiana local forces, 1922; ag. staff offr., B. Guiana local forces, 1922; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1923; county inspr., pol., 1923.

CRESWELL, Col. the Hon. Frederic Hugh Page, D.S.O.—B. 1866; ed. Bruce Castle, Derby Schl., and R. Schl. of Mines (grad. Ists.cl.); arrived in S. Africa, May, 1893; mining in Rhodesia, 1893-94; man., Durban Roodpoort Deep Mine, 1895-99; served in Imp. Light Horse during Anglo-Boer war; man., Village Main Reef, 1902-03; supported agitation for expulsion of Chinese labour; elec. to first Union parl., 1910, and led Labour Party; 2nd in commd., Rand Rifles, S. W. Africa, 1914; 2nd in commd., subsequently commdgs., 8th S. A. Infy. Brig., German E. Africa campaign; defeated in 1921 elec. but retd. at by-elec., July, 1922; min. of defence and labour, Hertzog cabinet, 30th June, 1924.

CRESWELL, Rear-Admiral Sir William Rooke, K.C.M.G. (1911), K.B.E. (1919), C.M.G. (1897).—Joined R.N., Dec., 1865; heut., 1873, for service in action at Laroot River (wounded); engaged in suppression of slave trade on African coast, 1875-7; ret. from Navy, 1878; apptd. to S. Australian naval force, 1885; comdr., 1891; capt., 1896; naval comdt., 1893-1900; comma. H.M.C.S. "Protector" to China during Box outbreak, 1900; naval comdt. of Queen's 1900-4; dir. of commonwealth naval forces; attended Imp. Conf. on naval and mil. def., 1909; rear-admiral, 1911; retired, 1919.

CREWE, 1st Marquess of (cr. 1911); Rt. Hon. Offley Ashburnton Crewe-Milnes, K.G., M.A., F.S.A.—B. 1858; Baron Houghton in the county of York, 1868; of Crewe (cr. 1895); Earl of Madeley (cr. 1915); ed. at Harrow and Trin. Coll., Camb.; sec. to sec. for foreign affairs (Earl Granville), 1883-84; lord-in-waiting to Queen Victoria, 1892; lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1892-95; lord pres. of coun., 1906-08; S. of S. for the Colonies, 1908; Lord Privy Seal (in conjunction with Secretaryship of State), 1908; S. of S. for India, 1910-15; accompanied H.M. King George V. on the occasion of the Royal visit to India, lord pres. of the coun., 1915.

CREWE, Brig.-Gen. the Hon. Sir Preston, K.C.M.G. (1915), C.B. (1900).—B. 1856; served in Cape M.R., 1878-81; M.L.A. for Griqualand, 1899; M.L.A. for Aliwal North col. sec., Feb., 1904, to June, 1907; sec. for army, June, 1907; raised and was major command Border Horse Regt., 1900; promoted to lieut.-col., May, 1900; colonel, 1901; in command of div. of Cape Nov., 1901, to termination of hosti. ties; ret. from Cape Colony forces, 31st Oct., 1902; sec. for agric., June, 1907, to Feb., M.L.A., East London, 1908; mem. for Eastern Union parl., 1910 to 1918.

CREWE-READ, E. C.—Asst. dist. inspr., E.A.P., 5th Jan., 1907; dist. commr., Akim.

CRICHLLOW, Nathaniel.—M.B., Ch. med. offr., Solomon Islands, Oct., 1914.

CRICHTON, Reginald, M.A.—B. 1871; ed. privately and at Univ. Coll., Oxford; asst. Perak, F.M.S., Nov., 1900; passed in May, 1902; passed in law, Oct., 1902; dist. mag., Kuala Kangsar, 30th Nov., ditto, Brusa, 23rd Oct., 1902; ag. asst. dist. mag., Gopeng, 21st Feb., 1903; ag. 2nd mag. Kuala Lumpur, 16th Sept., 1904; ag. asst. regis. rec., Ipoh, 16th Mar., 1906; dist. treas. rec., last Aug., 1906; state treas., Pahang, Int., 1907; ag. regis., sup. ct., 29th Jan., 1908; 31st Oct., 1911; dist. offr., Kuantan, 24th June, 1908; asst. dist. offr., Kuantan, 5th June, 1911; ag. regis. of sup. ct., 25th Nov., 1911; cls. IV., 1st Jan., 1912; asst. adviser to govt. Johore at Muar (seconded), 26th Apr., 1914; 2nd asst. col. sec., S. Stiltnitz, 9th Feb., 1915; offr. of cls. III., 1st Jan., 1918; cls. II., Int., 1919; dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, 7th Mar., 1920; dist. offr., Larut and Matang, 23rd June, 1920; dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, 11th July, 1923.

CRITIEN, Attilio, M.B.E. (1919), M.D., Malta Univ., D.P.H., D.T.M. (Liverpool, 1906.—B. 1872; demonstr., schl. of anatomy, 1901 to 1901; civil surgeon attchd. R.A.M.C., 1904; med. offr. of hth., Malta, 1906 to 1917; govt. med. offr. and supt. of pub. hth., with exec. coun. and coun. of govt., 1917.

CROFTON, Richard Hayes.—B. 1880; ed. John's Coll., Camb.; B.A. class, tripoa, 1904; fellow, Royal Economic Soc'y.; assoc. Town Planning Inst.; clk., col. audit branch, E.A. dept., 1st July, 1901; clk., audit dept., Hong Kong, 25th Aug., 1903; ag. local auditor, Feb. to 22nd Dec., 1904; ch. clk., col. sec. off., 11th Mar., 1905; ag. asst. col. sec., and d...
couns., for periods in 1907, 1911, 1912, 1913; st. chief sec., Zanzibar, 6th Feb., 1914; ag. sec. for various periods, 1914-18, 1922-23 and 1924; ag. sec., admntr., Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1919, to Mar., 1920; ag. treas., Zanzibar, for various periods, 1920-22; mem. u.c.m. comnr., 1920; chmn., oomnr., on agr., 1923; publications, "Statistics of the Zanzibar Prot., 193-1930," "Adventures in Administration."

CROOK, ALFRED H., B.A.—Ed. at Wesley Coll., Dublin; honorman and gold medallist, Trinity Coll., Dublin; M.A., 1906; F.R.G.S.; ast. mast., Wesley Coll., Dublin; junr. ast. mast., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, 1902; sen. ast., 1908; lecturer in biology, Hong Kong Coll. of Med., 1903-1912; 2nd mast., 1914 to 1915; ag. headmast., 1915; headmast., Yaumati govt. schl., 1917; 2nd mast., Queen's Coll., 1918; ast. mast., c.l., 1920.

CROOK, ROWLAND, O.B.E. (1919), I.C.E.—B. 1866; entered Crystal Pal. Engng. Sch., 1881; ast. to E. G. Griffith, C.E. (consulting sanitary engr.), 1883; ast. of drawing office, P. Engng. Sch., 1888; awarded 1st prize for civil engng., City of Lon. Coll., 1889; ast. engrg. water and drainage dept., Hong Kong, 1891-92; exec. engrg., P.W.D., with control of sewerage and water works, 1893-1900; in charge of roads and telephones, 1897; survr. to sanitary bd., 1892-1900; recd. thanks of govt. and S. of S. for services during plague, 1904; govt. engrg., Gibaltar, 1900; took over crown lands dept., 1903; ffr. for rates and expenses local revenue, 1907; comnr., 1919; ag. inspr. of schla., 1919; chief ast. and cable censor, 1914-19; local priority authority (Ministry of Munitions), 1917-19.

CROSBIE, HON. SIR JOHN C., K.B.E. (1919), M.H.A., Bay de Verde dist., Newfoundland, 908; M.E.C., 1909; mem. defence comtce., 1915; hrmn., tonnage comtce., 1917; min. of militia, 1917; min. of shipping, 1918.

CUBITT, GEORGE EATON STANNARD.—B. 1874; d. Ipswich Schl. and Royal Indian Engng. Coll., Cooper's Hill; ast. comnr., Indian forest serv., Burma, 4th Dec., 1896; dep. comnr., 29th Nov., 1902; ast. inspr.-gen., forests, Simla, 1st Aug., 1912; on deputation to S.S. and F.M.S. as comnr. of forests, 1st Apr., 1915; ret. from Ind. serv. and confirmed as comnr., forests, S.S. and F.M.S., 1st Apr., 1920; on tour to Canada representing India at Br. Empire Forestry Conf., June to Oct., 1923.

CULLEN, HON. SIR WM. PORTUS, K.C.M.G. (1912), KT. BACH. (1911), K.C., M.A., LL.D.—barrister-at-law; M.L.A., New South Wales, July, 1891; M.L.C., Aug., 1895; fellow of Senate of Sydney Univ. since 1896; vice-chancellor, 1908; resigned from legis. coun. and apptd. chief just. of N.S.W., Jan., 1910; lietut. gov., N.S.W., 30th Mar., 1910; chancellor of Sydney Univ., since Sept., 1914.

CULEGAN, HON. ARTHUR.—B. 1879; lumberman and farmer; elected to legis. assem., New Brunswick, 1912; min. without portfolio in Murray admin., 1917.

CULMER, J. J., M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.).—B. 1866; ast. surgeon, New Providence Island, 1896; res. surg.-supt., ditto, 1905; res. surg., gen., Bahamas, 1911; M.H.A., Bahamas, 1911-18; ag. med. offr. for various periods between 1911 and 1923; lieut., Bahamas Vol. Defence Force, 1917; mem., bd. of comnrs., Bahamas gen. hosp., 1918; mem., venereal diseases comnr., 1918; sp. certif. roentgenology, New York post grad. hosp., 1919; mem., discharged soldiers comnr., 1919; introduced X-rays in Bahamas, 1920; mem., bd. to examine med. and dental practitioners in the Bahamas, 1923; mem., B.M.A., 1924.

CULMER, J. S.—B. 1868; entd. Bahamas civ. serv., 1894; Out Island comnr. (3rd div.), 1909; (2nd div.), 1914.

CUNYNGHAME, SIR PERCY F., BART.—B. 1867; cadet, Sarawak civ. ser., July, 1886; asst. res. of Trusan, May, 1890; res. (2nd class), Mar., 1896; lieut. 3rd battn. Middlesex Rifles, May, 1897; capt., Oct., 1901; ag. res., Limbang, May, 1899; res., 2nd class, Upper Rejang, Aug., 1901; commdt., Sarawak Rangers, July, 1903; res., 1st div., and mem. of sup. coun., May, 1904; ret., 1908.

CURLEWIS, HERBERT RAINE, B.A., LL.B.—Judge of industrial arbit. ct., New S. Wales, 1917.

CURLEWIS, JOHN STEPHEN, B.A., LL.B. (Cape).—Cape civ. serv., 1883-1888; advocate, sup. ct., Cape Colony, 12th Oct., 1887; advocate, high ct. (late S.A.R.), May, 1888; counsel for Imperial gort. in arbit. with late S.A.R. re Asiatic question, 1898; ag. judge of high ct. (late S.A.R.), 15th Apr., 1899 to 31st Jan., 1900; pres. of crim. ct. for Witwatersrand, 2nd Nov., 1899 to 31st Jan., 1900; puisne judge, sup. ct., Transvaal, 1st Sept., 1903; puisne judge, sup. ct. of S. Africa (Transvaal Prov. Div.), 31st May, 1910; judge pres., July, 1924.

CURMI, TANCRED, M.V.O. (1907).—Ast. supt. of pol., Malta, 1890; sen. ast., 1902; supt., 1903; ret., Sept., 1915.

CURRY, H. D.—B. 1893; ed. Dulwich coll.; served in Fiji, 1911-15; ag. 2nd cls. clk., C.S.O., 1915; cadet, Solomon Islands, 1915; ag. dist. offr., Gizo, 1915; on mily. serv., 1917-19; 2nd lieut., 1919; priv. sec. to gov. of B. Honduras, 1919; resumed duty Solomon Is., 1920; ag. dist. offr., Shortlands, 1920; ag. sec., 1920.

CUSACK, CAPT. HENRY VERNON (Res. of Offrs.).—B. 1895; ed. Aravon Schl. and Royal Coll. of Sci., Ireland; served in European War, Flanders and N. Russia, 1915-19; ast. audr., Sierra Leone, July, 1920; ag. audr., Oct.-Nov., 1921; ast. audr., Nigeria, Oct., 1922.

CUSACK-SMITH, SIR THOMAS BERRY, K.C.M.G. (1898).—B. 1859; ed. at Eton; barrister, MiddleTem., 1884; law scholarship, 1883; formerly lieut. 1st V.B. Essex regt.; apptd. H.M. Consul at Samoa, Jan., 1890, and H.M. dep. comnr. for the W. Pacific at Samoa, May, 1890; proceeded in H.M.S. "Curaçao" to Union Group to report on land claims, Aug., 1892; dep. comnr. for the Samoan and Union Groups, and authorised to perform the duties of res. in the Union Group, Oct., 1892; special judicial comnr., Apr., 1893; apptd. to license and superintend employment of Gilbert Is. natives in Samoa, Jan., 1894; consul-gen., Valparaiso, 1897.

CUSCADEN, GEORGE PERCY.—B. 1883; ed. Conig Schl., Dublin; attd. to Roy. Irish Constab., Nov., 1902 to Aug., 1903; ag. ast. supt., pol., S. Sttlmts., Dec., 1903; ast. comnr., pol., F.M.S., May, 1904; ag. dist. supt. of prisons, N. Semilan, in addn. ob. pol. offr., May-June, 1907; ag. adjt., pol. depot, Apr.-Aug., 1908; comnr., pol., Johore, and pub. pros. in addn., Apr., 1912, to Apr., 1913; comnr. of pol., Johore, 1st July, 1915; offr. commdg., Johore Vol. Rifles, Sept., 1915, to Aug., 1916; dep. comnr., pol., F.M.S., 1st Jan., 1919; dep. comnr., pol., Selangor, July, 1920.

CUSSEN, SIR. LEO FINN BERNARD, KT. BACH. (1922).—B. 1859; judge of sup. ct., Victoria, since Mar., 1906.
Cussen, Richard Cecil.—B. 1887; B.A., Dublin; cadet, F.M.S., 1911; ag. dist. offr., Jelebu, 1912; ag. asst. collr., land rev., Seremban, 1913; ag. asst. dist. offr., Lipis, 1913; ag. asst. dist. offr., Kualas Kubu, 1914; ag. dist. offr., Batang Padang, 1915; ag. dist. offr., Kroh, 1916; ag. dist. offr., Raub, 1917 and 1920; ag. dist. offr., Dindings, 1918; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, 1919; mag., Seremban and asst. registr., sup. ct., 1920; ag. dep. commr., trade and cust., F.M.S., 1923; ag. dep. pub. pros., Perak, Nov., 1923.

Cutfield, A. J.—Cadet, Sarawak civ. serv., Dec., 1904; asst. res., Jan., 1907; 2nd cls. res., June, 1908; resig., Dec., 1908; ag. dist. commr., G. Coast, 3rd Aug., 1910; attd., col. sec.'s office, 1912-13; dist. commr., Ashanti, 27th Jan., 1915; ag. prov. commr., S. Prov., Ashanti, 22nd June to 22nd Aug., 1916; dist. commr., N. Territories, 9th March, 1917 to 18th Jan., 1920; senr. asst. col. sec., 20th Nov., 1920; clk. of couns., 6th Feb., 1921; ag. ch. asst. col. sec., 1st Feb. to 10th Mar., 1921; dep. prov. commr., N. Territories, 1921.

Cuthbert, Morton.—Ed. Edin. Instit. and Glasgow and West of Scot. Tech. Coll.; apprent. engrnr. to Messrs. Dick, Kerr and Co., Ltd., London, 1895; electr. with Glasgow corpn. elec. dept., 1899; asst. engrnr. Govan corpn. elec. dept., 1901; chief asst. engrnr., Oban corpn. elec. dept., 1904; electr. engrnr., B. Honduras, 1905; exec. and electr. engrnr., P.W.D., B. Honduras, 1909; lieut., B.H.T.F., 1917; ag. adjutant, B.H.T.F., Aug., 1917 to Jan., 1918; hon. A.D.C. to gov., B. Honduras, 1919.

Cutler, Thomas Robert.—B. 1870; entered civ. ser., Trinidad, 1st Jan., 1890; asst. collr. of customs, 16th Dec., 1909; collr. of cust., 1924.

Cutteridge, J. O., A.C.P., F.R.G.S.—B. 1887; ed. Borough Road Coll., Isleworth, London, 1906-08; teacher's cert. (with 4 distinctions) Bd. of Educn., Lond.; A.C.T.cert., Bd. of Educn., Lond.; staff-capt., H.M. Forces; inspr., Q.M.G. services; maths. and drawing master, Junr. Tech. Schl., Liverpool, 1919; prin., govt. training coll., Trinidad, Jan., 1921; mem., Inter-Col. Educn. Confce, 1921; mem. bd. indust. training; supt., tech. classes, 1922; ag. senr. inspr. schls., Feb., 1923; senr. inspr. schls., Trinidad, 1st July, 1923.

Cuizen, Allan Leckie.—Served in R.E., 1901-2; S. African War (medal and five clasps); Cape police, 1902-6; Bech. Prot. police, 1906-14; passed Cape civ. serv. lower law exam., 1914; 2nd clk. to asst. commr., N. Dist., Bech. Prot., 1914; ag. asst. res. mag., ditto, 1915; passed 2nd grade Secwana exam., 1916; ag. res. mag., 1917; ag. asst. res. mag., 1919; res. mag., 1921.

Dabner, Charles J.—B. 1876; on mil'y. serv., France and Flanders, Sept., 1914 to Mar., 1919; clk., Army pay office, R. Engnr.s., Mar. to Oct., 1919; clk., Army pay office, command paymr., Overseas Bases, Oct., 1919 to July, 1922; cler. offr., C.O., 10th July, 1922.

Dakers, Colin Hugh.—B. 1897; ed., Manchester Gram. Schl. (class. side) till 1915; temp. 2nd lieut., 15th (S.) Bn. The Royal Scots, 10th Aug., 1915; went to France to 15th R.S., 16th June, 1916; M.C., 19th July, 1917; sent to North Russia, Archangel Prov., with 2/10th Royal Scots, 16th Aug., 1918; attd., 2nd Battn., The Royal Scots till disembodied with the rank of Captain, 11th Oct., 1919; cadet, F.M.S., 20th Nov., 1920; left to study Chinese in Canton, July, 1921; passed final Chinese exam., Aug., 1923; ag. asst. prot. Chinese, Singapore, Sept., 1923; ag. asst. prot. Chinese, Perak, Oct., 1923.

Dallas, Francis Henry.—Ed. Univ. School; asst. sec. Penang municipality, 1892; sec., May, 1896; Sarawak civ. ser.; ag. Sarawak Gazette, manager, Sarawak printing office, 1897; ag. treas. and clk., coun., June, 1902; treas. and recorder of coun., 1903; mem. of comtees of administ.; Dalli, Hon. Antonio.—B. 1865; ed. Episcopal Seminary, Malta; on editorial of different newspapers for many years; dist. in coun. of govt. under old consti., 1898-1920; el. to rep. 3rd dist. in new Parl., Oct., 1921; min. of pub. wks., 1921.

Dallin, Thomas.—Late lieut. 3rd Essex Regt.; served in S. African War (and two clasps); hon. 2nd lieut. in the 6th Oct., 1910; joined col. audit dept., Feb., 1904; examr., exchequer and audit, 1st July, 1906; asst. auditor, S. Nigeria, Oct., 1906, to 15th Feb., 1910; reverted to audit dept., 16th Feb., 1910; asst. aud. Hong Kong, 30th July, 1910; ag. audir., July to 15th Sept., 1911, 22nd Aug. to 15th 1912, 1st June to 28th Oct., 1913, 5th July to 13th Sept., 1914; asst. cable censor, Apr., 1914; on mil. serv., 7th Mar., 1915 to 1st June, 1916; ag. audir., 18th Aug., 1916 to 8th Dec., J.P., 1918; attd. to finan. branch, W.O., 1919 to Mar., 1919; ag. audir. on various commissions, 1920, 1922 and 1924.

Dalton, The Rev. John Neill, K.C.V.O. (1911), C.M.G. (1882).—B. 1879; gov. to T.R.H. Princes Albert Victor and of Wales, and ag. chaplain to H.M.S. "Bacchus," chaplain in ord. to Her Majesty, 1886; Windsor, 1885.

Dalton, Llewelyn Chisholm.—Ed. Marlborough and Trin. Coll., Camb., 1900 (Hist. Tripes); M.A., 1906; called bar, Gray's Inn, 1901; legal asst., land ser., O.R.C., Oct., 1901; asst. res. mag., June, 1902 to Nov., 1910; advoc., sup. reg., B. Guiana, Nov., 1910; jun. to local forces, 1914; ag. puiana judge, Feb. to Feb., 1913; Nov., 1914 to Jan., 1916; to June, 1917; July to Sept., 1917; to June, 1919; ag. solr.-gen., May to Aug., Sept., 1914 to Jan., 1915; ag. atty.-gen., Sept., 1914; Feb.-Apr., 1918; ag. ch. July-Sept., 1917; June-Oct., 1919; puisne B. Guiana, June, 1919; puisne judge, Coast, Feb., 1923; compiled and "Statutory Rules and Orders (B. Guiana, 1914, 2 vols.; editor, B. Guiana Law Rep., vols.; an asst. editor "Burge on Colonial Foreign Laws," 2nd edit., vol. iv.; comp. Digest of Case Law of British Guiana, 1910; author of "Civil Law of British Guiana."

Daly, Maurice Dominic.—B. 1873; Downside Coll. and London Univ.; barrister, Middle Temple, 1920; cadet, F.M.S., Dec., 1898; passed in Malay and Siamese; cadet, May, 1901; ag. dist. offr., Kuala Lumpur, Oct., 1901; asst. dist. offr., Pekan, Mar., 1902; ag. dist. offr., Kuantan, Sept., 1903; offr., c.l., Jan., 1903; cls. V., Jan., 1906; ag. dist. offr., Ipoh, July, 1906; ag. mag., Seremban, 1907; ag. dist. offr., Raub, Sept., 1908; ag. at Kuala Lumpur, Feb., 1911; offr., clk. IV., 1911; asst. sec. to ch. sec., cont. to ag. at Kuala Lumpur, Feb., 1911; ag. ch. asst. dist. offr., Kinta, June, 1913; ch. asst. dist. offr., III., Kinta, Dec., 1913; dist. offr., Kinta, Apr., 1918; dep. pub. pros., Perak, July, 1918;
DAVEY, JOHN ALEXANDER.—Cape tel. serv., 27th Apr., 1892; sub. inspr., 1st Oct., 1894; 2nd cls. survr. clk. and asst. inspr., 1st Jan., 1899; 1st cls. ditto, 1st July, 1904; survr. and dist. engnr., Eastern distr., 1st Apr., 1912; Natal distr., 1st Mar., 1917; survr., 1st grade ditto, 25th Jan., 1918; survr., 1st grade Transvaal, 1st Apr., 1920; postmr., Johannesburg, 1st Apr., 1922; asst. sec., 1st Nov., 1923.

DAVID, PAUL AUGUST FELIX, B.A., Oxon.—Cadet, F.M.S., Dec., 1896; asst. dist. offr. and treas., Kuala Lumpur, Perak, Dec., 1900; 2nd asst. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Perak, Jan., 1903; dist. offr., Temerloh, Pahang, Mar., 1904; ditto, Christmas Is., May, 1907; ag. dep. regar., Penang, May, 1909; 2nd asst. prof. of Chinese, and ag. offl. assignee, Singapore, Feb., 1910; promoted to cls. III., May, 1911; ag. 2nd mag., Singapore, June, 1912; ag. asst. col. sec., and clk. of couns., July, 1912; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, Sept., 1913, ag. offl. assignee, Singapore, Oct., 1913; ag. sec., high comrn., F.M.S., and priv. sec., Apr., 1914; ag. auditor-gen., July, 1914; censor, Singapore, Mar., 1915; ag. sec., high comrn., F.M.S., Mar. to May, 1917; war services recog. by sec. of state, Apr., 1918; ag. 2nd mag., May, 1918; ag. dist. judge, May, 1918; offg. asst. col. sec. and clk. of couns., Mar., 1919; ag. dist. judge, June, 1919; ag. regist. of companies and offl. assignee, Nov., 1920; ag. dist. judge and 1st mag., Singapore, 13th Mar., 1922.

DAVIDSON, EDWARD ERNEST.—B. 1878; extra clk., C.S.O., Ceylon, 16th July, 1898; inspr. of post offices, Jan., 1900; office asst. to dir. of public instruction, Jan., 1906; ag. inspr. of schls., Apr., 1911, and May, 1912; apptd. to cls. V. of civ. serv., Jan., 1913; ag. asst. dir. of educn., Apr., 1920; addnl. asst. dir. of educn., Oct., 1920; office asst. to dir. educn., Nov., 1922.

DAVIDSON, GERALD LARCOM DEAN.—B. 1898; on mily. serv., Sept., 1917; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1921; attd. Colombo kachcheri, Dec., 1921; attd., Badulla kachcheri, Jan., 1922; office asst., Ratnapura kach., Oct., 1924.

DAVIDSON, J. C.—B. 1876; ed. Robert Gordon's Coll., Aberdeen; inspr., weights and measures, Aberdeen Corporation; town assizer, Johannesburg, Transvaal, 1903; aspt. of assize, dept. of mines and industries, Union of S. Africa, 1923.

DAVIDSON, NIGEL GEORGE.—B. 1873; ed. Charterhouse and New Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1896; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1899; Oxford circuit, 1899-1907; civ. judge and judge of the high ct., Sudan, 1907-17; advoc.-gen., Sudan, 1917; Order of the Nile, 3rd cls., 1919; judicial adviser, 'Iraq, 1921; ag. min. of just., Apr., 1922; legal sec. to high comrn., 'Iraq, Apr., 1922.

DAVIDSON, P.—Clk. treasy., Cape, Sept., 1888; asst. acctnt., Nov., 1903; ch. clk., income tax office, Aug., 1904; offr. i/c advances to co-operative societies, July, 1905; ch. assessor, income tax, Sept., 1908; dep. comrn., income tax, July, 1910; asst. dir. of census, May, 1911; prin. clk., irrigtn. dept., Jan., 1912; dep. comrn., income tax, Aug., 1914; inspr., inland rev. dept., Nov., 1916; recr. of rev., Durban, 1st Mar., 1921.

DAVIDSON-HOUSTON, Lieut.-Col. WILFRED B., C.M.G. (1911).—Ed. at Corrig schl., Ireland, and St. Edward's, Oxford; 2nd lieut. 5th Royal Dublin Fus., Jan., 1887; capt., 1892; major, 1902; neut.-col., 1906; B.S.A. Co. pol., and asst. comrn., Rhodesia, 1890-92; certificates, R.I.C. and Dublin met. pol., 1895; asst. inspr.,
G. Coast Constaby. (Hausas), Jan., 1894; inspr., Jan., 1898; capt., W.A.F.F., Jan., 1898; on spec. serv. Kwahu and Ashanti-Akim, Feb., 1894, to Mar., 1895; Ashanti exped., 1895-6; commanded advanced guard, main column (hon. ment. in desp., star); spec. miss. to N.W. Ashanti, Feb. to May, 1896; with Hausa detach. in London, Jubilee, 1897 (medal); operations in N.T. G. Coast, 1897-8 (medal and clasp); ag. res., Ashanti, May, 1899, to Apr., 1900; Ashanti campaign, 1900 (medal and clasp); S. African War, 1901-2, staff offr., Warrenton (medal and 5 clasps); European war, 1914-18; Br. War and Victory medals; adjutant 5th Roy. Dub. Fus., 1902; comsrr. of Ashanti, 1902; ag. ch. comsrr. of Ashanti, Mar. to May, 1903; and from July, 1904, to Mar., 1906; comsrr. of Montserrat, 25th Apr., 1906; assumed govt., 4th May, 1906; mem. gen. leg. and federal exec. couns., Leeward Is., 1906; Leeward Is. deleg. to Impl. educn. confoc., 1911; staff offr., colonial coronation contingent, 1911 (medal); deleg. to Canada-West Indies reciprocity confce. at Ottawa, 1912; D.A.Q.M.G., Central Force, 1915; Eastern command, 1916; headqrs., 1st Army, B.E.F., 1917; deputy controller of labour, France, 1918; admstr. and col. sec., St. Lucia, 27th Nov., 1918; assumed govt., 21st Dec., 1918; ag. gov., Windward Is., March, 1923 and from 2nd Nov., 1923 to May, 1924.

DAVIES, D. E.—B. 1889; ed. at Llandovery and Worcester Coll., Oxon.; astt. dist. comsrr., Gold Coast Ap., 1915; junr. astt. col. sec., May-July, 1915; ag. dist. comsrr., Addah, July, 1915 to May, 1916; ag. dist. comsrr., Accra, Sep., 1916 to Sep., 1917.

DAVIES, EDWARD HAROLD.—B. 1895; on mily. serv., Aug., 1914; cadet, Ceylon, Oct., 1920; attd. to Puttalam Kachcheri, Nov., 1920; ag. pol. mag. Matara, Jan., 1922; ditto Panadura, May, 1922; office astt. to govt. agt., Prov. of Uva, Oct., 1922; ag. pol. mag., Negombo, Feb., 1924; astt. dir., statistics, Mar., 1924; dep. fiscal, Colombo in addn., May, 1924.

DAVIES, RICHARD MORGAN.—B. 1892; on mily. serv., Dec., 1914; cadet, Ceylon, Sept., 1920; attd. to Puttalam Kachcheri, Oct., 1920; ditto, Colombo Kach., June, 1921; Colombo Port Coman., Oct., 1921; ag. office astt. to astt. govt. agt., Kegalla, Jan., 1922; pol. mag., Matale, Feb., 1923; dep. rubber contr., May, 1924.

DAVIES, THEOPHILUS ALFRED.—Temp. elk., Sierra Leone, Jan., 1885; ag. astt. examng. offr. of cust., Lavana, 1889; tide waiter, June, 1892; ag. astt. examng. offr. of cust., and postmr., Mano Salija, Mar. to Nov., 1893; prev. offr., Bassia, 1895; ditto, Kukuna, 1896; on special mission to open cust. station at Saioniya, Nov., 1896; prev. offr., Saioniya, 1896 to 1902; insp. of health, Saioniya, Tambakka dist., 1900; offr. in charge of cust. and postmr., Kambia, 1902, and 1903; sub-collr. of cust., sub.-acctnt., postmr. and money order elk., Mano Salija, July, 1903, to 1905; sen. warehouseman, Oct., 1905.

DAVIES, TUDOR THOMAS.—B. 1887; astt. govt. printer, Nyasaland Prot., 1916; ag. govt. printer and compt. stationery, May to July, 1917, July, 1919 to Mar., 1920 and Apr. to Dec., 1923; govt. printer, 15th Dec., 1923.

DAVIES, WILLIAM ALFORD NOEL.—B. 1883; ed. Monmouth Gram. Schl.; admitted solr. of sup. ct., England, Apr., 1906; private practice in England, 1906-1907; private practice in E. Africa, 1907-1908; astt. dist. comsrr., Sierra Leone, Dec., 1908; passed lower standard Mendi exam., June, 1911; ag. dist. comsrr., Dec., 1911, to June, 1912; ag. pol. mag., June to Dec., 1912; acted as crown prosecutor on several occasions; ag. dist. comsrr., 1913-14; master and regier., sup. ct., S. Leone, July, 1914; curator of intestate estates, Oct., 1914; regier., prize court, 1914; 2nd lieut., general list, Mar., 1916; mentioned in desps., 1916; attached S. Leone Batt., W.A.F.F., May, 1916; served in S. Leone, 1916-17; transf. to G. Coast Regt., 1917; served in Port. E. Africa, 1918; staff capt. with Col. Rose's column, Apr. to June, 1918; staff quartermr., 2nd W. African Service Brig., Oct., 1918; demob., Dec., 1918; resumed duties as regier., sup. ct., Sierra Leone, May, 1919; regier., sup. ct., S. Stlmtts., 12th Oct., 1920.

DAVIS, CHARLES GREY HOWICK.—B. 1871; Ent. col. ser. of Br. Guiana as astt. clk. audt. office, Nov., 1887; 5th cl. clk., Apr., 1889; 4th Sept., 1889; 3rd Jan., 1894; sec. to comtes. of combined court on col. expenditure, 1893-4; 2nd cl. clk., Nov., 1896; ag. 1st cl. clk., 1895-6-7-8; ag. acct. to sup. ct., July, 1899 to Sept., 1900; 1st clk. and acctnt. post office, Sept., 1900; ag. chmn., poor law comsrr., 9th to 20th Dec., 1906, 16th Mar., to 11th Dec., 1907, and from 10th July to 30th Sept., 1909; clk., audit off., 4th Apr., 1910; ag. chmn., poor law comsrrs., 30th Apr. to 25th Aug., 1910; ag. auditor-gen., and chmn., tender bd. for various periods, 1910-20; comsrr. of currency, 26th Oct., 1917 to 30th Mar., 1920; chmn., excess profits bd., 27th Mar. to 31st Dec., 1919; chmn., poor law comsrr., 27th Mar., 1919; dep. col. treas., 1st Jan., 1920; chmn., bd. of examms. for pub. auditors under companies' ordinance, 16th Apr., 1918 to 21st Mar., 1920; chmn., soldiers' pension bd., 6th May, 1920; audr. gen. and chmn., Jamaica tenders bd., 7th Oct., 1920; mem. standing selection comtes., Dec., 1920; mem. militia pensions and gratuities comtes., Dec., 1920; nominated mem., leg. com., 25th Jan., 1921; mem., bd. of supervision, 3rd Aug., 1921; chmn. of select comte. on travelling allowances of govt. offrs., 1922.

DAVIS, SIR CHARLES THOMAS, K.C.M.G. (1923), C.M.G. (1915).—B. 1873; ed. Christ's Coll., Brecon, and Oxford; classical scholar; Balliol Coll., 1892-6; 1st cls. classical mods., 1894; Jenkyns exhibnr., 1896; 1st cls. it. hum., 1896; apptd., after compet. exam., 1st cl. clk., acct.-gen.'s dept., admiralty, Oct. 5th, 1896; transf. to sec.'s dept., inland rev., Mar., 1897; 2nd cl. clk., col. office, Apr. 15th, 1897; went to Gibraltar as sec. to H.R. Hon. Sir C. R. Thompson on a mission to inquire into the currency question, May and June, 1898; sec. Pacif. cable comtes., 1900; priv. sec., to S. M. Ommannen, June, 1902; 1st cls. clk., 1st Apr., 1905; principal clk., 4th June, 1916; sec. asst. sec. to Imperial Conference; astt. sec., 1st Apr., 1920; astt. under-sec. of state, 1st Dec., 1921.

DAVIS, NORMAN STEPHEN.—Second div. clk., B. of T. and A.G.D., G.P.O., London; tranf. as acctnt., G.P.O., Sierra Leone, Sept., 1913; attd. as lieut., W. Africa Regt., 1917; astt. P.M.G. and acctnt., 1915; ag. P.M.G. on four occasions, 1915-1923.

DAVIS, STUART SPENCER, C.M.G. (1919).—B. 1875; rev. offr., St. Kitts, 1893; 1st clk., treasy. and cust., 1898; lieut., St. Kitts-Nevis def. force, 1898; ag. adjutant, 1899; attached to col. audit branch, E. and A. dept., July, 1901; acctnt., treasy., G. Coast, 1901; astt. treas., 1902; ag. treas., Oct., 1907; ch. astt.
rears., Nov., 1908; ag. postm.-gen., Feb. to Mar., 1909; ag. treas. and mem. exec. and legis. coun., mem. bd. of educ., Mar. to Dec., 1909; g. P.M.G., Feb., 1910; ag. treas., Nov., 1910 to June, 1911; ag. P.M.G., Aug. and Sept., 1911; g. treas., June to Dec., 1912, and on subsequent occasions; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1915; rear., civil admin., German East Africa occupied territory, Nov., 1916; treas., Tanzania Territory, 1919; ag. sec. to admin., June-Aug., 1919; dep. admstr., Mar.-Apr., 1920; treas., Palestine, May, 1922; chmn., economy comte., 1922; ag. ch. sec., June to Sept., 1923; chmn., currency comte., 1924; del. or Palestine at Constantinople in connec. with Ottoman pub. debt, Oct.-Nov., 1924.

DAVISON, H. B.—Asst. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., 1919.

DAVSON, SIR CHARLES SIMON, KT. BACH. (1917), B.A., LL.D., K.C.—Ed. at Westminster and Trin. Hall, Camb.; called to the bar, Middle Temp., Jan., 1881; admitted to bar of Br. Guiana, 1882; acted as solr.-gen. on many occasions; tig. mag., 1888; solr.-gen., 1898; ag. atty.-gen., Nov., 1898, to Oct., 1899; again, Oct., 1900, to Apr., 1901, and on several other occasions; puisne judge, Mauritius, 1906; ch. just., Fiji, and h. judicial commr., W. Pacific, 1914.

DAVY, ERNEST WILLIAM.—B. 1881; ed. privately; asst. forester, B.C.A. Prot., 1906; ag. head forestry and bot. dept., Feb.-Sept., 1907; engr. agriculturist, Nyassaland, Apr., 1909; ag. h. forestry offr., May-Nov., 1910, May-Dec., 1913 and May, 1916 to Feb., 1917; asst. dir. of gr., Nyassaland, Nov., 1920; ag. dir., July, 1924 to Mar., 1925.

DAWE, A. J.—B. 1891; ed. Berkhamsted Schl. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; scholar, 1910-1914; hon. mod. hist., 1914 (agotat); B.A.; ar. service, 1914-18; staff, 1917; lieut., t.N.V.R. (R.N.D.); temp. apptd. in C.O., Jan., 1918; apptd., under reconstruction scheme, 2nd cls. clk., C.O., June, 1919; asst. prin., 1st Apr., 1920; priv. sec. to Mr. Amery, 18th June, 1920; riv. sec. to Mr. E. F. L. Wood, 1921; prin., Jan. Dec., 1921; dep. sec. to Imp. Economic Confce., 1923.

DAWE, HON. ELI.—B. 1843; M.H.A. for Harbour Grace, Newfoundland, 1889-1905; rlyw. omanr., 1890; financial sec., 1893; chmn., f wks., 1895; min. of agric. and mines, 1900; mem. of cabinet, 1903; min. of marine and fisheries, 1904.

DAWSON, J. V.—Asst. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Oct., 1919.

DAWSON, RALPH HERBERT, M.Inst.T.—B. 1876; ed. at Berkhamsted Schl.; dist. goods dept., Ceylon rly., 23rd Sept., 1912; seconded for war serv., German E. Africa, 1916-19; dep. traffic man., 1919; traffic man., July, 1923; dep. en. man., Gold Coast rly., 5th Aug., 1924.

DAWSON, WILLIAM BELL, M.A., D.Sc.—B. 1854; ed., McGill Univ., Montreal; grad., ingénieur des ponts et Chaussées, Paris, 1875, with sp. dipl. of merit; mem. of the Engng. Inst. of Can., and Inst. of Civ. Engrs., London (Watt old medal); fellow of the Royal Soc., Can.; tureate of the Acad. of Sciences, Paris (Gay rizeman); on various surveys and engng. work, 1878-81; with the Dom. Bridge Co., 1882-4; with the C.P.R. on engng. work, 1884-92; 1893 to 1896, organizing and suptdg. the tidal and current survey on the east and Pacific coasts of Canada and in Hudson Bay; ch. of tidal and current surveys, dept. of marine and fisheries, Can., 1923; has prepared and published many repts. for the dept. on tides, tide-levels and currents in Canadian inland and maritime waters, besides annual tide-tables for E. Canada, Hudson Bay and Pacific coast.

DAY, ALBERT HARRY.—Clk. B. of T. London, 1886-87; rlyw. dept., Cape Town, 1889; passed Cape civ. serv. exam., 1891; law exam., 1894; olk. and shorthand-writer, acctnt. gen.'s off., Cape Town, 1892; treasy., 1895; special duty, Kimberley, 1897; ag. priv. sec. to premier, Cape Colony, 1897; sec. harbour bd. confce., 1900; hon. sec. Lloyd's patriotic fund, Cape, 1900; prin. clk., treasy., and J.P., Cape, 1903; priv. sec., treasy., 1904; ch. clk., treasy., 1905; sec., ocean mail confce., 1907; recvr. of rev., Cape Town, 1910; civ. commr., Cape, and regar. of friendly societies, 1912; recvr. of rev., Cape, 1916.

DAY, ALBERT CECIL., C.B.E. (1919).—Asst. priv. sec. to gov. of New Zealand, 1910-1912; offl. sec. to gov.-gen. of New Zealand since 1913.

DEACON, A.—Apptd. after exam. 3rd cl. mess., C.O., 1907; 2nd cls. mess., 30th Jan., 1911.

DEAN, H. E.—Asst., fencing dept., E.A.P., May, 1908; acctnt., pub. wks. dept., Mar., 1916.

DEANE, GEORGE CAMPBELL.—B. 1873; ed. at St. John's Coll., Oxford; M.A., Oxon (honours in jurisprudence); called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1898; practised at the bar, Br. Guiana, 1898-1903; ditto, Trinidad, 1903-1910; stip. mag., Arima, Trinidad, 10th Sept., 1910; ag. S.J.P., Port of Spain, Trinidad, 30th May to 5th Dec., 1911, and from 28th May to 22nd Oct., 1912; stip. mag., Port of Spain, 1913; ag. puisne judge, June-Oct., 1914, 4th to 14th June, 1915, 26th June to 30th Sept., 1915, 26th May to 10th Nov., 1916, and from 4th to 8th Oct., 1917; twice apptd. commr. under ordce., 119; capt. and adjutant, Trinidad Light Horse; 2nd puisne judge, 6th Apr., 1920; ch. just., Leeward Is., 3rd Jan., 1923; puisne judge, S. Stilments., 1924.

DE BOISSIERE, ARNAULD.—B. 1872; entd. customs dept., Trinidad, 1891; trooper, Light Horse, 1897; sub-lieut., 1901; lieut., 1903; ag. chief of fire brigade, Mar., 1903; J.P. for Colony, and inspr. of Indian immigrts., 1904; capt., Trinidad Light Horse, Aug., 1914; protector of Indian immigrts.; formed a new corps, Trinidad M. I.; apptd. major in command and mentioned for services rendered; attended confce. on Indian Immigrtn., London, 10th May, 1917; major cmdg. 8th Batt., B.W.I. Regt., in Belgium, Aug., 1917; evacuated gassed, Oct., 1917, returned to regt. in Italy, 1918; lieut.-col., 21st Aug., 1917; ment. in desps.

DE BOLTZ, W. H.—Apptd. to organise govt. press, Uganda Prot., 22nd March, 1900; govt. printer, Nov., 1903; comptroller of stationery and man. of "Official Gazette," 1908; sec., Uganda volunteer reserve, 1908-1911; govt. printer, Nigeria, 17th June, 1914.

DE BRUYN, DIRK CORNELIUS.—B. 1886; ed. at Venterstad, Paarl and Stellenbosch; B.A.; vice-principal, pub. schl., Boshof, Jan., 1908; principal, ditto, 20th July, 1909; inspr. of schls., O.F.S., 1st July, 1912.

DE CHAIR, VICEM-ADMIRAL SIR DUDLEY RAWSON STRATFORD, K.C.B. (1916), M.V.O. (1908).—B. 1864; mid. of the "Alexandra," at bombardment of Alexandria, 1882; landed with naval brig., naval attache. to courts of the Maritime Powers, 1902; and to N. and S. America, 1903-4; A.D.C. to the King, 1911-12; naval sec. to 1st lord of the adm'y., 1912-14; admi.
of training service, 1914; comdg. tenth cruiser squadron, 1914-16; naval adviser to F.O., 1916; vice-adm. comdg. battle squadron, 1917-18; vice-adm., 1917; adm. comdg. coast guard and reserve, 1919; gov., New S. Wales, 20th Oct., 1923.

DECK, S. F.—Aast. dist. comsnr. E.A.P., 23rd Aug., 1907; dist. comsnr., May, 1913; offr. in charge, Northern Frontier Dist., 1914-15; prin. inspr. of labour, Dec., 1920.

DE COLOGAN, ARTHUR THOMAS BERNARDO.—Aast. dist. comsnr., Somaliland Prot., July, 1914.

DEERR, GEORGE HENRY, M.A. Cantab.—B. 1868; ed. Coventry and Selwyn Coll., Cambridge; 3rd cls. class. tripes, 1890; inspr., schls., Jamaica, 1902; mem., bd. of educn., 1917; aast. dir., educn., 1919; ag. dir., educn., 1920 and 1923.

DE FREITAS, ANTHONY, O.B.E. (1918), B.A. (Clare Coll., Camb.).—B. 1869; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn; ag. chief just., St. Vincent, May-Oct., 1904; stip. mag., 1st Dist., St. Lucia, Oct., 1904; ag. atty.-gen., St. Lucia, July, 1906; atty.-gen., St. Lucia, Apr., 1907; chief just., St. Vincent, May, 1915; chief just., St. Lucia, Sept., 1919; ag. adminstr., St. Vincent, 1909, 1915, and Mar., 1917, to Dec., 1918; ag. col. sec., St. Lucia, on seven occasions; ag. adminstr., St. Lucia, on 15 occasions, including July, 1914, to May, 1915; puisne judge, Jamaica, Aug., 1921; ag. ch. just., Jamaica, July, 1922 to Sept., 1923.

DE FREITAS, JULIAN MIGNON, O.B.E.—B. 1889; ed. St. Augustine Coll., Ramagate, Haileybury Coll., and Clare Coll., Cambridge; B.A., LL.B., 1912; called to the bar, 1921; aast. mag., St. George West, Trinidad, 1924.

DE GAYE, JULES AUGUSTIN, F.L.S., F.E.S.—B. 1872; ed. at Royal coll., Mauritius; ag. aast. 2nd cls. mast., Royal coll., Mauritius, 1st Sept., 1891; aast. 2nd cls. mast., 4th Jan., 1893; 2nd cls. mast., 26th July, 1894; 2nd mast., Victoria schl., Seychelles, 25th Apr., 1902; ag. headmast. and ag. inspr. of schls., 7th Apr., to 12th Aug., 1908; ag. headmast., Victoria schl., 2nd June to 12th Aug., 1908; mem. of Fisheries enquiry comte., Nov., 1908; mem. of comte. for re-orgnizt. of educn., Seychelles, Aug., 1909; science and math. mast., King's schl., Lagos, S. Nigeria, 8th Feb., 1910; ag. principal, King's Coll., 22nd Dec., 1910, to 13th Apr., 1911, and from Mar. to Aug., 1913, 6th Aug. to 12th Nov., 1914, 18th Dec., 1915, to 2nd June, 1916, and from 2nd June, 1917, to 17th Nov., 1918; aast. censor, Lagos, Sept., 1914, to July, 1915, and from Dec., 1915, to Dec., 1916; inspr. of schls., Southern Provs., Nigeria, 24th June, 1918; ag. dep. dir., educn., June-Dec., 1921, and from Mar.-July, 1922; author of a Geography of the Seychelles Is., a Geographical Reader of Mauritius, and a text-book on the Science of Common Things and Nature Study.

DE GLANVILLE, BERTRAM GEORGE.—B. 1889; ed. Merchant Taylors' sch., Crosby, and Worcester coll., Oxford; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1908; aast. coll. of cust. and pol. mag., Trincomalie, Dec., 1909; pol. mag., Matale, June, 1911; ag. additional comsnr. of requests and addtl. pol. mag., Kurunegala, Aug., 1911; office ass't. to gvt. agt., W. Prov., Oct., 1911; pol. mag., Panadura, Nov., 1911; aast. settmnt. offr., Feb., 1912; pol. mag., Kurunegala, Mar., 1912; seconded for serv. under the excise comsnr., June, 1912; ag. comsnr. of excise, N. Divn., Jan., 1913; addtl. dist. judge and pol. mag., Ratnapura, June, 1915; ditto, Kegalla, June, 1915; dist. judge, Nuwara Eliya, May, 1916; aast. gvt. agt., Mannar, July, 1917; ag. chmn., mun. com., Colombo, Nov., 1920; aast. gvt. agt., Kalutara, Sept., 1921; dep. colir., cust., Aug., 1922; prin. collr., cust., Oct.-Nov., 1922.

DE GLANVILLE, R. J. A. P. G.—B. 1886; called to the bar, Bahamas, 1914; notary ps., 1914; priv. sec. to H.E. Wm. Hart Beazley, C.M.G., adminstr. of Bahamas, 1909; called to H.E. Sir W. DE HART, JOHN.—B. 1889; ed. St. Paul's Schol. and Wadham Coll., Oxford (exhib. 2nd cls. hon. mods. (classics); 3rd cls. lit. hons. DE HAVILLAND, THOMAS LITTLE, C.M.G., D.S.O.—B. 1874; ed. Elizabeth Col., Guernsey and R. Naval Schl., London; Bechuanaland campaign, 1897; Anglo-Boer war, 1900; France and Belgium, 1916-19; ser. as at-arms, H. of A., Union of S. Africa.

DE JAGER, SAMUEL JACOBUS, K.C., B.L., LL.B., Camb.—B. 1879; called to the bar, M.T., Tem., 1903; admitted advocate, O.R.C., 1907; atty.-gen., O.F.S., 1911.

DE LA HARPE, PETER HENRY.—B. 1877; apptd. to cls. V., Ceylon civ. serv., June, 1922; extra offr., Gallo Kach., June, 1923.

DE LA MOTHE, GODFREY ARNAUD.—B. 1889; ed. Rossall Schol.; served in France, Sierr Leone, Egypt, Palestine and Arabia; aast. dist. comsnr., Gold Coast, 23rd May, 1921.

DELMEGE, J. DE G.—Ed. Haileybury Coll. and Worcester Coll., Oxford; aast. colir., Uganda Prot., Dec., 1908.

DE MARTIN, G. P.—B.A., Trinity Coll., Dublin; jun. aast. master, Queen's Coll., Bangor, 1904; senr. aast. master, 1910; ag. inspr. of English schls., 1913; aast. postal censor, 1914; aast. master, cls. I., 1920; head mzn., Yaumati Schol., 1920; inspr. of English schls., 1924.

DENCH, L. J. E.—Served Br. post off., 1896; transfd. to post and telegraph dept., Es Africa and Uganda Prot., 1907; postmr., 1897; aast. postmr. gen., 1921; island postmr., Cyprus, 1922.

DENHAM, EDWARD BRANDIS, C.M.G. (1872)—B. 1876; ed. at Malvern and Merton Coll., Oxford (exhibtn.); B.A., 1899; cadet, Ceylon Nov., 1899; aast. gvt. agt., Mannar, Feb., 1902; ag. 2nd ast. col. sec., May, 1904, Mar., 1906; aast. gvt. agt. DENMAN, LORD.—3rd Baron (cr. 1834), Rt. Hon. Sir Thomas Denman, P.C. (1907); G.C.M.G. (1911); K.C.V.O. DENNISTOUN, ROBERT MAXWELL, C.B.E. (1918). B.A.—B. 1864; served in European War, 1914-18; capt., Fort Garry Horse; major, 46th batt.; lieut.-col., 63rd batt.; col. on H.Q. staff; dep. judge advocate-gen., Overseas Forces of Canada, 1917-19; ment. in despatches, 1918; colonial officers' long serv. med.; K.C., Ont., 1908; Man., 1910; bencher, Law Soc., Upper Can., 1906-07; bencher, Law Soc., Man., 1912-18; judge, ct. of appeal, Man., 1918; publications—"Notes on Mily. Law," "Notes on Dist. Courts Martials."

Denny, William Joseph, M.C.—M.H.A., S. Australia, since 1900; atty.-gen. and min. for Northern Territory, 1910-12; capt., A.I.F., European War, 1915-19; atty.-gen. and min. for housing, Apr., 1924.

DENOON, GEORGE.—M.A., Aberdeen (Hons. Nat. Sci.); M.A., Cape Univ.; LL.B. DENT, FRANKLAND, M. Sc., Ph.D., F.I.C.—Asts. govt. analyst, Singapore, Aug., 1905; govt. analyst and science lecturer, S. Stltmsts., Mar., 1906; ag. munio. analyst in addition, June, 1912 to 30th Nov., 1912; lecturer in chem. and physics, S. Stltmsts., 1st Jan., 1922.

Denton, Sir George Charadin, K.C.M.G. (1900), C.M.G. (1891).—B. 1851; ensign, 57th regt., Oct., 1869; lieut., May, 1871; adjt., Aug., 1876; capt., Jan., 1878; chief of pol., St. Vincent, Apr., 1880; apptd. one of the commsrs. to inquire into the pol. force, Barbados, Oct., 1880; mem. of exec. coun., Oct., 1881; represented St. Vincent at the telegraphic confce. at Barbados, May, 1882; admstd. govt. St. Vincent, May to July, 1886; again in 1886, and from Nov., 1887, to Mar., 1888; ag. col. sec., 1886 to 1888; col. sec., Lagos, Mar., 1888; admstd. govt. on many occasions, 1889-1900; apptd. lieut.-governor, 1900; admnr. of Gambia, Nov., 1900; gov., Mar., 1901; retired, 1911.

DE PASS, HAROLD S.—B. 1881; sub.-inspr. of constab., Trinidad, 1st July, 1904; inspr., 10th Apr., 1912; has acted as senr. inspr. and detective inspr. on many occasions; ag. deputy inspr. gen. of constab. and supt. of fire brigade, 1918.

DE PINTO, CYRIL ERNEST.—B. 1892; cadet, local division, Ceylon civ. ser., Sept., 1914; ag. office asst., Matara Kachcheri, July, 1915; ditto, Kalutara Kachcheri, Nov., 1915; ag. pol. mag., Negombo, Apr., 1916; attached to Kandy Kachcheri, May, 1916; office asst., Batticaloa Kach., Nov., 1917; pol. mag., Avissawella, Nov., 1919; office asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, July, 1921; pol. mag., Jaffna, Oct., 1921; ag. dist. judge, Badulla, Aug., 1923.

DE ROME, F. J.—B.Sc. (Lond.), Borough Road Coll., Isleworth, Lond., 1906-1908; teacher's certif. (with distinction) Bd. of Educn., Lond.; graduated B.Sc. Lond. Univ., 1908; Jena Univ. DERRICK, J.—B. 1888; ed. H.M. sch. ship "Conway"; lieut., R.N.R., 1914; lieut. commr., R.N.R., 1919; port offr., Seychelles, 1921; asst. port offr., Zanzibar, July, 1924; ag. port offr., July, 1924.

DE SAPAYO, SIR THOMAS EDWARD, KT. BACH. (1924), K.C., LL.B. (Cantab.)—B. 1855; puisne justice, Ceylon, June, 1915; ag. ch. just., Mar. to July, 1923; ret., 1924.

DESBARATS, GEORGE JOSEPH, C.M.G. (1915), B. App. Sc., M. Can. Soc. C.E., P.L.S.—B. 1861; ed. Pub. Schls. DESY, HON. LOUIS JOSEPH ALFRED.—B. 1878; ed. parish schl., Laval Univ. (B.A.); admitted to the bar, 1898; batonnier-general of Quebec bar, June, 1915; K.C., July, 1915; judge of the superior court of Quebec, Feb., 1916.

DE VERTEUIL, JOSEPH, F.C.S.—B. 1874; agrl. chem., dept. of agr., Trinidad, 14th Dec., 1899; supt. of field experiments, 1st Apr., 1913.

DEWHURST, JAMES.—B.Sc. (Manchester); asst. mast., Coptic Coll., Cairo, 1907-14; asst. mast., training institn., Accra, G. Coast, 11th Aug., 1915.

DHONDY, SAVAKSHA DHUNJISHA.—B. 1889; B.A., Oxon.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., 19th Dec., 1913; office asst. to gov't. agt., Ratnapura, Jan., 1914; ag. office asst. to gov't. agt., E. DICKINSON, JOHN ROBERT, M.C.—Ed. Liverpool Coll.; solnr., 1920; 2nd lieut., The King's Own (R. Lancaster Regt.), 1914; lieut., July, 1915; capt., Aug., 1916; France, 1915-18 (M.C. and Bar); asst. dist. comsnr., Gold Coast, Jan., 1921.
