Stiltns., class V., 7th Feb., 1914; class IV., 7th Feb., 1915; ag. grade III., 1st Aug., 1917; ag. senr. surg., Penang, Sept., 1917; med. offr., dist. hosp., Penang, Aug., 1919; med. offr., gen. hosp., Penang, Nov., 1919; ag. radiologist, Singapore gen. hosp. in addn., 10th Sept., 1921.

DODDS, JAMES HUGH HAMILTON.—B. 1880; ed. at private schl. and Eastbourne Coll.; enlisted in I.Y. for serv. in S. Africa, Jan., 1901; reed. comanr. as lieut. in I.Y. 12th Oct., 1901; resigned comanr. and granted hon. rank of lieut. in the Army, 6th Feb., 1902 (Queen's medal, five clasps); lieut., S.A.C., 6th Feb., 1902; resident J.P., Transvaal, 7th Mar., 1905; sub.-inspr., S.A.C., 1st July, 1906; retrenched from S.A.C., 31st July, 1907; lieut., Bedfordshire I.Y., 1st Nov., 1907; asst. dist. offr., Somaliland Prot., Sept., 1908; dist. offr., Somaliland Prot., Apr., 1910; represented H.M.'s comanr. of Somaliland on a mission to Abyssinia, July-Aug., 1910; seconded for service in Abyssinia, to be vice-consul, Harrar.

DOHERTY, A. G.—Veterinary offr., E.A.P., Sept., 1906; dep. ch. veterinary offr., Kenya, Apr., 1921.

DOHERTY, Rt. Hon. CHARLES JOSEPH, P.C. (1920), D.C.L., LL.D.—B. 1855; ed. Christian Brothers School St. Mary (Jesuit) Coll., McGill Univ., all at Montreal; advocate; K.C., 1887; judge of the superior ct., Quebece, 1891 to 1906; elected to H. of C., Canada, 1908; re-elec., 1911 and 1917; representing St. Ann's division, Montreal City; member of the Privy Coun. for Canada and min. of just. in Mr. Borden's cabinet, Oct., 1911, and in National govt., Oct., 1917 to Sept., 1921; signed the Peace Treaty with Germany as rep. of Canada with the Hon. A. L. Sifton, min. of pub. works; del. to League of Nations Assem., 1920 and 1921.

DOHERTY, JAMES.—B. 1889; Imp. cust., 1907; storekeeper and baggage examir., cust., E. Africa Prot., 1912; preventive offr., cust., E.A.P., 1914; inspr., cust. preventive serv., E.A.P., 1918; asst. govt. coast agt., Kenya and Uganda, 1919; ag. coast agt., Kenya and Uganda,
Aug. to Dec., 1920 and Sept. to Dec., 1922; govt. coast agt., Kenya and Uganda, 1923; E. African Vol. Arty., 1914-18; "1914-15" Star, War and Victory Medals.

DOHERTY, HON. MANNING W.—B. Ontario, 1873; ed. at Upper Canada Coll. and Ontario Agric. Coll.; post graduate course Cornell Univ., New York State; on staff of Ontario Agric. Coll. for a number of years; for some years has operated farm on which he was born; breeder of Clydesdale horses and Holstein cattle; dir. of the United Farmers of Ontario; min. of agric. in U.F.O. govt., Nov., 1919; re-e.l., 1923; resigned portfolio on defeat of U.F.O. admnstr., 1923; leader, U.F.O., 1923-24.

DOHERTY, THOMAS KEVILLE, B.A., B.C.L., LL.B.—B. 1858; ed. Prof. Acad., Sherbrooke, Montreal Coll., and Univ. of Bishop's Coll., Lennoxville; priv. sec., Dom. min. of agric., 1896-1099; comsnr. for Can., Internat. Inst. of Agric., dept. of agric., Can., 1910; founder and editor of the "Bulletin of Foreign Agric. Intelligence," 1910-16; editor, foreign section "Agricultural Gaz." 1916; del. to Internat. Agric. Cong., Madrid, 1911, and Internat. Inst. of Agric., Rome, 1911, 1913 and 1920; has published several analyses of world's food situation.

DOORLY, A.N.—Asst. dist. comsnr., E. Africa Prot., Mar., 1912; mag., 1919; senr. mag., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1923.

DOORLY, REV. CHARLES STOKELEY, B.A., Selwyn Coll. Camb.—B. 1882; 4th asst. mast., Queen's Royal Coll., Trinidad, 1st July, 1911; 3rd asst. mast., July, 1914; 2nd asst. mast., July, 1920.

DOORLY, CHARLES W.—B. 1875; 3rd ols. elk., imigr. dept., Jamaica, 1892; 2nd ols. elk., 1894; Hindustani interpreter, 1897; inspr. of imigrts., 1903; protector of imigrts., 1909; govt. emigr., agt., Madras, 1913; asst. col. sec., Jamaica, 1922.

DORAN, PIERCE TROLLIP.—Field asst. to conservator of forests, Transkeian conservancy, Cape, 1894; clk. and acctnt. to conservator, 1896; dist. forest offr., Umtata, 1898; ditto, Butterworth, 1903; conservator of forests, Transkeian conservancy, 1st Oct., 1910.

DORION, HON. CHARLES EDWARD.—B. 1860; ed. Quebec Seminary; Laval Univ. (L.L.L., 1884); admitted to bar of Prov. of Que., 1884; practised law in Queb. City until 1911; LL.D., Laval Univ., 1894; prof. of laws, Laval Univ., 1898; and since, prof. of civ. code; judge, superior ct., Prov. of Queb., 1911; judge, ct. of king's bench, 1921.

DORKIN, NORMAN.—B. 1878; O.F.S. govt. rly., 1897-99; Imp. Mily. Rlys., 1900-02; Cent. S. African rly., 1903-08; S. African rly., 1909-14; E. African mily. rly., 1915-18; Tanganyika rly., 1919; served in Boer War, 1899-1902, rebellion, S. Africa, 1914-15; E. African forces, 1915-18.

DOUGHTY, ARTHUR GEORGE, C.M.G. (1905), M.A., Litt.D.—B. 1860; priv. sec. to min. of pub. wkn., Quebec, Canada, 1896; librarian, Quebec, 1900; Dominion archivist, Canada, 1904; mem. of comsn. on War Records and Trophies, Dec., 1918; joint del. to internat. congress of the history of America at Rio-de-Janeiro, Sept., 1922.

DOUGLAS, FRANCIS WILLIAM.—B. 1874; passed Malay, Nov., 1896, Puahut, Sept., 1918 (in India); junr. offr., Jan., 1895; utltn. offr., Batu Gajah, Jan., 1896; ag. asst. dist. mag., Tanjong Malim, Jan., 1896; ag. asst. dist. mag., Batu Gajah, Oct., 1896; ag. dist. offr., Kuantan, Mar., 1897; ag. dist. offr., Temerloh, Mar., 1898; ag. asst. dist. mag., Ulu Pahang, July, 1899; asst. dist. mag., Perak, Apr., 1900; ag. asst. sec. to res., Apr., 1902; ag. dist. mag., Batang Padang, Apr., 1904; ag. ch. asst. mag., Kinta, Nov., 1902; asst. dist. offr., T. Malim, Jan., 1903; ag. ch. asst. dist. offr., Batu Gajah, Jan., 1903; ag. dist. offr., Larut, May, 1903; ag. supt., govt. plantations in addition, Nov., 1903; asst. dist. offr., Ipoh, Mar., 1904; ag. dist. dist. offr., Larut, Mr., 1904; dep. chmn. and sec., sany. bd., Kia North, Jan., 1905 and Jan., 1907; ag. chmn. sany. bd., K. Lumpur, and dist. impr. of prisons, Aug., 1911; ag. res., Lebuan, and Br. res., Brunei, Nov., 1913; temp. 2nd lieut., R.A.S.C., Oct., 1915; capt., R.A.S.C., Dec., 1915; demob. rank of major, July, 1919; ag. dir. of food prod., F.M.S. and S.S., and deputy food contr., F.M.S. and Malacca, Mar., 1920; ag. comsnr. of food and ag. dir. of food prodn., F.M.S. and S.S., 1920; supermvy. offr., ols. I.B. for undefend Malay States, June, 1921; dist. offr., Kia July, 1921; contr. rubber expts., S.S. and F.M.S., July, 1923; assumed duty as dist. offr., Kia Mar., 1924.

DOUGLAS, R. STAIR.—Cadet, Sarawak Nov., 1896; asst. res., June, 1899; res. 2nd Jan., 1902; 2nd cls. res., Baram dist., 1904.

DOUGLAS-JONES, C. D., C.M.G. (1895), Ed. Harrow; priv. sec. to res. comsnr., Rhodesia, Aug., 1898; lieut., S. Rhodesia, July, 1908; capt., May, 1910; musketry instr. certif., Hythe, 1908; sec. to res. comsnr., Rhodesia, Apr., 1911; ag. res. comsnr., S. Rhodesia, 1st Apr., 1918; res. comsnr., S. Rhodesia, 1st Oct., 1923.

DOUGLASS, EDWARD WINGFIELD, L.L.B. (1913).—B. 1873; ed. St. Andrew's Coll., Grahamstown, Cape Province; B.A. in Oxford, 1895; final bar exam., Middle Temp., 1895; called to the bar, Middle Temple; called to the bar, Cape, 1898; called to the E.D. Court, 1898; capt., Nesbit's Horse, African War, 1900-1902; crown prosecutor, tribunal, Johannesburg, 1900-1901; crown prosec. Witswatersrand dist., 1902-1913; atty.-gen., Natal, 1913-1915; atty.-gen., Cape Prov., Dec., 1915; ag. judge, Griqualand West Lon. Divn. of supreme ct. of S. Africa, May-Jun., Aug.-Sep., 1919.

DOUGLASS, WALTER JOHN, B.A., LL.B.—Ed. Trin. Coll., Camb.; admitted sol., 1889; asst. comsnr., Lagos, 1897-1900; admitted sol., leeward Is., 1901; called to the bar, Inner Temp., Nov., 1903; Leeward Is. bar, Jan., 1904; mag. and coroner, Ist. dist., St. Lucia, Oct., 1907; ag. atty.-gen., St. Lucia, 4th Oct., 1908 to Jul., 1909; sole assessor of income tax, 1910-1912; mag., Berbice dist., B. Guiana, 1st Apr., 1912; ag. puisne judge, Apr., 1919 to Sept., 1920; maj. Port of Spain, Trinidad, July, 1921; ag. puisne judge, June to Sept., 1922; junr. puisne judge, B. Guiana, June, 1923; ag. ch. just., Aug., 1923.

DOWRIGGIN, HERBERT LAYARD.—B. 1886; inspr. of pol., Ceylon, Jan., 1901; asst. sup't. pol., Apr., 1901; supt. of pol., Feb., 1906; inspr. gen. of pol., Nov., 1913.

DOWDEN, RICHARD.—B. 1873; M.D., M.R.C.H., B.A.O., Trin. Coll., Dub., 1898; L.N. Rotunda Hosp., Dublin; D.T.M., Liverpool; med. offr., L.C.C.A., Banstead, 1899-1900; mal-
ffr., Jamaica, 1900; trans. to F.M.S. 1903; ag. engr. med. offr., Perak, 1920; ag. prin. med. offr., 1920-21; on active serv., R.A.M.C., 1st May, 1915 to 1st May, 1916; prin. med. offr., F.M.S., th Nov., 1921.

DOWNIE, H. F., B.A. (1912), M.A. (1914).—l. 1889; ed. at Christ's Hospital and Oxford; lodge exhibtr. (class.) Univ. Coll., 1908-1912; at class moda., 1910; 2nd class Lit. Hum., 1912; uptd. after compet. exam., 2nd cls. clk., C.O., loc., 1912; on mil. serv. from 5th Aug. to 19th Oct., 1914, and from 10th June, 1915, to 7th Apr., 1918; ag. 1st cls. clk., 3rd Jan., 1919; prin., 1st pr., 1920.

DOWNING, GEOFFREY GEORGE DAVID, J.P.—Ed. Corrig Schtl., Ireland, Royal Irish Univ., and Royal Coll. of Surgeons, Ireland; served in Cape Mounted Rifles, 1883; Cape pol. (Griqua and West), 1888; Mashonaland exped. (Pioneers), 390; Dominica defence res., 1904-1914; lieut., Iov., 1914; ag. sub-inspr., Leeward Is. pol., O.C., Intserratt defence force, O.C., local forces, Intserratt, Dec., 1916; ag. sub-inspr., Leeward Is. pol., and offr. instr., local forces, Antigua, nly., 1917; O.C., Marine Battn., Antigua, Oct., 917; O.C., flashlight service, Antigua-Montserrat, an., 1919; capt., Dominica defence force, 1919; O.C., Dominica defence force, Nov., 1919; man. the Is. of Barbuda and receiver of wrecks, [ar., 1920.

DOWSE, THOMAS ALEXANDER.—B. 1875; luc. at Epsom; M.R.C.S. (Eng.); L.R.C.P. (Lond.); D.P.H. (Camb.); mem. R. Inst. of Pub. health; formerly hse.-surg. and res. obstetrical fr., Charing Cross hosp., London; civ. surg. oy. Mil. hosp., Colchester; set to Roy. Nat. liss. to Deep Sea Fishermen; govt. med. offr., iji, 1902-8; port. med. offr., Levuka, Fiji; dist. smnr., and govt. med. offr., Cockburn Harbour, urks Island, 1909.

DOYLE, EDWARD ANGEL GAYNES.—B. 1869; R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Lond.; obstet. soc., Lond.; em. Br. med. assoc.; late asst. house surg., Westminster hosp.; joined med. service, Trinidad, 1884; ag. dist. med. offr., 1886; res. surg., an Fernando hosp., Nov., 1892; ag. res. surg., il. hosp. Port of Spain, 1893; res. surg., ditto, 1997; D.M.O., S. Naperama, 1906.

DRAKE, HAROLD WILLIAM.—B. 1889; ed. institute of London Schtl.; entd. Coll. Audit Dept., ly., 1904; seconded to W.A.F.F., Oct., 1914 (Jigeria and Cameroons); paymr., Overseas contingent, W.A.F.F. (G.E.A.); Coll. Audit ept., Aug., 1918; asst. audr., Nyasaaland, Mar., 1919; senr. asst. audr., Dec., 1921; ag. audr., pr. to Oct., 1922.

DRAPER, CHRISTOPHER ROBERT BURRUGH, B.E. (1918).—B. 1878; served in S.A. War, 00-01; asst. native comsnr., N.E. Rhodesia, th Oct., 1901; native comsnr., 1st Sept., 1903; llr., N.W.R., 1st Oct., 1905; ag. asst. mag., 6th ov., 1906 to 22nd Oct., 1911; asst. mag., N.R., rd Oct., 1911; has acted as mag. on various casions between Oct., 1913 and Nov., 1921; ag., 27th Nov., 1921; J.P.

DRAYSON, MATTHEW JOHN.—B. 1865; apptd. ter compet. exam., a clerk in the lower (now 2nd) v. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., av., 1883; astt. regstr., May, 1892; promoted to gher grade 2nd div., July, 1896; seconded for service as chief clerk, col. sec.'s off., Hong Kong, th Jan., 1902; acted as clk. of coun., Aug., 1902; td. to C.O. as dep. ch. registr., 22nd July, 1905; st. acctnt., 27th Sept., 1915; clk. to comsnrs. income tax, C.O., 1915-21.

DRAYTON, HON. STR HENRY L., KT. BACH. (1915), K.C.—B. 1869; ed. in England and Canada; called to the bar, Ontario, 1891; counsel, railway comte., Ontario legislature, 1902; counsel for City of Toronto, 1910; Ontario govt. comsnr. on Toronto Power Comsn., 1911; ch. comsnr., bd. of railway comsnrs., Canada, 1912; resig. to assume portfolio of min. of finance in Union Govt., Aug., 1919; elec. by acclamation for Kingston, Oct., 1919; re-ele. for York West, g.e., Dec., 1921; resig. portfolio on defeat of admnstr., Dec., 1921.

DREW, DESMOND, B.A., M.B., B.Ch. (T.C.D.).—Med. offr., Bechuanaland Prot., 1921.

DROWER, E. M., C.B.E. (1923).—B. 1890; admitted solr., 1904; practised, consular ct., Cairo, 1904-6; Sudan bar, 1906-14; served European War, 1914-18; pres. of first instance, Hillah, 1918; Mosul, 1918-19; Basrah, 1919; asst. judicial adviser, Iraq, 1921; tempy. judicial adviser, 1921; govt. counsellor, 1921; advisor to miny. of just., 1922.

DRURY, EDWARD HERBERT MERIVALE, M.B.E. (1918).—Trinity Hall, Camb., 1890; called to the bar, Inner Temp., 1896; priv. sec. to Hon. Sir R. G. W. Herbert, G.C.B., Mar., 1899, to June, 1900; priv. sec. to Govr. Sir C. A. Moloney, K.C.M.G., Windward Is., July, 1900; ditto, Trinidad, Dec., 1900, to July, 1902; admitted to practice at Trinidad bar, July, 1902; ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, St. Helena, Oct., 1902; emgrn. agt., Oct., 1902; clk. to ex. coun., Apr., 1903; J.P., Nov., 1902; schl. attndce. offr., Aug., 1904; collr. of govt. rents and taxes, Jan., 1903, to Dec., 1906; asst. stip. mag., Nov., 1904; clk. to res. comsnr., Bech. Prot., Jan., 1907; ag. ch. clk. and registr., June, 1907; J.P., Bech. Prot., 1910; ag. astt. res. mag., Southern dist., 1st Mar. to 30th Nov., 1911; ditto, 7th May, 1912; astt. res. mag., 8th May, 1913; 2nd clk. to astt. comsnr., Southern Prot., 1st May, 1912; astt. res. mag., May, 1913; chmn., Bangwaketse and Bakwena schl. comtee., Jan., 1914; marriage offr., Bech. Prot., Oct., 1914; astt. res. mag., N. dist., Bech. Prot., 12th Aug., 1919; ag. astt. comsnr., ditto, Nov., 1920 to June, 1921; ag. res. mag., N. dist., Bech. Prot., Sept., 1921; hon. corres. in Bech. Prot. to Overseas Branch, B. of T., Mar., 1922; ag. res. mag., N. Dist., Bech. Prot., Apr., 1922.

DRURY, HON. ERNEST C.—B. 1878; first min. of agric. in prov. of Ontario; graduate of Ontario Agric. Coll.; student of agric. and economic problems; one of the organizers of the United Farmers of Ontario and first pres.; called upon to form cabinet upon defeat of Hearst adminstr. at polls, Oct., 1919; prime min. and pres. of coun. in U.F.O. govt., Nov., 1919; defeated in prov. elec., 1923; resigned on defeat of U.F.O. admnstr., 1923.

DRYBURGH, ALEXANDER MITCHELL.—B. 1895; ed. George Heriot Schtl., Edinburgh and Edinburgh Univ. (M.A.); cadet, F.M.S., 15th Oct., 1919; govt. rice agt., Tapah, 15th Mar., 1920; ag. 2nd astt. dist. offr., Batang Padang, 1st Sept., 1920; astt. to Fed. secr., Nov., 1920; ag. astt. dist. offr., Kuantan, Jan., 1921; passed law, Mar., 1921; ag. dist. offr., Jelebu, 1st May, 1921; passed cadet, 28th June, 1921; supernumy. offr., cls. V., Oct., 1922; ag. dist. offr., Ulu Kelantan, Aug., 1924.

DU BOULAY, ED.—Ag. clk. to audr. and treasr., St. Lucia, Jan. to May, 1890; 4th clk., treasr., Mar. to May, 1892; 3rd clk., May to Dec., 1892; 2nd clk., treasr., and accnt., Jan., 1893, to Apr., 1894; ag. ch. clk., treasr., Feb. to Nov.,
1893; audit clk., Apr., 1894; ag. audr., St. Lucia, Mar. to Sept., 1901; attached to Somerset house for service in W. African colonies, Dec., 1901; local auditor, S. Leone, 24th Apr., 1903; auditor, Cyprus, Apr., 1909; seconded under F.O. for sp. audit, Egypt, 14th Nov., 1922 to 3rd May, 1923 and from 14th Feb. to 23rd May, 1924; treas., 1924.

DU BOULAY, G.C.—Apptd. after compet. exam., asst. audit clk., St. Lucia, 25th Apr., 1899; 3rd clk., govt. office, 1st Aug., 1899; 4th clk., treasy. and customs, 17th Mar., 1903; ag. 2nd clk., treasy., from 17th Mar. to 16th Nov., 1903; chief clk., post office, 16th Jan., 1905; ag. revenue offr. and warden, Grose Islet and Anse La Range districts, Oct., 1907, to Mar., 1908; ag. harbour master, St. Lucia, Sept. 1909; priv. sec. and clk. to gov. of Seychelles, clk. to councils and supt. of printing, 11th Nov., 1912; ag. auditor, 3rd May, 1916; ag. treas. and mem. exec. and legis. couns., Mar. to May, 1919; asst. sec., col. sec.'s off., Gibraltar, Dec., 1919.

DUDLEY, Rt. Hon. Earl of, P.C. (1902); G.C.B. (1911); G.C.M.G. (1908); G.C.V.O. (1903).—B. 1867; L.C.C., a D.L. and co. ald. for Worcester; Lord High Steward of Kidderminster; major, Worcester, I.Y.; served in S. Africa, 1900; parly. sec. to B. of T., 1895-1902; lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1902-1908; gov.-gen. and comdr-in-chief of Commonwealth of Australia, 1908 to 1911.

DUFF, Sir H. L., K.B.E. (1918); C.M.G. (1915).—B. 1872; apptd. by F.O., asst. res. B.C. Africa, 1897; resig. from serv., 1903; re-apptd. Apr., 1904; res., 1906; seconded, 1909-10; admitted mem. of Inner Temple, Jan., 1909; 1st cls. hons. constitutional law, 1909; ag. dep. gov., July, 1910; and Apr. to July, 1911; 1st grade res. July, 1911; sec. to the admstn., 1912; ch. sec. to govt. and mem. exec. and legis. couns., 1914; served with Nyasaland Field Force, Aug., 1914 to Jan., 1915, montd. in despatches; served against rebels in Shire Highlands, 1915 (medal and clasp); ch. polit. offr. to Brig.-Gen. Northey, C.B., in operations against G.E. Africa, July, 1916; ag. gov., Nyasaland Prot., 1st Oct., 1918; ret., 1920; author of "Nyasaland under the F.O.," 2nd ed.; and a history of Nyasaland in the native dialect, published by the Prot. govt.

DUFF, Rt. Hon. Lyman Poore, P.C. (1919), B.A., LL.B. Toronto Univ.—B. 1865; apptd. judge, sup. ct., British Columbia, 1904; judge, sup. ct. of Canada, 1906; cent. appeal judge, Mil. Serv. Act, 1917.

DUFFY, Hon. Frank Gavan, K.C., M.A., LL.B.,—B. 1832; ed. at Stonyhurst Coll., and Melbourne Univ.; called to the bar, 1874; judge of the high ct. of Australia, Feb., 1913.

DUMORTE, ROWLEY, P. L.—B. 1869; entered Trinidad civ. serv., 1st Jan., 1894; 2nd clk. audit office, 1st Apr., 1912; ch. clk. and acct., G.P.O., July, 1923.

DUNCAN, ANDREW, H. F. (late lieut. R.N.)—Joined R.N., July, 1868; served in Mediterranean, S. America, Cape, India, Australia, and W. Coast of Africa; resig. Nov., 1883; passed exam. in theoretical survey, July, 1883, and practical survey, 1884, at the Cape Univ., in honours (first of his year on both occasions); from Apr., 1884, employed by the survr.-gen. of the Cape, and in priv. practice; mem. land coman. of Br. Bechuana-land, Sept., 1815; survr.-gen. of that col., July, 1886; survr.-gen. to Br. S. Africa Co., 1891.

DUNCAN, CLAUDE WOODRUFF—Clk., govt. sec.'s office, B. Guiana, May, 1899, to Feb., 1901; sub-inspr., B. Guiana police, 1st Mar., 1901; passed school of musketry, Hytha, 1901; pas school of instruction, Chelsea Barracks, 19 dist. inspr. and J.F., 5th May, 1907; ag. comn. inspr., 28th Jan., 1908, to 30th June, 1909; pas in Hindi, 1909; in command of special expediti to Venezuela frontier, Wenam, Oct. to Dec., 1910, and May to June, 1911; dep. inspr.-gen. police, Mauritius, 17th Sept., 1912; ag. inspr.-gen. of pol., and supt. of prisons, Nov., 1915; June, 1915; comnr. of police, Malta, July, 1916; also inspr. of prisons, Oct., 1917; awarded KZ police medal, 1st Jan., 1919; inspr.-gen. of pol. and director of prisons, Southern Prov. Nigeria, 19th June, 1919.

DUNCOMBE, ROGER KELLSALL.—B. 1875; ed. at Oxford, schol. Ball Coll.; 1st cls. mod., 1891; lat cls. final class. school, 1893; Gr. scholarship, 1890; clk., after compet. exam., rev., 1894; priv. sec. to Sir A. Milner; pr. clk., 1898; treas., Transvaal, 1901; col. sec., 1st Dec., 1903; mem. exec. and legis. couns.; mr. I.C.C.; ag. lieut.-gov., Oct., 1906; M.L.A. Yeoville; min. of interior, pub. health and educ., 1921-24.

DUNCOMBE, F. A. C.—B. 1880; 4th div. P.O., Bahamas, 1903; 2nd clk., C.S.O., 1904; clk., record office, 1909; comnr., 4th div., 1911.

DUNCOMBE, ROGER KELLSALL.—B. 1875; messenger, legis. coun., Bahamas, 1890; 2nd div. P.O., 1890; sec. keeper, general hosp., 1890; clk., legis. coun., 1892; clk., Nassau market, 1892; ag. regir., supreme ct., 1901, 1905, 1909, 1910; ag. regir. of records, 1908, 1909, 1910; coroner, 1909, 1910, 1913; supervisor of elections, 1911; regir. of records, 1912; asst. regir., Bahamas, Jan., 1918; ag. regir.-gen., various occasions, 1920, 1921 and 1923.

DUNDAS, HON. C. C. F., O.B.E. (1922).—Asst. dist. comnr., E.A.P., 4th Sept., 1908; dist. comnr., Aug., 1914; dist. polit. offr. (with rank of major), German E. Africa, provost admin., 25th Jan., 1916; senr. comnr., Tzani yika Territory, 1st Apr., 1920; ag. asst. dist. sec., 23rd June, 1924.

DUNDAS, CAPT. L.M.—B. 1885; ed. Wolver Coll., land ranger, E.A.P., Mar., 1910; senr. E.A.P. Forces, German E. Africa, 1914-19; commdr., K.A.R.; asst. dist. comnr., 1st Aug., 1920; ag. dist. comnr., Jubaland, Nov., 1921; June, 1923.

DUNEDIN, 3RD BISHOP OF (founded 1841).—Rt. Rev. Isaac Richards, M.A., D.D.—B. 1855; consecr., 1920; ed. Wesleyan Coll., Taunton; Exeter Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1883; M.A., 1886; D.D., 1921; deacon, 1882; priest, 1883; erch. of St. Paul's, Truro, 1882-6; vicar, St. Mary Remuera, N.Z., 1886-95; warden, Selwyn Col., Dunedin, 1895-1900; vicar, Tusapeka, 1900-1905; vicar, St. John's, Invercargill, 1916-20; can. St. Paul's, Dunedin, 1896-1916; archdeacon Queenstown, 1908-16; archdeacon of Invercargill, 1916-20.

D'UNIENVILLE, R. M.—B. 1879; called to the bar, Middle Temple, 1904; ag. dist. mag. ag. crown proscr., Mauritius, 1906-11; ag. dist. mag. and substitute master of supreme ct., Oct., 1911; ag. crown proscr., Dec., 1911; ag. adm. substitute procureur-general, Sept., 1912; ag. adviser and crown proscr., and pol. mag. Seychelles, Dec., 1912; ag. chief just., Seychelles, 23rd Mar. to 22nd Aug., 1914; dist. mag. Mauritius, 10th Jan., 1916.

DUNK, HERBERT.—Ed. King's Coll. London; home civ. serv., 1901; undergrad., Manch. Univ., 1906; comnr., for taking affidavit, 1907.
neurologist to Pretoria gen. hosp.; lect. in clinical psychiatry, Univ. of Witwatersrand; consulting psychiatrist to Union educn. and prison depts.

DUPIGNY, E. G. MORSON.—Asst. govt. off., Dominica, Feb., 1889; clk. comsnr. of valuation, 1890; clk. mag., dist. F., 1890; do. presdt.'s off. Dom., 1890-92; do. registrar's off., 1892; do. treas., Antigua, 1896; stud. Mid. Temp., 1906; asst. res., N. Nigeria, 1903; 3rd class res., 1906; 2nd class res., 1911.

DUPONT, P. RIVALT.—B. 1870; holds diplomas of agric. engrnr. (Grignon, France); attached in 1892 to laboratory of Messrs. Sallois & Dupont, Paris; chemist in charge and factory manager, Benare estate, Mauritius, 1894-99; ag. ast. dir., agronomic stattn., Mauritius, 1899-1900; on spec. mission to Seychelles in 1900 to investigate guano deposits; curator, botanic station, Seychelles, 1901; conservator of crn. lands, in addition to perm. duties, 1902; on govt. misson. to Ceylon, S. Settlements, Malay States, Java, Sumatra and India in 1902-03, and again in 1911, to investigate progress in various branches of trop. agriculture.

DU RAND, C. J.—B. 1874; ed. Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch; sworn translator, sup. ct. of S. Africa, Cape prov. divn.; clk. to ch. inspr., pub. wks., Cape, Jan., 1898; clk. to comsnr. of pub. wks., 1906; clk., admstr's. office, Cape, 1911; Gazette editor, Cape, 1912; senr. clk., educn. dept., O.F.S., 1914; inspr. of schl. bd. offices, O.F.S., Jan., 1918; prin. clk., educn. dept., O.F.S. 1919.

DURMAN, F. J.—B. 1882; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. serv., and assigned to C.O., 15th April, 1901; ch. clk., col. sec.,'s office, Fiji, 7th Oct., 1914; senr. astt. sec., Tanganyika Territory, 18th Aug., 1920; clk., exec. coun. Dec., 1920; ag. astt. ch. sec., Aug., 1921 to Sept., 1922, Apr., 1923 to Dec., 1923 and from Mar. to June, 1924; ag. ch. sec., Dec., 1923 to Mar., 1924.

DURRANT, F. C. WELLS, M.A.—K.C., 1864; ed. in St. Vincent, Univ. Coll. schl., Lond., and Univ. of Edin.; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., 1886; practised as barr. and solr. in St. Vincent; ag. pol. mag., St. Vincent, 1898; ag. atty.-gen., St. Vincent, 1898; stip. mag. and ag. atty.-gen., St. Lucia, 1902; resig., 1904; atty.-gen., Bahamas, 1909; ag. chief just., July, 1910, May to Aug., 1911, and from May to July, 1913; M.L.C.; ag. col. sec., 25th Mar. to 18th Sept., 1919, from 12th Nov., 1919 to 2nd Feb., 1920, and from 9th Apr. to 14th July, 1920.

DUSSEK, O. T., B.A.—B. 1886; ed. Eastbourne Coll. and Univ. of London; B.A., London, 1909; mem. of convocation; senr. astt. mast., Alleyne's Grammar Schl., Uttoxeter, 1909-11; senr. astt. mast., High Schl., Malacca, 1912-14; prin., Malay Training Coll., Malacca, 1914-22; prin., Sultan Idris Training Coll., F.M.S., 1922; in addn., astt. dir. of educn. (Malay), and examr. in Malay.

DU TOIT, PIETER JOHANNES.—Clk., dept. of agric., Cape of Good Hope, Jan., 1890; 2nd cls. clk., May, 1896; 1st cls. clk., June, 1900; sec. to lands relief bd., 1899 to 1905; ag. chief clk. to ag. dir. of agric., Aug., 1905; apptmt. confirmed, July, 1906; ag. dir. for agric., May to Sept., 1907; ag. under-sec. for agric., Mar., 1908; apptmt. confirmed, Jan., 1909; ag. under-sec. for agric. for Union of S. Africa, May, 1910; apptmt. confirmed, 1st Apr., 1912; mem. of pub. serv. comen. of inquiry, June, 1918 to Sept., 1920; sec. for agric., Union of S. Africa, Oct., 1920.
DUTTON, CHARLES LEONARD O'BRIEN.—B. 1877; ed. Ellesmere Coll. and Bradford Gram. Sch.; clk., Impl. mil. rly., S. Africa, Dec., 1900; chief clk., fincl. bd. of rly. control, Transvaal and O.R.C., Jan., 1902; chief clk. to high commr. for S. Africa, Nov., 1904; acted as Impl. sec., Aug., 1913 to Feb., 1914, Nov.-Dec., 1917 and Aug.-Sept., 1918; ast. Imperial sec., Apr., 1919; ag. Imp. sec., May-Nov., 1921; gov't. sec., Bechuanaland Prot., Nov., 1923.

DUTTON, ERIC ALDHelm TORLOGH, M.A.—Ed., Hurstpierpoint, and Keble Coll., Oxford; served in 'Gallipoli as Major, W. Yorks Regt. (ment. in desp.); cler. astt. to ast. commr., Quathing, Basutoland, 1918-19; passed I.C.S. exam., 1920; priv. sec. to gov. of Uganda, 1920; priv. sec. to gov., Kenya, 1922; sec., high commr., Zanzibar, 1922.

DUTTON, ERNEST GODFREY.—B. 1886; clk., Impl. mil. rlys., Apr., 1902; clk., high commr. for S. Africa, Apr. 1903 to May, 1916; Swaziland service, Apr., 1907; clk. to ast. commr., Maseru, Basutoland, June, 1916; ch. clk., master of ct. and regiar., July, 1919; ag. gov't. sec., June to Dec., 1923 and Feb. to Oct., 1924.

DUTTON, FREDERICK HUGH, M.A.—Ed. at Kings' schl., Worcester and Hertford Coll., Oxford; elementary schl. teacher under London schl. bd.; principal, Fickaburg govt. schl., O.R.C., 1904-1907; dir. of educn., Basutoland, 1907.

DUTTON, STEPHEN BERNARD.—B. 1881; served in stores dept., C.S.A.R., 1902-3; served in Zululand rebellion, 1906; comptroller of stores, Basutoland, Oct., 1909.

DUTTON, THOMAS EDWARD, M. Inst. T.—B. 1877; traffic supt., Ceylon, 2nd Oct., 1913; designation altered to traffic man., 1916; gen. man., Ceylon Govt. Rlys., July, 1923; mem., legis. coun.

DYER, SYDNEY WHITMORE, M.I.E.E., S.A.—B. 1885; ed. City of London schl.; astt. dir., rlyw. and elec. dept., Zanzibar, 12th Dec., 1911; ag. dir., 17th Apr. to 24th Nov., 1913, and from 27th Oct., 1915, to 20th Apr., 1916; immigr. offr., 4th Sept. to 21st Dec., 1917; ag. director, 28th Jan. to 3rd Dec., 1919.

DYER, SIR WILLIAM T. THIBSULTON, M.A., F.R.S., K.C.M.G. (1899), C.M.G. (1882).—B. 1843; Chr. Ch., Oxon, 1873; astt. dir., Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, 1873; dir., 1885; ret., 1906; botan. adviser to S. of S. for Col.

DYETT, RICHARD HENRY KORTRIGHT.—B. 1862; served in pres.'s office, Virgin Is., 1879 to 1881, and 1882 to 1884; clk., regiar.'s office, Nevis, 1886, and regiar. of pub. cemetery there, Apr., 1886; 2nd clk., regiar.'s office, Antigua, 1887; clk. to trustee, supt. ct. lib., July, 1883; ag. 1st clk. regiar.'s office, Mar., 1889, to Aug., 1890; commr. to adminstr. oaths, 1889; marshal V.-A. ct., L.I., Dec., 1889; clk. to mag., dist. A., 1890; dep. cor., dist. A., 1892; postmr., Antigua, May to Sept., 1894; 1st regiar.'s off., Jan., 1895; dep. cor., dist. B., 1896; ag. mag., dist. A., Jan., Feb., Apr. to Nov., 1897; sec. to H.M. Diamond Jubilee com., June, 1897; ag. mag., dist. B., Apr., 1898; Jan., 1899, during which period, May-June, 1898, acted also as mag., dist. A., and from Mr. Sept., 1899, and 25th Oct., 1899; ag. mag., dist. A., Nov., 1899, to May, 1900; during which period (Jan. to Apr.) acted also as mag., dist. J.P., Sept., 1899; ag. mag., dist. A., June to Mar., 1901; and Apr. to Nov., 1901; ag. Mar., 1902; mem. of "Coronation" committee, hon. sec. to same, May, 1902; ag. mag., dist. Aug., 1902, to Feb., 1903; regiar. and prov. mag. and regiar. of titles, St. Kitts-Nevia, 11th June, 1903; mem. of Basseterre town bd., and sec. chmn. of same, June, 1903; chmn. of same, 1903; J.P., St. Kitts, 1904; regiar. and marshal, Antigua, and ch. regiar., Leeward July, 1909; trustee, sup. ct. library, Aug., 1909; regiar. of joint stock companies, Leeward Nov., 1909; M.L.C., Antigua, Mar., 1907; cn. St. John's City commr., May, 1907, to Jan., 1909; chmn., trustees of pub. library, 1907, to 30th June, 1910; ag. mag., ex. Sept. to Oct., 1909; and May, 1913, to Feb., 1914; dists. A. and B., Apr. to Nov., R.M.E.C., Antigua, May to Nov., 1914; ag. mag., dists. A. and B., Apr. to July, 1915; ag. mag., Montserrat, July to Nov., 1915; ag. mag., A. and B., Jan. to Dec., 1916; apptd. permanently to that office, Mar., 1917; ag. commr., Ennserat, 1st Jan., 1917.

DYKE, HAMILTON WILLIAM.—B. 1816; ml. offr., Basutoland, 1913; served in Imperial War.

DYSON, EDWARD TREVOR.—ed. Ruthin schl., U.C.W., Aberystwyth (B.A.), and ses. Coll., Oxford (B.A.); B. 1886; cadet, Crimean ser., 26th Nov., 1910; attached to Transvaal Kachester, Dec., 1910; ag. pol. mag., Inzaalee, May, 1911; ag. pol. mag., Puttaka, 1912; office astt. to gov't. agt., N.W. Prov. Set., 1912; pol. mag., Kurungala, Aug., 1913; ag. mag., Kandy, Apr., 1916; additnl. astt. cao., Mat., 1918; 3rd astt. col. sec., May, 1919; ag. mag., Kandy, Sept., 1920; astt. gov't. agt., Eliya, Feb., 1921.

DYSON, HUBERT.—B. 1884; Assoc. M.I.C.E., ed. at pub. schl. and Leeds Univ.; pup. astt. to the late Thos. Hewson, M.I.C.E., and water engrnr. of Leeds, 1901; astt. to Henzell, M.I.C.E., water engrnr., Leeds; dist. engrnr., M.D.W., Fiji, 1911; ag. dep. exec. of works, Oct., 1916.

EADIE, DAVID.—B. 1868; ed. at Glas. telegraphist, Impl. serv., Glasgow, 1885; trans. to Cape serv. (posts and tels.), 1889; astt. to Reinelt, 1889; postmr., Barkly West, 1890; transf., law dept., 1896; clk. to civ. commr. and res. mag., Cradock, 1896; East Lothian, 1896; Kenhardt, 1897; astt. mag., Rustenburg, 1898; clk., Cape pol., Kimberley, 1899; ag. commr. and res. mag., Gordonia, 1900 (ceasing 1903); civ. commr. and res. mag., Howick, 1904; mag. and ollr. of cust., Walsh, 1905; civ. commr. and res. mag., Peddie, 1905; seconded for serv., German S.W. Africa; inspgr. mag. and inspgr. of prisons, 1920; serv. inspgr., 1921; civ. commr. and res. mag., Port Elizabeth, 1923.

EAGLESOME, SIR JOHN EGAN, K.C.M.G. (1916), C.M.G. (1906).—M. Inst. C.E.; serve
P.W.D., rly., India, 1890; recd. thanks of Indian govt., Khojak tunnel, 1892, Godavari bridge, 1900; services lent to C.O., 1st Sept., 1900, as D.P.W., Northern Nigeria; in charge of Baro-Kano rly. from 1907; dir. of rly. and works, Nigeria, 1912; ret. 1919.

Eales, Shirley, O.B.E. (1922).—B. 1883; served throughout S. African war, 1899-1902; 1st cls. clk., gov't. office, Transvaal and O.R.C., 1st July, 1902; 1st cls. clk., 1st July, 1904; transfd. to Basutoland service and attached to office of high commr. for S. Africa, 1st July, 1908; prin. clk., Dec., 1911, and ast. Impl. acctnt., Apr., 1915; chief clk., Apr., 1919; mem. of comm. to enquire into establishments, etc., in Bechuanaland Prov., Basutoland and Swaziland, 1921-22; ast. ast. Imp. sec., May-Nov., 1921 and Mar.-Sept., 1922; ast. Imp. sec. and ch. clk., 1923.

Eales, Stanley York, O.B.E. (1924).—B. 1886; clk. Imp. Mily. Rlys., 1901; refugees' aid dept., 1902; C.S.A. Rlys., 1903; patents office, Transvaal, 1903; exec. and legis. couns., 1904; agr. dept., Transvaal, 1906; treas., Union of S. Africa, 1917; prin. clk., 1921; custodian of enemy property, 1922.

Earle, Hugh J. M.—B. 1896; ed. Cheltenham; on war service, 1914-19; capt., 4th Batt., Essex Regt., 1918; ent. dept. of lands and mines, B. Guiana, 2nd Aug., 1921; 6th cls. clk., secretariat, 1st Mar., 1922.

Earle, Sir Lionel, K.C.B. (1916); C.B. (1911); C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1866; ed. at Marl., Univs. of Göttingen and Paris, and Merton Coll., Oxford; ast. sec. to royal comm. on Paris exhibn., 1898-1900; ag. 2nd sec. of embassy, 1900; priv. sec. to lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1902-1903; priv. sec. to lord pres. of the coun. (Earl of Crewe), 1907; priv. sec. to S. of S. for the colonies (Earl of Crewe), Apr., 1908; priv. sec. to S. of S. for the colonies (Mr. Lewis Harcourt), Nov., 1910; sec. to H.M. Office of Works, 1912.

Eaton, Bertie James, F.I.C., F.C.S., O.B.E. (Mily. Div., 1919).—B. 1883; ed. Dorchester Gram. Sch., Finsbury Tech. Coll. (City and Guilds of London Inst.) and Birkbeck Inst.; ast. research chem., Imperial Institute, 1904-06; gov't. chem., F.M.S., 1906-10; ag. dir. of agr., F.M.S., May, 1910; gov't. agr. chem., F.M.S. and S.S., 1910; del. to Internat. Rubber Congress and Exhibn., Batavia, 1914; recvd. thanks of the S. of S. and the Jovt., F.M.S., for re-searches on rubber, 1918; ag. dir. of agr., F.M.S. and S.S., May, 1921 to Feb., 1922; 2nd lieut., gen. list, adjutant, Civ. Guard, Kuala Lumpur, Aug., 1916; lieut., M.V.I.; D.C., M.V.I., Selangor, 1917; major, M.V.I., Jan., 1923; author of "The Preparation and Vulcanisation of Plantation Rubber," "The Cultivation and Preparation of Camphor in F.M.S." contrbs. on rubber researches to the Society of Chemical Industry, numerous articles on tropical agr., industries, etc., to the Agril. Bulletin, F.M.S. and other journals.

Eaves, Lieut.-Colonel Frederick, D.S.O., T.A. (Res.), Barrister-at-Law.—B. 1881; admitted olr. (Eng.), 1908; 2nd lieut., 5th King's Own T.F., 1908; served France, 1915-19; commd., 5th King's Own at "Second Ypres" and "Loos," 1915; 1/5th Loyal N. Lancs. at Messines, 1917 and "Cambrai," 1918; 18th Cameronians at Zecaut, 1918; 8th Scottish Rifles in Rhine Army and Ireland 1919; C.M.O.N., Ireland, 1921-22; J.S.O., 1916; ment. in despatches three times; ast. and offr., Hong Kong, 1922; called to bar Gray's Inn, 1923, J.P., Hong Kong, 1923; ag. and offr., 1924.

EBDEN, WILLIAM SYDENHAM.—B. 1887; ed. Clifton and Gonville and Caius Coll., Camb.; class. tripes, 1909; cadet, S. Sttlmts., 1911; ag. 4th mag. and ast. dist. judge, Singapore, 1912; ag. dist. offr., Jasir, 1912; ag. ast. to res., Malacca, 1913; 2nd lieut., Jan., 1915; lieut., Salonika Front; wounded and p. of w., Bulgaria; dist. offr., Ulu Langat, F.M.S., 1920; ag. sec. to res., Negri Sembilan, Aug., 1920.

ECCLES, WILLIAM HUNTER.—Ed. St. Paul's Schol., London; clk., educn. office, Trinidad, 1st Apr., 1907; clk. to commrs. of currency, 18th June, 1908; customs, 30th Jan., 1911; temp. sub-inspr. of pol., Nov., 1914, to Feb., 1915; 2nd lieut. for mily. serv., Feb., 1915; lieut., Mar., 1917; temp. capt., Apr., 1917; served at Dardanelles with M.E.F., Sept.-Dec., 1915, and with E.E.F., Jan., 1917, to Feb., 1919; returned to cuat., Trinidad, July, 1919; on sp. mill. duty to B. Guiana, 22nd Aug. to 1st Sept., 1919, and in Trinidad, 23rd Sept. to 1st Oct.; ast. recvr.-gen., Gambia, 7th Oct., 1919; relinquished comm. with rank of capt., 1st Sept., 1921; A.D.C. and priv. sec. to Mr. G. Gwyn, 15th to 22nd Sept., 1921 and to Mr. C. R. M. Workman, 23rd Sept., 1921 to 19th Jan., 1922; ag. clk., exec. coun., 15th Sept., 1921 to 19th Jan., 1922; offr.-in-charge, cuat., 29th June, 1923 to Nov., 1923.

ECKHARDT, HENRY CHARLES.—B. 1877; ed. London and St. John's Coll., Cambridge; B.A. Cantab.; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1899; ag. ast. dist. offr., Ulu Langat, June, 1900; ag. 2nd ast. dist. offr., Kuala Kubu, Jan., 1901; ag. sec., sany. bd., Kuala Lumpur, May, 1901 and May, 1902; passed cadet, Apr., 1902; ag. dist. offr., Kuala Langat, Sept., 1902; ag. ast. dist. offr., Kuala Langat, Jan., 1903; ag. 2nd mag., Kuala Lumpur, Apr., 1903; ag. dist. offr., Kuantan, May, 1903; ag. dist. offr., Temerloh, Aug., 1903; 2nd ast. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar; offr., cls. V., Jan., 1906; ag. ast. dist. offr., Kuala Kubu, Mar., 1906, Aug., 1907 and Aug., 1909; ag. dist. offr., Pekan, Aug., 1906; ag. dist. offr., Ulu Selangor, Apr., 1909; ag. adviser, Perlis, Nov., 1911; offr., cls. IV., Jan., 1912; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1917; offr., cls. II., Jan., 1919; sec. to high commr., Jan., 1921; ag. Br. adviser, Trengganu, Feb., 1921; dist. offr., Lower Perak, June, 1922; ag. adviser, lands, Kedah, Mar., 1923; ag. Br. adviser, Kedah, Nov., 1923.

Eden Charles William Guy.—Served in colonial audit dept., 1894-1899; ast. treas., Entebbe, Uganda Protectorate, 11th Sept., 1899; transfd. to adminstr. as ast. collr., May, 1901; collr., 14th Sept., 1904; prov. commr., 1st April, 1912.

Edgcumbe, John Aubrey Pearce, C.B.E. (1920).—B. 1886; ed. Winchester Coll. and Magdalene Coll., Cambridge (schol.); cls. I., class. tripes; ent., B. of T., 1910; national health insurance comm., 1912; war trade statistical dept., 1916; dir., 1918; attended Peace Confce., Paris, 1919; ast. dir., D.O.T., since 1919; attd. as economic adviser to staff of Adml. Sir F. Field, commdg. sp. service squadron during Empire cruise, 1924; priv. sec. to Mr. L. C. M. Amery, S. of S. for the Cola., 20th Nov., 1924.

Edginton, Edwin.—B. 1886; sorting clk. and telegraphist, Imp. serv., 1908; resigned, Jan., 1912; re-apptd., Dec., 1912; dist. survr., posts and telegs., G. Coast, Oct., 1913; senr. dist. survr., Feb., 1917; served as offr. in ch., posts and telegs., Br. Zone, Togoland, Nov., 1916 to Aug., 1917; postmr., Cyprus, Feb., 1920; P.M.G., Trinidad, 1922.
EDMOND, J. J. B., M.C., M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.).—R.A.M.C., July, 1916 to Aug., 1919; med. offr., Trans-Zambesia Rly. constrn., Portuguese E. Africa, July, 1920 to Dec., 1921; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 30th June, 1922.

EDMONDS, B. D.—B. 1895; on mily. serv., 7th Aug., 1914 to 5th Dec., 1919; awarded Mily. Med.; temp. clk., C.O., 2nd Feb., 1920; apptd. after compet. exam., cler.offr., C.O., 6th Nov., 1921.

EDMONDS, EDWARD REGINALD.—B. 1901; matric., London Univ., June, 1921; entered C.O., 1917; apptd. after exam., ast. clk., 23rd Apr., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

EDWARDS, S. W.—B. 1879; ed. privately; S.S. "Conway," 1893-4; served in S. Africa with 62nd I.Y. (medal and four clasps) 1900-1901; ast. res., N. Nigeria, 18th Nov., 1906; 3rd cls. res., 9th Feb., 1909; in charge of Bida Emirate from May, 1910; ag. in charge, Niger Prov., 1st-31st May, 1911.

EDWARDS, MAJOR-GENERAL SIR ALFRED HAMILTON MACKENZIE, C.B.—Served in 1st Dragoon Guards, Jan., 1883, to Apr., 1892; adjutant, Behar Light Horse Volunteers, India, Apr., 1892, to Apr., 1897; 1st and 5th Dragoon Guards and Imperial Light Horse, Apr., 1897, to Oct., 1900; Hazara (N.W. Frontier, India), 1888; ast. prov. marshal (ment. in des., medal and clasp); commanded Imperial Light Horse, S. African war, Nov., 1899, to June, 1900; dist. comsnr., Potchefstroom and Krugersdorp dists., June to Oct., 1900; commanded "A" division, S.A.C., Oct., 1900, to end of war (ment. in des., Queen's medal, 4 clasps, King's medal, 2 clasps); substantive lt.-col. in the army, dated 29th Nov., 1900; commdt., Transvaal volunteers; left the service, 1906; A.A.G., Northern com., India, 1906-7; chief constable, metrop. police, 1907-12; commt.-gen., Rhodesian forces, 1912; ret. 1st Apr., 1923.

EDWARDS, CAPT. D., M.A., LL.B. (Aberdeen).—Ast. dist. comsnr., Kenya, June, 1921; called to Scottish bar, Nov., 1924; regis., sup. ct., Kenya, Aug., 1924.

EDWARDS, HERBERT ARCHER, F.R.A.S.—Cadet, schoolship H.M.S. "Conway," Jan., 1886; passed out 1st on list, Dec., 1887; midshipman, R.N.R., 1889; sub-lieut., 1895; lieut., 1900; served in Royal Navy in several ships; 1st cls. certif. in torpedo and gunnery; extra master's certif.; naval instr., school ship H.M.S. "Conway," 1902-5; marine offr., Lagos, Aug., 1905; lent to gov't. of G. Coast for special service, Feb., 1906; diploma in surveying, R.G.S., 1907; comdr., S.Y., "Ivy," S. Nigeria, Dec., 1908.

EDWARDS, WILLIAM MAXWELL.—Examr. of diagrams, survr.-gens. office, Transvaal, Jan., 1903; professional ast., survr.-gen's. office, Transvaal, Apr., 1912; survr.-gen., O.F.S., Sept., 1922.

EDWARDS, WILLIAM STUART.—B. 1880; called to the bar, Ontario, Sept., 1909; legal offr., dept. of justice, Canada, Nov., 1910; sec. of dept. of justice, 1913; ast. dep. min., of justice, 1914.

EGAN, ALEXANDER HOWARD, B.A., Trinity Coll., Dublin.—B. 1889; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Dec., 1912; attached to Batticaloa Kachcheri, Jan., 1913; office ast. to gov't. ast., Eastern Prov., Aug., 1913; ast. office ast. to gov't. ast., S. Prov., Apr., 1915; pol. mag., Balapitiya, Nov., 1916; ditto, Matara, Apr., 1917; office ast. to gov't. ast., W. Prov., Oct., 1917; attached to censor's office, Apl., 1918; office ast. to gov't. ast., W. Prov., May, 1920; ag. dist. judge, Tangalla June, 1920; pol. mag., Galle, Mar., 1922; ast. gov't. ast., Hambantota, Mar., 1923.

EGERTON, SIR WALTER, K.C.M.G. (196 C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1858; ed. Tonbridge Sch., cadet, S. Stlitms., Oct., 1880; ast. to Chinese prot., Jan., 1881; mag., Singapore, Jan., 1881; passed final exam., Malay, May, 1882; collr. of land rev., Penang and P.W., Jan., 1882; 2nd mag. of pol., Penang, May, 1883; also offic. assignee under the Bankruptcy Ordinance (Sep., 1882); ag. sen. dist. offr., Butterworth, P.W., Apr., 1890; a.J.P. and coroner for S. Stlitms., and a vis. justice for Penang; offr. in char., Sungei Ujong, Jr., 1893; ag. res., Pahang, May to July, 1894; offic. assignee and regis. of deeds, Singapore, June, 1894; inspr. of prisons, S. Stlitms., May, 1897; dep. pres. mun. comsnr., Singapore, Mar., 1897; 1st m. Penang, Apr., 1897; ag. 1st mag., Singapore, Jul., 1898; ag. res. councillor, Malacca, Mar., 1898; 1st m. Mar., 1899; 1st mag., Singapore, Oct., 1899; continued to act as res. coun.; ag. col. treas., S.S., Nov.-Dec., 1898; ag. col. sec., S.S., Apr., 1899; ag. res. counclr., Penang, Feb. to Apr., 1901; col. treas., S.S., Aug.-Oct., 1902; res., Nag. Sec., Aug., 1902; high comsnr., S. Nigeria, Nov., 1902; and gov't., Lagos, 30th July, 1904; gov't. as comdr.-in-chief of the amalgamated colony as prot. of S. Nigeria, 1st Mar., 1906; represented the African Colonies and Prots. at the Coronation of H.M. King George V., 1911; gov', B. Giana, 5th Mar., 1912; retired, Mar., 1917.

EGGETT, W. H., O.B.E. (1922), I.S.O. (1922).—B. 1862; apptd. after a compet. exam., to head of the lower (now 2nd) div. of the civ. ser. assigned to the C.O., Nov., 1880; promoted to higher grade, 2nd div., Apr., 1896; ast. ast., 6th Apr., 1899; acctnt., 27th Sept., 1915.

EHRHARDT, ALBERT, K.C.—B. 1862; ed. Edwars's High Sch., B.H., and Woror. (Ed. Oxford; graduated with honours in mods. arts., hum., 1886; Inner Tem. schlrshp., comm., 1888; called to bar, 1889; dist. comsnr., Leg., 1896; travelling comsnr. on the E. bindry, Leg., 1897; ag. res. of Ibadan, 1898; ag. treas. and exec. and legis. couns., June, 1900; ag. atty.-sec., Sept., 1900; rly. comsnr. at Aro, June, 1901; ag. treas., Aug., 1901, to Mar., 1902; ag. atty.-sec., Mar. to June, 1902; apptd. res., Ibadan, Feb., 1902; apptd. col. treas., May, 1902; ag. gen. manager ex. and leg. coun., May, 1903; apptd. comsnr. to produce revised edition of ordinances of the colony, 1903; ag. ch. just., May to Oct., 1904; produced revised edition of ordinances, 1906; ag. ch. jus. and ch. jud. comsnr. of W. Pacific Hip. Coms., 1907; chmn. of coman. to inquire into customs duties and admn., 1907; 2nd purs. judge, E.A.P., Apr., 1914; temp. ast. ky. adviser, C.O., 1920.

ELLIOTT COULTON.—B. 1871; comdr. R.N.R. (retired) Assoe. Inst. Naval Architects; ed. at Plympton gram. schl. and H.M.S. "Worcester"; in merchant service to 1898, ex-mast.
