V.

FARRER, ROLAND J.—Ed. at Eton, and Ball Coll., Oxon.; cadet, S. Sttlmts., Nov., 1896; dist. offr., Nibong Tebal, Mar., 1897, to Sept., 1898, to Mar., 1900; ag. collr. land rev., Penang, Mar., 1900; ag. dist. offr., Dinding, May, 1900; ag. supt. educ., Penang, June, Aug., 1900; head of Malay Coll., Malacca, Nov., 1901; ag. 2nd ast. col. sec., June, 1901; ag. offr., Bukit Mertajam, May, 1902; confirmed, July, 1904; ag. dep. pub. proscr., July, 1904; resumed duty as dist. offr., B. Mertajam, Feb., 1905; ag. collr., land revenue, Singapore, Jan., 1908; seconded as municipal assessor, Singapore, Aug., 1911; promoted to class III., 11th Nov., 1911, but remained seconded; ag. British adm. Kelantan, 1915; offr., cls. II., 25th May, 1915; offr., cls. I. B., 1st Jan., 1919; lent to F.S. Govt., 7th Feb., 1919; ag. pres., munic. comnr., Singapore, June, 1919; chmn., Muhamad advisory bd., 1st Jan., 1920; pres., munic. comnr., Singapore, 1st Jan., 1921.

FARRER-MANBY, PERCY ALAN.—B. 1876; ed. at Charterhouse and Trin. Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1898; called to the bar, Inner Temp., 1902; S.E. circuit; seven years practice in land; stip. mag. for Georgetown, B. Gem., Nov., 1909; judicial comnr., F.M.S., 1915; ag. senr. puisne judge, Penang, 1920; ag. ch. jud. comnr., F.M.S., Oct., 1920; June, 1921 and Dec., 1921 to Jan., 1923.

FARROW, ROBINSON RUSSELL.—B. 1847; ed. pub. schls., Huron Co., Ontario; sessional H. of C., Canada, Jan., 1881; clk. dept. agric., June, 1881; transf'd to customs dept., June, 1884; acctnt., customs dept., July, 1884; asst. comnr. of customs, May, 1907; memb. bd. of customs, Sept., 1907; comnr. of customs and deputy min. of inland rev., Oct., 1919; admin., cust. and excise, 1924.

FAULKNER, S.N., O.B.E. (1918).—Assistant E.A.P., 8th Jan., 1909; senr. ast. auditor, ix., 1915; dep. ch. acctnt., Uganda Rly., 1917.

FAWCETT, J. F. ST. A.—Deputy registrar, E.A.P., 1910 regir., high court, Feb., 1911.

FAZAN, S. H.—Ast. dist. comnr., E. Afr. Prot., Nov., 1911; dist. comnr., Kenya, Feb., 1920.

FEETHAM, RICHARD.—B. 1874; ed. Marlborough and New Coll., Oxford; mem. Leg. Temple; called to bar, 1899; deputy townclerk, Johannesburg, 1902-3; town clk., Johannesburg, 1903-5; admitted advoc., Transvaal, 1903; adviser to high comnr. for S. Africa, 1907-1910; 1912-13; K.C., 1919; mem. leg. coun., Transvaal, 1907-10; mem., H. of A., Union of S. Afr., 1915-23; lieut., 1st battn., Cape Corps., 1916-19; mem., Southborough comteo. on Indian Reform and chmn. functions comteo., 1918-19; mem., India Office comteo. on Govt. of India Bill, 1919; ag. pres., sup. ct. of Swaziland, 1922-23; jojo sup. ct., Transvaal Prov. Divn., 16th Aug., 1923.

FEIJX-JONES, IVOR, B.A.—B. 1859; ed. Westminster and Trinity Hall, Cambridge; ed. educn. dept., N. Provs., Nigeria, 8th Mar., 1922.

FELL, T. E., C.M.G. (1918).—Ed. Royal Grammar Schl., Lancaster, and Owens Coll., Manche ster, and Pembroke Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1875; ch. clk., C.S.O., G. Coast, 1897; ag. ast. col. sec.
lept., 1899; inspr., customs preventive service, Dec., 1899; trav. commr., 16th June, 1902; in charge nat. affs. dept., 16th June to 26th Nov., 902; ag. astt. col. sec., Nov., 1902, to Jan., 1903; n charge nat. affs. dept., Feb. to June, 1903; ag. ec. for nat. affs., 29th Dec., 1903 to 14th June, 1904; ag. commr., Eastern Prov., 12th July, 1904; attd. to C.S.O., 24th Aug., 1904; ist. commr., Ashanti, 1905; prov. commr., shanti, 1907; col. sec., Barbados, 1916; adminstr. ov't., May to Sept., 1918; col. sec., Fiji, 1919; ov.'s dep., 22nd Aug.-3rd Oct., 1919; ag. gov', 9th May, 1920; ag. gov., Fiji and high commr. or W. Pacific, 24th May, 1921 to 25th Mar., 1922 and from 18th Jan., 1924.

FELLING, C. L. N., C.M.G.—S. African Ilya.; seconded to Kenya as gen. man., Uganda Ilya., Dec., 1922; mem., leg. coun.

FENN, JOHN CYRIL DOUGLAS, C.M.G. (1924).—B. 1879; ed. at Marlborough Coll.; ast. treas., Gold Coast, Nov., 1903; resigned, Dec., 1906; re-apptd., Jan., 1908; sen. ast. treas., June, 1908; retired, Apr., 1909; acctnt., reasy., Cyprus, May, 1910; astt. treas., kpr., 1913; ag. treas., June to Nov., 1913, nd. Apr. to Oct., 1915; chief astt. sec., Nov., 913; ag. chief sec., from 29th Aug., 1916, to 5th May, 1917; ag. treas., Dec., 1917, to Mar., 918; registr.-gen. and dir. of surveys, Ist. Sept., 918; ag. chief sec. to govt., Nov., 1918, to Sept., 919; apptd. Br. deleg. of evkaf., 1st Aug., 1919; g. treas., June to Oct., 1920; ag. chief sec. to ov't., Dec., 1919, to Aug., 1920; chief sec., 25th ug., 1920; admstrd. govt. 27th Oct., 1920 to 3rd eb., 1921, 17th to 23rd Mar., 1921, 14th May to 7th June, 1922, 27th June to 3rd Nov., 1922, 7th June to 13th Oct., 1923, and 27th June to 3rd Sept., 1924.

FENTON, JAMES STEVENSON.—B. 1891; ed. undee High Sch. and Edinburgh Univ., M.A. (Edin.); war service, Mesopotamia 1917-19; assd progress exam. in Mendi; astt. dist. mannr., Sierra Leone, 28th Apr., 1915.

FENWICK, CAPT. F. G.—Astt. dist. commr., Kenya, May, 1920.

FERGUSON, DAVID GILBERT.—B. 1861; called to the bar, 1890; judge of sup. ct., New S. Vales, Mar., 1912.

FERGUSON, HON. GEORGE HOWARD, B.A., L.B.—B. 1870; ed. Kemptville, Ont., High ch., Toronto Univ. and Osgoode Hall; called to ar., 1894; el. to Ont. legis., g.e., 1905; re-el., e., 1908, 1911, 1914, 1919 and 1923; leader of conservative party since 1920; premier of Ont., 923.

FERGUSON, HERBERT, C.B.E., (1924).—B. 374; ed. Perth and Edinburgh; apptd. after impt. exam. to Imp. civ. serv., inland rev. sept., 1893; col. treas., Grenada, Nov., 1909; g. col. sec. and admin., Apr. to July, 1914, col. sec., July 1915; represented Windward Is. at Canada—W. Indies confec., Ottawa, June, 1920; imstd. govt. on various occasions between 1915 nd 1924.

FERGUSON, HON. WILLIAM NASSAU.—B. 69; ed. at Upper Canada Coll. and Osgoode all, Toronto; called to the bar, 1894; practised a profession at Toronto; K.C., 1908; bencher the Law Society of Upper Canada, 1915; justice appeal, sup. ct., Ontario, 4th Dec., 1916.

FERGUSSON, GEN. SIR CHARLES, BART., C.M.G. (1924); K.C.B. (1915); K.C.M.G. (918); C.B. (1911); M.V.O. (1906); D.S.O. (898), D.L., J.P.—B. 1865; ed. Eton and Sand- drat; joined Grenadier Guards, 1883; adjutant, 1890-94; joined Egyptian Army, 1895; Sudanese campaigns, 1896-98; severely wounded, Rosaires (med. with eight clasps, ment. five times in desps.); commanded 15th Sudanese, 1899(2nd cls. Medjidie); garrison and dist., Omdurman, 1900; adjt.-gen., Egyptian Army, 1901-3; commanded 3rd Batt. Grenadier Guards, 1904-7; brig.-gen., gen. staff, Irish commd., 1907-8; inspr., infy., 1909-13; served European War, 1914-18; in commd., 5th divn. and subsequently of 2nd and 17th Army Corps; mily. gov., occupied German territory, 1918-19 (seven times ment. in desps.); gov. and commdr.-in-ch., New Zealand, 20th Oct., 1921; assumed govt., 13th Dec., 1924.

FERNANDO, SIR HILARION MARCUS, KT. BACH. (1923), M.D., B.Sc. (Lond.), Fellow of Univ. Coll. (London); J.P.—B. 1864; ed. at the Royal Coll., Colombo, and Univ. Coll., Lond.; Ceylon Govt. Univ. Scholar and Gilchrist Scholar for the East, 1882-83; 2nd medical entrance scholar, Univ. Coll., 1884; Atchison scholar, 1888, 1st. cls. hons. and gold medal, physiology, medicine, and forensic medi- cine (Univ. of London); astt. off. surg. and regis., Ceylon med. coll., 1890; 1st physician, general hosp., and lecturer in medicine, Ceylon med. coll., 1898; reported on outbreak of malaria in Galle, 1894, and plague in Bombay, 1897, (rec. thanks of govt.); ret. from govt. serv., 1909; served on Colombo lake development, railway traffic, education, opium, prevention of tubercu- losis, and several other commissions and comites. of enquiry (1909-1918); nominated mem. of legis. coun. of Ceylon as the first low-country Sinhalese representative, Jan., 1917; nom. unoffl. mem., leg. coun., 1921; ditto, exec. coun., 1924.

FERNANDO, PETER OLIVIER.—B. 1898; cadet Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1921; attd. to Kurunegalla Kachcheri, Dec., 1921; ditto, Batticaloa Kachcheri, Feb., 1922; ditto, Jaffna Kachcheri, Mar., 1923; pol. mag., Puttalam, Apr., 1924.

FERREIRA, P. J., C.M.G. (1880).—Was comdt. of local cavalry in the Transvaal against Sikukuni.

FESTING, RICHARD ARTHUR GRINDALL.—B. 1875; ed. Clifton, and scholar of Queen's Coll., Oxford (B.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1899; off. astt. to govt. agt., C. Prov., June, 1901; Oct., 1902; ag. astt. govt. agt., Nuwara Eliya, July, 1902; astt. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Jan., 1903; Matale, Feb., 1906; Nuwara Eliya, Feb., 1909; ag. govt. agt., Prov. of Uva, in addition to own duties, May to July, 1912; ag. govt. agt., E. Prov., Apr., 1914; astt. govt. agt., Kalutara, June, 1914; ag. govt. agt., N. Prov., Sept., 1914; astt. govt. agt., Kalutara, Jan., 1915; ag. govt. agt., E. Prov., June, 1916; govt. agt., Uva, Oct., 1921.

FIDDES, SIR GEORGE VANDELEUR, G.C.M.G. (1917), K.C.M.G. (1912), C.B. (1901), C.M.G. (1905), B.A.—B. 1838; ed. at Dulwich Coll., and late scholar of Brasenose Coll., Oxford; 2nd cls. class. moda., 1879; apptd., after compet. exam., to be a clk. in the office of the sec. of state for the cols., 25th Mar., 1881; priv. sec. to Earl of Onslow, Feb., 1887; and to Baron H. de Worms (afterwards Lord Pirbright), Feb., 1888, to Aug., 1892; priv. sec. to Sir R. Meade, 11th Mar., 1896; 1st class clk., 1896; imperial sec. and acctnt. to Sir A. Milner, high commr. for S. Africa, Sept., 1897; political sec. to Lord Roberts at Pretoria, June, 1900; sec. to the Transvaal administration, Dec., 1900; returned to C. O., 1902, as prin. clk.; accounting offr., 1907; astt. under-sec. of state, 20th June,
1909; chmn., West African currency board, 1912-1916; perm. under-sec. of state for the colonies; 10th Mar., 1916; sec. to the Order of St. Michael and St. George; ret., 1921.

FIDDIAN, ALEXANDER.—B. 1875; ed. Univ. Coll., Cardiff, and Oxford; schlr. Pembroke Coll., 1893; 1st class classical honours, 1896; Goldsmiths' co. exhibn., 1895; 1st class lit. hum., 1897; B.A., 1897; apptd., after compet. exam. 2nd class clk., C.O., Oct. 12th, 1897; astv. priv. sec. to Rt. Hon. Alfred Lyttelton, S. of S. for the colonies, 1st Apr., 1905; ditto to Earl of Elgin, Dec., 1906; 1st cls. elk., Jan., 1907; mem. of deptnl. comtee. on W. African med. staff, 1909; principal elk., 1st Nov., 1917; astv. sec., 1st Apr., 1920.

FIELD, EDGAR JOHN.—B. 1874; ed. pub. schls. and Christian Brothers' Coll., Adelaide; ent. survey dept., S. Australia, Jan., 1891; elk., office of comnwr. of crown lands, 1892; ch. elk. and scot., 1909; ch. imigrn. offr., 1911; sec. for lands, chmn. of advances to settlers bd. and recr. of rents, 2nd Apr., 1917, chmn., irrign. comn., S. Aust., 1923.

FIELDGATE, ALAN FREDERIC EDMOND, B.A. (Oxon).—B. 1889; ed. Worcester Coll., Oxford; astv. dist. comnwr., Gold Coast Colony, 28th Apr., 1915.

FIELDING, THE RT. HON. WILLIAM STEVENS, P.C. (1923), D.C.L., LL.D.—B. 1848; mem. for Halifax, Nova Scotia assem., 1882; declined premiership, but entered govt. without office in that year, and continued in that position till May, 1884, when he resig.; premier, provincial sec., and treas., Aug., 1884; min. of finance in Sir W. Laurier's admnstr., June, 1896; deleg. to Col. Conf., London, 1902; one of H.M.'s plenipotentiaries for negotiation of Franco-Canadian treaty, 1907; one of the Royal Comnwsrs. to inquire into trade relations between Canada and Brit. W. Indies, 1909; del. to Washington to discuss proposed reciprocity agreement, 1911; defeated at g. e. 1911; re-elec., g. e., 1917 and 1921; min. of finance in King admnstr., 29th Dec., 1921; del. to League of Nations Assem., 1922.

FIENNES, LIEUT.-COL. THE HON. SIR EUSTACE EDWARD TWISLETON-WYKEHAM, BART.—B. 1864; Lieut.-Col., Oxford Imp. Yeo.; served Riel rebellion, 1885 (medal with clasp); Egypt, 1887 and 1888 (medal with clasp, bronze star); pioneer expdn. to Mashonaland, 1890; South Africa, 1900 (medal with three clasps; twice ment. in desps.); European war, 1914 (France, Belgium, Dardanelles and Home); M.P. (L.) Banbury div. of Oxfordshire, 1906-1910, and 1910-1918; gov. and comdr-in-chief, Seychelles, 6th July, 1918; assumed govt., 8th Oct., 1918; gov., Leeward Is., 29th Oct., 1921; assumed govt., 4th Dec., 1921.

FIIFI, LOUIS ANTHONY.—B. 1864; entd. civ. ser., Trinidad, 1887; dep. regisr.-gen., 26th Oct., 1910; also supt. regisr., births and deaths, Port of Spain; has acted as regisr.-gen. on several occasions.

FILLEUL, P. R.—Astv. dist. comnwr., E.A.P., 1910; dist. comnwr., Kenya, June, 1918.

FINLAY, GEORGE HUGO.—B. 1888 ed.; Repton and Oriel Coll., Oxford; B.A. (Hons. Mod. Hist.); astv. dist. offr., Southern Nigeria, 1911.

FINLAY, HON. SIR JOHN GEORGE, K.C.M.G. (1910); LL.D. K.C.—Atty.-gen. and col.sec., New Zealand, Nov., 1906; attended Imp. Conf., 1911; resigned, 1911.

FINLAY, ACHESON ARUNDEL CAMERON, I.S.O. (1917).—3rd cls. elk., collr.-gen.'s off., Jamaica, 1st Feb., 1891; 3rd cls. elk., col.sec.'s off., 1st Feb., 1894; 2nd lieut., Jamaica militia, 14th Sept., 1898; lieut., 25th Aug., 1898; A.D.C. to ag. gov. Olivier, 3rd July, 1900; 2nd cls. elk., col.sec.'s off., 1st July, 1901; sec., bd. of visitors, industrial schls. and reform torics, 1st July, 1901, to 31st Dec., 1902; ag. su offr., Jamaica militia, 1st Aug. to 31st Dec., 1902; priv. sec. and A.D.C. to ag. gov. Olivier, 29th Nov., 1902; ag. supt., govt. printing off., 15th May, 1903; one of the compilers of the Jamaica Handbook, Dec., 1902, to Oct., 1906; capt., Jamaica militia, 16th Sept., 1902; ag. elk. of privy coun., Oct., 1903; A.D.C. to ag. gov. Olivier, 26th May, 1904; ag. supt., govt. printing off., July to Nov., 1904; astv. col. sec., G. Coast, 6th Oct., 1906; ag. elk. astv. col. sec. and elk. of couns. in 1909, 1911 and 1912; sen. astv. col. sec., 1st Jan., 1913; ag. ch. astv. col. sec. and elk. of couns. for various periods, 1914-19; elk. of couns., 17th July, 1919; ch. astv. col. sec., 4th May, 1920; ag. col. sec. for various periods, 1921-24; gov.'s dep. for various periods, 1922-24.

FINLAYSON, GEORGE ALEXANDER.—Bacteriologist, Singapore, May, 1903; pathologist, Nov., 1906; ag. prin., S. Stltlms., and F.M.S. Med. schl., Mar., 1907; mem., S. Stltlms., F.M.S. med. coun., Jan., 1908; del. to Hongkong med. confere., Jan., 1912; seconded for spe. on anti-malarial work, Mar., 1912; del. to Saigon med. congress, Nov., 1913; capt., R.A.M.C., Egypt, Sept., 1915; ag. ch. med. offr., gen. hos. in addition, Jan., 1917; mem., S. Stltlms., F.M.S. med coun., Jan., 1917.

FINLAYSON, GEORGE DANIEL.—B. 1868; ed. Pictou Acad. and Dalhousie Univ.; B.A., 1897; apptd. to dept. of insurance, Ont., 1907; associate of Inst. of Actuaries of Great Britain, 1911; supt. of insurance, Canada, 1914; dep. min. of insurance, 1924.

FINN, BASIL ARTHUR.—B. 1888; ed. at Alleyne's Sch., Dulwich and Wadham Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1912, 2nd cls. mod. hist.; astv. dist. offr., N. Provinces, Nigeria, 29th Apr., 1914; attached to Eastern dept., C.O., 20th Dec., 1914; to 19th Mar., 1919; ag. astv. col. sec., Gambia, 17th May, 1919; ag. col. sec. for various periods, 1919-24; astv. col. sec., 17th Feb., 1920.

FIRR, TOM FREEMAN, A.M.I.C.E.—Ed. Crystal Palace Engng. Sch.; 1st astv. surtn., Nsw. Land Prot., June, 1903; astv. dir. of pub. wks., 1914.

FISET, MAJOR-GEN. SIR EUGENE, KT. B.T. (1917), C.M.G. (1916), D.S.O., G.H.S., R.M.D.—B. 1874; apptd. staff, adjt. med. corp., Canada, 1902; dir.-gen., med. services, 1903; dep. min. of militia and defence, vice-prsd. of the militia coun. since 1906; recd. D.S.O. in service in S. Africa; mentioned in despatches.

FISHER, RT. HON. ANDREW, P.C. (1911); B. 1862; M.L.A. for Gympie, Queensland, 1893 and 1899; sec. for rly.s. and min. of pub. wks., 1899; returned to first H. of R., C. of A., 1901; re-elected 1903 and 1906; min. for trade and cust., 1906; deputy leader of Federal Labour Party; chmn. Labour party, 1907; prime min. and treas., C. of A., 1908-9, Apr., 1910—June, 1913; represented C. of A. at the Coronation of H.M. King George V. and at Imp. Conf., 1911; prime min., C. of A., Sept., 1914, to Oct., 1916; high comnwr. in London for Commonwealth of Australia, Jan., 1916; mem. of comtee. for settlmt. of ex-service men within the Empire, 1917; ret., 1920.

FISHER, JOHN CAMPBELL, O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1880; ed. at Oakham Schl. and Sid. Sum. Coll., Cambridge; elk., coll. audit branch, exchequer audit dept., 14th July, 1903; astv. auditor, Lega...
h Sept., 1903; detached for duty in N. Nigeria, Nov., 1903; asst. auditor, N. Nigeria, 30th l., 1905; local auditor, 24th July, 1909; examnr., audit branch, E. and A. dept., 1st Feb., 1910; div. clk. (2nd cls.), central office, 1st May, 0; auditor, Malta, 17th Mch., 1913; mem. of trol board and head of food and commerce trol office, Malta, 1917; senr. clk., central io, 1st May, 1918.

ISHER, SIR STANLEY, KT. BACH. (1922).—at Westminster and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; l., 1891; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple and coln's Inn (called 1890); apptd. pres. of dist. of Kyrena, Cyprus, May, 1902; puisne judge, prus, 1911; ch. just., Cyprus, 1919; on sp. sion to Cairo under F.O., 24th Jan. to 14th r., 1924; ch. just., Trinidad, 1924; passed m. in modern Greek, Dec. 1903 and in arkish, 1918; joint commr. for compiling ised edition of Statute Laws of Cyprus (published 1907) for which recd. thanks of m. coun. and S. of S.; joint commr. under rint of statutes law, 1913; edition pub- lished, Feb., 1914; commr. for laws, under rint of statutes law, 1922; edition published, 4; compiler of "The Mukhtar's Handbook," 1; published "Ottoman Land Laws," 1919.

ISHER, V. M.—Medical offr., E.A.P., Mar., 9.

ISHLOCK, WALTER CHARLES.—Trained at ral Gardens, Kew; agric. instructor, Virgin Apr., 1902; mem. exec. coun., 1903; mem. rantine bd., 1906; mem. bd. of health, 1906; , 1908; ag. commr. and dep. judge, summary s. ct., Virgin Is., 7th May to 5th July, 7.

ITCHETT, WILLIAM HERBERT.—Ck., agric. r., Cape Colony, 22nd Feb., 1895; ck. to r., R.M., Wodehouse, 27th Sept., 1898; Elizabeth, 23rd Oct., 1899; Coleburg, 16th r., 1900; Britstown, 16th Aug., 1901; acted C.C. and R.M., Britstown, 1902; asst. regis., h. c., and chief ck. to the sheriff of the R.C., 29th July, 1902; acted as regis. and riff in 1903 and 1904; regis. and sheriff, S.I., 1st Aug., 1921.

ITZGERALD, BRYAN.—B. 1878; 3rd clerical , chief commissary's off., B. Guiana, Aug., 3; 6th cl. clk., audit dept., May, 1896; 5th clk., Nov., 1896; ag. clk. of ct. and gold offr., t. of mines, Bartica, and navigation offr., for Essequibo and its tributaries, Nov., 1900, to r., 1901, and May to July, 1901; clk. of ct., entyne Coast judicial dist., Nov., 1901; J.P., r., 1902; 4th cls. clk., G.P.O., Feb., 1904; elk., Berbice judi. dist., Apr., 1904; J.P., 1907; , postmr., G. Coast, Dec., 1907; 2nd cls. super- r., oust., 11th Mar., 1909; 1st cls. supervisor, k., 30th Nov., 1911; senr. collr., 1st Jan., 1.

ITZGERALD, T.—F.M.S. postal service; P.M.G., Kenya, July, 1920; P.M.G., Jan., 2.

ITZ-GIBBON, WILLIAM GUERRIN.—B.A., al Univ. of Ireland; B. 1886; entd. serv. of woolon-Canton Ry. (British Section), 1913; 1st colonial secretariat, Hong Kong, 1917; ag. clk., colonial secretariat, 1921; J.P., 1924.

ITZMAURICE, ALEXANDER LINDSAY—L.C.S., L.R.C.P. (1909); M.B., B.S. (Lond.), late out-patient offr., asst. house surg., and physician, Guy's Hosp.; med. offr. Somali- Prof., 1914.

ITZPATRICK, RIGHT HON. SIR CHARLES, (1908); G.C.M.G. (1911); K.C.M.G. (1907).—Born in Quebec, 1863; Dufferin medallist, law faculty, Laval Univ., 1876; one of the counsel for the defence of Louis Riel at Regina in 1886; elected to Quebec legislature, 1890; to Dominion parl., 1896, again in 1900 and 1904; solr.-gen., Canada, 1896; min. of just., 1902; ch. just. of Canada, 1906-1918; mem. of Hague tribunal of arbitration, 1908; lieut.-gov. of Quebec, 1918 to 1923.

FITZPATRICK, JAMES PATRICK, L.R.C.P.I. and L.R.C.S.I.—House Surg., Jervis St. Hosp., Dublin, Jan. to June, 1914; med. serv., R.A.M.C., 1915-17; med. offr., med. dept., F.M.S., 11th Nov., 1921; ag. health offr., Tamplin, Dec., 1921; med. offr., Taiping, May, 1922.

FITZPATRICK, CAPT. JOSEPH FREDERIC JOHN LEITH.—B. 1882; ed. Ratcliffe Coll., Leicestershire; served as private with infantry C.I.V., S. African war, 1900; later as lieut. attached to Essex regt.; asst. res., Northern Nigeria, 13th April, 1907; capt. 3rd V.B. Essex Regt., 1907 to 1910; dist. offr., 2nd cls., N. Nigeria, 1st Jan., 1914; served in Cameroons Exped. Force, 1914; invalided, 1915; ment. in des., temp. capt. in Army, Nov., 1917; served in France, 1918; granted rank of capt., June, 1919.

FLANAGAN, MAURICE JOSEPH, B.A. (Cantab.).—Asst. audr., S. Nigeria, Nov., 1912; audr., Cameroons Expedy. Force, 1916; audr., Windward Is., June, 1919.

FLAVIN, FRANK.—B. 1888; Imp. posts and tel., July, 1905; postmst., Nyassaland, 26th Sept., 1919; ag. asst. postmst.-gen., Mar., 1922 to Feb., 1923; asst. postmst.-gen., 3rd Feb., 1923.

FLEISCHER, HENRY CECIL.—B. 1872; clk., mines dept., Transvaal, 1900; principal clk., 1901; dep. asst. regis. of mining rights, 1903; asst. regis., 1903; regis. of mining rights, 1908; served on Vredefort stands comm., transfer duty comtee., board for regulation of trading on mining ground, township board, regis. of mining titles and Rand townships, regis. of underground mining rights (Bewaarplaateen Comm.), 1909; mem., pub. serv. comm., Oct., 1921.

FLEMING, EDWARD DONOVAN.—B. 1898; ed. Bradford Gram. Schl. and Jesus Coll., Camb.; 2nd lieut., R.G.A., Sept., 1917; Salonika, Dec., 1917-Feb., 1919; cadet, F.M.S., Apr., 1921; sent to Canton to study Chinese, Dec., 1921; attd. Chinese prot., Mar., 1924; offr., cls. V., Apr., 1924; attd., cust. dept., Apr., 1924.

FLEMING, ERNEST.—B. 1891; 5th class clk., crown agts. office, Oct., 1910; appfd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd division of the civ. serv. and temporarily employed in the Bd. of Trade, Jan., 1912; assigned to C.O., April, 1912; on military service from 26th May, 1915 to 9th Feb., 1919; cler. offr., higher grade, 1st Apr., 1922.

FLEMING, W. P.—B. 1887; appfd. after compet. exam., S. and T. clk., G.P.O.; lent to C.O., 9th May, 1921; cler. offr., C.O., 1st Sept., 1921; on mil. serv., 4th Apr., 1915 to 4th May, 1919.

FLETCHER, ARTHUR GEORGE MURCHISON, C.M.G. (1922), C.B.E. (1919).—Ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Trin. Coll., Oxford (exhiblr.); cadet, Hong Kong, 1901; seconded for famine relief work in Kwang Si, May-June, 1903; ag. asst. regis. gen., 1903-4; J.P., 1904; ag. asst. col. sec. and clk. of couns., 1906-8; priv. sec. to O.A.G., 1907; dep. offr. recvr., 1909; asst. to atty-gen., 1909; regis. of trade marks and letters patent, 1910; ag. assessor of rates, 1911; ag. dep. regis., 1911; priv. sec. to O.A.G., 1912; offr. recvr., 1912; ag. asst. col. sec. and clk. of
couns., 1912; ag. treasr., 1913; asst. col. sec. and clk. of couns., Aug., 1913; priv. sec. to O.A.G., and to gov., Aug.-Dec., 1913; ag. col. sec. and mem. of exec. and leg. couns. in 1916, 1917, 1918, 1919, 1920 and 1922; chmn., shipping control comttee., 1917-19; priv. sec. gov., to 1918; ag. col. sec. and mem., exec. and leg. couns., 1923.

FLETCHER, Wm., D.S.O.—Surgeon, capt. militia med. staff corps; 6 mos. in 1898 attached to regulars at R.A.M.C. depot, Aldershot; med. offr., Niger Coast Prot. (now So. Nigeria), 1898; served with Ashanti expdn., 1900 (medal and clasp); Aro expdn., 1901-2 (medal and clasp).

FLETCHER, WILLIAM.—B. 1872; ed. Caius Coll., Camb., and St. Mary's Hosp., London; B.A., 1893; M.B., B.C., 1896; M.D. 1910; Univ. Schol., St. Mary's Hosp., 1893; Cragg's research prizeman, London Schol. of Trop. Med., 1909; dist. surg., F.M.S., 1905; pathologist, Inst. for Med. Research, K. Lumpur, 1909; temp. lieut., R.A.M.C., 1915; capt., 1916-18; specialist in bacteriology, R.A.M.C.; bacteriologist, Inst. for Med. Research, K. Lumpur, 1920; author of articles on beri-beri, malaria, dysentery, enterics, leprosy, syphilis, influenza, etc.

FLEURY, CAPT. A. M.—Second lieut., 3rd Royal Irish Fusiliers, May, 1900; capt., May, 1906; lieut., W.A.F.F., July, 1900; Ashanti campaign (medal), 1900; dist. comntr., N. Territories, G. Coast, Jan., 1907; local comm., Cyprus mil. police, Feb., 1910; comntr., Famagusta, Cyprus, Nov., 1915.

FLINN, MAJOR WILLIAM HENRY, O.B.E. (1919).—B. 1895; ed. St. Andrew's Coll. and Trinity Coll., Dublin; Royal Irish Regt. and staff, 1914-19; adminstr. offr., Nigeria, Sept., 1919; asst. sec., ch. sec.'s office, Cyprus, Mar., 1921; A.D.C. and priv. sec. to H. Comsrr., 14th Apr., 1921; ag. clk., exec. coun., Feb.-Mar., 1922; passed exam. in mod. Greek, Apr., 1922; ag. ch. asst. sec., July, 1922; ag. comntr., Sept., 1922; ag. ch. asst. sec., June to July, 1923; ag. regiar., co-op. societies, June, 1923; regiar., co-op. societies, July, 1923; ag. regiar., co-op. credit societies, June, 1923 to Apr., 1924 and Oct. to Dec., 1924; ag. ch. asst. sec., Apr., 1924 and Oct. to Dec., 1924.

FLOOD, J. E. W.—B. 1886; ed. at Portora Royal Schol., Enniskillen, and Trin. Coll., Dublin, B.A. (scholar univ. student); apptd. after compet. exam., 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 10th Oct., 1910; sec., edible nuts comttee., 1916; 1st cls. clk., 15th Oct., 1918; on military service from 16th Apr., 1917 to 7th Dec., 1918; prin., 1st Apr., 1920.

FLOWERS, HON. F.—M.L.C., New South Wales, since 1900; vice-chmn. of parly. standing comttee. on pub. wks., 1904; chmn., 1907; vice-pres. of exec. coun., Oct., 1910; min. of pub. health, 1914; now pres. of legis. coun.

FLYNN, HON. EDMUND JAMES.—B. 1847; ed. Quebec Seminary and Laval Univ. (L.L. 1873); admitted to Queb. bar, 1873; prof. of Roman law in Laval Univ., 1874-1914; LL.D., Laval 1878; is dean of law faculty; practised as advoc. in Queb. City; mem., Queb. legislature for Gaspe, 1878-1900 when elected for Nicolet Co.; comntr., crown lands, Chapleau adminstr., 1879-1882; comntr. of rlys., and solr. gen., Ross adminstr., 1884-87; comntr., crown lands, de Boucherville gov't. from 1891-96; prime min. and comntr. of pub. wks., May, 1896 to May, 1897; leader of opposition, 1897 to 1904; retired from Queb. legislature 1904; Q.C. by Dom. gov't., 1887 subsequently by Queb. gov't.; batonnier of Queb. bar, 1907-09; apptd. judge of superior ct., Jun., 1914; promoted to ct. of king's bench, Jul., 1920.

FOLLOWS, CHARLES GEOFFREY SHIELD.—B. 1896; ed. Wellington; 2nd lieut., The King's (Liverpool) Regt., 1914; served in France, 1915-18, latterly as adjt.; on staff, 1918 and 1919; attached to H.Q., Southern dist., Ireland, in H.Q., Aldershott command; priv. sec. to gov. of Seychelles and clk. to couns., 1920.

FOLLWELL, EDGAR NELSON.—B. 1875; storekeeper, marine dept., N. Nigeria, 11th Jul., 1911; on amalgamation of N. and S. Nigeria appended, asst. acctnt., 1914; paymr., lieut.-comdr., Nigerian Marine Contingent, 1915-18; acctnt., Nigeria, 1916; ag. ch. acctnt., 1919, 1921 and 1922; senr. acctnt., 1920.

FOORD, FRANCIS LATTON.—B. 1874; served in Cape Mounted Rifles, S. African War, 1899-1902; lieut., 1st S. Staffs. regt.; sub-instr., Basutoland Mounted Pol., 1902; inspr., 1913; asst. comntr., 1914; accompanied Beauto depattions to England in 1909 and 1919; mem., poor white comm., 1918.

FORAN, WILLIAM.—B. 1871; entered civ. serv., Canada, 1890; 2nd cls. clk., 1894; sec., bd. of crit. ser. examns., 1895; 1st cls. clk., 1906; sec. of crit. ser. comntr., 1908.

FORBES, HARRY.—B. 1873; cust. dept., Fiji, 1911; clk. of peace, Rewa, Fiji, 1914-18; J.P., 1915; cashier, treas., 1918; ag. acct., Gilbert & Elllice Coll., 20th June, 1921; ag. treas., ch. postmr. and collr. of cust., June-Dec., 1922; acct., Br. residency, New Hebrides, 7th Aug., 1923.

FORBES, LESLIE.—B. 1889; B.A., Oxon. (lis. hum.), 1913; cadet, F.M.S., 1913; lent to Kedah gov't., 1914; sec. to adviser, Kedah, 1916; dist. offr., Tampin, Dec., 1920; dist. offr., (Tu Kelantan, June, 1922; dist. offr., Kuala Selangor, Apr., 1923.

FORD, P. C.—Asst. loco. supt., Uganda rly., 1912; workshops man., 1914.

FORD, SIR THEODORE THOMAS, KT. BACH. (1888).—B. 1829; called to the bar, Middle Temp., 1866; puisne judge, S. Sttltns., Mar., 1874; ag. judge of Penang, 1874, to Apr., 1875; resig. and returned to England; re-apptd. senior puisne judge, 1876; ch. justice, 1886; ret., 1889.

FORMAN, MAURICE BUXTON.—Cape tele. serv., 24th Feb., 1894; trans. to stores branch, Is Nov., 1894; clk., foreign mails dept., 1st Jan., 1896; prin. clk., ditto, 1st June, 1906; prin. ch. clk.'s office, 1st July, 1908; prin. clk., te. mails branch, 1st Oct., 1910; prin. clk., postm. gen.'s office, 1st Jan., 1913; prin. clk., staff branch, 24th Jan., 1920; ag. ch. clk., 13th Aug., 1920; ch. clk., 5th Aug., 1921; asst. sec., Nov., 1923.

FORRER, HENRY AUGUSTUS, B.A. Cantab.—B. 1886; cadet S. Sttltns., 22nd Oct., 1909; ag. 2nd asst. prot. of Chinese, 5th Dec., 1912; ag. asst. dist. judge and 4th mag., Singapore, 9th Jan., 1913; ag. dist. offr., Christmas Island, 19th Mar., 1913; passed cadet, 3rd Aug., 1913; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, 5th Sept., 1913; supernumerary offr. of cls. V., 12th Mar., 1914; ag. temporarily as 2nd mag., Singapore, 23rd Mar., 1914; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, 16th May, 1914; attached to censor's office, 16th May, 1915; ag. dist. offr., Christmas Island, 1st July, 1915; services lent to the F.M.S., 12th Jan., 1917; ag. 2nd mag., Kinta, 23rd Jan., 1917; ag. asst. dist. offr., Larut, 1st Nov., 1917; offr., cls. IV., 1st Jan., 1919; 2nd mag., Kuala Lumpur, July,
FORREST, ARTHUR ERIC E.—B. 1892; asst. auditor, E. Africa Prot., July, 1915; on active service, Oct., 1915 to Dec., 1916; asst. auditor in charge, Somaliland, 1917; ag. senr. asst. auditor, E. Africa Prot., Dec., 1917 to Apr., 1919, Nov., 1919 to Jan., 1920; asst. auditor in charge, Zanzibar, Feb., 1920; senr. asst. audr., Kenya, Jan., 1922.

FORREST, R. A. D.—B. 1893; ed. Aberdeen Univ.; cadet, Hong Kong, Oct., 1919; passed naval exam. in Cantonese, 10th Jan., 1922.

FORSTER, BARON (cr. 1919), Rt. Hon. HENRY WILLIAM, P.C. (1917), G.C.M.G. (1920).—L.—B. 1866; ed. Eton and New Coll., Oxford; I.P., Sevenoaks, Kent, 1892-1919; a lord commr. f the treasury, 1902-05; finan. sec. to the W.O., 1915-19; mem. of army council; gov.gen. and omdr. in chief, Commonwealth of Austr., 23rd July, 1920; assumed govt., 6th Oct., 1920.

FORSTER, LANCELOT, B.A. (Lond.)—B. 1882; st. mast., (edun. dept.) Hong Kong, 1914; st. mast., cl. II., Jan., 1920; seconded as prof. f edun., Hong Kong univ., 1920.

FOSDIKE, ALFRED ERNEST.—Served in techuanaland Prot. pol., 1907-1917; contrlr. of stores, 1917.

FOSTER, RIGHT HON. SIR GEORGE E., P.C. (U.K.) (1916); G.C.M.G. (1918); K.C.M.G. (1914).—A.D., D.C.L., LL.D.—B. 1847; ed. Superior Schls. and Univ. of New Brunswick, Edinburgh and Heidelberg; prof. of classics, Univ., N.B., 1873-1877; elec. to H. of C., Canada, 1882, for electoral dist. of Kingston, N.B.; min. of marine and sherias, 1885; re-elec., 1887 and 1891 for same constituency; 1896 for York Co., N.B.; 1904 for North Toronto, Ontario; re-elec. 1908, 1911 and 1917 for same constituency; min. of finance in Sir John A. Macdonald's govt., 1888 to 1891, and in govt.s of Sir John Thompson, Sir John Abbott, Sir Mackenzie Bowell and Sir Charles Tupper from 1891-1896; min. of trade and commerce in Sir Borden's govt., 1911; ditto in National govt., Oct., 1917; mem. of Dominions royal comm., 1912; mem. of the Peace Conf. at Versailles, 1919, as joint representative of the Dominion of Canada; del. to League of Nations assem., Nov., 1920; resig. portfolio and called to the senate of Canada, 22nd Sept., 1921.

FOSTER, R. S.—B. 1894, Apptd. after compet. exam. clk. of the 2nd div. of the civil service; temporarily employed at Nat. Hi'th. Insurance Comnr., Mar., 1913 to June, 1914; assigned to L.O., June, 1914; on military service from 1st Aug., 1914, to 6th Jan., 1919; asst. auditor, Gold Coast, Jan., 1920.

FOSTER, HON. RICHARD WITTY.—Mem. of H. f Assem., S. Australia, 1893 to 1906; Commr. f pub. wks., 1899; ditto, and min. of industry, 1902-1904; ditto, and min. of agric., 1st March to 6th July, 1905; mem. of H. of R., C. of A., 1909; min. of wks. and rly.s., 1921-3.

FOSTER, ROBERT SPEKE, M.A. (Oxon.)—B. 1891; ed. Magdalen Coll. Schl. and St. Edmund's Hall, Oxford; 2nd lieut., K.S.L.I., 1915; K.A.R., 1917-18; head mast., educn. dept., Tanganyika territory, 1922; ag. dir., educn., Aug. to Oct., 1924.

FOWLER, JAMES ROBINSON.—B. 1875; ed. Bathmines Schl. and Trinity Coll., Dublin; 1st Hebrew Sizar, 1894; 1st entrance prize Eng. hist. and mod. geog., 1894; prizeman in classics and Eng. lit., 1896; Hebrew, 1896; second of first honours in classics, 1896; scholar in classics, 1899; 1st junr. moderator in classics, 1899 (B.A.); prizeman in biblical Greek, 1900; vice-chancellor's gold medallist in Latin, 1900; 2nd cls. professor of classics and English, Royal Coll., Mauritius, Sept., 1913; ag. 1st cls. professor, Apl., 1914 to Nov., 1915; Jan. to Nov., 1916, and from Apl., 1917.

FOWLIS, HENRY GEORGE.—Entd. judl. dept., Gambia, 1890; govt.'s off., 1893-1901; col. sec.'s off., 1902-06; ch. clk. and acctnt., P.W.D., 1906.

FRANCIS, HENRY DUNLOP.—Rev. off., Anguilla, 1896; govt. off., St. Kitts, 1897; rev. off., Nevis, 1899; tarif clk., treas., St. Kitts, 1901; ag. audit clk., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1902; supervisor of cust., G. Coast, Sept., 1904; 1st cls. supervisor of cust., 20th Aug., 1909; ag. inspr., cust. preven. serv., Mar.-Oct., 1911; ag. inspr., maritime cust., Oct., 1916 to Jan., 1917; prov. coll. cust., 1st Jan., 1921.

FRANCIS, AUGUSTUS CLAUDE.—Served in I.Y., South African war, Jan., 1900, to Aug., 1901, (Queen's medal and four clasps); asst. nativ. commr., North Eastern Rhodesia (B.S.A. Co.'s service), Mar., 1902, to Nov., 1905; asst. res., N. Nigeria, 2nd Dec., 1906.

FRANCIS, BERTRAM ALEXANDER.—B. 1878; ed. St. Edmunds Schl., Canterbury, and St. Catherine's Coll., Camb.; B.A. (class. tripos) 1900; 2nd lieut. R.G.A., 1900; lieut. 1902; inspr. of immigrts., Mauritius, 1908; ag. auditor-gen., Jan. to June, 1908; prot. of immigrts., and poor law commr., 1912; temp. capt., R.G.A., Jan., 1915 to 1918; ag. recvr-gen., Feb. to Nov., 1919, Dec., 1919 to Jan., 1922 and from Nov., 1922 to Aug., 1923; chmn. profiteering comtee, May, 1920; coll. of cust. and harbmr., 25th Aug., 1924.

FRANCIS, CLIFFORD CLAUDE.—B. 1889; ed. at King's Schl., Rochester, and Lincoln Coll., Oxford; ag. pay and qrtm.r. and clk., Fiji constab., 4th Feb., 1908; clk. of the peace, Taveuni, 9th Aug., 1908; served in audit and recvr-general's depts.; asst. mtr., Queen Victoria schl., Nasinu, Fiji, 1st Feb., 1910; ag. headmaster, ditto, 20th Apl. to 3rd July, 1911; ag. chief clk., native dept., 25th Sept., 1911, to 26th Feb., 1912; cadet, Br. Solomon Is. Prot., 28th June, 1912.

FRANCIS, CYRIL GERARD BROOKE.—Apptd. Fiji civ. serv., 1898; lieut., armed nativ. constab., 1901; certif., musketry and machine gun, Hythe, 1905; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1907; inspr., Fiji constab., 1907; barrister and solr., sup. ct., Fiji, 1908; A.D.C. to ag. gov., Dec., 1908 to 1909; ag. inspr.-genl constab., and prisons, 1909 to 1910; A.D.C. to ag. gov., Aug., 1910 to Feb., 1911; ag. commr. and stip. mag., 1911-12; ag. chief pol. mag., July to Aug., 1911; ag. inspr.-genl., constab. and prisons, 1912 to 1913; 2nd grade dist. commr., May, 1912; ag. chief pol. mag., Mar., 1913 to Dec., 1914; 2nd in cmd. local forces with rank of major, 5th Aug., 1914; mentioned by Army Council for services in 1914 in connection with defence of Fiji; capt., E. Surrey Regt., Mar., 1915; cov. comdr., K.A.R., E. Africa, 1916-19; 1st grade dist. commr., Fiji, Jan., 1916; regiar.-genl., regiar., sup. ct., commr. stamps, and pub. trustee, Fiji, Jan., 1920; cust., enemy property and contr. L.C.O., Fiji and W. Pacific, Feb., 1920; ag. atty.-gen., May, 1920 to May, 1921; commr. for the revision of the laws of Fiji, 1920; atty.-gen. B. Honduras, July, 1921; ag. ch. just., July
1921 to May, 1922 and from July, 1923; chmn., ooman. to enquire into outbreak of yellow fever, 1921; chmn., retrenchment oomtee, 1922; chmn., franchise ooman, 1923; atty.-gen., Zanzibar, 27th Nov., 1924.

FRANCIS, WILLIAM, F.I.O.—Ed. Glasgow Univ.; "Malcolm Kerr" bursar in chem. and astt. to prof. of chem., Glasgow Univ., 1890; astt. to Sir C. A. Cameron, C.B., govt. analyst, Ireland, 1892-4; govt. analyst, agrl. chemist and lect. in chem. to the govt. of Cyprus, 1900-20; ag. island postmnr., astt censor, and pres. of the note currency bd., Cyprus, 1915-20; dep. govt. analyst and geologist, B. Guiana, 1920; ag. dir. of science and agr., Feb.-July, 1921 and in 1922; astt. dir., science and agr., B. Guiana, 1922; senr. editor, B. Guiana Handbook, 1922.

FRANKLIN, B. J. F.—Astt. jun. staff survr., E. Africa Prot., 1914; astt. dist. comsnr., May, 1915.

FRANKLIN, J. C.—L.R.C.S. and P., Edin., L.F.P. and S., Glasgow; ed. at Queen's Coll., Cork, and Royal Coll. of Surgs., Edin.; certif., Lond. Schol. of trop. med.; med. offr. to Impl. forces at home and S. Africa, Dec., 1899, to Sept., 1902; med. offr., Gambia, Apl., 1903; ag. trav. comsnr., McCarthy Prov., Aug. to Dec., 1903; public vaccinator.

FRASER, D. M.—2nd cls. postmaster, E. Africa Prot., Jan., 1918.

FRASER, FREDERICK WILLIAM, C.B.E.(1922).—B. 1870; ed. Sherborne Schol.; cadet, B. N. Borneo civ. serv., 1896; dist. offr., Keningau, 1899; sec. to gov., 1903; res. of the interior, 1905; sessions judge, 1906; res., East Coast, 1909; res., West Coast, 1911; M.L.C., 1912; judge of high court, 1912; govt. sec., 1912; O.A.G., 1912; resumed appt. as govt. sec., 1913; O.A.G., 1915.

FRASER, HUGH.—B. 1890; ed. Wellington and Exeter Coll., Oxford (schol.); cadet, F.M.S., 1913; ag. priv. sec. to ch. sec., Apr., 1914-Feb., 1915; ag. supervisor of cust., Port Dickson, May, 1915; ag. supervisor of cust., Port Swettenham; Jan., 1916; passed cadet, Dec., 1916; offr., cls. V., Dec., 1916; 3rd astt. sec., Fed. sect., Aug., 1917; priv. sec. to ch. sec. in addn., Sept., 1917; dist. offr., Jelebu, Feb., 1918; astt. dist. offr., Ipoh, Sept., 1920; offr., cls. IV., Nov., 1920; 3rd astt. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Dec., 1921; dist. offr., Kuantan, Sept., 1924.

FRASER, JOHN ALEXANDER, M.C.—B. 1896; ed. Trinity Academy, Leith, and Edin. Univ.; on mily. serv., 1915-19; cadet, Hong Kong, 1919; attd. to sany. dept., 1921; 3rd astt. to sec. for Chinese affrs., 1921; 2nd pol. mag., Apr., 1922; dist. offr. (North), June, 1922; passed in Cantonese, 1922; astt. head, sany. dept. and sec. to sany. bd., 1922; ag. head, sany. dept., 1923; dist. offr., South, 1924.

FRASER, SIE JOHN GEORGE, KT. BACH. (1924), C.M.G. (1913).—B. 1864; cadet Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1887; ag. dist. judge, &c., Badulla, Feb., 1894; astt. govt. agt., Chilaw, Dec., 1899; land settmtn. offr., Aug., 1901; ag. govt. agt., W. Prov., 4th Jan., 1912; ag. controller of revenue, in 1911, 1912, 1913, 1915 and 1916; govt. agt., W. Prov., July, 1914; M.L.C.; ret., 1924.

FRASER, LAURENCE, L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S. (Eng.)—Lieut., R.A.M.C., Dec., 1915; capt., Dec., 1916; M.O., 15th (R.) Batt. York and Lancaster Regt., Dec., 1915 to July, 1916; St. George's hosp., Malta, July, 1916 to May, 1917; 63rd Gen. Hosp., Salonika, May-Nov., 1917; 1/1st S. Midland F.A., 5th Royal Sussex Regt., 1/6th Gloucester Regt., N. Italy, Nov., 1917; Feb., 1919; 1/6th Gloucester Regt., Albania, Feb., May, 1919; 1/6th Gloucester Regt., 2/13th Lond. Regt., mil. hosp., Raseltin, Alexandria, May, 1919 to Nov., 1920; dist. med. offr., Cyprus, Mar., 1921.

FRASER, MALCOLM, O.B.E. (1919).—B. 1873; ed. at Inverness; entd. N.Z. land and income tax dept., 1893; astt. pub. serv. superannuation fund, 1908; govt. statistician since 1911; admst. enrolment and balloting, Expedy. Force Reserv., 1916-18; N.Z. rep. at British Empire Conf. of Statisticians, 1920.

FRASER, PERCY LOUIS ALEXANDER, M.B.E. (1918).—B. 1867; entd. civ. ser., Trinidad, 1st Dec., 1886; supt. of prisons, 1st Jan., 1907.

FRASER, WINFORD BLACHE.—B. 1868; call. to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1892; mag., St. Andrew Trinidad, Jan., 1923; mag., Caroni, Nov., 1923.

FRAZER, HON. FRANCIS VERNON, M.A., LL.B.—B. 1880; ed. Nelson Coll., Otago Univ. Coll., and Canterbury Univ. Coll.; barrister-at-law, stip. mag., 1911; chmn., N.Z. pub. serv. appeal bd., 1918; astt. pub. serv. comsnr., 1920; judge, ct. of arbit., 1921.

FREEMAN, B. J.—Astt. chief acctnt., G.P.O., E. Afric Prot., Apl., 1918.

FREEMAN, GEORGE BOVET.—B. 1886; ed. Winchester Coll.; astt. dist. comsnr., Gold Coast, 29th Apr., 1914; dist. comsnr., 1916.

FREEMAN, WILLIAM GEORGE, B.Sc. (Lond.), A.R.C.S., F.L.S.—B. 1874; ed. at St. Olave's Gram. Schol. and Royal Coll. of Science, Lond.; B.Sc. (1st cls. hons. in Botany), 1898; priv. astt. to dir. of Royal Bot. Gardens, Ceylon, 1896-97; demonstrator in Botany, Royal Coll. of Science, 1897-1900; scientific astt., Imp. dep. of agric., West Indies, 1900-1903; supt. of colonial collections, Imp. FREESTON, LESLIE BRIAN.—B. 1892; ed. Willaston Schol., Nantwich and Oxford; schol. New Coll., 1911-1919; 2nd cls., hon. med., 1913; B.A. (war) 1919; on mil. ser., 17th Sep., 1914 to 8th Mar., 1919; temp. 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 10th Mar. to 15th July, 1919; app't. under reconstruction scheme, 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 16th July, 1919; astt. prin., 1st Apr., 1920; priv. astt. to perm. under-sec., 18th June, 1920; sent to Ceylon for temp. serv. as sec., salaries comm., 1921; ast. princ., 6th Dec., 1922; prine., 1st April, 1924.

FREMANTLE, JOHN MORTON, M.B.R. (1919).—B. 1876; ed. at Eton and Hertford Coll., Oxford; M.A., 1902; served in S. Africa, first in the ranks (Distinguished Conduct Medal), and afterwards as capt., 15th Batt. I.Y.; is hon. cnsm. in the army and capt., 3rd Co. of London L.Y.; priv. sec. to S. of S. for War and astt. sec. to royal comen. on militia and volunteers, 1903; comptroller of the household to gov.-gen. of Canada, 1910-11; 3rd cls. res. Northern Nigeria, Nov., 1904; 2nd cls. res., Jan., 1910; is now res. at Zaria.

FRENCH, JOHN KERRIE.—B. 1872; clk., prov. law bd., Sandy Point, Mar., 1894; clk., P.O., St.
Kitts, Nov., 1897; clk. to regisr. and prov. marshal, Nevis, Sept., 1901; govt. offr., sub-reasy., Sandy Point, St. Kitts, June, 1906; clk., reasy., St. Kitts, Oct., 1907.

FRENCH, Sir SOMERSET RICHARD, K.C.M.G. (1901), C.M.G. (1896);—B. 1848; postmr.-gen.; apptd. money order dept., G.P.O., Lond., 30th Aug., 1866; transf. to sec.'s off. (postal branch), Sept., 1869; in Feb., 1870, asstd. in transfer to state of the undertakings of the telegraph companies in the U.K.; apptd. offr. in charge of cantell. branch, telegraphs, and subsequently to control of racing and special arrangements branch of impl. telegraph service; also May to Oct., 1874, supervised surveying branch, home counties dist.; in July, 1878, selected to proceed to Cyprus with expeditionary force under Lieut.-Gen. Sir Garnet Wolseley, to organise a postal and telegraph service on that island. Shortly after return to J.K. was asked to undertake reorganisation of Cape Colony postal service; acted as sec. and compt., P.O., Cape Colony, 1st Aug., 1880, to 1st July, 1881, when apptnt. confirmed; intro-duced P.O. savings bk. system, 1st Jan., 1884; rom which date acted as controller of branch in addition to other apptnt.; P.M.G. and gen. man. of telegraphs, Cape Colony and Basutoland, 7th Jan., 1892; also P.M.G., Bechuanaland, 1st Apr., 1893, until 1897, when that territory annexed to Cape Colony; P.M.G., Bechuanaland r.t., 1897; organised postal and telegraph services of Rhodesia, and acted as gen. man. of Rhodesian telegraph service, 1893-7; mem. of tender and advisory bds.; agt. gen. for Cape Colony in Lond., 1907, retired, 1st July, 1910.

FRENCH, T.—Asst. traffic man., Uganda Rly., apl., 1911.

FRERE, Sir BARTLE HENRY TEMPLE, KT., B.A., (1918), LL.B.—Ed. at Charterhouse schl., and Trin. Coll., Cam.; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1887; pres. dist. court, Cyprus, 1897; transf. to Gibraltar as pol. mag. and coroner, 1902; atty.-gen., 1911; chief justice, Apl., 1914; judge of the prize ct., Aug., 1914; cable censor during the European War; ret., Aug., 1922.

FRERE, Noel Gray.—B. 1885; ed. Wanganui Collegiate Schl., N.Z., and Cranby Schl.; asst. ist. comsnr., S. Leone, 31st July, 1909; dist. comsnr., 7th Jan., 1915; ag. prov. comsnr., N. Prov., Sept., 1921 to Nov., 1921.

FROST, H. E. F.—Asst. game warden, E. Africa Prot., Jan., 1919.

FROST, Capt. Meadows, M.C.—B. 1875; ed. Charterhouse and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; B.A., Oxon; cadet, F.M.S., 1898; passed cadet, 1901; I.V.I., 1903; cls. V., 1905; seconded as H.B.M.'s consul for west coast of Siam, 1905; cls. IV, and adviser to H.H. the Raja of Perla, 1910; acted as tr. adviser, Kedah, 1911; cls. III, 1912; joined the Army for gen. serv., 1915; discharged, 1919; cls. II, 1919; ag. dist. offr., Kinta, 1920; dist. ffr., Larut, Sept., 1922; comsnr., lands and mines, Johore, Aug., 1923.

FROUDE, Ashley A., B.A., C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1863; ed. Westminster and Oriel Coll., Oxford riv. sec. (unpaid) to Sir Robert Herbert at the C.O., ov., 1886; sec. to roy. comsnr. for the division of Malta into electoral dists., Jan., 1888; sec. to the Behring Sea comsnr., June, 1891, and to the joint Behring Sea comsnr. at Washington, Jan., 1892; n the staff of the Br. agt., Behring Sea arbitra- tion, 1892-3.

FRY, R. S.—Trigonometrical asst., survey dept., S. Sttlmtn., Jan., 1881; res. Aug., 1884; rejoined July, 1885; dist. survr., Sept., 1885; ch. survr., Dec., 1888; observer for time balls and dep. regiar. of shipping, Jan., 1894.

FRY, WM. HERBERT, L.R.C.P. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.).—B. 1868; late house surg. and house physician, N.W., Lond. hosp.; asst. electro-therapeutic physician, Charing Cross hosp.; house surg., Liverpool hosp.; house surgeon, S. Sttlmtn., 13th Aug., 1896; supernumerary col. surg., Sing., 1st Apr., 1900; col. surg., Prov. Wellesley South, 17th Nov., 1900; ditto, Prov. Wellesley North, 1st Mar., 1901; asst. col. surg. res., Penang, 18th Mar., 1901; state surg., Pahang, F.M.S., June, 1905; ag. senr. med. offr., Penang, 1908; med. offr., grade I., 1st Oct., 1908; ditto, Perak, 7th Apr., 1909; ag. senr. med. offr. in charge, gen. hosp., Singapore, 14th Apr., 1911; ag. health offr., Perak N., 5th Oct., 1912 to 24th Sept., 1913; ag. senr. med. offr., Perak in addtn., 21st June, 1913 to 8th May, 1914; ag. health offr., Perak N., 8th June, 1914; med. offr. in charge, Pahang, 1st May, 1915; mag., Raub dist., in addition, 1st July, 1916; ch. med. offr., Penang, Aug., 1919; ag. ch. med. offr., Singapore, 27th May, 1922.

FULLARTON, R.—Harbourmr., Melbourne, 1877; ch. harbourmr., pres. pilot bd., and chmn. steam navign. bd., 1882; capt. comding. Victorian naval brigade, 1871; mem. of coun. of defence, 1884.

FULLER, Sir F. C. P. D., K.B.E. (1919), C.M.G. (1906).—Cadet, Fiji, 1884; res. comsnr., Rotuma, 1889; dis. comsnr., Lagos, 1892; res. of Ibadan, 1897; col. treas., Lagos, 1901; asst. sec. to govt., Malta, 1902; mem. exec. coun.; ch. comsnr., Ashanti, 1905; ret., 24th July, 1920.

FULLER, Hon. Sir GEORGE WARBURTON, K.C.M.G. (1919).—Elected to first H. of R., C. of A., 1901; re-elected, 1903 and 1906; min. of home affairs, C. of A., June, 1909 to Apl., 1910; col. sec., N. S. Wales Nov., 1910-20; premier, 1922.

FULLER-MAITLAND, G. A.—Ed. at Wellington Coll. and Oriel Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1908; asst. dist. comsnr., E.A.P., 8th Jan., 1909; ag. supt. of in. rev. and conservancy, 1910 and 1912; junr. asst. sec. to govt., E.A.P., 27th Jan., 1913; dist. comsnr., 1917.

FURKERT, FREDERICK WILLIAM, M.I.C.E., A.M.I.M.E.—B. 1876; ed. Hokitika High Schl., Wellington and Dunedin Tech. Schls., and Otago Univ., N.Z.; joined N.Z. pub. wks. dept., 1894; res. engr., 1903; inspecting engr., 1912; asst. engr.-in-chief, 1919; engr.-in-chief and under sec., 1920.

FURNESS, ROBERT HOWARD.—B. 1880; ed. King William's Coll., Isle of Man; solr. (hons.), 1902; practised at bar of B. Honduras, 1906-13; registr.-gen., B. Honduras, 1913; ag. atty.-gen., 1914-15; lieut.-comdg. 1st B. Honduras war contingent, 1915; served with B.W.I. Regt., 1915-19; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1919; mag., Tanganyika Territory, 9th Jan., 1920; senr. mag., Apr., 1921; ag. puisne judge, Nov., 1922 to Feb., 1923; solr. gen., Trinidad, Nov., 1923; ag. atty.-gen., Apr. to Oct., 1924.

FURSE, Major R. D., D.S.O.—B. 1887; ed. Eton and Balliol Coll., Oxford, B.A.; asst. priv. sec. to sec. of state (Mr. Lewis (now Lord Harcourt), Dec., 1910 to Aug., 1914; on active service in 1st King Edward's Horse, K.O.D.R., 5th Aug., 1914 to 26th Nov., 1918; served in France and Italy, Apl., 1913 to 26th Nov., 1918; promoted capt., 1914; major, 1916; wounded, 1917; D.S.O., July, 1918; Bar to D.S.O., gazetted, Mar., 1919; twice ment. in despatches, asst. priv. sec. (apptmnts.) to sec. of state (Lord Milner), May, 1919; Mr. Winston Churchill, Feb., 1921;
Duke of Devonshire, Oct., 1922; priv. sec., (apptmts.) to sec. of state, Mr. Thomas, Jan., 1924; Mr. L. C. M. S. Amery, Nov., 1924; visited Canada on C.O. business, 1922, and again in 1923 as rep. at Imp. Forestry Confce; mem., bd. of govs., Imp. Forestry Inst.

GALE, WALTER A., C.M.G. (1920).—Ed. high schl., Perth, St. Peter's Coll., Adelaide, and Exeter Coll., Oxon.; 3rd master, high schl., Perth, 1885; asst. regisr., col. sec.'s office, W. Australia, 1886; sec. to cent. bd. of educn., 1888; regist.-gen.; regist. of patents, etc., Sept., 1890; in charge of census for 1891; clk. of legis. assem., 1891; transf'd, to Commonwealth govt., 1901; clk. of house of representatives, since 1917.

GALIA, ARTHUR.—B. 1872; ed. Malta Lyceum; ent. Malta civ. serv., 1891; 3rd cls. clk., 1st Jan., 1895; 2nd cls. clk., 1st July, 1901; asst. regisr. cts. of judicial pol., 17th Dec., 1913 regisr., 6th Jan., 1914; transf'd., secretariat, 14th May, 1918; ch. clk., lieut.-gov.'s office, Sept., 1920; ch. clk. to legislature, 26th Dec., 1921; compt'r., charitable institutions, 4th Apr., 1923.

GALL, GEORGE LOUIS BECKLES.—B. 1880; ed. at Queen's Coll., B. Guiana; clerical asst., dept. of mines, B. Guiana, 1897; ditto, govt. secretariat, 1898 to 1900; crown lands offr., 1900; in charge of outlying dist., together with duties of comsry. of taxation, and postmtr., 1901; J.P., 1902; 3rd grade comsry. of taxation, 1904; sworn weigher and gauger, 1905; qual. in colloquial Hindi, 1909; ag. imgrn. agt., in addition to substantive duties, 1911; sec. to new duties comsny., 1912; ag. imgrn. agt., in addition to other duties, 1913; took over duties of clk. of wks., in addition to substantive appts., 1915; 1st grade comsry. of taxation, Oct., 1915; asstd. in Georgetown fiscal dist., together with duties as sec. to excise bd., until July, 1916; sec. to sugar comte., 1916.

GALLAGHER, LT.-COL. ALBERT ERNEST, D.S.O. (1907).—Reserve of offs.; B. 1872; Ed. privately; served in S. African war, 1900; served with N. Nigeria Regt., W.A.F.F., 1901-1908; Argungu operations, 1902 (deeps.); Sokoto expedit., 1903; Sokoto expedit., 1906, (wounded, deaps., D.S.O.); asst. res., N. Nigeria, 1908; local comdt. Cyprus, mil. police, 1909; chief comdt. Cyprus mil. police, 1915; served with 7th Royal Munster Fus., 10th Divn., Dardanelles, 1915, and Serbia, 1915; major and 2nd in command, 11th Worcester Regt., Salonika Force, Sept., 1916; served with 7th Royal Fus. (63rd Div.) as 2nd in command, 1917, B.E.F., France; lieut.-col. comdg. 2nd Royal Inniskilling Fusiliers, Sept., 1918, B.E.F., France; wounded, Oct., 1918; resumed duties as chief comdt., Cyprus mil. police, Aug., 1919; ag. regr. gen., Apl. to June, and in 1922, Aug., 1922; mem., exec. coun., Apr., 1922.

GALLIHER, HON. WM. ALFRED.—B. 1860; ed. pub. and high schls., Walkerton, and Collegiate Inst., Collingwood; called to the bar, Manitoba, 1887; N.W.T., 1889; B. Columbia, 1897; served in the Nile expedit. 1884-5; elected to H. of C., Canada, 1900 and 1904; judge of ct. of appeal, B. Columbia, 1909.

GALT, HON. ALEXANDER CASIMIR.—L. 1853; ed. Hellmouth Coll., Toronto Univ.; practised law in Toronto, 1876-1896; Rossland, B.C., 1896-1905; Winnipeg, 1906-1912; judge of the ct. of king's bench, Manitoba, 1912; contrib. to Can. Law Journal and Can. Law Times.

GALWAY, LT.-COL. SIR HENRY LIONEL, K.C.M.G. (1910), C.M.G. (1899), D.S.O. (1896).—B. 1859; ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Sandhurst; entered army, May, 1878; promoted lieut., Mar., 1881; capt., Oct., 1887; brevet-major, May, 1897; maj., Mar., 1899; and lt.-col., Apr., 1901; apptd. dep. commr. and vice-consul, Niger Rivers prot., Mar., 1891; dep. commr. and consul, Niger Coast prot., Jan., 1897; and dir. commr. Niger Coast prot. (now South. Nigeria), Apr., 1899; ag. consul-gen. Niger Coast prot., Apr., to Nov., 1896; Jan., 1897; Feb., 1898, to Jan., 1899; ag. high commr., South. Nigeria, Mar., to Dec., 1899; Brass expedn., 1895 (deaps., medal with clas. D.S.O.); Benin expedn., 1897 (deaps., clasp, brevet majority); Aro expedn. as chief political offr., 1902 (deaps., medal with clasp); gov., St. Helena, 1902; gov., Gambia, 30th Sept., 1911; gov., S. Australia, 27th Feb., 1914; assume gov't., 18th Apr., 1914, retired, 1920.

GALWAY, JOHN PATRICK FRANCIS.—Ed. St. Francis Xavier's Coll., Liverpool; clk. vet. pathological lab'y., Kabete, Aug., 1910; seconded mil. serv., 1915; corp., E. African Vty. Corp., 1st June, 1916; lieut., ditto, 17th Oct., 1917; lieut., 3rd K.A.R.; "1914-19" Star, Gen. Serv. and Victory meda.; labour inspnr. offr., E. Africa Prot., Apl., 1919; office supt., P.W.D., Dec., 1922.

GAMBLE, F. C.—Asst. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Feb., 1915; seconded as req. mg., July, 1923.

GAMBLE, JOSEPH SAMUEL.—Ag. sub-insp. of police, B. Guiana, 1905; wounded in Georgetown town riots, 1905; sub-insp. of police, Hythe musketry certif., 1908; dist. insp. of police, 1912.

GAMMANS, LEONARD DAVID.—B. 1896; lieut., R.F.A., 1915; B.E.F., France, 1916; lieut. and capt., 1917; seconded for serv. as instr. in gunnery and equitation, R. Milly. Coll., Carassai, May, 1918; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1920; ag. 2nd ast. dist. offr., Ulu Selangor, Jan., 1921; pass cadet, Jan., 1922; ag. ast. dist. offr., Kuala Kubu, Apr., 1922; ast. supervisor, cust., Port Dickson, Oct., 1922; supervisor, cust., Pantai Buntar, Mar., 1923; ag. dist. offr., Port Dickson, July, 1923.

GANT, HON. TETLEY, C.M.G. (1918)—M.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1866; called to the bar, Inner Temple; pres. of legis. coun. of Tasmania, July, 1907.

GARBUTT, FRANK THORNTON OWEN.—Sci. inspnr., Bechuana land Prot. police, 1907; ag. mg., Aug., 1913 to Apr., 1914; ag. ast. mg., 1915 and 1918; granted local rank of capt. ag. res. mag., 1916; inspnr., 1922.

GARDINER, FREDERICK GEORGE.—B. 1874; ed. Diocesan Coll., Rondebosch, and Keble Coll., Oxford; B.A., Cape and Oxford; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1896; admitted to bar, 1897; ag. puiane judge, Natal, 1906; atty.-gen., Cape Province, 1910; puiane jud. of sup. ct. of S. Africa (Cape Prov. Div.), Oct., 1914.

GARDNER, H. M.—Ast. conservator, forests, E.A.P., May, 1914.

GARDNER, JOHN HYSLOP, B.Sc.—B. 1882; ed. Kelvinside Acad. and Univ., Glasgow; engnr., Basutoland, 1909; govt. engnr., Swaziland, 1919; served with R.E., Flanders 1914-18.

GARNETT, W. J., B.Sc. (Lond.), B. 1883; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., Jan., 1907; seconded for service in Overseas Stntmt. Offce., Jan., 1919.

GARRAN, SIR ROBERT RANDOLPH, K.C.M.G. (1920), KT. BACH. (1917), C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1867; barrister-at-law; sec. to drafting commi.
of Australian Fed. Convention, 1897-8; sec. atty.-gen.'s dept., C. of A., Jan., 1901; and parly. draftman; solr.-gen., 1916; author of "The Coming Commonwealth," 1897, and joint author (with the Hon. Sir John Quick) of "The Annotated Constitution of the Austn. Commonwealth," 1901.

GARRAWAY, DAVID JULIAN.—B. 1878; entd. pub. serv., St. Lucia, Mar., 1892, as supernum. clk.; assy., ag. 4th clk., Nov., 1893; clk., P.O., June, 1893; ag. clk. to adminstr.-in-chief, Windward Is., Aug., 1893; 2nd clk. regis.'s off., June, 1896; ch. clk., Jan., 1896; ag. regis., sheriff and adminstr.-gen., on 3 occasions, 1901-23; rev. offr., Grenada, June, 1903; ag. pol. mag., West Dist., Feb., 1904; additional coroner, West Dist., Mar., 1904; ag. pol. mag., North Dist., for spec. purpose of hearing appeals agst. town bd. assessmts. for 1904; assist. tax offr. in connectn. with hearing appeals agst. assessmts. for land and house taxes for 1904; ag. pol. mag., West Dist., May and June, 1905; ag. commr., Carriacou, Aug.-Sept., 1906; ag. road surv., West Dist., Oct., 1906, in addition to duties of substantive office; ch. clk., regis.'s off., and dep. regis., Oct., 1907; regis., sup. ct., Oct., 1914.

GARRAWAY, LT.-COL. SIR E. C. F., K.C.M.G. (1922), C.M.G. (1911), L.R.C.S.I.—Dist. surg., Millwood, Knysna, Cape Colony, 1888; ditto, Kuruman, Br. Bech., 1891; surg., Bech. Bord. pol., 1892; divsnl. med. offr., M.A.C., with rank of major, 1901; prin. med. offr., Ditto, Mar., 1905; mil. sec., S. Africa, from 1st July, 1908, with rank of major; mil. sec., to Lord Gladstone, 1910-1913; mem. of S. Rhodesia military reserves comm., since May, 1914; served in Matabele wars and Boer war (1899-1902); res. commr., Bech. Prot., 1st May, 1916; res. commr., Basutoland, 15th Dec., 1917.

GARRAWAY, ROBERT FRDERICK.—B. 1860; postmtr., Dominica, June, 1881; sec. bd. of hth and quar. bd., Sept., 1881; ag. dist. mag., dist. G., Apr., 1893; commr. of oaths, Oct., 1893; ag. regis. of sup. ct., Dec., 1898; off. M.L.C., Dec., 1898; mag. dist. G., and collr. of rev., Portsmouth, Mar., 1896; mem. of quarantine bd., Van., 1906.

GARRIOCH, C. G.—2nd clk., govt. sec's dept., British New Guinea, 13th Nov., 1901; chief clk., 11th May, 1903; priv. sec. to lieut. gov. of Papua, and clk. of exec. and legis. couns., 22nd Apr., 1907; is also regis. of central court offr. of armed constab., mag. for native affairs, and J.P. for Papua.

GARTHORNE, ERIC HENRY RUDSTON.—B. S.A., pol. srv.; clk., govt. house, Cape Town, 1898; clk., high commrs' office, 1901; permit offr., native affrs. dept., Transvaal, 1902; ch. clk., native affrs. dept., Transvaal, 1902; prin. clk., native affrs. dept., Union of S. Africa, 1910; ch. clk., native affrs. dept., Union of S. Africa, Oct., 1919.

GARTON, HARRY.—B. 1889; served in R.F.A., France, Salonica, Egypt and Palestine, 4th Aug., 1914 to Apr., 1919; clk. to court martials offr., R.F.A., May to Sept., 1919; Admiralty, 21st Oct., 1919 to Oct., 1922; served on Naval Inter-allied Com. of Control in Germany, May, 1921 to Oct., 1922; cler. offr., C.O., 21st Oct., 1922.

GARVIN, THOMAS FORREST, K.C.—B. 1881; crown counsel, Ceylon, Mar., 1908; ag. solr.-gen., Feb., 1913; ag. addtl. dist. judge, Colombo, Feb., 1914; solr.-gen., 1915; ag. puisne just., Nov., 1921 to Jan., 1922; ag. atty.-gen., June, 1922 to Dec., 1922; ag. puisne just., sup. ct., Jan., 1923; puisne just., June, 1924.

GASH, VINCENT GORDON.—Served in Bechuanaland Prot. pol., 1911-15; sub-inspr., 1915; passed 3rd grade Seewana exam., 1923.

GATFIELD, WILLIAM HUKETT, M.C.—B. 1895; ed. Streatham Gram. Schl. and St. George's Coll., London; apptd. to the 2nd divn. of the Imp. civ. serv., 1914; joined Queen's Westminster Rifles, 1915; 2nd lieut., 1916; served in France, and demob. with rank of lieut., 1919; cadet, S. Stiltns., 20th Nov., 1920; proceeded to China to study Chinese, July, 1921.

GATT, L., C.M.G. (1901), C.E.—Entered the Malta ser., Mar., 1883, as land survr.; rly. inspr., 1884; astt. engnr., waterwks., 1885; survr. P.W.D., 1888; manager and engnr., Malta rly., 1895; ch. engnr., waterwks., and elect. lighting dept., 1896; supt. of P.W., with a seat in exec. coun., and a seat in coun. of govt., 1897.

GAUNT, A. E.—B. 1897; entd. C.O., Aug., 1913; apptd. astt. clk., Oct., 1915; on mil. ser. from Dec., 1915 to Mar., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

GAUNT, REGINALD FREDERIC, M.A.—B. 1885; Hastings exhib., Queen's Coll., Oxon.; B.A. (Hons. Mod. Hist.), 1908; F.R.G.S.; astt. dist. commr., S. Nigeria, 26th July, 1911; special commr., Archchuku mutiny cases, 1913; educn. dept., E. Africa Prot., 8th July, 1914; ag. liquidator of enemy aliens, 7th Jan., 1918; inspr., coast educn., 1st Apr., 1919; inspr. inspr. of achls., Kenya, 17th Aug., 1920; ag. dir. of educn., 3rd May, 1921.

GEAR, HON. HENRY.—M.H.A. for dist. of Burin, Newfoundland, 1900; again elected, 1904; mem. exec. coun., 1903.

GEBBERS, H. L.—Student Int. S.N.A. Dep., 1894; clk., Zulu and D. Int. mag. ct., Dundee, 1895; 3rd cls. clk., 1896; 2nd cls. clk., 1900; lent to Transvaal, 1901; clk. of ct. P. V. Vryheid, 1901; J.P., Vryheid, 1901; A. A. M., Vryheid, 1902; reverted to Natal service, 1903; transf. to mag. ct., Dundee, 1904, senior clk. and A. A. M.; astt. mag., Inanda div. at Indwedwe, 1912; mag., Emtonjaneni div., Nov., 1916; Ngotsha, Oct., 1920; Helpmakar, Apr., 1923.

GEERING, SIDNEY.—Temp. astt. to irrng. engnr., P.W.D., B. Guiana, 1st Aug., 1916 to Oct., 1918; ag. dist. engnr., Oct., 1918 to Aug., 1920; 1st cls. overseer, July, 1919; clk. of works, Gambia, 20th Aug., 1920.

GENT, G. E. J., D.S.O., M.C.—B. 1895; ed. King's Schl., Canterbury (King's Scholar, 1909-14) and Trinity Coll., Oxford (Ford Studentship, Dec., 1913); 2nd lieut. sp. res. of offrs., 3rd batt., D.C.L.I., Aug., 1914; capt., 1916; ag. major, Nov., 1917; served in France and Italy, 1914-18; demobilised, Feb., 1919; relinquished comm. with rank of major, Apr., 1920; twice men. in desps.; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, astt. prin., C.O., 19th July, 1920; sec., advisory rubber comtee., 1922; act. prin., 19th Nov., 1923; pvt. sec. to Mr. Ormsby Gore, Dec., 1924.

GENTLE, GEORGE EDWIN PALMER.—B. 1880; ed. Denstone Coll.; clk., gov.'s office, Gienna, 1896; warden, P.W.D., St. Vincent, 1901; road survr., Grenada, 1905; ag. supt., pub. wks., 1914, 1916, 1918, 1921, 1922; astt. supt., pub. wks., 1916; supt., pub. wks., 1922; unoff. mem., leg. coun., 1922.

GENTLE, WILLIAM TODD ATKINSON.—B. 1879; ed. George Watsons Coll., George Heriot's Schl. and Univ., Edinburgh; astt. audr. for rly., Ceylon, 1910; ag. col. audr. in addn., July and Aug., 1919; ag. astt. gen. man. and acct.
GIBSON, HARRISON WYATT.—Inspr. of pub. wks., Basutoland, 1904; dir. of pub. wks., 1910.

GIBSON, SIR HENRY JAMES, K.C.B. (1872): C.B. (1902), B.A.—B. 1860; ed. Rossall; St. John's Coll., Oxford; Casherd schol.; 1st cl. class. mods.; clk. War Office, 1875; prino. clk., 1897; ast. acctnt.-gen., 1900; sec. acctnt.-gen., 1903; ast. dir. of Army finances, 1904; priv. sec. to Mr. Woodall, 1894; to Hon. St. John Brodrick, 1896-6; ast. compt. and audr., 1905; mem. of comte., to inquire into organisation of crown agents' office, 1906; ast. audr. for certain Crown Colonies and Prov. ag. on behalf of the S. of S. for the Colonies, compt. and audr.-gen., 1911.

GIBSON, COLONEL SIR JOHN MONCKTON, K.C.M.G. (1912), K.C., M.A., L.L.B.—B. 1842; called to the bar, 1867; LL.B., Toronto Univ., 1869; mem. of senate of Tanta Univ., 1873; re-elected, 1878 and 1883; mem. of Ontario legislature, 1879; re-elected, 1885 and 1888; provi. sec., 1889; commr. of crown lands, 1896; has also held office as atty.-gen.; lieut.-gov. of Ontario, 1908-1914.

GIBSON, LESLIE BERTRAM.—B. 1896; ed. Ex-Henry VIII. Schl., Coventry; hon. LL.B., London; flight sub-lieut., R.N.A.S., attd. gunnery fleet; lieut., R.A.F.; cadet, S. Stltms., May, 1920; attd. to atty.-gen.'s office, Singapore, Apr., 1920; dep. dir. of food prodn., Penang, Apr., 1921; ag. colnr., income tax, Malacca, Dec., 1921; passed cadet, Mar., 1922; dep. regisr. and int-off., assignee, Penang, June, 1922.

GIBSON, ROY ALEXANDER.—B. 1885; ed. Brandon High Schl. and Brandon Coll.; ed. govt. serv. at Regina, 1908; transferred to crown and apptd. ch. clk. to dep. min., 1908; ast. dep. min., 1st June, 1919; commr., Yukon and N.W. Territories, 1923.

GIBSON, THOMAS WILLIAM.—B. 1859; ed. pub. schl., Wroxeter Academy, Rockwood, Ontario; sec. bureau of mines, Ontario, 1897; ditto, 1900; dep. min. of mines, 1906.

GIBSON, HON. WILLIAM GERRAND.—Ld. of the H. of R., Commonwealth of Australia for Orangamite, Dec., 1919; postmtr.-gen., Ceylon, 1923.

GIBSON, WILLIAM SUMNER, B.A., Barrister-at-Law (Lincoln's Inn).—B. 1876; Marlborough and Keble Coll., Oxford (sec. B.A. (1st cls. mod. hist.), 1899); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1899; passed final exam., Cantonese, Nov., 1902, Malay, Jan., 1908; ag. Indian immigr., Perak, Oct., 1902; ag. mag., Taiping, July, 1903; ag. 2nd astt. prot. of Chinese, Singapore, and off., Xmas Is. (alternately), May, 1904 to Oct., 1909; services lent to Johore govt., July-Nov., 1908; ast. man., monopolies dept., Penang, 1909; ag. mag., Ipoh, Jan., 1911; called to bar, June, 1913; ag. prot. of Chinese, Feb.-Nov., 1913; ag. dist. judge, Singapore, Feb., 1915; ag. regisr., sup. ct., Penang, May, 1916; legal adviser, Kedah, Jan., 1916; offr., clk. Mar., 1916; judge of high ct., Kedah (in adj. July, 1916; offr., cls. II., Jan., 1919; ag. legal adviser, F.M.S., Dec., 1920; pres., comm. to enquire into organisation and expend. of depta., F.M.S., Feb., 1922; legal adviser, F.M.S., December, 1922.

GILBERT, JOSEPH TROUNSELL, B.A. (Oxon), B. 1888; ed. Bedford Gram. Schl. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn, 1914; ast. colnr. (now ast. dist. comm.), Zanzibar, 4th Jan., 1912; ag. junr. mag., 191
