WALLACE—Solr., Barbados, 1881; mem. house of assem., 1883-93; mem. of comttee. of inquiry into Dodd's reformatory and industrial schl., 1884; mem. bd. of health, 1884-92; J.P., 1885; mem. of financial inquiry comn., 1886; of general hosp. bd., 1889-92; pol. mag. and judge petty debt ct., Dist. E, Barbados, 1892; receiver of wrecks, Dist. E, July, 1897; pol. mag. Dist. A, Oct., 1901; visiting just., Lazaretto, Jan., 1902; receiver of wrecks, Dist. A, May, 1902; commr. of probates, Aug., 1902; judge, Bridgetown petty debt ct., Dec., 1902; has acted on numerous occasions as inspr. of prisons, regis. of friendly societies, coroner, judge of the aast. ct. of appeal and master-in-chancery; visiting just., Glendairy prison, Jan., 1913; regis., 1921.

GOWER, I. L. O.—Conveyancer, E. Africa Prot., 1908; legal asst. to land offr., 1914; solr.-gen., Apr., 1917; ag. atty-gen., Aug., 1918; M.L.C., Oct., 1918; ag. atty-gen., 1919.

GOWERS, WILLIAM FREDERICK, C.M.G. (1919).—B. 1875; ed. Rugby and Trin. Coll., Camb.; B.A. 1898 (1st cls. class. triplos); entd. service of B.S.A. Co., Jan., 1899; asst. native commr., Matabeleland, 1900; resigned, 1902; 3rd cls. res., N. Nigeria, Dec., 1902; 2nd cls. res., 1906; 1st cls. res., 1910; ag. chief sec., Sept., 1912; lieut.-gov., N. Nigeria, June, 1921; gov. of Uganda, 4th Feb., 1925.

GRAAFF, HON. SIR D. P. DE VILLIERS, BART. (1911).—Formerly cabinet min. in Cape Colony; min. of pub. wks., and min. of posts and telegraphs, Union of S. Africa, 1910; attended Imp. Conf., 1911; min. without portfolio, 1912; resigned, 23rd Sept., 1913; min. of finance during 1915.

GRAAFF, HON. SIR J. A. C., K.C.M.G. (1917).—B. 1863; formerly M.L.C., Cape Prov.; min. without portfolio, Union of S. Africa, 1915; min. of posts and telegraphs and of pub. wks., 1920; elected senator, 1921.

GRAHAM, MICHAEL, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P.(Lond.), M.A., M.B., B.C.(Camb.), 1891—B. 1866; ed. St. John's Coll., Camb.; St Thomas's hosp., Lon.; R.A. Camb., 1887; 1st cl. honours nat. sciences triplos and exhibitioner St. John's Coll.; asst. med. offr., city asylum, Birmingham, 3rd Nov., 1891; surg. to the lying-in hospital and general penitentiary, Kingston, Jamaica, 1st Apr., 1892; re-apptd., 1st July, 1899; served on cattle disease comn., 1894; late sec. med. council of Jamaica, 1897; mem. bd. of governors, Institute of Jamaica, 1902; joint author, with F. V. Theobald (S.E. Agric. Coll.), "A Monograph on the Mosquitoes of Jamaica," 1906; author of various papers on same subject, 1906 and 1907.

GRAHAM, HON. GEORGE PERRY, LL.D. B. 1859; ed. High schls., Iroquois and Morrisburg, Ontario; journalist; Morrisburg Herald, Ottawa Free Press, Brockville Recorder; elected to Ontario legislature for Brockville, 1898, 1902 and 1905; provcl. sec. of Ontario, 1904; resign. with the govt., 1905; leader of the opposition in the Ontario legislature, 1907; sworn of the privy coun. for Canada and min. of rlyws. and canals, 1907; elected to the H. of C. for Brockville, by acclamation, 1907; defeated at g.e., 1911; re-elec. for S. Renfrew, bye-elec., 1912; did not seek election at gen.-elec., 1917; re-el., g.e., Dec., 1921; min. of militia and defence, and of nav. service in King admtn., 29th Dec., 1921; min. of rlyws. and canals, 1922.

GRAHAM, SIR JOHN JAMES, K.C.M.G. (196). C.M.G. (1899).—B. 1847; clk. to C.C. and R.M., Albany, 1864; clk. to register, E. dists. ct., May, 1865; asst. regis., Jan., 1868; asst. regis., ct., Mar., 1872; regis. and master, E. dists. ct., Feb., 1875; clk. to atty-gen. and clk. of peace, Capetown, Jan., 1878; sec., law dep., July, 1882; high sheriff and taxing offr., sup. ct., May, 1884; mem. of the col. tender bd.; a J.P. for the col.; sec. to law dept., 1889; ret., Oct., 1914.

GRAHAM, SIR HON. THOMAS LYNDON KT. BACH (1920), K.C.—B. 1860; ed. at St. Andrew's Coll., Grahamstown, and Clare Coll., Camb.(B.A.), barrister-at-law, Inner Temp., 1883; advoc. of sup. ct., Cape of Good Hope; M.L.C., 1885; atty-gen., May to Oct., 1898; col. sec., 1900-1902; atty-gen., 1902; ag. prime min., Jun. to Aug., 1902; judge of sup. ct., Cape of Good Hope, July, 1904; judge pres., Eastern Distra local div., 15th Apr., 1913; chmn. pub. enq. inquiry comn., June, 1918.

GRANNUM, EDWARD ALLAN, C.M.G., 191.—Passed Barbados, W.I., civ. ser. exam., 1885; 3rd clk. regis.'s off., Jan. to Oct., 1885; 2nd clk. Oct., 1885, to Nov., 1887; clk. master-in-chancery off., Nov., 1887, to June, 1888; honours graduate diploma, Ontario Com. Coll., Canada, affiliated institute chartered accountants, Canada, Dec., 1889; practised public accountant, Barbados, W.I., to Aug., 1897; asst. auditor, Sierra Leone and Gambia, 25th Sept., 1897, to 15th Jan., 1901; acted auditor May to Nov., 1898; asst. auditor Gold Coast and Lagos, Jan. to March, 1900; auditor, March, 1900; introduced system double entry accounts Gold Coast P.O., July, 1901; prepared scheme for introduction of double entry system of accounts for Accra town council, Aug., 1901; local auditor, Cyprus, 1902; auditor, Mauritius, 23rd Apr., 1909; revr.-gen., Mombasa, 1912; ag. col. sec., Feb. to Nov., 1919, Dec. 1919 to Sept., 1920 and from May, 1922 to Aug., 1923; col. sec., 9th Aug., 1923; admstl. gov't, bar 16th Aug., 1924.

GRANNUM, REGINALD CLIFTON.—B. 1873; 2nd clk. to gov., Windward Is., Sept., 1891; distr. St. Vincent, Apr., 1892; supervisor of customs, G. Coast Col., Oct., 1893; asst. local audr. G. Coast and Lagos, May, 1895; local audr., S. Leone June 1896; J.P., S. Leone, 1897; ch. ass't treas. G. Coast, Apr., 1903; ag. treas. and mem. treas. and leg. couns., mem. bd. of educ., July, 1903; June, 1904, Dec., 1904, to Dec., 1905, June, 1906 to May, 1907; Oct., 1907, to Sept., 1908; admitted student of Gray's Inn, Aug., 1908; revr.-gen., B. Guiana, Sept., 1908; mem. exec. and legis. couns., Dec., 1908; ag. gov't sec., 22nd July to 22nd Oct., 1913; deputy sec., 2nd Sept. to 22nd Oct., 1913; treas. and mem. exec. and leg. couns., Kenya, Sept., 1922.

GRANT, ANDREW, M.I. Mech. E., M.I.Mech.E.—B. 1876; ed. Rennett's Acad., Aberdeen, and West of Scot. Tech. Coll., Glasgow; mech. engr., 1897; regd. boiler examiner, Br. Guiana, 1907; eng. engr., Demerara and Essequibo Rly., 1918-1919; J.P., 1917; supt. engr., col. steam service, Br. Guiana, 1920; supt. engr., col. transport dept., 1922; chmn., Seba comn.; mem. bd. of industrial training.

GRANT, CHARLES CAMERON, M.B.E.—King's student, Aberdeen Univ., 1897-8; M.A., dita., 1899 2nd asst., Fraserburgh pub. sch., Aberdeenshire, 1899-1901; 1st asst., Aberlour pub. sch.,
LANFF-SHIRE, 1901-2; priv. coun. certif., Scotch duem. dept., 1901; teacher, refugee camp, Springfontein, O.R.C., Nov., 1902; prin., govt. schl., Winburg, Jan., 1903; odorprpce. clk., educn. dept., Sept., 1904; admtrve. clk., 1905; sec., Grey Coll. coun., 1906; junr. prin. clk., educn. dept., 1912; I.F.B.E. for services in E. Africa, 1916-17; astt. regi., Univ. of S. Africa, 1918; registr., Univ. of S. Africa, 1922.

GRANT, D. K. S.—Asst. conservator of forests, E.A.P., Dec., 1912; conservator of forests, Tanyika Territory, Dec., 1920.

GRANT, EZRAEL AUGUSTUS.—Ent. Brit. Honduras civ. serv. after compet. exam., as copyist to survey dept., 27th Nov., 1899; 3rd cls. clk. (astt. keeper), King's warehouse, 1st Feb., 1906; 2nd cls. clk., P.W.D., 1st Apr., 1907; on active serv. with B.W.I. Regt. during war, 14th Apr., 1916 to 31st July, 1919; ag. 1st cls. clk., P.W.D., 7th Aug., 1919 to 31st Mar., 1920; acct., P.W.D., 1st Apr., 1920; ag. ch. clk. and storekeeper, P.W.D., 1st Apr., 1921; ag. astt. inspr., schl., during 1921 to 1923; astt. inspr., schl., provisionally, 1st Apr., 1923.

GRANT, McCALLUM.—Lieut.-gov., Nova Scotia, 29th Nov., 1916; re-apptd., 1922.

GRANT, R.—Suptdg. engr., Uganda rly. marine, 1911.

GRANT, R. W. LYALL.—M.A. (Aberdeen) 1895; studied at Gottingen and Marburg Unv.; L.B. (Edin.); Vans Dunlop Scholar in Law, Edin. Univ.; mem. Faculty of Advocs. (Scottish bar), 1903; lectured on law of domicile, Edin. Univ.; one of the compilers of the "Digest of Scottish Cases from 1800"; in practice at Scottish Bar till 1909; atty.-gen., Nyassaland, Apr., 1909; mem. of exec. and legis. couns.; ag. judge, Sept., 1909 to June, 1910, and from Aug., 1912, to May, 1913; responsible for census, 1910; judge of the high ct., Aug., 1914, and mem. of H.B.M. ct. of appeal for Eastern Africa, Aug., 1914; chmn. of native rising comm., 1915; mem. of various comm. in the protectorate; chmn., perm. bd. under Defence O. in C.; censor of German corres.; judge advoc., Norforce; ag. atty.-gen., 1916-18 in addn. to own duties; atty.-gen., Kenya col., Aug., 1920; mem. exec. and leg. couns.; African Geu. Serv. Med. with clasp, Nyassaland, 1915; Territorial Decor., 1923.

GRANT, THOS. ST. JOHN.—B.A., Dublin Univ., 1896; clk. to C. C. and R. M., Komga, Cape Colony, Dec., 1897; ditto, East London, June, 1898; ditto, Port Elizabeth, Jan., 1899; passed Cape civ. serv. law exam., Feb., 1899; clk., atty.-gen.'s off., Cape Town, July, 1899; clk. to R. M., Cape, Oct., 1899; registr. to judge pres. of high ct., Griqualand West, Sept., 1901; transf. to R.K.C. civ. serv. as astt. res. mag., Winburg, May, 1902; ditto, Bloemfontein, July, 1904; ag. res. mag., Hoopstad, Nov., 1905, to Mar., 1906; res. mag., Hoopstad, 1907; mag., Bethulie dist., 1913; Parij, Feb., 1913.

GRANTHAM, ALEXANDER WILLIAM GEORGE.—B.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1899; cadet, Hongkong, Nov., 1922.

GRAY, ALEXANDER.—B. 1873; clk., audit dept., Fiji, Jan., 1900; clk., treasy., Jan., 1891; acctnt., immigr. dept., May, 1893; acctnt., native axes, etc., June, 1899; cashier of immigr. acctnt. and clk., treasy., Mar., 1901; ag. acctnt., treasy., May, 1907; acctnt., treasy., 1910; 1st cls. clk., treasy., Jan., 1911; transf. to G.P.O., Mar., 1912.

GRAY, H. W., O.B.E.—Office supt., lieut.-gov.'s off., E.A.P., May, 1908; clk. of the couns., Oct., 1908; astt. dist. comsnr., 1911; dist. comsnr., Kenya, Jan., 1920; ch. registr. of natives, Jan., 1920.

GRAY, JAMES DUNBAR.—B. 1872; entd. N.Z. civ. serv., 1894; astt. priv. sec. to premier, 1894; partly reporting staff, 1896; sec., national recruiting bd., 1916; sec. of external affrs., 1919; also for Cook Is., 1922.

GRAY, JOHN.—B. 1874; ed. Glasgow Univ. and F.C. Training Coll., Glasgow; held several educational appts. in Scotland and England; served in S. African war; supt., Brandfort refugee camp, 1902-3; prin., Hoopstad schl., O.F.S., 1903; 1st cls. clk., educn. dept., O.F.S., 1904; senr. clk., educn. dept., 1912; ag. sec., educn. dept., Nov., 1918; prin. clk., educn. dept., 1919; sec., educn. dept., 1921.

GRAY, SIR REGINALD, KT. BACH, (1920), K.C. (1908).—B. 1861; called to the bar, Inner Tem., 1875; compiled, in 1884, Bermuda laws from 1690-1883; revising offr., Bermuda, 1889-93; compiled, in 1903, Bermuda laws from 1690-1902; counsel to statute law consolidation comm., since 1900; atty.-gen., Bermuda, 28th May, 1900; ag. chief just. in Oct. and Nov., 1911; ex-officio mem. of exec. coun.; M.L.A., 1895-1897, 1900-1906, and from 1907.

GRAY, MAJOR WILLIAM BAIN.—B. 1886; ed. George Watson's Coll., Edinburgh, Univ. of Edinburgh (M.A., 1st cls. hons. and Ph.D.) and New Coll., Oxford (B.Litt.); sometime Carnegie Research Fellow; lect., Technical Coll., Brighton; examr., Univ. of Edinburgh, Oxford and Cambridge joint bd. and Oxford local exams.; 2nd lieut., 6th Batt., The Royal Scots, Feb., 1912; mobilised, Aug., 1914; adjt., Jan.-Dec., 1915; capt., Aug., 1916; gen. staff, Aldershot comm., Dec., 1918-Apr., 1921; major, Army Educational Corps., Nov., 1920; major, R.A.R.O., Mar., 1923; comsnr., educn., British Guiana, Oct., 1924.

GREALY, DOMINICK GERALD, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1892; lieut., R.A.V.C., Feb., 1917; proceeded to Egypt, May, 1917; capt., Mar., 1918; joined 10th Divn., Palestine, Jan., 1919; demob., Nov., 1919; vety. offr., Gold Coast, 20th May, 1921.

GREAVES, SIR WILLIAM HERBERT, KT. BACH, (1904), K.C.—B. 1857; B.A., Oxon., honours, juris., 1879; called to the bar, Mid. Tem., 1880; ag. solr.-gen., Barbados, Aug., 1884, to July, 1885, and July, 1886, to Jan., 1887, when confirmed; J.P., Sept., 1885; escheator-gen., 1887; Q.C. for Barbados, 1890; mem. exec. coun., 1890; acted as atty.-gen., July to Dec., 1887, and June to Dec., 1891; mem. of house of assem. and of bd. of educn., 1888-1902; atty.-gen., Mar., 1896; ch. just., Apr., 1902.

GRECH, WYNHAM, LL.D. (Malta), 1913.—Called to the bar (Grays Inn), 1916; 2nd lieut., R.F.C., 1916; capt., R.A.F., 1918; sp. serv., Malta and Rome, 1917; attd. Italian Sup. Comil., 1918-19 (Chevalier, Crown of Italy); transf., unemployed list (R.A.F.), 1919; astt. legal adviser, Seychelles, 1921; ag. legal adviser and crown pros., 14th Mar., 1921 to 25th Sept., 1922; ag. ch. just., Dec., 1923 to Jan., 1924; crown pros., legal adviser etc., 1924.

GREEN, AMAZIAH.—Entd. audit dept., N.S. Wales, 1877; registr. of adjustments, audit dept., for two years; bookkeeper, post and telegraph dept., for eight years; acctnt., dept. of justice, 1887; senior inspr., treasy. dept., 1896; military staff paymr., 1900; Comwth. pub. serv. inspr. for W. Australia, 1902; is also Comwth. electoral offr., and registr. for Comwth. pub. wks. for W. Australia.
GREEN, ALFRED PIERCE.—B. 1866; surg., A.M.D., 1878; med. offr., col. forces in Basuto war, 1881; regtl. surg., left wing, C.M.R., 1881-4; med. offr., Cape rlya., 1885; ditto, Bechuanaland border pol., 1885; J.P., Mafeking, 1892; surg.-capt., Johannesburg mtd. rifles, 1901; sen. med. offr., concentration camp, Wymburg, O.R.C., 1902; Basutoland war medal, 1901; S. African war medal and clasp, 1901.

GREEN, CHARLES FRANCIS J.—Cadet, S. Sttlmts., Nov., 1898; ag. dist. offr., Prov. Wellesley, Mar., 1900; ag. 4th mag., Sing., June, 1901; passed final exam. in Malay, Oct., 1901; ag. dist. offr., Malacca, Feb., 1902; confirmed, July, 1903; ag. 2nd mag., Sing., July, 1906; passed exam. for dist. judge, July, 1909; offr. of class IV, as regisr., dist. judge and mag., Malacca, 23rd July, 1910; ag. inspr. of prisons, S. Sttlmts., 18th Mar., 1912; offr. of class III., 25th Apr., 1912; chmn., sanitary bd., Kuala Lumpur, 5th Nov., 1913; offr., cls. II., 1st Jan., 1919; chmn., Kinta sany. bd., 30th Dec., 1919; dep. res., munic. commsrs., Singapore, 30th Jan., 1921; ag. dir. of supplies and offr. in ch., fisheries, 2nd Oct., 1921.

GREEN, CLAUDE.—B. 1879; entd. Trinidad civ. serv., 10th Mar., 1896; ch. clk. to gen. man. of rlwya., 10th Mar., 1917.

GREEN, GEORGE.—B. 1894; ed. Westminster City Sch.; on mil. serv., Oct., 1914 to Mar., 1919; 2nd lieut., The Buffs; wounded in France; temp. clk., C.O., Oct., 1919 to Feb., 1920; miny. of lab., Sept., 1920 to Dec., 1920; C.O. Div., 1920 to June, 1922; apptd. cler. offr., C.O., 21st June, 1922.

GREEN, GEORGE C.—B. 1882; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to C.O., 26th Aug., 1901; cler. offr., higher grade, 1st Apr., 1922.

GREEN, GEORGE C.—B. 1897; clerical asst., col. sec.'s office, B. Guiana, 1912; 6th cls. clk., 1913; 3rd cls. clk., 1918; sec. to comm. for considering disposal of colony lands, 1917; 2nd cls. clk., 1920.

GREEN, HAROLD.—B. 1887; ed. at Queen Mary's Gram. Sch., Hants.; entd. Royal botanic gardens, Kew, 1907; asst. supt., botanical and forestry dept., Hong Kong, 1911; seconded for mil. serv., 1917-20; supt., botanical and forestry dept., Hong Kong, 1920; J.P., 1922.

GREEN, JOHN FREDERICK NORMAN, B.A.—B. 1873; scholar, Emman. Coll., Camb., 1890; bracketed 15th wrangler, 1893; B.A., 1893; 1st class, Part II., nat. science tripods, 1894; 2nd class clk., C.O., after compet. exam., Feb., 1896; priv. sec. to Sir E. Wingfield, Dec., 1898; to Sir M. Ommanney, 1900; 1st class clk., 16th June, 1902; sec. to col. regns. comm., 1907-8; principal clk., 10th Mar., 1916; asst. sec., 1st Apr., 1920.

GREEN, WILLIAM HENRY.—Fellow of the Associated Society of Accountants, London; clk., audit office, Transvaal, 6th June, 1901; 1st grade clk., 1st Jan., 1902; senr. clk., 1st Jan., 1909; 1st cls. prin. clk., control and audit office, Union of S. Africa, 1st Apr., 1912; senr. inspr., control and audit office, 1st Feb., 1920; ag. ch. inspr. of expenditure audit, 18th Feb., 1921 to 9th Aug., 1921.

GREEN, WILLIAM KIRBY.—Ed. Eton and Bruges; served in 10th regt. I.Y., S. Africa, 1900-01 (medal with 4 clasps); 3rd grade res., Nyassaland Prot., 1901; 2nd grade res., Feb., 1909; prov. commr., July, 1922.

GREENBERG, LEOPOLD.—B. 1885; ed. at Grey Coll., Bloemfontein, and S. African Coll., Cape Town; B.A., LL.B.; called to Transvaal bar, 1911; practised at Johannesburg, 1911-24; puisne judge, Transvaal Prov. divn., sup. c. Nov., 1924.

GREENE, HON. COL. EDWARD MACKENZIE C.M.G. (1909), K.C.V.D.—Hon. colonel in arm. served in Zulu war, 1878-1879 (medal, with clas. S. African war, 1899-1902, in command of Na Carbineers (Queen's medal, with three clas twice mentioned in despatches); mem. of Na legis. assem., 1893 to date of Union; min. rlyas. and harbours, 13th July, 1908; Na deleg. to S. African National Convention, 1908, to May, 1909; represented Na Impl. Confce. on defence, 1909; mem. and harbours bd., Union of S. Africa, 1916-1916.

GREENE, MAURICE CHERBY.—B. 1864; at Rathmine's schl. and St. Stephen's entd. schl., Dublin, and Dublin Univ.; B.A. student, King's Inns, Dublin, 1910-1911; res., N. Nigeria, 24th July, 1912.

GREENE, RT.HON. STWILLIAM CONNELL P.C. (1912), G.C.M.G. (1914), K.C.B. (1897).—B. 1864; ed. Harrow, and Pet Coll., Ox.; M.A. 1880; entrd. F.O. ag. 3rd sec. legation at Athens, 1889; ditts. Stuttgart, 1883; ag. chargé d'affaires Stuttgart, Darmstadt at various times, 1883-9; in diplomatic service, 1887; 2nd sec. Hague, Brussels, 1891-3; sec. of legation and chargé d'affaires, Teheran, 1893-6; H.M. agr. at Prus S.A. Republic, with rank of chargé d'affaires, 25th Aug., 1896, to 1899; envoy extraordinary Switzerland, 1901; ditto, Roumania, 1905; Denmark, 1910; H.M.'s Ambassador, Jan., 1911.

GREENER, HERBERT.—D.S.O., clk. dept., G.P.O., Cape, 1884; in charge of new order dept., 1886; 1st clk., admin. dept., B. Bechuanaland, 1888; recvr. of misc Vryburg, and P.M.G., Bechuanaland; examnr. of acct., acctant. to high comm. (town, 1890; paymr. (rank captain), Bech pol., 1891, combined with prin. cust. at Bech. Prot., 1896; specially employed as ass. of finances, Mafeking siege, and finances of mil. govt., Bloemfontein, 1899-1900; trans. S.A.C. as ch. paymstr. and acctant-gen. major, Oct., 1900; promoted lt.-col., regiar., Rhodes Univ. Coll., Grahamstown, June to 4th Oct., 1915.

GREENHALLGH, N., B.Sc., Hons. (Trin.), B. 1888; agric. and science master, Antigua gram. schl., 1910; lecturer in agric. scienc students of training coll., Antigua; asst. mgr. of schls., Barbados, 1912; lecturer in educ. master of method, training inst., Codrington Coll.; ag. chief inspr. of schls., Trinid., June to 4th Oct., 1915.

GREENHILL, MARCUS ARTHUR.—B. 1879; entd. C.O., Sep., 1914; apptd., after exam., asst. clk., C.O., Oct., 1916; on mil. service, May, 1917, to Feb., 1919.

GREENIDGE, CHARLES WILTON WOOD, B.A. (1889; educ. Harrison Coll., Barbados, and Davy Coll., Camb.; B.A. (Nat. Sci. Tripods) 1910; Lt.-Col., called to the bar, Mid. Tem., 1st Mar.; 1st cls. hon. criminal law; admitted to Barbados, 1912; assisted indexing revised laws Barbados; ag. mag., dist. "F," Barbados, 1912; ag. mag., dist. "A," June to Nov.; parochial treas., St. James', Barbados, and ch. boards for poor relief, sanitation and highw., Feb., 1915; ag. mag., dist. "A," Sept., ditto, dist. "B," Mar., 1916, to Apr., 1919; judge, ct. of appeal, Barbados; mag., dist.
St. Kitts, May, 1919; ag. crown atty., St. Kitts, and mem. legis. coun., Aug., 1919, to Jan., 1920.

GREENWAY, J. W.—B. 1861; ed. Ontario schls.; removed to Manitoba, 1879; in charge of schls. lands admstr. in Man. and N.W. Territories (now Sask. and Alta.), 1898; comnr. of Dom. lands, 1904.

GREENWOOD, THOMAS JAMES.—B. 1864; adj. of transport, Egyptian campaign, 1882; awarded Queen's medal and Khedive's star; inspr. Cyprus pol., Feb., 1887; ag. local comdt., Limassol, Oct. to Dec., 1894, and Apr. to July, 1895; bronze medal, roy. hum. soc., for saving and attempting to save life during Limassol floods, Nov. 12th, 1894; local comdt., Cyprus pol., 1896; ag. comnr., Kyrenia, May to Nov., 1900; ditto, Larnaca, Oct. to Dec., 1901; ag. comnr., Paphos, 1st Nov. to 26th Dec., 1907, and 12th June to 11th Sept., 1914; ditto, Larnaca, 17th June to 23rd Nov., 1910, 3rd May to 6th Nov., 1912, and 23rd Apr. to 29th Oct., 1915; provost marshal, 15th Aug., 1914 to 31st July, 1921; refugee comnr., 9th Nov., 1915 to 17th Feb., 1918; cable censor, 7th June, 1916 to 17th Feb., 1918; ag. comnr., Larnaca, 4th July, 1916 to 10th Feb., 1918; ditto, Paphos, 12th Feb., 1918 to 19th Feb., 1919; comnr. and coroner, 20th Feb., 1919.

GREGOROWSKI, REGINALD ADDINGTON.—2nd clk., govt. sec.'s office, O.F.S., Dec., 1895; priv. sec. to state pres., 6th Mar., 1896; landdrost, Bethlehem, Dec., 1897; priv. sec. to state pres., July, 1898; landdrost olk., Wepener, 1899; priv., govt. schl., Reddersburg, O.R.C., 1st Oct., 1900; astt. olk., eduon. dept., 1st Mar., 1901; schl. clk. and regtr., eduon. dept., 1st July, 1901; priv. clk., col. sec.'s off., June, 1909; ch. clk. to admstr., O.F.S. prov., 10th Aug., 1910.

GREGORY, CHARLES WILLIAM, M.B.E. (1919).—Natal Mounted pol. (Zululand), 1896-1901; attached to Army Service Corps, 1901-1902; chief storekeeper, central stores, Pretoria, Transvaal repatriation department, 1902-1904; Transvaal serv. ser., 1906; chief storekeeper, P.W.D., East Africa Prot. Sept., 1906.

GREGORY, HON. FRANCIS BROOKE, LL.B.—B. 1862; ed. at pub. schls. and Harvard Univ.; admtd. an atty., New Brunswick, 1884, and called to the bar, 1885; called to the bar, B. Columbia, 1890; regsr. of probate et., York Co., New Brunswick, 1885-1890; French cons. agt., at Victoria, B. Columbia, 1904-1909; comdt. 6th regt. Canadian garr. artil. at Victoria, B. Columbia, 1898-1903; lieut.-col., reserve of offrs. Canadian Militia; mem. of Diamond Jubilee contingent to England, 1897; on spec. ser. to Alaska in connection with Behring sea fisheries dispute, 1891-2; judge of sup. ct., B. Columbia, Nov., 1909.

GREGORY, HON. HENRY.—B. 1860; M.L.A. for N. Coolgardie, W. Australia, 1897; ditto for Menzies since 1901; min. for mines, 1901-2, and 1902-4; min. for mines and rly., Aug., 1905; ditto, 16th Sept., 1910, to Oct., 1911; mem. H. R., C. of A., 1913.

GREIG, CLINTON HENRY.—B. 1875; entd. customs dept., B. Guiana, 1895; sub. inspr., B. Guiana police, Dec., 1900; 2nd lieut. (unattached), B. Guiana militia, Dec., 1900; on special service to Trinidad (after riots), Apr. to July, 1903; inspr. of police, Trinidad, and comdt. Port of Spain fire brigade, Sept., 1903; capt., Trinidad local forces, May, 1905; special certif. (captain's), infantry training schl. of instr., Chelsea Barracks, London, and Hythe certif. (musketry), D., 1905; astt. supt. of police, Gambia, Aug., 1910; comnr. of police, sheriff and inspr. of prisons, July, 1911; ag. chief mag., Gambia, July to Oct., 1912; capt. comdg. Gambia volr. artil., Sept., 1912; ag. rec-gen., July to Aug., 1912, and Jan. to Mar., 1914; ag. offr.-in-charge of secretariat, and provtnl. M.L.C., 1912; provtnl. M.E.C., Dec., 1913; on active serv. in Cameroons, June, 1915, to Mar., 1916; dist. offr., with judicial powers, Duala prov., Cameroons, July, 1915; apptd. hon. capt. in the Army (for services with Cameroons Exped. Force), as from Mar., 1916; temp. capt., W.A.F.F., Gambia, May, 1917; mem., African taxation comte., 1921; del. to confere. of W. African contra. of cust., London, 1921.

GREIG, GORDON KASTLEY, A.R.S.M.—B. 1879; ed. Wellington Coll., and Royal Schl. of Mines, London; inspr. of mines, F.M.S., 1902; ag. astt. warden, I'ahang, 1907; astt. warden, Perak, 1910; ag. warden, Selangor, 1914; ag. warden, Perak, 1916 and 1920; ag. senr. warden of mines, F.M.S., Mar., 1921; warden of mines, Perak, Mar., 1921; ag. senr. warden of mines, F.M.S., Feb., 1922.

GRELL, JESSIE MITCHINSON POTTER, M.B., B.S. Cantab., M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P.—B. 1880; entd. med. serv., Trinidad, 1st June, 1908; dist. med. offr., 1st Aug., 1912.

GREY-WILSON, SIR WM., K.C.M.G. (1904), K.B.E. (1918), C.M.G. (1891), Commdr., Star of Roumania (1921).—B. 1852; ed. at Chelt. Coll.; priv. sec. to Sir William Grey, gov. of Jamaica, 1874; to Lieut.-Gov. Edwd. E. Rushworth, Mar., 1877; admstr., Major-Gen. J. R. Mann, R.E., Aug., 1877; to Lieut.-Gov. F. P. Barlee, Br. Honduras, Sept., 1877; and clk. of the exec. and legis. couns., June, 1878; ag. mg. Orange Walk, in charge of frontier scouts, Dec., 1879, to Apr., 1880, and June, 1880, to Mar., 1881; astt. col. sec. and treas., S. Leone, 1883; special comnr., Sulymah, Dec., 1883, to June, 1884; 4th astt. col. sec., G. Coast Col., 1884; col. sec., St. Helena, July, 1886; ag. gov., 1887; gov., 1890; gov., Falklands, 1897; gov., Bahamas, 5th May, 1904; ret., 1912.

GRIER, SELWYN MACGREGOR.—B. 1878; ed. at Marlboro' Coll. (classical scholar) and Pembroke Coll., Cambridge (classical scholar); 2nd class tripos, 1900; 1st class French and English special, 1901; B.A. 1900; called to the bar, Nov., 1910; schoolmaster at Berkhamstead, Herts., 1901-1902; ditto, Cheam, Surrey, 1902-1905; astt. res., Northern Nigeria, 1906; passed in Hausa, 1907; 3rd class res., 1st Oct., 1908; in charge of Zaria prov., April, 1910; and from May to Nov., 1911; sec., native affrs., Nigeria, 1st Jan., 1921.

GRIERSON, CHARLES HENRY ALEXANDER.—B. 1889; ed. privately and St. Paul's Schl.; served local forces and 2nd Batt. Loyal N. Lancs. Regt. in E. African campaign, 4th Aug., 1914 to 20th Jan., 1920; Turkana expdn., 1915; astt. polit. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1st Dec., 1916; adminis. offr., 1st grade, 1st Apr., 1921.

GRIFFIN, SIR CHARLES JAMES, KT. BACH. (1923), K.C., Ireland (1920), K.C., Gibraltar (1914).—B. 1875; B.A. (hons.) Royal Univ., Ireland; 1st scholar in modern literature, exhibtioner; Chancellor's gold medallist; called to the Irish Bar, June, 1898; went Connaught circuit; apptd. Crown prosecutor, B.C.A. Protectorate (now Nyasaland), July, 1901; ag. chief judicial offr. and H.B.M. vice-consul, Nov., 1901 to June, 1902; ag. judge of High Court, Feb. to Oct., 1904 and Nov., 1905, to Feb., 1906; atty.-
gen., Nov., 1905; judge of High Court, Feb., 1906, and member of H.B.M. Court of Appeal for Eastern Africa; chairman of comsn. on trading and licensing, May to Sept., 1909 (reed. thanks of Prot. govt.); sole comsnr. for revision of Nyasaland laws, 1913, and reed. thanks of Prot. govt.; atty.-gen., Gibraltar, Oct., 1914; King's proctor for prize ct. proceedings; K.C. for the colony, Dec., 1914; chief justice, Leeward Is., 1919; sole comsnr. for revision of laws of Antigua and Montserrat, 1921; ch. just., high ct., Uganda, 7th May, 1921; sole comsnr. for revision of laws of Uganda, 1923, and reed. thanks of govt. in coun.; chin., Batoka land comsn., 1924.

GRIFFIN, EUGENE PATRICK, M.B.E. (1918).—Third clk., treas., Gibraltar (after compet. exam.), Feb., 1883; pol. clk., 1883; 3rd clk., col. sec.'s office, 1886; 2nd class clk., Jan., 1890; 1st class clk., Jan., 1893; ch. clk. and cashier, P.O., Nov., 1893; transf. to col. sec.'s office, July, 1895; ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, and reg. of births, marriages, and deaths, 1913; ag. asst. col. sec. on various occasions; chief asst. sec., col. sec.'s office, and sec. to bd. of health, Aug., 1919; ag. col. sec., on two occasions; ag. inspr., schls., 1922.

GRIFFIN, NEVILLE ALFRED MALCOLM.—B. 1888; ed. Blundell's; pol. probationer, S. Stlnt., 1908; ag. asst. sup't. pol., Singapore, Feb., 1911; asst. sup't. pol., Penang, Mar., 1912; asst. sup't. pol., Malacca and ast. prot., Chinese, July, 1912; seconded, Kedah, Oct., 1914; adjt., S. S. pol., Oct., 1916; ag. sup't. pol., Singapore, Apr., 1920; sup't. pol., Penang, Mar., 1923.

GRIFFITH, A. W. M.—Administrative offr., S. Rhodesia adminstr., 12th Apr., 1912; war serv. with 2nd Rhodesia Regt., 30th Nov., 1914 to 12th Sept., 1916; polit. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 12th Sept., 1916.

GRIFFITH, CARL.—Asst. auditor, Gold Coast, 14th Jan., 1920.

GRIFFITH, FRANCIS W.—Matric. Loud. Univ., 1885; supernum. P.O. St. Vincent, Sept., 1885; clk. P.O., Jan., 1886; clk. to col. regist., June, 1886; marshal V.A. ct., Nov., 1887; escheator-gen. and casual receiver, Nov., 1890; inspr. of schls., Dec., 1890; ch. clk. govt. office and clk. of couns., June, 1893; J.P., Apr., 1894; filled combined offices of inspr. of schls. and local audit clk., Jan.-Dec., 1897; med. regist., Jan., 1898; spec. ment. in despa. and commended by S. of S. for services rendered in connection with hurricane relief work, 1898; sec. of hurricane loan bd., June, 1899; mag. 3rd dist. and mag. 1st dist. (criml. jurisdn.), Oct.-Nov., 1899; off. visitor and visiting just., Kingston prison, June, 1900; nominated offr. mem., Kingston bd., 30th June, 1900; sec. to hosp. and asylums inquiry coman., 1900; supvr. of cust. and port offr., Apr.-May, 1901; sup't. of Crown lands, land comsnr., and in charge of survey dept., May, 1903, to Jan., 1904; chief of pol., chief of excise, etc., Jan., 1905; confirmed July, 1907; chief of pol., Grenada, Oct. to Dec., 1907; deleg. of St. Vincent at Canadian Reciprocity Conference held at Barbados, Jan., 1908; land comsnr. and in charge of crown lands, May to Nov., 1910, and from Feb. to Apr., 1911; off. representative of St. Vincent before Canada-West Indies Royal Comsn., 1910; mem. exec. legis. comsn., Apr., 1911; rep. St. Vincent at Canadian-West Indian Reciprocity Conference held at Ottawa, 1911; fed. treas., Leeward Is. and treas., Antigua, Apr., 1913; J.P., Antigua, 1914; rep. Leewards at cust. confee., Trinidad, 1919; capt., Antigua defence force, has held various ag. apps.

GRIFFITH, SIR WM. BRANDFORD, K.T., B.A. (1898).—B. 1868; Gilchrist scholar, 1871; B.A. (Lond.), 1880; called to the bar, Mid. Term, Jan., 1881; ag. Queen's advoc., G. Coast Col., Apr., Oct., 1884; dist. commr., 1885; ag. puisne judge, Lagos, Jan., and Cape Coast, May, 1885; ag. Queen's advoc., 1886 and 1887; compiled ordinances of G. Coast Col., 1887; res. mag., Jamaica, 1888; R.M., St. Catherine, Feb., 1893; ag. agr. gen., May to Dec., 1893; ch. just., G. Coast, May, 1895; admstd. gov't. of Lagos, July, 1896; dep. for gov. G. Coast, Aug., to Nov., 1897; revised ordinances of G. Coast Col., 1898 and 1903; retired, 1911.

GRIFFITHS, JEFFREY ARTHUR, F.R.C.V.S. B. 1884; Ed. Univ. of Liverpool; veterinary in Nyasaland, 7th June, 1913; attached Intell. Corps, Nyasaland Field Force, Aug., 1914 to July, 1915; seconded to rinderpest comsn., German E. Afr., July, 1917 to May, 1919; ag. rinderpest comsn., Aug., 1918 to May, 1919; chief vet. offr., July, 1919; ment. in despa. (gallantry in South Africa, 1901; ment. in despa., service in Field Force, Nyasaland, 1915 and 1917; ag. dr. agr., Oct. to Dec., 1920.

GRIFFITHS, LIEUT. NOEL STEWART, R.N.—B. 1896; ed., Leatherhead Schl.; supt., div. dept., N. Prove., Nigeria, 5th Apr., 1922.

GRIFFITHS, W., A.M.I.E.E.—Imp. Ins. Office, 1889; R.N.A.S., 1915; twice ment. in despa.; transf., unemployed list, 1919; seconded Kenya and Uganda as engnr. ast., 1920; tel. engnr., 1922; ag. tel. engnr., 1923.

GRIMBLE, ARTHUR FRANCIS, M.A., F.R.L.S.—B. 1888; ed. Magdalene Coll., Cambridge, France Germany; cadet, Gilbert and Elllice Is., Mar., 1914; passed cadet, Mar., 1915; dep. comsnr. for W. Pacific, Aug., 1915; ag. dist. offr., Junv., Mar., 1916; dist. offr., Aug., 1916; cent. Gilberts, Feb., 1917; S. Gilberts, Oct., 1918; sp. comsnr. to settle native land disputes throughout sl. and organise records, Jan., 1920; ag. res. comsnr., Apr., to July, 1920 and Jan. to Feb., 1921; dist. offr., 1924; ag. res. comsnr., Mar., 1924.

GRIMMER, WARD CHIPMAN HAZEN, M.L.L.D.—B. 1888; admitted atty., 1880; barrister, 1881; K.C., 1920; elected to prov. leg. N. Bruna, 1903; re-elected, 1908, 1912; surv. gr. N. Bruna, 1908; atty.-gen., 1911; puisne judge appeal ct. of N. Bruna, Jan., 1914.

GRIMSHAW, HERBERT C. W.—B. 1874; privately, and at Trin. Coll., Dublin; B.A., 1896; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1897; lieut., 5th Batt., Royal Dublin Fusiliers, 1911; dist. comsnr., Gold Coast, 1902; ag. agr. gen., 3rd May to 10th Aug., 1907; cantonment mag., Coomassie, 1909; prov. comsnr., Gold Coast, 1911; ret. through ill-health, 1915; paymaster, army pay dept., Oct., 1916; Mar., 1917; pres., dist. ct., Cyprus, 14th Mar., 1917; ag. puisne judge on several occasions; puisne judge, 1st Nov., 1923; ag. ch. just., Feb. to Mar., 1924 and Nov., 1924.

GRINDLE, SIR G. E. A., K.C.M.G. (1922), C.B. (1919); C.M.G. (1914).—B. 1869; schoo. of Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford; 1st class classics, 1889; 1st class in final classical sch., 1891; B.A., 1891; elected fellow of C.C.C., 1891; Chancellor's English Essay, 1892; M.A., 1894; 2nd class clk., in local govt. board, Feb., 1893; called to the bar at Lincoln's Inn, Nov., 1895; 2nd class clk., after compet. exam., in office of S. of S. for Cola, 10th Feb., 1896; ass. priv. sec. to Mr. Chamberlain, Nov., 1898; le...
GULLIVER, E. G.—Cust. astt., Kenya, July, 1916.

GUNARATNA, JULIUS ALBERT.—B. 1869; apptd. to cls. V. Ceylon civ. serv., May, 1920; office astt., Matara Kachcheri, May, 1920.

GUNN, HON. JOHN.—B. 1885; M.P. for Adelaide, 1915; leader, party, Labour Party, 1918; premier and treas., S. Australia, Apr., 1924.

GUPPY, ROBERT.—Imperial postal serv., 31st Mar., 1892; ch. clk. and acctnt., post and tel. dept., G. Coast, 1900; ag. dir. of telegraphs, 2nd June to 26th July, 1901; acctnt., 1902; prepared system of accounting passed in Council and brought into force 1st Sept., 1902.

GURNER, JOHN AUGUSTUS.—B. 1855; ed. at Chelt. Coll., and Jesus Coll. (Camb.), LL.B.; called to the bar, Inner Tem., 1877; party, draughtsman, Victoria, May, 1882; Crown prosecutor, Mar., 1889.

GURNEY, H. L. G.—Astt. dist. commnr., Kenya, June 1921.

GUSHUE, GEO. WILLIAM.—B. 1854; M.H.A. for Trinity Dist., Newfoundland, 1894; again elected, 1900; re-elected, 1904; min. of pub. wks., 1900.

GUTHRIE, HON. DAVID HENRY.—B. 1856; ed. Kildare St. Coll., Dublin; elected to N.Z. parl., 1908; whip to Reform party, 1910; min. of lands, 1918-24; min. of rly.s., 1922-23; mem., exec. coun., without portfolio, 1924.

GUTHRIE-SMITH, FRANK, M.A.—B. 1873; ed. at Watson's Coll., Edinburgh Univ. and Trin. Coll., Cambridge; barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn, June, 1900; conveyancer to the land office, Uganda Prot., June, 1913; mag., May, 1914; ag. atty.-gen., Mar., 1917 to July, 1918; puisne judge and mem. of ct. of appeal for Eastern Africa, June, 1919; chancellor of the diocese of Uganda.

GYDE, CHARLIE JOHN.—Indian govt. service, 1897-1902; astt. engrnr., P.W.D., Transvaal, June, 1902; inspr. of wks., July, 1904; dist. engrnr., Mar., 1907; inspecting engrnr., Sept., 1917.

HADDON, ERNEST B., M.A., F.R.A.I.—B. 1882; ed. Christ's Coll., Camb.; nat. science trips, 1904; dip. anthorp., Camb., 1912; astt. collr., Uganda, 1905; dist. commnr., 1912.

HADDON-SMITH, SIR GEO. BASIL, K.C.M.G. (1915); C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1861; lieut. Royal Guernsey militia, 1879; attached 32nd (D.C.L.I.) regt., 1880; attached 107th (Royal Sussex) regt., 1881; astt. inspr., Lagos constab., 1886; adjk., 1887; priv. sec. to ag. gov. and clk. of coun., 1887, 1889, and 1893; ag. inspr.-gen. and sheriff of Lagos, 1888, 1890, 1891, and 1893; ag. dist. commnr., 1887, 1888, 1889, and 1891; took part in Jebu expedition, 1892, mentioned in despatches (medal and clasp); political offr. on Sir G. Carter's mission to Yorubaland, 1893; astt. col. sec., Lagos, 1894; ag. col. sec., 1895; priv. sec. to Sir F. Scott in Ashanti expdn., 1896; ch. ass. col. sec., G. Coast, 1896; ag. col. sec., 1896-7; mem. of exec. and legis. coun., G. Coast col.: political offr. to Col. Sir J. Willcocks in the Ashanti expdn., 1900; took part in relief of Kumasi, spec. ment. in despatches (Ashanti medal and clasp); ag. gov. Gambia, July to Oct., 1901; col. sec., S. Leone, 1901-1911; ag. gov. of S. Leone on many occasions; gov., Bahamas, 1912; gov., Windward Is., 14th Dec., 1914; assumed govt., 30th Dec., 1914; ret., 1924.

HADDRILL, CYRIL F.—B. 1902; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 29th Apr., 1920.

HAHN, D. M., M. Inst. C.E.—B. 1867; ed. Queen's Roy. Coll., Trinidad, Realschool, Hamburg, and Technological Inst., Hamburg; in
charge of govt. saw mill, Trinidad, Jan., 1897; foreman, P.W.D., Jan., 1888; ag. ast. engr., 1891; ast. engr., in charge of wks. and bidding, Feb., 1894; ast. engr., office and wks., Nov., 1899; engr., office and wks., Apr., 1906; ag. div. engr., N. Div., 1903 and 1907, in addition to substantive duties; ag. inspr. of mines, July, 1907 to June, 1908; and dep. inspr. of mines, July, 1908, in addition to substantive duties; mem. bd. of industrial training; ast. dir., pub. wks., Apr., 1914; ag. dir., pub. wks., on several occasions.

HAKE, WALTER CONWAY.—H.M.S. "Conway," 1902-1904; midshipman, R.N.R.; served in H.M.S. "Essex," 1908; H.M.S. "Roxburgh," 1910; H.M.S. "Leander," 1912; in command, West Indian Mail Steamers, 1913-14; navigating lieut., H.M.S. "Edinburgh Castle," 1914-1917; navigating lieut., H.M.S. "Tyne," 1918; elected a younger brother of Trinity House; in commd., H.M.S. "Fame" (China Station), 1918-1920; elected F.R.G.S., 1923; awarded the R.D., promoted to lieut. commdr. and placed on the retired list; ag. ast. harbmr., and apptd. ast. harbmr., 1920; ag. harbmr., 1921, 1923 and 1924.

HALFYARD, HON. W. W.—Elected M.H.A., Fogo, Newfoundland, 1913; min. of agric. and mines, 1917; M.E.C., 1917; col. sec., 1918.

HALL, GUTHRIE.—B. 1897; 2nd lieut., Cheshire Rgt., 1915; lieut., 1917; served with Waziristan Field Force, 1919; ast. dist. comsrr., Gold Coast, 1921.

HALL, J. D., B.A. (Oxon).—Cadet, S. Sttlmts., Nov., 1910; ag. dep. regiar., sup. ot., Singapore and sec., Mohammedan and Hindu endowments bd., in addition, Apr., 1911; ag. dist. offr., Alor Gajah, Apr., 1912; passed cadet, July, 1913; supernmy. offr., cl. V., continued ag. dist. offr., Alor Gajah, Dec., 1913; ast. adviser, Batu Pahat, Johore, Feb., 1914; supernmy. offr., cl. IV., Dec., 1919; ag. 2nd mag., Dec., 1919; ag. 2nd ast. col. sec., Mar., 1920; 3rd ast. col. sec., Apr., 1920; ag. 2nd ast. col. sec., Apr., 1921; ag. 2nd ast. sec. A., June, 1921; ag. 1st ast. sec. B., Dec., 1921.

HALL, J. HATHORN, D.S.O., M.C. Croix-de-Guerre (Belgium).—B. 1894; ed. St. Paul's Schl., and Lincoln Coll., Oxford (1913-14); B.A.; on mily. serv., France and Belgium, Dec., 1915 to July, 1916, Oct., 1916, to Dec., 1918, Germany, Dec., 1918, to Apr., 1919; lieut. Royal Munster Fusiliers, Dec., 1914; capt., Dec., 1915; staff-capt., Mar., 1918; brig. major, Oct., 1918; wounded, 1916; ment. in desp., 1919; Egyptian civ. serv., miny. of finance, Sept., 1919, to Feb., 1921; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, ast. prin., C.O., 17th Feb., 1921.

HALL, PHILIP EDWARD.—B. 1877; ed. at Clifton Coll. and Wadham Coll., Oxford (B.A.); ast. native comsrr., N.E. Rhodesia, 12th Jan., 1901; native comsrr., 1st Sept., 1902; ast. mag., 15th May, 1905; ag. mag., 25th Oct., 1911 to 16th Sept., 1912; mag., 26th Aug., 1915; ag. res. mag., Barotse dist., 5th Aug., 1920 to 20th May, 1921; J.P.

HALL, ROGER EVANS.—B. 1883; ed. Winchester and New Coll., Oxford; 3rd cl. hon. mods.; 2nd cl. hon. final jurisprudence; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1908; ast. dist. comsrr., Gold Coast, 1910; crown counsel, 1914; ag. senr. crown counsel, 1914; senr. crown counsel, 1915; ag. solr.-gen., 1916, 1917 and 1918; circuit judge, Ashanti (temporary appt.), 1918; ag. atty.-gen., 1919; circuit judge, Ashanti and N. Territories, G. Coast, 1st Jan., 1920; ag. puisne judge, 1920; puisne judge, 1921.

HALL, W.—B. 1901; apptd. after comp. exam., ast. clk., and assigned to C.O., Jan., 1914.

HALLIFAX, EDWIN RICHARD, C.M.G. (1922), O.B.E. (1918).—Ed. Blundell's schl.; Blundell's scholar, Balliol Coll., Oxford, B.A., 1896; cadet, Hong Kong, 1897; pas. cadet, 1900; ag. police mag., New Territor., 1899; pol. mag., Hong Kong, 1899; J.P., 1901; ast. supt. of pol., and pol. mag., N.T., 1901; ag. regiar.-gen., 1902; acted as dep. sup. pol., ast. supt. of fire brigade, capt. supt. of pol., etc., on several occasions, 1902-04; seconded Transvaal emigrn. agt. at Chinwangtao, 18th dist. offr., N.T., 1907; in addition, acted as land offr., N.T., 1907 and 1908; ag. inspr. mag., 1909 to 1911; ag. dep. supt. of police, ast. supt. of fire brig., 1911; ag. regiar.-gen., M.L.C., 1911; M.E.C., 1912; regiar.-gen., 1913; title altered to sec. for Chinese affairs, 1913; sec. to gov., in addition, 1914 to 1915; conc. Hong Kong sec., Br. Empire Exhibn., 1924.

HALL-JONES, HON. SIR WILLIAM, K.C.M.G. (1910).—B. 1851; ed. at public schls.; arrived New Zealand, 1875; mem. of house of representatives for Timaru, New Zealand, 1890; min. of pub. wks. and marine, 1896; premier-treas., min. for educn. and labour, June, 1904; resig. premiership, and assumed portfolio pub. wks. and rlys. in Ward ministry, 1904-06; high comsrr. in Lond., 1908-1912; LL.D., since 1913.

HAM, GORDON LUPTON.—Cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1908; lent to Kelantan, 13th, Oct. 1910; cls. IV., S. Sttlmts., 1st Jan., 1918; ag. ast. ast. col. sec., 14th Apr., 1919; clk. of comsrr., 2nd Sept., 1919; 1st ast. col. sec., S. Selangor and clk. of ounrr., Jan., 1920; ast. offr. mag., Dec., 1920; ag. sec. to high comsrr., Feb., 1921; ag. ast. adviser to gov't. of Kelantan, Apr., 1921; 1st ast. ast. sec. B. S. Sttlmts., Apr., 1921.

HAMBLIN, R. A.—B. 1881; apptd. after compet. exam., elk. of the 2nd div. of art. ser. and temporarily employed in the same and art dept. from Mar. 21st to May 26th, 1899; assigned to C.O. July, 1899; conf. clk., Jan., 1918.

HAMILTON, ANDREW TODD.—B. 1879; mast., educn. dept., Hong Kong, 1910; on milt. serv., 14th Dec., 1917 to 11th Feb., 1919; mast., cls. II., 1st Jan., 1920; ast. ma., 1921.

HAMILTON, ARTHUR WEEDMORE HARTWIG.—B. 1887; ed. Tonbridge Schl.; probationer, 1908; proceeded to Amoy to study Chinese (Hokkien), Apr., 1908; passed final exam. in Hokkien, Jan., 1911; ag. ast. supt., pol., Singapore, Feb., 1911; passed final exam. Malay, Jan., 1912; ast. supt., pol., Prai, Mar., 1913; ag. ch. pol. offr., Kelantan, Jan., 1915; ast. supt., pol., Singapore, June, 1915; ast. supt., pol., Penang, Oct., 1916; ast. supt., pol., Singapore, Apr., 1920; ag. dir. crimin. intell., May, 1920; ast. comsrr., pol., Kedah, Apr., 1921; ag. ch. pol. offr., Malacca, Feb., 1922; dep. comsrr., F.M.S. and ch. pol. ch., Pahang, Feb., 1923.

HANDS, ARTHUR L. C., M.B.E.—B. 1880; clk., in P.O., St. Helena, Sept., 1896; 2nd clk., col. sec.'s off., Apr., 1898; regiar. of births and deaths, 1904-07; ch. clk. and clk. to exec. coun., Jan., 1907; J.P., 1910; ag. crown prosecutor, clk. of the peace and pol. mag. during 1923.

HANDYSIDE, WILLIAM LUCAS, M.A. (Glas.)—B. 1891; prizeman, hons. English, Glasgow Univ., 1913; ast. mast., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, July, 1915; ag. normal mast., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, 1918-20; ag. master of method, Hong Kong Univ., 1918-20; ast. mast., cls. II., 1st Jan., 1920; lecturer, teachers' classes, tech. inst., 1922; external examir., geography, history of educn., 1922, and prac. teaching, Hong Kong Univ.

HANKEY, Lieut.-Col. Sir, M. P. A., G.C.B. (1919); K.C.B. (1916); C.B. (1912).—B. 1877; ed. Rugby; joined R.M.A., 1895; served in H.M.S.
