HANKINSON, WALTER CROSSFIELD, M.C. (1918).—B. 1894; ed. Manchester Gram. Schl. and Jesus Coll., Oxford (exhibitioner); private, Royal Fusiliers, Sept., 1914; 2nd lieut., Yorks and Lancs. Regt., 9th Jan., 1915; lieut., 1st Apr., 1915; capt., 13th May, 1915; served in Egypt and France; demobilised, 28th Feb., 1919; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, 2nd cls. clk., C.O., Feb., 1920; ast. priv., 1st Apr., 1920; ast. priv. sec. to Duke of Devonshire, 1st Mar., 1923; ast. priv. sec. to Mr. J. H. Thomas, 22nd Jan., 1924.

HANN, HUGH.—B. 1862; joined R.A. 1881; served in India, 1882 to 1890; ret. from serv., 1890; joined home prison serv., 1891; promoted clk. and schoolmaster, 1896; sup't. of pris., S. Leone, 1891; sheriff and ag. sup't. of pol., S. Leone, July to Sept., 1902; J.P. for colony, 1902; formed S. Leone fire brigade and first sup't., 1893; 1st ast. sup't. of pris., Ceylon, 1906; sup't. of pris., Kandy, 1st Nov., 1906, to Sept., 1908; ast. sup't., convict establishment, Colombo, Oct., 1908, to Dec., 1909; ag. insp.gen. of prisons, Ceylon, and sup't. of convict establishment, Sept. to Dec., 1909; sup't., Mutwal and Hulftsdorp prisons, Jan. to Aug., 1910; sup't., Mahara prison, Sept., 1910; ag. insp.r-gen. of prisons, Sept. to Dec., 1911; sup't., Fremantle prison, W. Aust., 1st Jan., 1912.

HANNAY, HENRY DESMOND.—Sub-inspr., Bechuanaland Prot. police, 1901; ag.mag., N'Gami, 1907-08; inspr., Feb., 1914; ag. res. mag., 1914.

HANSON, B. E.—Edue. Clifton Coll.; clk., exchequer and audit dept., 10th Apr., 1899; clk., audit off., Hong Kong, 1st June, 1900; ag. local aud., 31st Mar., 1901, to 1st Aug., 1902; ast. audr., Uganda, 9th Jan., 1904; ag. local aud., May to Nov., 1904, and July to Nov., 1906; local aud., N. Nigeria, 3rd Mar., 1908; local aud., Sierra Leone, 23rd July, 1909; audr., Nigeria, 23rd June, 1921.

HARCOURT, HAROLD WALLACE.—B. 1885; examng. clk., audit dept., Fiji, Nov., 1909; book-kpr., treas'y., May, 1910; chief audr., Tonga, under three years agreement with native govt., June, 1911; audr.-gen. and govt. sec., Sept., 1911; ag. premier, 1st Jan. to 25th Feb., 1914; 2nd ast. audr., Fiji, 14th Oct., 1914; ag. ch. clk.,
treasy., 15th Oct., 1918; ag. ast. audr., 3rd July, 1920; ag. ch. clk., treas. and sec., comanrs. of currency, 29th Oct., 1920; ag. comanr., inland rev., 18th Apr., 1921; cust., enemy property and contr., clearing office, Fiji and W. Pacific (conjoint), 11th May, 1921; provisionally M.L.C., 15th Aug., 1921; ag. comanr. of stamps (conjoint), 18th Jan., 1922; ag. audr. (conjoint), 3rd Apr., to 30th June, 1922; dep. treas. and comanr. of inland rev. and stamps, 1st Jan., 1923; ag. col. treas., 15th Apr. to 15th Aug., 1924; prov. mem., exec. coun., 22nd Apr., 1924; ditto, leg. coun., 20th July, 1924.

HARDING, ALFRED J., O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1878; ed. Christ's Coll., Brecon, and St. John's, Camb.; foundtn. schlr., 1899; 1st class nat. sci. trip. part I., 1900; B.A., 1900; M.A., 1920; ent. C.O. after compet. exam. as 2nd cl. clk., Oct., 1901; sec. to comatee, to inquire into organisation of Crown agents' office, 1908; astt. priv. sec. to Lord Crewe, 1st Feb., 1909; sec. to Royal comanr. on Mauritius, 1909; astt. priv. sec. to Mr. Lewis Harcourt, Nov., 1910; ag. lat. cls. clk., Sept., 1910 to Jan., 1911, and from 1st Apr., 1912; 1st cls. clk., 12th Oct., 1914; sec. colonial blue-books comtee., 1917; ag. prin. clk., 1st Jan., 1920; astt. sec., 1st Apr., 1920.

HARDING, EDWARD J., C.M.G. (1917), M.A. (1907).—B. 1880; ed. Dulwich Coll. and Hertford Coll., Oxford (scholar, 1899); 1st cls. class. mods., 1901; 2nd cls. lit. hum., 1903; B.A., 1903; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1912; apptd. after compet. exam., 2nd cls. clk., marine dept., bd. of trade, 30th Nov., 1903; 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 31st May, 1904; sec. to distressed colonial seamen comtee., 1909; astt. priv. sec. to Mr. Lewis Harcourt, 14th Oct., 1912; sec. to Dominions Royal Comanr., Dec., 1912; ag. 1st cls. clk., 10th Apr., 1916; 1st cls. clk., 4th June, 1916; on military service from 20th Nov., 1915, to 9th Apr., 1916; sec. to comatee. for attlt. of ex-service men within the Empire, 1917; ag. prin. clk., 1st Apr., 1919; prin., 1st Apr., 1920; astt. sec., 1st Dec., 1921.

HARDY, THOMAS JAMES, A.C.R.A. (1924).—B. 1900; passed exams. of London Assn. of Accts. and Corporation of Accts., 1923; diplomas in book-keeping and accountancy, executoryship and trust law and accts., mercantile law, auditing and economics, 1923; ent. C.O., 3rd Mar., 1916; apptd. astt. clk., C.O., after compet. exam., 24th Apr., 1918; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

HARE, REGINALD CHARLES, C.M.G. (1915).—B. 1853; clk. treasy., W. Australia, Apl., 1881; pol. inspr. S. diast., June, 1886; ag. gov't. rea., Wyndham, May, 1888; ditto, Roebourne, June, 1889; sec., W. Australian govt. agency, London, May, 1891; ag. agent-gen., 1909.

HARKNESS, EDWARD BURNS, C.M.G. (1922).—Entered treasy., New S. Wales, 1891; sec. to Premier's office, 1901-16; under sec., depts. of ch. sec. and public health, since 1916.

HARLEY, JOHN A.—M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.), certif. Lond. S.T.M. (with distinction), July, 1909; apptd. to W.A.M.S., Gambia, 16th Apl., 1910; ag. protectorate med. offr., 2nd Jan. to 11th May, 1911.

HARMAN, H. A. A.F., D.S.O.—B.Sc. (Lond.), Capt. 4th (S.R.) Batt., S. Staff. Regt.; prin., govt. training inst. for teachers, Accra, Gold Coast, 17th Apl., 1912; ag. adjt. Gold Coast volunteers, 29th Jan. to 30th July, 1915; supervising offr., No. 5 Young Officers Compy., West Lancs. Divn., 29th Nov., 1915, to 8th Mar., 1916 (temp. major); att. G. Coast Regt., 14th May, 1916, to 31st Dec., 1918, for service in E. Africa (slightly wounded twice ment. in desps.); major, 2nd in command, 4th Batt. Gold Coast Regt., 1st Nov., 1918; pr. King's Coll., Lagos, Dec., 1919.

HARPER, CHARLES HENRY, C.M.G. (1919), O.B.E. (1919).—Ed. at Blundell's schl., Devon; Exeter Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1899; called to the Inner Temple, 5th May, 1909; cadet, G. C.O., 24th Jan., 1900; attached to Ashanti field force, 1st June to 1st Sept., 1900; astt. dist. comm., Sept., 1901; ag. astt. col. sec., 26th Oct., 1901; astt. col. sec., 8th Feb., 1906; ag. chief ass't. sec. and clk. of couns., 14th Apl. to 25th June, 1908; cantonment mag., Coomassie, 16th June, 1908; prov. comanr., 23rd July, 1909; offr., 1911; ag. chief ass't. and clk. of couns., 1st May to 29th June, 1912; ag. col. sec., Jan., 1912, and from 3rd May to 27th Aug., 1914; attached to Togoland field force, 29th Aug. to 2nd Dec., 1914; chief astt. col. sec., 14th Feb., 1915; ag. col. sec., 25th June to 17th Nov., 1915; sec., 1915, to 27th June, 1916, and from 1st Dec., 1916, to 23rd Apl., 1917; ch. comm., Ashanti, May, 1920; gov't., St. Helena, 20th Dec., 1924; assumed gov't., 2nd Feb., 1925.

HARRAGIN, ALFRED ERNEST ALBERT—B. 1877; sub-inspr., constab., Trinidad, 1st Jan., 1905; inspr., 1st Nov., 1912; now servin' in the army as temp. major.

HARRAGIN, WALTER—B. 1890; barrister-at-law; clk. of the peace and sub.-regis., San Fernando and Victoria, Trinidad, 9th Mar., 1914; served with the army as temporary captn., Victoria, Sept., 1919; crown counsel, 17th ag. solr.-gen., Apr. to Oct., 1924.

HARRAGIN, WILLIAM THORNTON.—B. 1878; clk., sup. ct., Trinidad, 1910; astt. maj., Queen's Royal Coll., 1911; held comanr. in Gordon Highlanders, 1915-16; served in France, May to Oct., 1915; astt. mast., Queen Victoria Sch., Fiji, 1916; cadet, Solomon Is., 1917; superint. of customs, 2nd cls., G. Coast, 1st June, 1918; ag. astt. dist. comm., Jan.-Mar., 1919; astt. dist. comm., 28th Apr., 1919; ag. dist. comm., 1919 and 1920; astt. col. sec., 1st Jan., 1921.

HARREL, MELVILLE DAVID, O.B.E. (1921).—B. 1872; attchd. Royal Irish constab. depot, certifs., drill and police duties; sub-inspr. Jamaican constab., Jan., 1896; spl. serv. to Nicaragua, Jan., 1897; 3rd cl. inspr., Nov., 1901; 2nd Feb., 1907; 1st cl., June, 1913; deputy inspr.-gen., Oct., 1913; ag. inspr.-gen. of police prisons, July to Sep., 1914; inspr.-gen. of police and comdt. local forces, Barbados, Aug., 1919; local rank of lieut.-col., 1919.

HARRIGAN, SAMUEL SIMONS.—Head teacher Wesleyan schlr., Virgin Is., 1878; resig., 1901.
HARRINGTON, WILFRED FRANCIS, M.C.—B. 1886; asst. polit. offr., 5th Dec., 1917; adminis. ffr., 1st grade, Tanganyika Territory, 1st Aug., 1923.

HARRIOTT, EDMUND COWLES.—B. 1865; clk. comsrr., and to legis.bd., Turks and Caicos Islds., Nov., 1887; inspected govt. schls., 1890, 1891, nd 1902; ag. regisr. sup. ct., and of deeds, 1891 nd 1894; ag. asst. comsrr. (dist. mag., regisr. up. ct. and regisr.-gen., man. savings bank, and aspr. of pol. and prisons), G. Turk, May to July, 896, Aug. to Nov., 1901, and May to Aug., 1906; P., 1901; ag. aud., Aug. and Sept., 1901, and une to Aug., 1906; ag. dist. mag., visiting Caicos s., July, 1902; ag.acoont. and clk. (coll. ofr., estmr., cashier and regisr. shipping); comsrr.'s office, Apl. to June, 1903; confirmed July, 1903; g. ofl. mem., legis. bd., 1906; 1st. cl. clk., rev. sept., Jamaica, Jan., 1907; ag. asst. comsrr., alt Cay, May to July, 1909; ag. deputy stamp msnrr., Aug. to Nov., 1909; served in cust. ept., occupied territory, E. Africa, 1916-18; collr. f taxes and parochial treas., St. Anne, Jamaica, an., 1920.

HARRIS, ST CHARLES ALKXANDER, K.C.M.G. (1917); C.B. (1904): C.M.G. (1900); C.V.O. (1917); M.V.O. (1911), B.A.—B. 1858; scholar, rizeman, and Porteous medallist of Christ's Coll., Camb.; Taunred student in com. law, Linc's nn., 1877; 12th classic, 1878; apptd. 2nd cls. clk., O., after open competn., 1st July, 1879; sec. to W. Indies Finance Comms., Dec., 1882; asst. sec. sugar Bounties Confce., 1889; priv. sec. to Mr. Luxton, M.P., Jan., 1894, to June, 1895; and to the Earl of Selborne, June, 1895; 1st cls. clk., 896; specially engaged in work connected with Venezuelean bndry. arbitn., 1896-8; prin. clk., 898; sent to Paris, 1899, in connection with the Venez. bndry. arbitn.; conducted British case in Brazilian-B. Guiana bndry. arbitn., 1901-4; mem. of comtee. to inquire into organisation of brown agents' office, 1908; ch. clk., 1st Feb., 1909; presented C.O. on advisory comtee. of comm.stell., B. of T., 1900-17; mem. of managing comtee. of Imp. Inst. 1909-16; gov. and c. in c., Newfoundland, 1st Nov., 1917; assumed govt., 7th Dec., 1917; ret., 1922; author of numerous articles in Dict. of Pol. Econ. on economic and statistical subjects, and of lives of various colonial evs. and statesmen in Dict. of Nat. Biog.

HARRIS, DAVID JOHN EDWARD.—B. 1897; optd. after compet. exam., boy clk., G.P.O., 1912; on mily. serv. (R.E. and R.A.F.), 8th Oct., 1915 to 27th Feb., 1919; tempy. employment k., Miny. of Labour, 1st Oct., 1919 to 20th June, 1920; permanent ditto, 21st June, 1920 to 10th Sept., 1922; cler. offr., C.O., 1st Oct., 1922.

HARRIS, HERBERT JOHN.—B. 1884; entd. serv. Imperial Post Office, 1st Jan., 1900; transf'd. dept. of posts and telegraphs, Cape of Good ope, 13th Nov., 1902; resig., Dec., 1907, and td. S. Rhodesia telegraph serv., 1st Jan., 1908; conded for serv. with African Trans-Continental telegraph Co., 12th Apr., 1908; resig., 31st an., 1910; provincial postmaster, S. Nigeria, 1st eb., 1910; asst. supt. of posts and telegraphs, Malay States, 14th June, 1918; seconded for il. serv., Mar., 1918; 2nd lieut., Indian army s. of offrs., unattached, Mar., 1918; 2nd lieut. at Punjabis, July, 1918; lieut., Mar., 1919; released from army serv., Oct., 1919; resumed duty, Kuala Lumpur, July, 1920; relinquished coman., I.A.R.O., Sept., 1920.

HARRIS, REGINALD ROBERT.—B. 1890; ed. Queen Mary's Schi., Basingstoke; clk., govt. sec.'s office, Nyassaland Prot., 18th June, 1913; editor, govt. gaz., since 1914; clk., 1st grade, Oct., 1920; ag. ch. clk., secretariat, Nov. 1920 to June, 1921.

HARRIS, HON. ROBERT EDWARD, D.C.L., LL.D.—B. 1860; ed. High School, Annapolis Royal; pri. tuition; D.C.L., King's Coll. Univ., Windsor, N.S.; LL.D., Dalhousie Univ., Halifax, N.S.; called to the N.S. bar, 1882; K.C., 1889; practised at Yarmouth, 1882-92; Halifax, 1892-1915; justice, sup. ct., N.S., 1915; ch. just., sup. ct., N.S., 7th Feb., 1918; selected as third arbitr. to determine value of Canadian Northern Ry. stock, on its acquisition by the Dom. Govt.; mem. of the coun. of the N.S. Barrister's Soc., and for some years pres.; chancellor, diocese of N.S., 1905; dir., schl. for blind, Halifax; gov. of King's Coll., Windsor, N.S.

HARRISON, ALBERT SIDDON, M.Sc. Manchester, 1908.—B. 1887; on staff of Manchester Univ., and asst. mast., Fielden demonstrn. schl., 1908-10; senr. mast., Haleowen commnl. schl., 1910-12; on staff Manchester Univ. educn. dept., and headmnr., Fielden demonstrn. schl., 1912-14; inspr. of schla., Ceylon, Apr., 1914; on active serv., 1918-19; ag. asst. dir. of educn., Ceylon, May, 1919, to Apr., 1920; ag. dir. of educn., Apr. to Oct., 1920; ag. asst. dir. of educn., Oct., 1920; prin., training coll., Jan., 1921.

HARRISON, CUTHBERT WOODVILLE.—B. 1874; ed. at Sherborne Schi., Clifton Coll., Balliol Coll., Oxford, and with Walter Wren, Esq.; 3rd cl. class. moda., 1894; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1897; ag. asst. dist. offr., Klang, May, 1899; also ag. harb. mast., Klang, Feb., 1901; passed cadet, Apr., 1901; asst. dist. offr., Ulu Langat, continued also as ag. asst. dist. offr. Klang and harb. mast. at Port Swettenham, Oct., 1901; ag. dist. offr., Ulu Langat, Dec., 1903; ditto, Tampin, Mar. 1904; also asst. dist. offr., Matang, Oct., 1904; ag. asst. sec. to res., Mar., 1905; ag. sec. to res., Aug., 1906; ag. asst. sec. to res., Dec., 1906; ag. regisr., sup. ct., Nov., 1907; ag. asst. dist. offr., Larut, Feb., 1908; also ag. dist. offr., Larut, and regisr. of titles, Perak North, Aug., 1908; dist. offr., Ulu Langat, Mar., 1909; ag. asst. dist. offr., Larut and Krian, and regisr. of titles, Perak North in addition, Feb., 1911; ag. sec. to res., Jan., 1912; dist. offr., Larut, Sep., 1914; collr. of land rev., Seremban, and regisr. of titles, Negri Sembilan, May, 1915; temporarily ag. British res., Negri Sembilan, in addition, Aug., 1917; collr. of land rev., Kuala Lumpur, and regisr. of titles, Selangor, 8th Mar., 1918; sec. to res., Selangor, 24th July, 1919; sec. to res., Perak, Dec., 1921; ag. commr., lands, F.M.S., Apr., 1923; ag. under sec. to govt., F.M.S., Apr., 1924; commr., lands, F.M.S., Aug., 1924; editor of "Illustrated Guide to F.M.S."; author of "The Magic of Malaya," and "Railway Guide to F.M.S. and Siam."

HARRISON, ERNEST, M.S.A. (Iwra), B.Sc. (Agric.), N.D.A. (Hons.).—Lecturer in agr., schl. of agr., Groofontein, Cape, 1904; prin., schl. of agr., Cedara, Natal, 1913; dep. dir., agr., Kenya, 1921; ag. dir., agr., Feb. to Nov., 1922 and Mar.-Oct., 1924.

HARRISON, JOHN BURCHMORE, C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1856; Nat. Sc. scholar, Christ's Coll., Camb., B.A. (Nat. Sc. Tripos), 1878; M.A., 1887;
prof. of chemistry and agricul. science, Barbados, Sept., 1879; govt. analyst and prof. of chem., Br. Guiana, Dec., 1889; director of dept. of science and agric., B. Guiana, Jan., 1906; is F.I.C., F.G.S., F.C.S., and F.G.S. of America; author of numerous papers relating to the agric. and geology of the W. Indies and B. Guiana; on spec. serv. to U.S.A. in connection with questions relating to sugar analysis, reed. thanks of U.S. govt.; specially thanked on several occasions by S. of S. for services in connection with tropical agriculture, etc.

HARRISON-JONES, CHARLES.—B. 1884; ed. Reading and St. John's Coll., Oxford (B.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1907; pol. mag., Puttalam, Jan., 1909; asst. govt. agt., Colombo and Negombo dists., July, 1910; ag. ast. govt. agt., Hambantota, Apr., 1912; pol. mag., Matare, May, 1912; ag. ast. govt. agt., Mannar, Feb., 1913; on military duty, Jan., 1915; dist. judge Tangalla, Dec., 1919; ag. ast. govt. agt., Matale, June, 1920.

HARRISONSON, SYDNEY THIRLEWALL, C.M.G. (1908), O.B.E. (1919).—Ed. Blackheath; apptd. ast. acct., P.W.D., G. C. Col., 9th Nov., 1894; ch. acct., 2nd June, 1897; ast. acct., W.A.F.F., 26th Feb., 1898; ch. acct., 8th Nov., 1899; treas., N. Nig., 1st Jan., 1900; comptroller of customs, Barbados, 1908.

HART-DAVIS, CHARLES HENRY.—B. 1874; ed. at Eton and New Coll., Oxford, B.A.; served in 13th I.Y. in South Africa, 1900 (Queen's medal, 3 clasps); priv. sec. to Sir W. Haynes Smith, Cyprus, 1901; ast. inap. of schools, Cyprus, 1901 to 1906; passed exams. in Turkish and Greek, 1903; inap. of schools, Gold Coast, 1906; dist. commr., 1906 to 1910; sec. to high commr. for the Western Pacific, 1910; on mily. serv., 1915-19; ch. ast. sec., Cyprus, Apr., 1920; ag. ch. inspr. of schls., Aug. to Oct., 1919; ag. ch. sec., Sept. to Dec., 1919; ag. regisr.-gen., Dec. to May, 1920; ag. commr., July to Oct., 1920; ag. ch. sec., 27th Oct., 1920 to 3rd Feb., 1921, 17th to 23rd Mar., 11th May to 3rd Oct., 1921 and 14th July to 13th Oct., 1923; commr., 1st July, 1922; mem., leg. coun., Jan., 1924.

HARTER, JEAN DENIS EDGARD.—B. 1879; ed. R. Coll. of Mauritius; ast. mast., R. Coll., 1901; ast. mast., Victoria Schl., Seychelles, Aug., 1902; ast. mast., King's Coll., 1910; headmast., Victoria Schl., July, 1920; ag. dir., educn. and inspr. of schls., Seychelles, Jan., 1922; inspr. of schls., Seychelles, Jan., 1924; sec. to bd. of educn.; local sec., Cambridge local exam.; ag. pte. wks., clk. to gov. and clk. to coun., from 16th Dec., 1924.

HARTNELL, G. F. W.—Chief mechanical engnr., Uganda rlyw., June, 1918, and from Apr.-June, 1922; commr., July, 1922; ag. regisr.-gen., July-Sept., 1922.

HARVEY, DAVID HAROLD.—B. 1874; entd. Natal civ. serv., Apr., 1898; transf. to Swaziland adminstr. as elk., Mar., 1903; sub-inspr., Swazi-land police, Apr., 1907; dep. ast. commr., Apr., 1911; ast. commr., Mlankaisana dist., 1920.

HARVEY, HON. JOHN MUSGRAVE.—B. 1865; judge of the sup. ct., New S. Wales, 1913.

HASKINS, WILFRED J., A.M.C.E.A.—Asst. supt. of wks., S. Stlltns., Mar., 1905; dist. engnr., F.M.S. rlyw., May, 1912; senr. dist. engnr., grade B., F.M.S. rlyw., July, 1919; ag. engnr. for ways and wks., Nov., 1920 to Oct., 1921; ag. ch. res. engnr. for constrn., Mar., 1923.

HASZARD, HON. FRANCIS LONGCHAMP.—B. 1849; ed. at Prince of Wales's Coll., Prince Edward Is.; called to the bar, 1872; K.C., 1896; elected to legis., P.E.I., 1904 and 1908; mem. exec. coun., 1906; prem. and atty.-gen., P.E.I., 1898; judge, supreme ct., and master of the req., P.E.I., 1911.

HATCHER, C. M.—B. 1873; apptd. to compet. exam., elk. 2nd div. civ. ser., and assigned to W.O., 11th Sept., 1893; transf. to C. 18th Mar., 1896; minor staff offr., Feb., 1st staff clk., first grade, July, 1913; deptl. ass., 26th Feb., 1923.

HATHORN, HON. KENNETH HOWARD, K.C.B., 1849; puisne judge of supreme ct. of S. Afr. (Natal prov. division), May, 1910.

HAUGHTON, T. H.—B. 1881; served as African Constab., Mar., 1901, to Dec., 1917; held rank of lieut. and sub-inspr. (Queen's mac. with five clasps); ast. res., Muri Prov., Nigeria, 9th May, 1908.

HAUSSMANN, G. C. J. L. F.—B. 1868; dir. treas., Cape, 1889; acct., pension funds, Oct., 1896; prin. clk., treas., Pretoria, 1910; ch. pensions, treas., 1917; ch. pensions of 1919.

HAVENGA, HON. NICOLAAS CHRISTIAAN—Atty-at-law; mem., prov. coun. for Faurez, O.F.S. and mem., exec. comtee. for O.F.S., 1910-15; mem., Union H. of A. for Faurez from 1915; min. of finance, 30th June, 1921.

HAWKEN, H. E.A.—B. 1879; ed. pub. dist., Ottawa Colleg. Inst.; ent. civ. serv. of Canada as jun. clk., dept. marine and fisheries, 1901; 2nd cls. clk., 1908; 1st cls. clk., 1910; ch. clk., 1917; ast. dep. min., 1st Apr., 1920.

HAWKINS, GERALD.—B. 1891; B.A., Leeds Univ.; pte., 1/5th Gloucester Regt., 8th 14th, 1914; 2nd lieut., 1/5th Gloucester Regt., 1st Feb., 1915; B.E.F., 29th Mar., 1915; men's dep., 20th Dec., 1917; wounded, and discharged with rank of capt., 6th May, 1920; cadet, F.Y.S., 20th Nov., 1920; attd. to land office, Penang, 21st Dec., 1920; dep. collr. of land rev., Penang, 14th Jan., 1921; ag. dist. offr., Balik Pulau, 24 Dec., 1921.

HAY, CLIFFORD H., C.M.G., M.V.O.—Premier of New S. Wales since Mar., 1916.

HAY, FRANK, M.B., C.M. (Aberdeen)—B. 1867; ed. privately; dep. inspr.-gen., mem. hosps., N.Z., 1904; inspr.-gen., 1907; mem. prison bd. and nat. prov. fund bd.

HAY, MORTIMER CECIL.—B. 1891; ed. Tav. Schl., Bishop Stortford and St. Catharine's Coll., Cambridge (exhib.) B.A., Cantab.; ed. F.M.S., Nov., 1913; ag. ast. contrlr. of lab., Penang, Mar., 1915; ag. ast. dist. offr., Ksa Lipis, Mar., 1916; passed cadet, July, 1916; offr., cls. V., Dec., 1916; dep. contrlr. of lab., Klang, Dec., 1920; ag. ast. adviser, Eng., Johore, May, 1921; ag. ast. adviser, Batu-Pahat, Mar., 1922; ag. prof. of Chinese and contrlr. of lab., Johore, Oct., 1922; ag. ast. adviser, Batu-Pahat, Sept., 1923.

HAYCRAFT, SIR THOS. WAGSTAFFE K.B.A. (1919).—B.A., St. John's Coll., Oxon; called to the bar, In. Tem., 1885; practised in S.E. circuit and Sussex sessions; examr. of ct., 1889 to 1899; apptd. arbitrator on bd. of Lond. chm. of arbitn., 1897; pres. dist. c. Larneach, Cyprus, 1899; pol. mag., 1911; puisne judge, Mauritius, 1913; ch. just., Grenada, 1916; ch. just., Palestine, 1921; author of "Executive Powers in relation to Crime and Disorder."

HAYDEN, JAMES J.—B. 1883; ed. St. Mary's Coll., Dublin; clasped in feudal and English law.
HAYDON, LEONARD GUSCOTE, D.S.O.—M.B., M.D., D.P.H. (Univ. of Aberdeen); admstv. M.O., plague suppression, Mandvi, Bombay, 1897; pub. health serv., Victorian Govt., 1899; civ. surg., etc., Africa, 1900; pub. health serv., Natal govt., 1902; asst. M.O.H., Union of S. Africa, 1910; D.M.S., central force, S.W. African campaign, 1914; prin. med. offr., S.W. African Prot., 1915; st. M.O.H., Union of S. Africa, 1917; senr. asst. health offr., Union of S. Africa, 1919.

HAYES-SADLER, C. W., B.A. (Oxon.).—Asst. ist. comnstr., Kenya, Nov., 1920.

HAYNES, ALWYN SIDNEY.—B. 1878; ed. at Ilaleybury Coll.; cadet, F.M.S. civ. serv., Nov., 1901; attached to dist. office, Batang Padang, an., 1902; ag. financial asst., Krian, Oct., 1902, o Apr., 1903; passed final exam. in law, Oct., 1902; mag. for Perak, 1902; passed final exam. in Tamil, Aug., 1903; ag. financial asst., Krian, lept., 1903; administered estate of late Datoh 'anglima Kinta in Perak, 1904-1906; passed final exam. in Malay, Nov., 1905; ag. asst. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Mar., 1906; ag. inspr. of schls., Negri Sembilan, Nov., 1906; ist cls. mag., Negri Sembilan, 1906; ag. asst. supt. of Indian immigrts., Penang, Nov., 1906; ag. asst. supt., ditto, Nov., 1908; examiner in Tamil, Perak and Penang; g. supt. of Indian immigrts., F.M.S. and S. Sultms., Feb. to May, Jan., 1911; passed final exam. in Siamese, Aug., 1912; ag. dist. offr., 'ekan, Sept., 1912; ag. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Dec., 1914; mem. of board of examnrs. in Malay or Perak, Apr., 1915; dist. offr., Tampin, 1916; sec. to high comnstr., F.M.S., Apr., 1920; ec. for agr., S.S. and F.M.S., and dir., food production dist., Feb., 1922; chmn., small holdings commte. (rubber restrictions), Nov., 1923; ag. Br. sec., Pahang, Feb., 1924.

HAZELTON, ERIC.—B. 1895; 2nd lieut., Monmouthshire Brig., R.F.A., June, 1915; joined E.E.F., France, Nov., 1915; lieut., R.H. and R.F.A., June, 1916; served with E.E.F., Suez Canal, Sinai, Palestine, 1916-19; cadet, F.M.S. (lohire, Dec., 1919; 2nd asst. adviser to govt. of lohire, Jan., 1921; temp. ag. asst. adviser, Endau, Feb., 1921; ag. 2nd asst. adviser, Batu Pahat, May, 1921; passed cadet, Nov., 1921; ag. 4th asst. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Aug., 1922; 4th asst. ec. to govt., F.M.S., Nov., 1922; ag. pvtc. sec., o ch. sec., Nov., 1923.

HAZEN, HON. SIR JOHN DOUGLAS, K.C.M.G. (1918), K.C., LL.D.—B. 1860; ed. at Collegiate Sch., Fredericton, and Univ. of New Brunswick; called to the bar, 1883; K.C., 1894; elec. to H. of Canada, for St. John City and County, 1891; defeated, 1896; elec. to New Brunswick legis. for Sunbury, 1899, 1903, 1908; leader of the opposition in the New Brunswick legis. during that period; prem. and atty.-gen. of New Brunswick, 1908-1911; has been pres. of St. John law soc. and barristers oc. of New Brunswick; mem. of the P.C. for Canada, and min. of marine and fisheries in Mr. Borden's cabinet, Oct., 1911; chief just. of New Brunswick, Nov., 1917.

HAZLBRIGG, THOMAS MAYNARD, M.C.—Admitted solnr., sup. ct., England, 1906; lieut., R.A.S.C., 1914-1915; capt., R.A.S.C., 1915 to 1920; asst. crown solnr., Hong Kong, 1920; ag. asst. land offr. in addn., 1921 to 1922 and from 1922 to 1923; ag. crown solnr., Mar. to Nov., 1924.

HEAD, W. G.—B. 1899; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Oct., 1916; on mil. serv. from July, 1917, to Oct., 1919; cler. offr., Ist Jan., 1920.

HEAD-EVANS, ELLIS JAMES, M.I.M. & C.E., A.M.S.E.—Asst. engr., P.W.D., Nyasaland, Jan., 1912 to Aug., 1916; ag. asst. D.P.W., Nyasaland, Jan. to Sept., 1913; served with Nyasaland Vol. Res., 1914-15 (A.G.S. Med.); attd. as civil offr. to Nyasaland Field Force as ch. engr., road constr. in opera. in German E. Africa, Mar., 1916 to Sept., 1917; seconded as asst. engr., P.W.D., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1916; exec. engr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1920.

HEARST, SIR WILLIAM HOWARD, K.C.M.G. (1917).—B. 1864; ed. pub. schls., Collingwood Coll. Inst., and Toronto Univ.; called to the bar, 1888; K.C., 1908; prominent legal practitioner at Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario; now head of firm Hearst, Rowland and Atkin; has been counsel in all more important civil and criminal cases in Algoma district in recent years; unsuccessful cand. for legis. assembly, Ontario, 1894; elec. at g.e. 1908, 1911, and 1914; min. of lands, forests and mines in Whitney administration, 1911; premier of Ontario, 1914; also min. of agric.; defeated at g.e., Oct., 1919; resig. with his gov't., Nov., 1919; mem., internat. joint comnstr. (Can. section), 23rd Feb., 1920.

HEATH, A. P.—B. 1897; ed. Uppingham; on mil'y. serv., Aug., 1915; 2nd lieut., Feb., 1917 to Aug., 1917; temp. clk., Min. of Nat. Serv., Nov., 1917; transf'd., O.S.O., Mar., 1919; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., O.S.O., Nov., 1921.

HEATH, W. G.—M.B., Ch.B., Edin. Univ.; qualified 1897; med. offr., Windward dist., Dominica, 1898; med. offr., dist. 2, Montserrat, 1901; ag. med. offr., dist. "D," Dominica, 1903; ditto, dist. "A" 1904; ag. sen. med. offr., Montserrat, 1905, 1912, and since 1916; pres., defence reserve, 1909; ag. mem. legis. coun., 1911; ag. med. offr., Antigua, 1911; mem. legis. coun., May, 1915; med. offr.-in-chg. of Montserrat recruits for the B.W.I. regt., Mar., 1916; surg.-lieut., defence force, 1916; provisionally mem. exec. coun., 1916; ag. comnstr. Montserrat, on several occasions since Feb., 1916.

HEDDON, JOHN DONALD, B.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1879; clk., cust., Port Elizabeth, 1903; prin. clk., East London, 1915; surr., Durban, 1916; ch. clk., head office, Pretoria, 1918; del. for Union govt. at Imp. Cust. Conf., 1921; cust. adviser to delegn. to Australian govt. (flour shipments), 1921; mem., delegn. to Kenya to rept. on trade prospects, 1922; rep. of Union govt. at economic conference, Antananarivo, Madagascar, 1923.

HEDOG-JONES, DAVID.—Ed. at Univ. Coll. of Wales, 1902-1906; dept. of Agric. Science (agric. scholar), and at Jesus Coll., Oxford (Nat. Science exhibitioner), 1907-1911; B.A., 1910; M.A., 1914; holder of National Diplomas in the science and practise of agriculture and dairying (N.D.A. and N.D.D.); associate of Univ. Coll. of Wales; F.R. Anthropol. Inst.; apptd. prin. of secondary schools, Grenada, 1911; deleg. to W. Indian Agric. Conf., 1912; editor of the "Caribbean," and author of "The Development of the Negro" and "Negro Folk Lore," and various
agricultural and educational papers; a lieut. and adjutant of the Grenada volunteer force; acted as adjutant to West Indian Overseas Contingent, 1915.

HEIDENSTAM, EDGAR HENRY DE.—Ed. Rossall and private tutors; ag. priv. sec. to Sir W. F. Haynes Smith, high comsnr. of Cyprus, 1st Nov., 1901, to 13th July, 1902; clk., chief sec.'s office, 14th July, 1902; inspr. of Cyprus military police, 1st Feb., 1905; a.d.c. and priv. sec. to Sir C. King-Harman, and clk. to exec. coun., 1st Mar., 1906; clk. to legis. coun. and ast. clk., chief sec.'s office, 1st Oct., 1907; ag. chief clk., C.S.O., 15th July to 15th Oct., 1908; ag. ast. sec. to govt., July to Oct., 1915, and from Aug., 1916, to May, 1917; ast. sec., 1st Feb., 1918; ag. priv. sec., Nov., 1918; ast. audir., 1st Sept., 1920; ag. audir., Nov., 1922 to May, 1923, Feb. to May and July to Oct., 1924.

HEIDENSTAM, OSCAR CHARLES.—B. 1877; ed. at King's Schl., Warwick; vol. clk. col. sec.'s off., Cyprus, 5th Feb., 1897; 3rd div. clk., ditto, 16th Jan., 1899; inspr. of pol., 12th Jan., 1904; sent to Egypt for training with H.M.'s troops, May, June, and July, 1904; in command of depot, 8th Aug., 1904; in command of Kyrenia div., gov. of prison and dep. coroner, 15th July, 1905; in command of Papho div., gov. of prison and dep. coroner, 4th Aug., 1906; acted as comsnr. for Papho on several occasions; passed in mod. Greek, lower standard, Apr., 1906; ag. priv. sec. and A.D.C. to high comsnr., Sir C. A. King-Harman, and clk. of exec. coun., 4th Jan. to 15th Feb., 1907; temporarily attached to ch. sec.'s off., 16th Feb., 1907; in comd. of pol., Kyrenia div., gov. of pris., and dep. coroner, 24th June, 1907; ast. dist. supt. of pol., Uganda Prot., 12th July, 1907; in commd. of Entebbe pol., and supt. of cent. gaol, 10th Sept., 1907; inspr. of police, Cyprus, Apr., 1910; ch. of pol., Grenada, 22nd July, 1914.

HELLINGS, GEOFFREY STUART.—B. 1888; ed. Christ's Hosp. (foundation schl.) and St. John's Coll., Camb., Camb., 1909; B.A., 1910 (cl. trip. ii, I); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1911; seconded for mil. ser., Jan., 1915; 2nd lieut., 8th (Service) Batt. Duke of Cornwall's Light Infy., Mar., 1915; 2nd lieut., 2nd Batt. D.C.L.I., May, 1916; lieut., 2nd Batt. D.C.L.I., Sept., 1916; ag. capt., 2nd Batt. D.C.L.I., June, 1918; demob., Sept., 1919; ag. 2nd ast. dist. offr., Batu Gajah, Nov., 1919; ag. ast. prot. of Chinese, Perak, Dec., 1920; ag. ast. prot. Chinese, Selangor, Sept., 1921; contr., lab. and prot. of Chinese, Johore, Sept., 1923; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1923.

HELPS, EDMUND ARTHUR PLUNKETT.—B.1888; ed. Marlborough and Clare Coll., Cambridge; history tripos., 2nd clm. (1909); B.A. (1909); cadet, F.M.S., Jan., 1912; ag. 2nd ast. supt. of imigrts., Klang, Sept., 1912; ag. ast. contrlr., lab., Aug., 1913; ag. ast. sec. to res., Selangor, May, 1914; passed cadet, July, 1914; offr., cls. V., Mar., 1916; lent for service under the admistr. of German E. Africa, July, 1917; offr., cls. IV., Jan., 1919; ast. dist. offr., Raub, Apr., 1920; ag. ast. dist. offr., Kuala Lipis, May, 1920; ast. dist. offr., Larut, July, 1920; dist. offr., Kuala Selangor, May, 1921; attd. to sec., rubber restriction comm., Kulim, Nov., 1923; ag. ast. adviser, Kedah, Jan., 1924.

HEMMANT, GEORGE.—B. 1880; ed. Tonbridge and Pembroke Coll., Cambridge; cadet, F.M.S., 1903; ag. ast. dist. treas., Kuala Lumpur, June-Dec., 1904 and Mar.-June, 1905; passed cadet (Malay and Law), May, 1905; ag. rev. sec., Negri Sembilan, July, 1906; ag. ast. dist. of Kuala Pilah, Aug., 1906-Mar., 1908; ag. dist. offr., Jelabu, Mar.-July, 1908 and Jan.-Feb., 1909; ag. ast. dist. offr., Kuala Pilah, Jul.-Sept., 1908; ag. ast. dist. offr., Tampin, Oct., 1908-Jan., 1909 and from Mar., 1909-Oct., 1910; ast. collr., land rev., Seremban, Dec., 1910; ag. dist. offr., Temerloh, Oct., 1911-Jan., 1912; seconded, Kedah, Oct., 1914; ag. legal advir., Kedah, Dec., 1914-Jan., 1916; seconded, Johor Jan., 1916; ag. ast. adviser, Muar, Jan., 1916; June, 1918; collr. of land rev., Kuala Lampur and register of titles, Selangor, Nov., 1919-Nov., 1920; sec. to res., Selangor, Dec., 1920-Nov., 1922; mag., Kuala Lumpur, Jan.-Apr., 1923; ag. under-sec., S. Sttlmts., May, 1923-Mar., 1924; and from Apr.-July, 1924; ag. col. sec., S. Sttlmts., Mar. and Aug., 1924; gov.'s sec., Mar., 1924; ag. gen. adviser, Johore, Sep., 1924.

HEMSTED, RUPERT WILLIAM, O.B.E. (1879)—2nd treasy astt., E.A.P., 19th Sept., 1899; acctnt., Somaliland, 1st Dec., 1901, to 1st Feb., 1903; astt. collr., E.A.P., 1st Dec., 1904; clk., 17th Dec., 1906; offr.-in-charge, Masai reserve, 1912.

HENDERSON, FREDERICK LOUIS.—Ed. Camb. Univ.; B.A., 1897; M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.); med. offr., E. Africa and Uganda Prots., 18th Oct., 1904; senr. med. offr., Apr., 1920; dist. surg., May, 1923.

HENDRY, WILLIAM, M.A. (Edin.)—B. 1886; ed. Daniel Stewart's Coll., Edinburgh (dux and medallist), and Edinburgh Univ.; Egyptian educ. serv., 1911-15 and 1919-20; served Royal Eng. and Royal Irish Regt., 1915-19; med. despatch, 1919; dir. of educn., Zanzibar, 1920.

HENKEL, JOHN SPURGEON.—Joined forest dept., Eastern Conservancy, Cape, 1st Jan., 1888; astt. to conservator, 1st Mar., 1890; dist. forest offr., King William's Town, 1st Aug., 1896; Stutterheim, 1st Aug., 1898; selected to proceed to Royal Indian Engineering Col., Cooper's Hill, for scientific course of forestry; obtained coll. diploma and specially commended by pres. of coll., 5th Aug., 1902; astt. conservator of forests, Eastern Conservancy, 1st Oct., 1902; astt. conservator, Western Conservancy, 1st Nov., 1907; apptd. principal lecturer in forestry, African schl. of forestry, 29th Oct., 1906; lecturership, 29th Feb., 1908; chmn. of bd. of management, S. African schl. of forestry, 1st May, 1907 to 31st Jan., 1909; astt. conservator of forests, Midland Conservancy, 1st Feb., 1909; conservator of forests, Midland Conservancy, 2nd grade, 1st Apr., 1912; Conservator of Forest Natal Conservancy, Dec., 1914; served as comm. with dist. mounted troops during S. Africa war, 1901-2; Queen's medal; tranfd., Rhodesian forest serv., 1st Jan., 1920.

HENLEN, GEORGE WILLIAM.—B. 1902; apptd. after compet. exam., astt. clk., C.O., Feb., 1903; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1909.

HENNESSEY, PATRICK H.—M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.); house surg., S. Sttlmts., Feb., 1907; supernumerary med. offr., Penang, Feb., 1908; med. offr. gen. hosp., Singapore, 1st May, 1908; ag. med. offr., Malacca, 14th Oct., 1908; med. offr., grade II, Kuala Pilah, and med. offr., construction, 1st Apr., 1909; ag. med. offr., grade I, 6th May, 1914; ag. senr. med. offr., Selangor, 2nd to 26th Nov., 1918, in addition and again 3rd Dec., 1918 to 9th Feb., 1919, from 9th Apr. to 23rd Dec., 1919; ophthalmologist.
physician in addition; med. offr., gen. hosp., K. Lumpur, 1st Sept., 1920; med. offr. and ophtal. urg., Ipoh, 20th Sept., 1923.

HENNIKER-HEATON, HERBERT.—B.A., Oxon.; ed. at Eton and New Coll., Oxford, hon. hist., 1901); cadet, Fiji, 1902; attached to col. sec.'s off., to 1905; European offr., armed constab., June, 1903; in regis.-gen.'s off., Mar., May, 1904; ag. adjut., armed constab., musk. instr., and inspr. of pol., Feb., 1905, to Feb., 1906; stip. mag., Feb., 1906, and ag. stip. mag., Jan., 1906; inspr. of taxes, Feb. to May, 1906; ch. clk., native dept., and ag. asst. native commr., July, 1906; asst. nat. native commr., Mar., 1907; g. chief pol. mag. and off. recvr. in bankruptcy, Mar., 1910, to Feb., 1911; mem. of mining bd., Apr., 1910; commr. of customs, Jan., 1911; mem. bd. of examiners, Feb., 1911; nom. mem. hwa schl. bd., Oct., 1911; ag. chief pol. mag., Jan., 1912; mem. native regulation bd., May, 1912; asst. col. sec., Mauritius, Oct., 1913; g. col. sec., Mar. to Sept., 1914; ag. prot. of nigmtgs. and poor law commr., Apr., 1915, to an., 1916; ag. col. sec., Jan. to May and from July, 1916, to May, 1917; in comd., coy., Mauritius Vol. Force, 1916-17; col. sec., Gambia, 1917; ag. ov., June to Dec., 1918, Oct. to Dec., 1919 and July, 1920 to Jan., 1921; col. sec., Falkland Is., 921; ag. gov., June, 1923 to May, 1924.

HENRY, HON. GEORGE STEWART, B.A., LL.B.—B. 1871; ed. pub. schs., Upper Can. Coll., Univ. of Toronto, and Ont. Agric. Coll.; farmer; el. to Int. legis., by el., 1913; re-el., 1914, 1919 and 1923; min. of pub. wks. and highways in Ferguson dmstr., 1923.

HENSHAW, PERCY HOWARD.—B. 1874; ed. King's Schl., Chester; L.N.W.R., 1892-1901; dist. traf. supt., F.M.S.R., July, 1901; dist. traf. supt., Aug., 1904; dep. traf. man., 1908; traf. man., May, 1914; ag. gen. man., Jan., 1922, and Mar., 1924.

HERBERT, CHAS. EDWARD.—M.H.A., South Australia, 1900-05; gov't. res. and judge of N. Territory, 1905 to 1910; now deputy chief judicial ffr. in Papua.

HERBST, JOHN FREDERICK, C.B.E. (1919).—Ikl., Cape census off., May, 1891; Carnarvon, Dec., 1891; Willommore, May, 1895; atty.-gen'l. ffr., Cape Town, July, 1895; held several ag. punts.; asst. mag., Gordonia, Apr., 1897; relv. ffr., Apr., 1899; ag. asst. mag., Rietfontein, Nov., 905; confirmed Jan., 1908; ag. civ. commr. and ag., Somerset, E., May, 1908; mag., St. Marks, July, 1908; detached for special service in B.B. rot. in connection with inroads of Hottentotts x German S.W. Africa, under Simon Kooper; received thanks of the Cape govt. and Imp. govt. upon successful accomplishments of mission; inspecting mag., S.W. Africa Prot. (with rank of Major in Union Defence Forces), Sept., 915; dep. sec'y., S.W. Africa Protectorate, Mar., 916; sec'y. for Protectorate, Dec., 1916; acctg. ffr. in addition, Apr., 1920; ag. admstr., S.W. Africa, 2nd to 17th Oct., 1920; sec' for S.W. Africa, civ. admstr., 1921; sec' for native affrs., Union of S. Africa, Apr., 1923.

HERCHENHODER, SR. FURCY ALFRED, KT. IACH. (1914), K.C.—B. 1865; ed. Roy. Coll., Mauritius; called to bar, Mid. Tem., June, 1888; g. crown pros., Mauritius, 1893-8; leg. adviser, ol. mag., crown pros., conserv'r of mortgages, and curator of vacant estates, Seychelles, May, 898; judge, Seychelles, 1900; ch. just., 1903; proc. and advoc. gen., Mauritius, 3rd Apr., 1905; ag. chief just., 3rd Sept., 1912; ch. just., 1st Jan., 1913.

HERDMAN, HON. ALEXANDER LAWRENCE.—B. 1869; ed. at Otago and Oamaru high schl.; barrister-at-law, 1894; entd. New Zealand parl., 1902; atty.-gen., min. of justice, 1912; atty.-gen. in National ministry, 1915; resig. 1918, and apptd. judge of N.Z. sup. ct.

HEREFORD, GEORGE A., MA., (Oxon.), barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn.—B. 1875; Cadet, S. Stiltna., Nov., 1898; ag. dist. officer, Balik Pulau, Penang, Apr., 1899; passed final exam. in Malay, Oct., 1901; supt. of educn., Penang, Nov., 1902; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Jan., 1904; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, Mar., 1906; asst. dist. offr., Batu Gajah, Jan., 1907; ag. mag., Kuala Lumpur, July, 1908; ag. asst. dist. offr., Larut, July, 1909; ag. asst. dist. offr., Kinta, Feb., 1910; ag. dep. pub. prosecutor, Kuala Lumpur, Apr., 1910; dist. offr., Raub., continued ag. dep. pub. prosecutor, May, 1910; offr., cls. III., Jan., 1912; passed final exam. for the bar, May, 1913; ag. reg'ar., sup. off., P.M.S., June, 1913; ag. censor, Penang, June, 1915; ag. senr. dist. offr., Prov. of Wellesley, June, 1915; ag. 2nd mag., Singapore, May, 1917; ag. dist. offr., Butterworth in addition, Nov., 1917; ag. prov. munic. commrs., Penang, May, 1919; offr. collr., land rev., Penang, May, 1919; offr., cls. II., Jan., 1919; legal adviser, Johore, offr., cls. I.B., Sept., 1920; ag. reg'ar. of impts. and expts., Singapore, June, 1921; ag. gen. adviser, Johore, Feb., 1924.

HERMON-HODGE, H. B.—B. 1885; ed. Winchester coll. (scholar) and Magdalen coll., Oxford; B.A., hons. in mods. and hist.; asst. res., N. Nigeria, 26th Dec., 1908.

HEROLD, THOMAS BARRY.—Cape civ. ser., 1882-1901; ch. clk. to master of sup. ct., Transvaal, Oct., 1901; asst. master, June, 1902; commr. of protocols, Dec., 1904; master of the sup. ct., Oct., 1906; mem. of prisons advisory bd., Feb., 1907; dir. (chmn., 1907-8 and 1908-9), land and agric. bank, Oct., 1907; chmn. and gen.-man., land and agric. bank of South Africa, 1912; J.P., Union of S. Africa, 1912; man. dir., land and agric. bank, Oct., 1924.

HERSSENHOHN, J. M. N. A.—1st cls. asst., govt. schls., Natal, 1899; clk., col. sec.'s dept., 1900; sworn translator, Dutch; senr. clk., 1906; civ. ser. examr., 1902; Dutch bd. of examrs., 1903; one of the secretaries at S. Africa National Convention, 1908-1909; chief clk., admstr.'s dept., Natal Prov., 1910; ag. prov. sec., Aug.-Nov., 1913, and from Aug., 1917; prov. sec., 1st Feb., 1918.

HERTZOG, HON. J. B. M., B.A., LL.D., M.L.A.—B. 1868; ed. at Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch, and Amsterdam Univ.; judge of O.F.S., 1895 to 1900; comd. Boer forces of S.W. div., 1899 to 1902; one of the signatories of the treaty of Vereeniging; atty.-gen., O.R.C.; min. of just., Union of S. Africa, 1910-1912; leader of opposition in Union parl., 1913-24; prime min., 30th June, 1924.

HESLIP, MAJOR ISAAC.—B. 1876; 3rd batt., R. Irish Rifles; passed course of instrn., R.I.C., Dublin; Hythe certif.; asst. commr., pol., Sierra Leone, 8th Feb., 1911; commr., pol. and sheriff, 8th July, 1914; dist. commr., 22nd Sept., 1920.

HEWINS, WILLIAM ALBERT SAMUEL, M.P.—B. 1865; ed. at Wolverhampton Grammar schl. and Pembroke Coll., Oxford; M.A.; dir. of London schl. of economics, 1895-1903; teacher of modern economic history, Univ. of London, 1902-3; Tooke professor of economic science and statistics, King's Coll., 1897-1903; mem. of senate of Univ. of London, 1900-1903; late sec. of Tariff
HEWLETT, JOHN BERTRAM.—B. 1890; ass't auditor, G. Coast, 25th Feb., 1914; ag. senr. ass't auditor, 28th Jan. to 17th Mar., 1919; ag. ass't col. sec., 19th Aug. to 14th Sept., 1919; jun. clk., Col. Audit Dept., 1st July, 1920; 2nd cls. elk., 1st Apr., 1921; aud'r., Gibraltar, 3rd Nov., 1922.

HEWLETT-COOPER, C. T.—Ent. "Britannia," 1889; lieut., 1898; comdr., 1909; capt. (ret.), 1921; S. African Med., 1900; commanded H.M.S. Aquarius, Egyptian and Adriatic operations, 1914-17; commanded H.M.S. Andes, escort to convoys, 1918; commanded H.M.S. Marshal, 1919-20; joined col. serv. as dir. of marine, Dares-Salaam, 2nd Oct., 1920; sent to India to study Tamil, Nov., 1921; ag. ass't contr., lab., Aug., 1922.

HEYWOOD-WADDINGTON, ALFRED.—B. 1898; ed. Oriel Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1920; lieut., 3rd Somerset L.I., 25th July, 1918; cadet, F.M.S., 15th Mar., 1921; ag. ass't contr. of lab., 1st May, 1921; ditto, Seremban, Jan., 1923; passed cadet, Aug., 1923; ass't contr., lab., Seremban, Mar., 1924; ass't contr. lab., Klang, Aug., 1924.

HIAM, ROBERT WOOD, M.I.C.E., M.I.M.E., M.I.S.E.—B. 1874; ed. Claremont Grammar Sch.; pupil, G.W.Rly., 1890-1893; enggr. staff, G.W.Rly., 1893-1910; enggr. staff, F.M.S.R., 1910-19; engnr. for ways and wks., F.M.S.R., 1919.

HICKMAN, HON. ALBERT E.—Elce. M.H.A., Bay de Verde, Newfoundland, 1913; M.E.C., 1917; mem. tonnage comtee., 1917; min. without portfolio, 1918.

HICKSON-MAHONY, R.S.B.M.—Civ. ser., Cape Colony and Union of S. Africa, 3rd Jan., 1903 to 19th Mar., 1917; ass't polit. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 20th Mar., 1917; war ser., Boer War, 1899-1900, Great War, 9th S. African Inf., 1915-1917.

HIGGINS, EVELYN SCOTT.—Ed. at Blundell's Sch., Tiverton, and Chatham House, Ramsgate; served on Uganda rly., 1898-1900; supt. of pol., Somaliland Prot., 22nd May, 1905; ass't supt. of pol., E. Africa Prot., Sept., 1911.

HIGGINS, HON. HENRY BOURNES.—B. 1851; M.L.A., Victoria, 1894-1900; chrmn. of royal comm. on legal procedure; mem. of Austn. Fed. Convention, 1897-98, and of the first Federal parlmt.; judge of High Court, C. of A., since Oct., 1906.

HIGHAM, REGINALD.—B. 1879; traffic canvasser, Gold Coast rly., Feb., 1904; ag. senr. traffic asst., May to Oct., 1910; ch. traffic offr., Aug., 1911.

HIGHET, DAVID JOHN, M.I.C.E.—First ass't engnr., Ulu Selangor extension, Oct., 1890; ch. ass't engnr., Jan., 1894; ag. res. engnr. torri rwy., Mar., 1894; dist. rlyw. engnr., F.M.S.R., Jan., 1903; ag. divisional engnr., Selangor and N. Sombilan, June, 1904; divisional engnr., South, Apr., 1906; ag. gen. man., F.M.S.R., May, 1909.

HIGNETT, CHARLES FRANCIS.—Ed. Woking Coll., Surrey; served with Imp. (civ. serv. law, 1893)—B. 1871; entered Cape civ. serv. in 1890; occupied several public positions including those of ag. civ. comsnr. and mag. at various stations up to 1897, when he became priv. sec. to col. sec. of Cape Colony (Dr. Te Water); clk. astt., Cape House of Assembly, 1897; clk. of first House of Assembly, Transvaal, 1907; Transvaal sec. to S. HORN, ARTHUR EDWIN, C.M.G. (1922), M.D., B.Sc. (Lond.); M.R.O.S. (Eng.); L.R.C.P. (Lond.); D.T.M. and H. (Cantab.); certif., Lond. Schl. of Trop. Med. Coast, N. and S. Nigeria and Gambia; awarded Cragga research prize for original research in trop. med. (London S.T.M.), 1908; recd. thanks of S. of S. for the Colonies for report on cerebro-spinal fever in Northern Territories of the G. Coast, 1908, and for report on sleeping sickness in the Volta River dist. of the G. Coast, 1910; seconded for special service at the C.O., 1910-12; personal astt. to the P.M.O., S. Nigeria, 1913; senr. med. offr. and mem., exec. and leg. couns., Gambia, 1914-16; prin. civ. med. offr., German E. Africa, 1917-19; attd. Rockefeller comsn. for investigation of yellow fever in W. Africa, 1920; dir., med. and sany. services, Malaya, 1921-22; pres. elect for 5th Congress of Far Eastern Assoc. of Trop. Med., 1923; med. sec. to Col. Advisory Med. and Sany. Comtee. at C.O., 1923-24; junr. med. adviser to C.O., 1924; mem., exec. comtee. of Br. Empire Leprosy Relief Assoc.; fellow R. Soc'y. of Med.; R. Soc'y. Trop. Med.; author of "Health of Europeans in W. Africa," "Health of Europeans in E. Africa."

HORBY-PORRER, CHARLES.—Apptd. dist. commnr., Lagos, 1897; 2nd astt. col. sec., 1901; senior astt. col. sec., 1903; ag. col. treas., 1902-1903; ag. col. sec., 1904; holds dormant comsn. to sit as pol. mag., and sat as such in 1897, 1901, 1902 and 1903; on spec. serv. to Ijebu-Ode, 1901 and 1904, and to Oyo and also to Ife, 1904; pres. of pol. coman., 1901; mem. of rly. coman., 1901; pres. of cust. coman., 1904.

HORNE, EDWARD BUTLER.—Ed. at Bedford Gram. Schl.; asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., 21st Apr., 1904; dist. commnr., 1st Apr., 1909; offr.-in-charge, Masai res., May, 1923.

HORNE, EDWIN NOEL.—B. 1902; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 4th May, 1920.

HORNE, HENRY HASTINGS, O.B.E., Mily. (1918).—Ed. at Cliffon Coll.; Brit. vice-consul, Mexico, 1900-01; S. Africa, field neld. force, S. African medal; asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., 3rd Apr., 1903; dist. commnr., 1st Apr., 1907; slavery comsnr., Lamu, 1908-9; polit. offr. to G.E.A. exped. force, 1915-18 (mentd. in despatches); lent to Empire Cotton Comtee. for sp. rept., Tanganyika Territory, 1920-21; offr. in charge, Jubaland, 1922-24.

HOWOOD, HON. SIR WM. HENRY, KT. BACH. (1904).—B. 1862; ed. at Bishop Feld Coll., St. John's; called to the bar, 1886; bencher of the law society, Newfoundland, 1891; Q.C., 1895; elected to the legislature, 1894; acted as col. sec. 1894-5; delegate from the Newfoundland govt. to the Ottawa conf., Apr., 1895, on the subject of confedn. with Canada; mem. of ex. coun., 1894-97; ag. atty.-gen., 1897; elected to legislature to represent Harbour Grace, 1897; apptd. by ch. just., with minister of just. to act in conjunction with judges as committee to amend rules and procedure, sup. court, 1898; minister of just. and atty.-gen., 1900; ex-officio mem. of ex. coun., and of treasy. board; acted as leader of gov't. during sess. of 1901; and also 1902; apptd. ch. just., July, 1902; administrator of govt., 1902, 1904, 1909, 1912, 1913, 1914; dep. gov', 1907, 1910; chrmn. of royal comsn. on Sealing Industry, 1913; pres., Newfield. assn. of St. John Ambulance Amoocn.; chrmn. of comtee. for selection of non-combatants for service abroad; chrmn. of Newfield. fund for bo'ats for cots for soldiers and sailors; representative of Peace Comsn. established under treaty between Great Britain and U.S.A., May, 1916.

HOSE, CHARLES, D.S.C.—Cadet Sarawak service, Mar., 1884; res. 2nd cl., 4th div., Jan., 1886; res. 3rd Div., and mem. of sup. coun., May, 1891; dist. mag., ditto, Nov., 1893; ag. dist. mag., Batang Padang, Oct., 1898; asst. sec. to Perak, Nov., 1898; ag. dist. offr., Larut, Krian, May, 1903; offr. of cls. III., S. Settlements, Mar., 1904; ag. dep. pub. pros.; ag. 2nd nat. requests, Singapore, Aug., 1904; chmn. admin. board, Kuala Lumpur, Oct., 1904; ag. comm. trade and cust., F.M.S., Sept., 1912; ag. atty.-gen., 1912; ag. controller of labour, May, 1913; ag. dir. of agric., Oct., 1915; offr. of cls. II., F.M.S., Mar., 1916; dist. offr., Lower Perak; dir. food production, F.M.S., 8th Feb., 1918; dir. food production, S. Slims., 17th July, 1918; in addition; contr. of lab., F.M.S. and S. Slims. (offr. cls. Ia.), but continues to act as dir. of food production, Sept., 1919; dep. food contr., Malacca, in addition, Jan., 1920; food contr., Man., 1920; ag. Br. res., Selangor, Sept., 1920; ag. Br. res., Negri Sembilan, Nov., 1921; Br. res., Negri Sembilan, Feb., 1922; ag. ch. sec., F.M.S., May, 1923; resumed duty as Br. res., Negri Sembilan, Oct., 1923; ag. col. sec., S.S., Apr., 1924; col. sec., July, 1924.

HOSKING, E. B.—Aust. dist. commnr. E.A.P., Dec., 1913.

HOSKING, HON. JOHN HENRY.—B. 1848; barrister and solicitor; K.C., 1908; judge sup. ct., New Zealand, 1914.

HOUGHTON, H. E.—B. 1892; apptd. after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the cir. and assigned to the C.O., Apr., 1912; attached to office of high commr. for S. Africa, Nov., 1912; transf'd. to Basutoland serv., Nov., 1923.

HOW, DOUGLAS WALSHAM.—B. 1889; Cheltenham Coll., London Matric.; Un. of Africa civ. serv. lower law exam.; Basutoland 2nd grade Senato exam.; clerical astt., Basutoland, 5th Oct., 1910; sub-inspr., Basutoland mtd. pol., 1st July, 1912; chief clk., mtd. ct. and regiar., 1st July, 1917; served as 2nd Lieut. with Royal Welsh Fusiliers in France, 1918; maj. and staff offr., Basutoland mtd. pol., 1st July, 1919; dep. astt. commnr., 1923.

HOWARD, HON. ERATUS EDWIN.—B. 1866; ed. Iroquois High Schl., Inverness Acad., McGill Univ.; B.A., 1895; gold medallist, math. and nat. philos.; B.C.L. (gold medal), 1898; barrister; practised in Montreal, 1899-1913; called to the bar, Quebec, July, 1899; K.C., Sept., 1913; judge, superior ct., prov. of Quebec, 2nd Sept., 1919; judge of ct. of King's Bench, Aug., 1920; prof., civ. law, McGill Univ.
HOWARD, FREDERICK JAMES, O.B.E.—B. 1883; ed. at Bedford; 2nd divn. clk., W.O., June, 1901; 2nd cls. astt. acctnt., army accts. dept., May, 1905; selected for advancement to higher grade of scale, 1st Nov., 1911; ag. 1st cls. astt. acctnt., Oct., 1914; ag. acctnt., Nov., 1916; 1st cls. astt. acctnt., 15th Dec., 1919; personal supernumy, app't, as acctnt., 1st Jan., 1921; served with min. of munitions as dir. from 1915, and with disposal and liquidation commn. treas., as astt. contr. of deptl. finance until 1921; O.B.E., 1st Jan., 1918; ag. prin., oli style, 1st Jan., 1920; 3rd prin. C.O., 15th Sept., 1921.

HOWARD, JOHN CURTIS.—B. 1887; ed. at Lppingham and Clare Coll., Camb. (exhib.); called to the bar, Middle Temple, Jan., 1913; 2nd lieutenant, 4th Lincoln Regt., Mar., 1915; served in France, Jan., 1917 to July, 1920; legal adviser, H.Q., France, May, 1919 to July, 1920; pres. intst. ct., Cyprus, Aug., 1920; passed exam. in mod. Greek, Aug., 1921; ag. king's advoc., Nov., 1922 to Mar. 1923 and Aug., 1923; king's advoc., July, 1924.

HOWARD, HON. JOSEPH, O.B.E. (1920).—B. 1862; pres. of chamber of commerce, 1920-21; pres., govt. emigr. comte., 1917-20; head of Malta delegation to France in connection with the employment of Maltese labr. in France, 1919; officier de l'instruction publique, France, 1920; senator in Malta parl., Oct., 1921; head of ministry, 28th Oct., 1921; has rec'd Japanese order, 3rd cls., of the Sacred Treasure and 3rd cls. of the Order of the Rising Sun and also 2nd cls. of Tunisian Order of the Nichan.

HOWARTH, SAMUEL EDWARD JAMES.—Ed. at Suxton Coll., London; served in S. African War; Queen's and King's medals with five clasps; astt. Colony manager, field force canteens, O.R.C., Feb., 1902, to Mar., 1903; astt. acctnt., P.W.D., S. Africa Prot., 6th May, 1905; ch. acct., P.W.D., 916.

HOWATSON, CHARLES WILLIAM, M.B., C.M. Edin.).—B. 1861; dist. med. offr., Trinidad, 5th May, 1905.

HOWELL, ALLEYN GRAHAM.—B. 1871; 5th klk. corrpdg. branch, C.S.O., Barbados, 1890; 3rd klk., 1892; 3rd klk., Jan., 1898; ch. clk. commr. of agriculture, 1899; sec. to W. Indian agric. conferences, 1900, 1901, 1902, 1905, and 1907.

HOWELL, E. H.—B. 1879; app'td., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., Mar., 1898; promoted, with gratuity, Dec., 1907; conf. clk., 1911; staff clk., 1st grade, 8th Sept., 1917; cler. offr. higher grade, 1st Apr., 1922; ag. deptl. astt., 6th Jan., 1923; clk. for legal instruments, 26th Feb., 1923.

HOWELL, FREDERICK ROUSE.—B. 1886; up. clk., P.O., Barbados, Feb., 1907; jun. clk., P.O., Nov., 1907; clk. to master in chancery, Dec., 1907; 4th klk., C.S.O., May, 1909; 3rd klk., C.S.O., 1910.

HOWELL, JOHN BRUCE.—B. 1867; 3rd klk., reasy., Barbados, July, 1886; 3rd klk., col. sec.'s office, Sept., 1891; ag. ch. clk., record branch, C.S.O., Sept., 1893, to Apr., 1894; ag. ch. clk., provost-marshal's office, Dec., 1897, to Apr., 1898; nd klk., C.S.O., and clk. of exec. coun. and comte., Jan., 1898; ag. ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, May to October, 1900; ag. priv. sec. and A.D.C. to the gov. of Barbados, 1st Apr. to 6th July, 1902, and Jan. to Oct., 1904; ag. ch. clk., col. sec.'s off., June to Dec., 1906; priv. sec. and A.D.C. to ag. gov., June to Sept., 1906, and from June to Oct., 1907; ag. priv. sec. and A.D.C. to gov., Mar. to July, 1910, and to ag. gov., July, 1910 to Feb., 1911; ag. priv. sec. to gov., Mar. to July, 1911; ag. inspr. of pol., Sept., 1915 to Nov., 1918; J.P., 1918; ch. clk., col. sec.'s off., Aug., 1918; ag. col. sec., 16th May to 13th Oct., 1922 and from 11th Apr. to 15th Nov., 1923.

HOWELL, WILFRED IRVING.—Cadet, botanical and experiment statn., St. Kitts, July, 1907; foreman, Mar., 1909; agri. instr., Nevis, Apr., 1912.

HOWES, ARTHUR BURNABY.—B. 1879; ed. at Dulwich Coll.; called to the bar, Middle Temple, June, 1906; Western circuit; conveyancer, Uganda Prot., 22nd May, 1916; custodian of enemy property, 20th Mar., 1917; dist. mag., dist. judge, and admstr.-gen., Entebbe, Uganda, 1st Apr., 1907; dist. mag., dist. judge, and offl. rec. in bankruptcy, Kampala, Uganda, 18th July, 1917; ag. judge of high ct., Jan.-June, 1920; ag. atty.-gen., Feb. to Dec., 1921; senr. mag., 1st Jan., 1922; ag. judge of high ct., Apr. to Oct., 1922 and June, 1923; puisne judge, Gold Coast, Dec., 1924.

HOWITT, CAPT. CHARLES ROBERTS.—B. 1894; ed. Carlisle and Queen's Coll., Oxford; R. Fusiliers, 1914-16; Border Regt., 1916-19; Malayan civ. serv., Nov., 1920; attd., land office, Johore, Dec., 1920; 2nd cls. mag., Sept., 1921; ag. 2nd cls. mag., Johore, May, 1922; 1st cls. mag., May, 1922; passed cadet, June, 1922; astt. collr. of land rev., Johore Bahru, Sept., 1922; offr. cls. V, June, 1922; collr., land rev., Johore Bahru, Oct., 1922; 2nd lieut., J.V.R., Aug., 1923; astt. adviser, Kota Tinggi, May, 1924; lieut., J.V.R., Aug., 1924.

HOY, SIR WILLIAM WILSON, K.C.B. (1922), KT. BACH. (1916); C.B. (1918).—B. 1868; entd. serv. of Cape Govt. rly., 1889; representative of C.G.R. in Johannesburg, 1896; ag. astt. traffic manager, Bulawayo, 1897-8; Kimberley, 1898; astt. traffic manager, Port Elizabeth, 1899; traffic manager, Bloemfontein, Johannesburg, 1900-02; chief traffic manager, C.S.A.R., 1902; represented C.S.A.R. at rly. confce. at Washington; ag. gen. manager in 1905 and 1907; astt. gen. manager, 1909; gen. manager of rly. and harbours, Union of S. Africa, 31st May, 1910.

HUBBALL, JOHN GORST.—Clt., control and audit office, Cape, 1895; examr., 1895; astt. acctnt., 1903; astt. acctnt., contrir. and auditor-gen.'s office, Union of S. Africa, 1910; prin. clk., 1912; chief acctnt., treas., Union of S.Africa, 1916.

HUBER, JOSEPH, O.B.E. (1923).—B. 1866; entd. Malta civ. serv., 1892; in charge of govt. savings bank, 1892; acctnt., rec.gen. office, and in charge of savings bank, 1893; dep. rec-gen. and dir. of contracts, 1904; astt. treas., 1913; treas. and dir. of contracts, 16th Aug., 1916; also man. of savings bank since 1898; offl. mem. exec. coun. and of coun. of govt., 18th Aug., 1916.

HUDSON, HAROLD.—Book-keeper, treas. dept., Uganda Prot., Mar., 1911; cashier, treas. dept., Aug., 1911; astt. treas., Mar., 1914; 1st grade astt. treas., Jan., 1922; ag. deputy treas., June to Dec., 1919, Dec., 1921 to Feb., 1922, Sept., 1922 to Apr., 1923 and from May, 1923 to Mar., 1924.

HUDSON, PHILIP JAMES.—B. 1897; on mily. serv., June, 1916; cadet, Ceylon, Mar., 1920; attd. to Colombo Kachcheri, Apr., 1920; pol. mag., Balapitoya, Mar., 1921; astt. settlement offr., 1922.

HUGGARD, WALTER CLARENCE, K.C., B.A., LL.D.—B. 1884; ed. at Dublin Univ.; 1st honour-
HUGGINS, Horatio Crichton, M.Soc.E.—B. 1880; ed North London Collegiate Schl. and Polytechnic Schl. of Engurg.; served three years articles under the Hon. W. Wrightson, M.I.C.E., C.M.G.; served in pub. wks. dept., Trinidad, 1st June, 1900 to 4th June, 1909; 1st grade asst. engr., P.W.D., Nigeria, 5th June, 1909; exec. engr., 2nd grade, 4th Oct., 1918; author of "Bridge Roads in the West Indies" (Trans. Soc. Engurg., 1907); "Reinforced Concrete in Nigeria" (Trans. Concrete Inst., 1913).

HUGGINS, John, M.C. (1916).—B. 1891; ed. Bridlington Gram. Schl. and Leeds Univ., B.A.; 2nd lieut., Yorks Regt., Nov. 1914; Gallipoli, 1915; Egypt, 1916; France, July 1st, 1916; capt., Sept., 1916; ment. in desp.; cadet, F.M.S., 27th Mar., 1920; govt. rice agt., Klang, 28th May, 1920; ag. asst. dist. offr., Kuala Lipis, 7th July, 1920; agt. to food contr., Selangor and Pahang, 7th Oct., 1920; passed exam. in law, Mar., 1921; 4th ass't. sec. to govt., 9th Mar., 1921; passed final exam., Malay., June, 1921; dist. offr., Kajang, 24th Aug., 1921; offr., cls. IV., Aug., 1923.

HUGHES, D.B.B., M.B., C.M. (Edin.).—1st prizeman, senior surgery; medallist, anatomy and pathology; ag. surg. in charge, col. hosp., Grenada, 1900; dist. med. offr., St. Vincent, Dec., 1900.

HUGHES, John Whitehouse Ward.—B. 1883; ed. Oakham and Emmanuel Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1905; M.A., 1919; cadet, F.M.S., 1906; ag. supt., inland rev., Kelantan, Dec., 1910; mag., Kota Bharu, Sept., 1911; ag. dist. offr., Temerloh, Oct., 1914; ag. ass't. adviser, Kelantan, Jan., 1919; ag. collr., land rev., Penang, Oct., 1921; ag. dist. offr., Kuantan, Oct., 1922; ag. Br. adviser, Perlis, June, 1923; offr., cls. II., Dec., 1923.

HUGHES, Leslie Donald Charleton, M.C.—B. 1890; B.A., Oxon; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1914; attached to Colombo Kachcheri, Dec., 1914; attached to chief censor's office, Apr., 1915; attached to Badulla Kachcheri, Oct., 1915; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Uva, March, 1916; on military duty, 1917-19; asst. dir. of food prodn., Apr., 1920; pol. mag., Jaffna, Mar., 1921; asst. govt. agt., Batticaloa, Nov., 1921; ag. dist. judge, Badulla, Mar., 1923; asst. stlit. offr., Nov., 1923.

HUGHES, Brig.-Gen. Robert Herbert Wilfred, C.B. (1921), C.S.I. (1918), C.M.G. (1917), D.S.O. (1916), Officer Legion of Honour (1917)—B. 1872; cadet, H.M.S. "Conway," 1886-87; merchant service, 1887-1898; Bd. of T. master mariner's certif.; sub-lieut., R.N.R., 1896; lieut., 1904; comdr., 1914; capt., 1919; served in S. African war, in S.A. Light Horse, Bethune's M.I., and Royal Navy, from 12th Dec., 1899 to 1st May, 1902; marine offr., S. Nigeria, 27th March, 1903; qualified in surveying at R.G.S. in 1906; elected a younger Brother of Trinity House, 1909; senr. marine offr., 1st Jan., 1909; ag. marine supt. and harbr.-mast., Lagos, 1st July to 10th Dec., 1906; commanded Nigerian govt. yacht "Ivy" as armed auxiliary under the R.N. in the Cameroons Exped., Aug., 1914-Jan., 1916; Trinity House pilot in N. Sea, Apr.-June, 1916; seconded to Army as Major, R.E., June, 1916; lieut.-col., Sept., 1916; brig.-gen., May, 1917; dir. Inland Water Transport, Messina, till Apr. 1921; demob., 13th Apr. 1921; dep. dir. of marine, Nigeria, Aug., 1921; dir. of marine, Oct., 1921.

HUGHES, Rt. Hon. William Morris, P.C., M.P.—B. 1864; M.L.A., New South Wales, 1894-1901; elec. to 1st H. of H., C. of A., 1901; member since; min. for external affairs, 1904; representative of C. of A. at Navigational Conf., London, 1907; atty.-gen., C. of A., 1910-1913, and from Sept., 1914, to Oct., 1916; prime min., and atty.-gen., 27th Oct., 1916; ditto, 14th Nov., 1916; ditto, 17th Feb., 1917; ditto, 10th Jan., 1918; resigned, Jan., 1923.

HULL, Hon. H. C.—B. 1860; entd. Cap. ser., 1879; left the civ. ser. and practised law; bar for many years; served in S. African war; treas., Transvaal; min. of finance, Transvaal, S. Africa, 1910-1912.

HUMPHREYS, John Lisseter.—B. 1881; ed. at Bromsgrove Schl. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford (senr. class. scholar, 1900); 1st cls. class med., 1902; B.A., 1904; cadet, S. Sttlmsts., Oct., 1904; dep. collr. of land rev., and regiar. of distr., Singapore, May, 1906; ag. dist. offr., Alor Nov., Malacca, Nov., 1906; passed final exam. in Malay., passed cadet, July, 1907; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Dec., 1909; ag. dist. offr., Dindinge, Mar., 1910; seconded for serv. in Johore as collr. and sec., Batu Pahat, Feb., 1911; ag. 3rd mag., Singap., Nov., 1912; ag. dep. regiar., supr. et., Singap., Mar., 1913; also asst. supr. of Indian immgr., seconded for serv. in Johore as ass't. sec., Muar, Feb., 1915; ag. Brit. agt., Trengganu, Nov., 1915; British Adviser, Trengganu, May, 1919.

HUMPHRYS, H. L.—Ed., at gram. sch., Antigua; senior Camb. certif., 3rd div., house cashier, treasry., Antigua, Jan., 1892; 2nd div. offr., 1896; ag. 1st indoor offr. on several occasions; ag. ch. audit clk., Leeward Is., Dec., 1897 to Jan., 1898; ag. audit clk., St. Kitts-Nevis, Dec., 1903, to Mar., 1904; 1st indoor offr. of treasry., Antigua, Apr., 1904; ag. ch. ass't clk. and federal acctnt., Leeward Is., May to Oct., 1909, Aug., 1910, and from Apr., 1911 to Jan., 1912; ag. treasur. of Antigua, and federal acctnt., from Dec., 1912 to Apr., 1913.

HUNT, Athle Arthur, C.M.G. (1916)—B. 1864; ed. at Balmain pub. schl. and Sydenham Gram. schl.; entd. lands dept., New S. Wales, 1879; resigned in 1887 to study for the bar; admitted to the bar, 1892, and practised law; priv. sec. to first prime min., of C. of A., Jan., 1901; sec. and permanent head of dept. of external affairs, C. of A., since 1901; atty.-gen., Imp. Conf., 1907 and 1911; now arbitr., fed. pub. service.

HUNT, Edmund Langley, C.M.G., M.C., L.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Ireland.—B. 1868; ed. Lond. Sch. of Trop. Med.; civ. surg. with African field force, 1889-1902; med. offr., personal staff of comdr-in-chief (twice med. desps., 2 medals, 6 clasps); employed in Austria-German bdny. comm. to Lake Chad; thanks of German govt. and the Royal Order of the Crown of Prussia (3rd class); appd. med. W.A.M.S., Feb., 1905; recd. thanks of S. Ceylon for services in connection with outbreak of plague at Acora, 1908; inspecting med. offr., Ceylon, Mar., 1912; asst. prin. civ. med. offr., Ceylon, Aug., 1915; suptdg. med. offr., Jamaica, 1919.
HUNT, HENRY AMBROSE.—B. 1866; F.R.Met., C.; meteorologist, C. of A., 1906.

HUNTER, Lieut.-Gen. Sir ARCHIBALD, C.B. (1898), D.S.O. (1886).—Ed. at Glasgow Acad. and Sandhurst; 4th King's Own Royal Lancaster; 1874; capt., 1882; lieut.-col., 1889; col., 1894; maj.-gen., 1896; served in Egypt, and twice wounded; gov. of Dongola Prov. and commandt. Frontier Field Force, 1865-99; gov. of Omdurman, 1899; Egyptian medal and other orders; in command of 1st cls. dist. in India; lieutenant-gen. on staff, commanded 10th div. S.Africa, 1900-01 (twice ment. in desps.); commanded in Scotland, 1901-3; Western Army Corps, India, 1904-7; commanded Southern Army, Indian Army, 1907-9; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Gibraltar, 1910-13.

HUNTER, Sir GEORGE, K.T. BACH. (1921).—B. 1860; mem., N.Z. parlmt., 1896-99, and since 1911.

HUNTER, Hon. Gordon.—B. 1863; ed. Bradford Coll. Inst. and Toronto Univ.; called to the bar, Ontario, 1888; removed to B. Columbia, 1891; ch. just., sup. ct., B. Columbia, 1902.

HUNTER, JAMES BLAIR, B.A. (Univ. of Toronto).—B. 1876; clk., priv. coun. off., Canada, 1899; transf. to P.O. dept., 1900; marine and sheries, 1901; pub. wks., 1902 ch. clk., 1907; deputy min. of pub. wks., 1908.

HUNTER, John.—B. 1878; apptd., after compt. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. and assigned to the C.O., Apr., 1899; clk. to patronage comm., Nov., 1907.

HUNTER, John Adams.—B. 1890; ed. at Royal Grammar Schol., Newcastle-on-Tyne and St. John's Coll., Camb.; B.A., 1913 (hist. tripods 2, I.); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1914; ag. supervisor of cust., Port Dickson, Dec., 1915 to Aug., 1917; ag. supervisor of cust., Port Swettenham, Aug.-Dec., 1917; in India studying Tamil, Jan.-Sept., 1918; offr., cl. V, 26th Sept., 1918; asst. list. offr., Klang, Oct. 5th-28th Dec., 1918; attd. to chief sec.'s office, Jan.-Mar., 1919; seconded to serv. in food control dept., 26th Mar., 1919; g. 3rd ass't. sec. to Govt., F.M.S., 7th Oct., 1920; 3rd ass't. sec. to Govt., 3rd Oct., 1921; offr., cl. V., offg. dep. contr. lab., Seremban, Nov., 1921; dep. contr. lab., Kuala Lumpur, July, 1922; on spl. duty, rubber census, July, 1923; offr. in ch., govt. toddy shops in addn., July, 1923; 3rd ass't. sec. to Govt., F.M.S., Nov., 1923.

HUNTER, K. L.—Asst. dist. comsnr., E. Africa Prot., Apr., 1919.

HUNTER, Louis Lucien.—B. 1889; cadet, local div., Ceylon civ. ser., Sept., 1914; attached to Colombo Kachcheri, Sept., 1914; addtl. comsnr. of requests and pol. mag., Ratnapura, Oct., 1915; addtl. comsnr. of requests and pol. mag., Panadura, Sept., 1916; office asst. to govt. agt., N.C. Prov., Aug., 1918; pol. mag., Chilaw, sept., 1919; addnl. asst. govt. agt., Colombo, Feb., 1922; asst. stiml. offr., Jan., 1923.

HUNTER, Reginald John.—Ck., audit office, Transvaal, 18th May, 1901; prin. clk., 1st June, 1901; ag. asst. auditor-gen., Apr. to Aug., 1905, and Apr. to Oct., 1909; ch. clk., control and audit office, Union of S. Desert Provs., Egypt, 1920; mil. adviser to Iraq Govt., Mar., 1921.

JOYNT, HENRY RAYMOND, B.A.—B. 1888; ed. Bradfield, and Balliol Coll., Oxon. (math. schol.); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1911; ag. 2nd asst. contr. of lab., Penang, Mar., 1913; ag. asst. contr. of lab., K. Lumpur, Apr., 1914; passed cadet, July, 1914; ag. rev. audir., Sel., N. Sembilan and Phg., June, 1918; dist. offr., K. III., Nov., 1923.

JUST, SIR HARTMANN W., K.C.M.G. (1911), C.B. (1902), C.M.G. (1900), B.A. (1877).—B. 1854; appointed, after compet. exam., clk. in office of sec. of state for the col., 3rd June, 1878; ed. at Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford; was an open scholar on the foundation; 1st class in classical mods., 1874; Taylorian exhib., pioneer for German, 1876; 2nd class in final classical school, 1877; asst. priv. sec. to the late Earl of Derby, 6th Feb., 1883, to Col. F. A. Stanley (now Earl of Derby), 24th June, 1885, and to Mr. Stanhope, 3rd Aug., 1886; priv. sec. to Mr. Osborn Morgan, 6th Feb. to 3rd Aug., 1886; asst. priv. sec. to Sir H. Holland (afterwards Viscount Knutsford), 12th Jan., 1887, and to the Marquess of Ripon, 17th Aug., 1892; asst. sec. to the col. confee., 1897; 1st class clk., Apr., 1895; prin. clk., Mar., 1897; accompanied Rt. Hon. Joseph Chamberlain on his visit to S. Africa, 1902-3; asst. under-sec. of state, Jan., 1907; jt. sec. to Imp. Confce., 1907; sec. to Imp. Confce. on naval and mil. defence, 1909; visited Canada, 1910; also Australia and New Zealand, 1914; permanent sec. to Imp. Confce.; regir. of the Order of St. Michael and St. George; represented C.O. on advisory comte. of comm. intell., B. of T.; retired, 1916.

KANE, RICHARD RUTLEDGE, M.C. (1916), Bar. (1917).—B. 1877; ed. Royal Arty. Inst., Belfast and Portora Royal Schl., Enniskillen; served Bechuanaland Field Force, 1896-7 (S. African Jen. Serv. Med. with Bech. clasp); cadet, Fiji, Apr., 1899; clk. to stip. mag., Ba., Apr., 1901; inspr. of stock, Mar., 1905; stip. mag., Fiji, Jan., 1906; ag. stip. mag. and asst. native comsnr., Kaduva, Jan., 1906; ag. stip. mag., Ba., Apr., 1906 and Jan., 1906; ag. sub-inspr., constab., Jan., 1907; ag. stip. mag., Lautoka, Jan., 1909; assigned dist. of Nadi, Jan., 1909; 2nd grade mag., Jan., 1910; mag., Ba., Feb., 1910; ag. stip. mag., Levuka, and comsnr., Lomaviti, Mar., 1913; dist. comsnr., Ba., Jan., 1914; 1st grade dist. comsnr., July, 1915; proceeded on mil. serv., Aug., 1915; resumed duty, May, 1919; mag. dist. of Rewa, May, 1919; prov. comsnr., Naitasiri (conj.), May, 1919; dist. comsnr., Tailevu, May, 1919; nom. mem. leg. council, Fiji, June, 1919; spec. comsnr., N.W. Vitivili, during Indian strike, Feb. Mar., 1921; ment. by gov. in council for work in connection with strike, Apr., 1921; ag. res. comsnr., Br. Solomon Is., Apr., 1921; dep. comsnr., W. Pacific, Apr., 1921; res. comsnr., Br. Sol. Is., Sept., 1921; judl. comsnr., W. Pacific, 26th July, 1922.

KANNANGARA, EDWARD WILMOT.—B.1894; B.A., Lond.; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., local divn., Aug., 1919; attached to Kandy Kach., Aug., 1919; attached to Batticaloa Kach., Jan., 1920; ag. admn. pol. mag., Colombo, Negombo and Avissawella, May, 1921; pol. mag., Avissawella, Mar., 1923.

KANTAWALA, MOHAN HARGOVINDAS.—B. 1890; B.A., Cantab.; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1915; attached to Anuradhapura Kach., Feb., 1915; addtl. pol. mag., Anuradhapura, in addition to his own duties, July, 1915; addtl. pol. mag. and addtl. mun. mag., Colombo, July, 1917; pol. mag., Avissawella, Mar., 1918; office asst. to govt. agt., E. Prov., Oct., 1919; pol. mag., Negombo, Jan., 1921; ditto, Panadura, June, 1923.

KAUFMANN, HILARY PILKINGTON.—B. 1892; on mil. serv., Aug., 1915; cadet, Ceylon, Apr., 1920; addl. to Jaffna Kachohere, June, 1920; ag. office asst. to govt. agt. N. Prov., May, 1921; pol. mag., Balapitiya, Nov., 1922; dep. rubber contr., Nov., 1923.

KAUNTZER, W. H.—Bacteriologist and pathologist, E. Africa Prot., Jan., 1919.

KAY, WILLIAM, M.A. (Edin.).—B. 1887; asst. mast., educ. dept., Hong Kong, 1913; asst. mast., cls. II., Jan., 1920; cls. I., 1924.

KEAN, HON. ABRAHAM.—M.H.A., Bonavista, Newfoundland, 1885-89, Bay de Verde, 1897; mem. exec. coun. (without portfolio), 1897; ag. min. agricul. and mines, 1898.

KEATINGE, WILLIAM MAYBURY, B.A., LL.D.—B. 1879; ed. Monmouth Gram. Schl. and Trinity Coll., Dublin (Jellett prizeman); B.A., LL.B. (1900); LL.D. (1903); solr., 1904; admstr.-gen., regir. of deeds, and sec., Walf comsn., Zanzibar, 30th Mar., 1915; joint custodian of enemy property and liquidator of enemy firms, Nov., 1915; off. trustee, 1918; contr., local clearing office, Nov., 1920.

KEAY, DAVID DOIG.—Cik., Natal govt. rly., 1901-2; clk., law dept., Transvaal, Mar., 1902; ag. ch. clk., admtn. branch, atty.-gen.'s off., Nov., 1903; ch. clk., July, 1904; chief clk., dept. of just., 1st Apr., 1912; under sec. for justice, Nov., 1917.

KEET, JOHAN DIEDERIK MOHR.—Asst. dist. forest offr., working plans, eastern conservancy, Jan., 1908; asst. dist. forest offr., Keiskama Hoek, Jan., 1909; ag. dist. forest offr., Keiskama Hoek, Jan., 1914; ag. dist. forest offr., Knysna, Nov., 1915; dist. forest offr., Knysna, Apr., 1917; conservator of forests, Transvaal, Mar., 1923.

KEIR, A., M.A., U.D.A.—B. 1884; ed. Fordyce Acad. and Aberdeen University; M.A.
(Aberdeen), 1905; diploma, agr., Cambridge Univ., 1913; educ. dept., S.S. and F.M.S., 1906; inspr., schls., Selangor, 1911; head, Malay training coll., Matang, 1913; inspr., schls., Perak, 1920; repd. British Malaya at Imp. conf. on educ., 1923; ch. inspr., English schls., S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1928-Sept., 1924.

KEITH-ROACH, EDWARD.—B., 1885; ed. privately; 2nd lieut., 7th Lancs. Fusils., Aug., 1914; capt., Nov., 1914; major, July, 1915; seconded, gen. staff, G.H.Q., E.E.F., July, 1915; Bimbashi, Egyptian Army, May, 1916; intell. offr., Sudan govt., May, 1916; inspr., Port Sudan, Aug., 1916; Darfur Exped., and first inspr., Umkedada, Darfur, Oct., 1916 (Sudan Med. and Bar); 2nd cls. mag., 1916; dist. commr., Eastern Darfur, Jan., 1917; passed Sudan govt. Arabic exam., 1917; 1st cls. mag., June, 1917; pub. cust., enemy property in Palestine, under occupied enemy territory adminstr., Dec., 1919; 1st asst. sec., Palestine govt., 11th Oct., 1920; lent to C.O. by Palestine govt. and ag. prin., Feb., 1924 to Feb., 1925; publications, "Darfur, a Province of the Anglo-Egyptian Sudan," joint editor, "Handbook of Palestine, 1922."

KELLAGHER, GEORGE BANNERMAN.—B., 1889; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1919; cadet, S.S., 1913; attd. res. councillor's office, Penang, Dec., 1913; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Feb. to Mar., 1914; attd. G.P.O., Singapore, May, 1914; ag. 4th mag. and asst. dist. judge, Nov., 1914; passed cadet, Feb., 1917; supernumy offr., cls. V., Feb., 1917; on mil. serv., Apr., 1917; 2nd lieut., R.E., Dec., 1917; B.E.F., France, Apr., 1918; wounded Oct., 1918; lieut., R.R., June, 1919; demob., Feb., 1920; supernumy offr., cls. IV., Nov., 1920; ag. asst. offl. assignee, Singapore, Apr., 1921.

KELLY, F. L.—Asst. conservator of forests, E.A.P., Jan., 1913.

KELLY, SIR HENRY GREENE, KT. BACH. (1906).—Ed. Trin. Coll., Dub.; honorand and prizeman in hist. and political science; B.A. and LL.B.; called to the bar, King's Inn, Dub., Mich. Term, 1884; apptd. a puisne judge in the Niger Territories, 1891; acted on several occasions as chief justice; chief justice, 1899; chief justice of Southern Nigeria, 1900; ret., 10th Feb., 1908.

KELLY, HON. HUGH THOMAS.—B., 1868; ed. St. Michael's Coll., Toronto, and Toronto Univ.; called to the bar, 1886; K.C., 1908; pres., York Co. Law Assoc., 1910 and 1911; chmn., Toronto pub. lib. bd. for 3 years; a gov. of Toronto Univ., 1906-1912; judge of high ct. of Ontario, 1911.

KELLY, PERCY JAMES.—B., 1876; M.B., Ch.B., Glasgow, 1906; house surg., W. Kent general hosp., Maidstone, 1907-8; employed by govt. of Bengal on famine duty, 1907; certif. Lond. schl. of trop. med., 1908; apptd. to W. African med. serv., G. Coast, 1908; med. offr., Hong Kong, 1910; med. offr. to Victoria gaol and visiting med. offr. to Tung Wa hospital; med. offr. in charge of infectious diseases hosp., Kennedy Town; reglar., med. coll., Ceylon, 1912; on military duty, 1915-1918; surg. gen., B. Guiana, 1922.

KELSICK, OSCAR RICHARDSON.—Ag. cashier, savings bank, Antigua, 21st Aug., 1906; apptd. as ditto, 16th Jan., 1908; ag. acctnt., savings bank, 16th Jan., 1908; apptd. as ditto, 1st Sept., 1908; ag. acctnt., treas., 1st May to 4th Aug., 1909; junr. audit clk., 12th June, 1909; ag. govt. offr. Antigua, 1st Apr., 1915; clk. to treas.; clk. postmaster, cashier and acctnt., savings bank to exec. coun., Virgin Is., 21st July, 1915.

KEMP, HON. SIR ALBERT EDWARD, K.C.I. (1917).—B., 1858; ed. Public Schl., Claremont Quebec and Lacolle Acad.; pres. of Cana Manufacturers' Assoctn., 1895 and 1896; pm board of trade of the City of Toronto 1899-1900; elec. to H. of C., Canada, 1900; ree. 1904, 1911 and 1917; mem. of the Privy Com. for Canada and min. without portfolio in Robert Borden's cabinet, Oct., 1911; min. militia and defence, Nov., 1916; min. of own military forces, Oct., 1917; called to sen. Nov., 1921.

KEMP, GEN. THE HON. JAN C. G.—Min. Union of S. Africa since 1920; min. of agr., June, 1924.

KEMP, JOSEPH HORSFORD, C.B.E. (1918).—B., 1874; B.A., Cape Univ.; barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn; cadet, Hong Kong, 1884; offr., New Territory, 1889; reglar., land offr., 1900; ag. 2nd pol. mag., 1900 to 1904; ag. pol. mag., 1904; asst. sec., sanitary bd., deputy-reglar. and appraiser, sup. ct., 1904; reglar., sup. ct., offl. admistr., offl. trustee, reglar. of companies, 1907; ag. offl. rev. bank., Apl., 1907, to Apl., 1908; ag. inspr., 1908, to 1909; head of san. dep., reglar., sup. ct., offl. administrator, offl. trustee, reglar. of companies, 1909; crown sol., puisne judge, 1913; ag. atty.-gen., 1914; gen., 1915.

KEMP, JOHN TURNBULL.—B., 1892; ed. Exeter Coll., Brecon, and Exeter Coll., Oxford (Oxon.); war service, E. Africa 1917-18; progressed exam. in Tombe; asst. dist. ass. Sierra Leone, 15th Jan., 1915.

KEMPE, SIR JOHN ARROW, K.C.B. (1900).—B.A.—B., 1846; ed. St. Paul's and Trin. Coll., Camb.; clk., treas., N.W. sec. to chanclor. of excheqr., 1874-90; to Lingen, 1890-81, to Lord F. Cavendish, mem. of comsn. on agric. and dairy schls., prin. clk., treas., 1888; dep. chimn., bd. dir., 1894; mem. of royal comsn. on elec. comms. with lighthouses and light vessels, 1899; comptlr. and auditor, 1904; comptlr. and aud., 1905; hon. auditor of certain crown colonies and protectorates, ag. on behalf of S. of the cols.; retired, 1911.

KEMPE, JOHN ERSKINE.—B., 1888; ed. Exeter Coll. and University Coll., Oxford (2nd cls. soc. mod. hist.); B.A., 1910; cadet, F.K., 1911; passed final exam., Malay, May, 1913; asst. dist. offr., K. Kangsar, Oct., 1915; dist. offr., K. Kangsar, Feb., 1915; ag. 2nd dist. K. Lumpur, Mar., 1918; offr., cls. IV., 1st Jan., 1919; dist. offr., Pekan, Feb., 1919; 2nd cls. M.V.I., Pahang, Apr., 1919; seconded for ag. asst. comrn., lands, Trengganu, Feb., 1920; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1923.

KEMPSFORD, GEORGE HENRY.—B., 1870; apptd., after exam., 3rd cls. messenger, 22nd Feb., 1904; 2nd cls., 1907; 1st cls., 3rd cls., 1915.

KENDALL, NEVILLE.—B., 1871; ed. Exeter Pembroke Coll., Oxford (B.A.); jun. offr., Pen. 16th Aug., 1895; ag. asst. dist. mag., Selborne, 7th Apr., 1896; ag. coll. of land rev., Pen., 30th Jan., 1897; asst. dist. mag., Ulu Bros., Jan., 1899; ag. asst. dist. mag., Gopeng, Mar., 1899; coll. of land rev., L. KENNAN, THOMAS BERTRAM, M.C.—B. 1891; cler. asst., Basutoland, 1910; sub-inspr., pol., 1913; inspr., 1919; served in European War.

KENNEDY, F.—B. 1899; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Apl., 1917; passed London matric., June, 1917; on mil. service from 17th sept., 1917, to 19th March, 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

KENNEDY-SKIPTON, GEORGE STACY.—B. 1898; ed. Sherborne and Trinity Coll., Dublin; 2nd cls. schl., 1919; triple senr. mod., 1920-21; cadet, Hong Kong, Dec., 1921; sec., sany. bd., 1924.

KENNEDY, W.—Vet. offr., E.A.P., May, 1910; dep. chief vet. offr., Aug., 1914; ch. vet. offr., Kenya, Apr., 1921.

KENT, HON. JAS. M.—K.C., B.A.; M.H.A. Newfoundland, 1904; mem. of exec. coun. and min. of just., 1907; judge, supreme ct., 1916.

KENWORTHY, MAJOR H., R.E. (ret.), O.B.E.—B. 1873; ed. privately; mech. and civ. engr., specialising in land reclamation and irrig., anti-malarial drainage; serv. in France, Belgium and Italy, 1915-20 (twice ment. in desp., chevalier Crown of Italy); C.R.E., 1920; tech. adviser, disposal bd.; lent to Italian Genio Marina for anti-malarial reclamation and drainage; supt., P.W.D., Seychelles, 1921.

KENYON-SLANEY, NEVILLE AGLIONBY.—Ed. at Haileybury Coll.; asst. collr., E. KERR, DAVID IRVINE.—B. 1878; clk. to pol. mag., Grenada, 1899; rev. offr. KERR-PEARSE, MAJOR B. A. T. (formerly Rifle Brigade).—B. 1871; A.D.C. to gov.-gen. of Australia (Lord Northcote), 1906-07; priv. sec. to gov. of West Australia (Sir G.
