Stiltns., temp., Apr., 1920; puisne judge, S. Stiltns., Sept., 1920; pres., retrenchment comm., F.M.S., Mar., 1922 to Jan., 1923; judl. comm., F.M.S., Feb., 1923.

REDINGTON, DUDLEY CECIL.—B. 1883; ed. Clongowes Coll., Ireland; Natal police, 1903-11; Zanzibar police, 25th March, 1911; sup't., 15th Mar., 1912; asst. commd., 1st Feb., 1914; ag. commd. of police and ag. gov. of prisons, 7th Oct., 1915 to 31st Nov., 1916, and from 18th Mar. to 20th May, 1920; seconded for mil'y. serv. (7th Hussars), June, 1917; ag. port offr., Zanzibar, Dec., 1920 to Mar., 1921; ag. commd. of pol. and gov. of prisons, Apr.-Oct., 1921.

REDLICH, VIVIAN PERCIVAL.—B. 1881; ag. pol. mag., Negombo, Ceylon, Jan., 1908; ditto, Avisawella, June, 1910; apptd. to cls. V. of civ. serv., local divn., Jan., 1913; ag. itinerating pol. mag., W. Prov., Feb., 1913; addnl. pol. mag., Kurunegala, June, 1916; ag. pol. mag., ditto, Nov., 1918; apptd. to cls. IV. of civ. serv., Dec., 1918; ag. dist. judge, Kegalla, Oct., 1919; pol. mag., Galle, Mar., 1923; ditto, Gampola, Oct., 1924.

REED, E. A.—B. 1894; on mil'y. serv., Aug., 1914-Jan., 1918; temp. paper keeper, C.O. lib., 22nd Nov., 1920-15th Aug., 1924; estab. paper keeper (library attendant) after qual. exam., 16th Aug., 1924.

REED, HARRY LESLIE, M.A. (Cantab).—B. 1885; prin., Royal Coll., Ceylon, Aug., 1920.

REED, HATHORNE.—B. 1873; M.A., Cantab.; ed. Bath Coll. and Emmanuel Coll., Cambridge; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1897; Western Circuit; lieut., S. African Constabulary, 1902-1908; 2nd mag., Zanzibar, Dec., 1908; 1st mag., 8th Dec., 1910; ag. asst. judge, June-Dec., 1910, Mar.-Aug., 1915, Apr.-Nov., 1916, June, 1917, to Feb., 1918, and from Mar. to Dec., 1919; asst. judge, 9th Sept., 1920; ag. chief judge and judge of prize ct., Dec., 1919 to Feb., 1921, and from Dec., 1921 to Sept., 1922; author of "A Commentary on the Moneylenders' Act, 1900," and "A Commentary on the Police Offences Ordinance, 1902, of the Orange River Colony."

REED, HON. JOHN RANKEN, C.B.E. (1919).—B. 1864; ed. Gram. Sch., Auckland, N.Z.; Victoria Coll., Jersey, and Clare Coll., Cambridge; judge, N.Z. sup. ct., 1921; is judge advoc.-gen., N.Z. Defence Forces, with rank of colonel.

REES, ARCHIBALD PANETON CLEMENT.—B. 1893; ed. Christ Coll., Brecon, and St. Edmund Hall, Oxford; capt., Royal Welch Fusiliers, 1915; serv. Gallipoli, Mesopotamia and Fase ast. dist. commnr., Gold Coast, 17th Ju., 1920.

REES, LEWIS CHARLES MORRIS PARKER.—1876; ed. Kingston Coll., Yeovil and Meriv Venturers Tech. Coll., Bristol; art. pep. Messrs. Foster and La Trobe, architects & survr., Bristol, 1892; ast. to borough eng. Islington, 1897; ch. ast. borough engr., Mayo, 1900; prin. land survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1902; also sec., squatters' bd., 1905; lieut.-com. Kong vol. corps., 1909-1920; supt., crown land surveys, 1922.

REES-DAVIES, SIR COLIN, KT. BACH.—K.C.—Ed. at Ton; barrister-at-law, Inde.; admitted solr. of sup. ct., Sept., 1891; prac nine years in S. Wales; under-sheriff, Poweshire, 1899; called to the bar, Bahamas; ag. ch. just., Feb., 1903; ag. prosecu. for the Crown, May, 1903; coroner, Nov., regar.-gen., Br. Hond. (to act as atty.-gen. Apr., 1905; also regar., vice-admiralty & atty.-gen. on various occasions; mem. of educn. and quarantine; J.P. for col.; atty. and advocate in admiralty, Feb., 1907; adm. of exec. and legis. couns.; held comm. of govr. in certain events; ag. ch. just., Br. Hond. Mar. to Sept., 1908, Jan. to July, 1910, and Jan. to Sept., 1912; ag. col. sec., Oct., 1910, Jan., 1909, and Mar. to Aug., 1909; chan. of the diocese of B. Honduras and Cent. Am. for six years; deleg. from Br. Hond. to the educn. conf., 1911; solr.-gen., B. Guiana, 1913; ag. atty., gen., B. Guiana, May to 1914, Jan. and Dec., 1916, and Mar. to 1917; K.C., B. Guiana, July, 1917; ch. educn., Bermuda, Dec., 1917; pres., legis. com., bd. of educn.; trustee, Bermuda bor. Bermuda, del. to Imp. educn. conf.; senr. puisne judge, Trinidad, Nov., 1923; ag. just., June to Nov., 1924.

REES-DAVIES, SIR WM., KT. BACH.—B. 1863; ed. Eton and Trin. Hall, Camb., 1885; called to bar (Inner Temp.), 1887; South Wales circuit; J.P. and dep. lieut., Worcestershire; J.P. for Haverfordwest; M. Pembroke, 1892-8; priv. sec. to the hon. Sir W. V. Harcourt when chancellor exchequer, 1893-5, and afterwards from 1896; atty.-gen., Bahamas, 1897; admin. of govt., 1901; ag. ch. just., 1902; King's counsel, Cyprus, Oct., 1902; atty.-gen., Hong Kong, K.C., 1908; ag. ch. just., 1909-10; ch. Hong Kong, 1912; chmn. of gen. mil'y. tribunal, 1918; chmn., pub. serv. comm., Hong Kong, 1919; chmn., exec. comte., on the hon. H.R.H. The Prince of Wales, 1922; ret. 1923.

REEVES, FREDERIC WILLIAM.—B. 1865; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados, Christ's Camb., and Wren's Inst.; Barbados Sch.; math. scholar, Christ's Coll., 1886; R.A. (optime), 1898; M.A., 1906; ast. insp. of educn., Grenada, 1903; unofficial mem. of educn. comte., of bd. of dir. of secondary educn., 1906; ag. insp. of schls., Grenada, Dec. to Jan., 1907; ditto, St. Vincent, May to 1907; ag. ch. clk., audit office, Grenada, 1907, to Jan., 1908; ag. insp. of schls., Grenada, Jan.-Feb., 1908; headmaster, gram. sch.; insp. of schls., St. Vincent, Aug., 1908; bd. of educn., Sept., 1908.

REEVES, HON. WILLIAM PENBERTH.—Canterbury, N.Z., 1857; ed. in Colony; scholarship holder, 1868 and 1872; N.Z.ships in classics and English, 1874;
COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.

REID, THOMAS.—B. 1881; ed. Clongowes Wood, and Queen's Coll., Royal Univ., Dublin (B.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1906; off. asst. to govt. agt., E. Prov., Apr., 1907; mun. mag., Colombo, Dec., 1909; landing surv., customs, Colombo, Aug., 1910; dist. judge, Badulla, June, 1913; asst. govt. agt., Trincomalee, June, 1914; ditto, Matara, Apr., 1916; asst. chmn., mun. coun., Colombo, 5th Sept., 1919; ag. chmn., ditto, 22nd Sept., 1919; chmn., ditto, Sept., 1921.

REID, WILLIAM WALKER.—B. 1868; asst. engrnr., govt. rly., Trinidad, 3rd July, 1906; ch. engrnr., 1st Jan., 1923.

REILLY, ROBERT O'MALLEY.—Sub-inspr., Bechuanaland Prot. police, 1904; passed Cape civ. ser. lower law exam., 1909; ag. asst. res. mag., 1912; inspr., Apr., 1914; ag. res. mag., 1914; res. mag., 1921; passed 3rd grade Seawana exam., 1922.

REIMERS, EDMUND.—B. 1881; archivist and librarian, Ceylon, Oct., 1921.

REITZ, COL. HON. DENYS.—M.L.A. for Port Elizabeth (cent.); min. of lands, Union of S. Africa, 1921-24.

REITZ, HON. F. W.—B. 1845; ed. in Cape Colony and at Edin. Univ.; called to the bar, England, 1868; chief just. of O.F.S.; state sec. of S.A.R.; pres. of O.F.S.; pres. of Senate, Union of S. Africa, 1910.

REJAS, FRIX.—B. 1856; entd. civ. ser., Trinidad, 15th Feb., 1887; warden, 1st July, 1912.

RENDLE, HILARY CAMERON RUSSEL.—B. 1899; ed. Christ's Coll., Christchurch, New Zealand, Canterbury Coll., N.Z. and New Coll., Oxford; cadet, F.M.S., 1921; attd., dist. office, Lower Perak, 1923; attd., dist. office, Parit, 1922-23; ag. asst. dist. offr., Kroh and asst. supt. of cust., Kroh, 1923-24; asst. collr., land rev., Larut, 1924.

RENNE, CHARLES ROBERT.—B. 1880; clk., acct.'s office, N.E. Rhodesia, Apr., 1903; asst. acct., Apr., 1904; ag. paymr. and clk.-in-charge, P.W.D., Apr., 1905; asst. native consmr., Apr., 1906; ag. asst. mag., Mar., 1910-Jan., 1911; native consmr., Dec., 1910; has acted as asst. mag. on various occasions between Aug., 1911 and June, 1914; asst. mag., June, 1914; has acted as mag. on various occasions between July, 1918 and Sept., 1924; mag., Oct., 1924; J.P.

RENNIK, GILBERT MCCALL, M.C., M.A. (Glas.).—B. 1895; on mily. serv., July, 1915; cadet, Ceylon, Apr., 1920; attd. to Anuradhapura Kachcheri, June, 1920; attd. to N'Ellya Kachcheri, Nov., 1920; office assist. to govt. agt., E. Prov., Nov., 1921; pol. mag., Dandagamwa, Dec., 1923; ditto, Chilaw, Mar., 1924.

RENTON, SIR ALEXANDER WOOD, KT. BACH. (1915); M.A., LL.B. (honours), Edin., K.C.—Forensic prizeman; Lord Rector's essay prizeman; Bacon scholar, Gray's Inn, 1882; bencher, Gray's Inn, 1917; b. 1861; called to the bar, 1885; puisne judge, Mauritius, Aug., 1901; chmn., local comtee. of soc. of comp. legia., 1902; chmn. of mountain reserves comm., 1903-4; ag. procureur and advocate-gen., Aug., 1904; puisne judge, Ceylon, Aug., 1905; received thanks of S. of S. for drafting rules of sup. ct. of Mauritius, 1904; mem. of comtee. apptd. in 1912 to prepare new code of civil procedure, Ceylon; ag. chief just., Ceylon, May, 1913; chief just., Ceylon, Aug., 1914; chmn., police inquiry comsn., Sept., 1915; chmn. of comsn. of inquiry into certain cases of shooting during Ceylon riots, 1915; ret., 26th July, 1918; on special mission to Nigeria and G. Coast as to
war bonus, Sept., 1918 (recd. thanks of S. of S.); went to Egypt at request of F.O., Feb., 1919; and prepared draft Code of Criminal Procedure for Unified Tribunals; chmn., comm. of enquiry, Upper Egypt train murders; vice-pres., riots indemnities commn., Oct., 1919; chmn., Ceylon salaries commn., June, 1921; chmn., compensation (Ireland) commn., Feb., 1923; K.C., 12th Oct., 1923; author of "Wood Renton on Lunacy"; joint author of first edition of "Edmunds on Patents"; editor of Law Journal; editor of "Encyclopaedia of the Laws of England"; editor of "The English Reports"; joint editor of 2nd edition of "Burge on Colonial and Foreign Laws."

RENWICK, HENRY LANGDON.—B. 1898; London Rifle Brig., Apr., 1915; attd. gen. staff, W.O., 1919; ch. clk. to H.M.T.C. in E. Africa, Dec., 1919; asst. imigrn. and embarkation offr., Mombasa, July, 1920; asst. cust. dept., Zanzibar, Dec., 1920; imigrn., offr., Zbar., 1st Aug., 1921; ag. asst. collr. of cust., 28th Sept., 1923.

REX, MARCUS.—B. 1886; ed. Highgate and Trin. Coll., Camb. (exhbr.); B.A., 1908; cadet, F.M.S., 1910; asst. sec. to rec., Perak, 1912 and 1915; asst. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, 1913; supt., chandlery monopoly, Sel., N.S. and Pahang, 1917; dist. offr., Raub, 1919; ag. collr. of statistics, 1921; sec., retrenchment commn., in addition, Feb., 1922; dep. contr. of rubber expts., in addition, Oct., 1922; superanny, offr., cls. III., Nov., 1922; ag. finan. commr. and audr.-gen., Johore, June, 1924.

REYNOLDS, A. E.—B. 1881; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., Aug., 1900; conf. clk., 1st Jan., 1918.

REYNOLDS, R. M.—Marine supt., Uganda riv., 1911.

RHODES, HON. SIR ROBERT HEATON, K.B.E. (1920).—B. 1861; B.A. Oxford; entd. New Zealand parlmt., 1889; served in S. African war (Queen's medal and 4 clasps); lt.-col., 1st Regt., Canterbury Rifles Yeomanry Cavalry; postmrgen., min. of telegraphs, min. of pub. health, 1912-1915; min. of defence, 1920; commr., state forests, 1922.

RHODES, WILLIAM FREDERICK, B.A. (Cantab.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), D.P.H. (Oxon.)—Govt. pathologist, Durban.

RICH, HON. GEO. EDWARD.—Justice of the high court of Australia, Apr., 1913.

RICHARD, DANIEL.—B. 1886; ed. Foyle Coll., Londonderry and Queen's Univ., Belfast; B.A., 1908; cadet, F.M.S., 1910; ag. 2nd asst. prot. of Chinese, Singapore, 1914; asst. contr. of lab., 1915; mag., Ipoh, Nov., 1915; asst. contr. of lab., Dec., 1915; collr. of war tax, Singapore, 1918; ag. asst. offl. assignee, Singapore and ag. asst. supt., Indian immgrts. in addn., July, 1918; collr. of war tax, Singapore, Oct., 1918; ag. dist. offr., Dindings, 1919; ag. asst. prot. of Chinese, Penang, May, 1920; ag. prot. of Chinese, Perak, Sept., 1920; ag. prot. of Chinese, Selangor and Pahang, 1921; prot. of Chinese, Selangor and Pahang, 1922.

RICHARDS, A. F., B.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1885; ed. Clifton Coll., and Christ Ch., Oxford; cadet, S. Stltlms., Nov., 1908; ag. asst. dist. offr., Port Dickson, Apr. to Sept., 1910; ag. habrn., Perak, Aug., 1911; ag. asst. dist. offr., Batang Padang, Feb., 1912; offr., Cls. RICHARDS, FREDERICK WILLIAM, LL.Crown sol., S. Australia, 1916; formerly ass'tary draftsman.

RICHARDS, P. E.—B. 1901; apptd. to compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., 24th Apr.; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

RICHARDSON, CECILY.—B. 1889; ed. Laurels, Rugby and Royal Holloway Coll., London, 1912; asst. mistress, gov't. girl's school, Penang, 1914; asst. mistress, Raffles girl's school, Singapore, 1915; ag. prin., 1920 and 1921.

RICHARDSON, BRIG.-GEN. SPARROW (1917), C.M.G. (1915), C.B.E. (1919)—Enlisted in Royal Artillery, Aug., 1886; sent to N.Z. Forces as instructor in gunnery; wks. of master gunner, Aug., 1891; capt., S. India and dir. of artillery services (N.Z.), Apr., 1894; transferred to N.Z. staff corps, Jan., 1911; maj.-gen., 1912; lieut.-col., 1915; col., 1919, and has with seniority as from Dec., 1915; N.Z. representative at War Office, London, and as Impl. gen. staff, Dec., 1913; attached to staff, Aug., 1914; attached Royal Naval Div. as asst. adjutant and qtrmr., Nov., 1914; service at Antwerp with Royal Naval Div.; subsequently served as A.A. and Q.M. at Gallipoli; selected as D.A. and Q.M. of Army Corps at Salonika with temporary rank of brig.-gen.; comdt., N.Z.R.F. in U.K., in 1916; G.O. in charge admtn., N.Z. Div., 5th May, 1919; admstr., W. Sans 2 Legion of Honour (Croix de Chevalier), by Pres. of the French Republic, 1916; received despatches (3).

RICHES, GEORGE FREDERICK.—B. 1885; gov't. printing press, Zanzibar, 8th May, 1913; ag. editor, offl. gaz., 1st Jan., 1917 to 31st Dec., 1918; comptr. of stationery, 1st Jan., 1919; printer and comptr. of stationery, 1st Jan., 1919.

RIDDELL, HON. WILLIAM RICHARD—B. 1852; ed. Cobourg, Ont., Coll. Inst. and Univ., Toronto; lecturer in maths, Normal School, Ottawa, 4 years; called to bar, 1883; Q.C., bench, Law Soc., Upper Can., since 1892; high ct., Ont., King's Bench div., 1906; appellate div. (second divi. ct.), 1915; mem., American Bar Assoc., and of Bar of several states; F.R. Hist. Soc., Eng. F.R.S.C., Can.; LL.D., Toronto, Yale, McGill, Lafayette, Rochester, Wesleyan, North Western Univ.; L.H.D., Syracuse Univ.; Trinity Coll. (Toronto); author of several hist. works; has contrib. extensively to scientific and literary jnl.

th the rank of col., 1889; under-sea., foreign pt., India, 1881-5; comnr. for delimitation of ghan frontier, 1886-7; under-sea. to lord-lieut. RIGBY, JAMES PHILIP CLAYTON.—Ed. West- nster Schol. and Trinity Coll., Cambridge (West- nster exhibr.); barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn; dep. regisr., sup. ct., Singapore, Aug., 1898; sheriff, 1899; regisr. of ct., Larut, 1901; ag. g., Larut, 1902; ag. state treas., Perak, 1907; asst. ditto, Larut, 1911; ag. asst. regisr., sup., Ipoh., 1916; regisr., sup. ct., Kuala Lumpur, 20; off. cls. II., Jan., 1924; pub. for F.M.S. wt., "The 99 Laws of Perak," under gen. ship of R. J. Wilkinson.

RIGBY, WILLIAM EDWARD.—B. 1897; ed. at Grey Gram. Schol.; 2nd lieut., Lanc. Fusiliers, pt., 1915; served in France from Aug., 1916 to Nov., 1918, and from June, 1918 to Nov., 1919; arded the M.C. and the Croix de Guerre; cadet, Stintma., 20th Nov., 1920; attd. to Chinese st., Penang, 21st Dec., 1920; attd. to Chinese st., Singapore, 28th Feb., 1921; proceeded to netor to study Chinese, 5th July, 1921.

RIMINGTON, CAPT. G.B.—Asst. dist. near, Kenya, May, 1920.

RIPPON, STEWART ROSS, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1855; lieut., R.A.V.C., 16th Jan., 1917; serv. in onica, Macedon, and with Army of Black capt., Jan., 1918; demob., 25th Jan., 1921; y. off., Gold Coast, 20th May, 1921.

RISLEY, SIR JOHN SHUCKBURGH, K.C.M.G. (2), K.C. (1921), C.B. (1912)—B. 1867; ed. Marlborough and Magd. Coll., Oxford (class exhibition); 2nd class classical mods., 3; 2nd class jurisprudence, 1890; open stu- ship, Inns of Court, 1892; called to the bar, 3; M.A. and B.C.L., 1894; author of "The ending of St. Stephen's Golf Club," 1893; "The war of War," 1897; "Notes and Echoes," 1902; tor of Dale's "Clergyman's Legal Handbook," edition; joint editor of Waterlow's "Com- mises Acts Manual," 11th and 12th editions; al assistant, C.O., March, 1901; legal adviser, h May, 1911.

TISSIK, HON. JOHANN FRIEDRICH BERNHARD, I.L.A., Transvaal, for the electoral division Pretoria North Cent., 1907; mem. exec. nc. as min. for lands and native affairs, 1907; astr. of the Transvaal, 1911; mem. rlws. harb. board, 1917.

ITCHIE, GEORGE LE HARIVEL KERR BAIN- DGE.—Natal Civ. Serv., 1891; lieut., 1st batt. R., 1892; served with Mashonaland Field ce, 1896, attached to Rhodesian Horse, present his relief of Ft. Charter, Ft. Salisbury, Mazoe, Hartley Hills, ment. in desp. (medal and p); ast. collr., Nyasaland Prot., Dec., 1897; grade resident, Apr., 1907.

ITCHIE, J. D.—Cik., agrl. dept., Kenya, 1912; head clk. and acct., cust. dept., 1922.

ITCHIE, HON. JAMES JOHNSTONE.—B. 1856; Annapolis Acad. and King's Coll. Schol., dsor., N.S.; LL.B., Harvard Law Schol.; fitted to Bar of N.S., Dec., 1877; K.C., 1890; N.S. Barristers Soc., 1910 and 1911; just., N.S., 16th Feb., 1912; judge in equity judge of ct. for divorce and matrimonial ns., 12th May, 1915.

RIVERS-SMITH, STANLEY, O.B.E. (1919), M.A. (Cantab.)—B.1877; ed. at St. Lawrence Coll., Ramsgate, and St. Catharine's Coll., Cambridge, (exhibtr.); entd. Egyptian civ. serv., 27th Sept., 1905; dir. of educn., Zanzibar, 2nd Oct., 1907; seconded for mil. serv., K.A.R., Dec., 1916 to Dec., 1918; dir. of educn., Tanganyika Territory, 12th Sept., 1920; Swahili examr.

ROACH, B. S.—B. 1864; entd. educn. dept., S. Australia, 1879; head teacher, 1891; editor of "Children's Hour" and "Education Gazette"; inspr. of schls. since 1915.

ROBB, HON. JAMES ALEXANDER.—B. 1869; ed. at dist. schl. and Huntingdon Acad.; mayor of Valleyfield, 1906-10; el. to H.C., 1908, 1911, 1917 and 1921; min. of trade and commerce in King admn., 29th Dec., 1921; min. of immigr. and colonisation, 1923.

ROBERT, FREDERIC.—Admitted a solicitor of sup. ct. of Mauritius, 1885; ag. mag., Rodrigues, from Nov., 1896, to Dec., 1896, June, 1897, to Sept., 1898, and Apr., 1900, to June, 1901; dist. clk. and sen. civ. status offr., Plaines Wilhems, Curepipe division, 15th July, 1901; ag. regisr.-gen., May to Oct., 1903; ag. mag., Rodrigues, 1st Apr., 1904; ag. dist. and stip. mag. of Mauritius, 20th July, 1904; ag. mag., Lesser Dependencies, 19th Sept., 1904, confirmed assuch, 11th Sept., 1905; confirmed as dist. and stip. mag. Mauritius, 1st Oct., 1907.

ROBERTS, ARTHUR HALLAM.—B. 1888; ed. Aldenham Schol. and Jesus Coll., Camb.; called to the bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1914; cadet, Fiji, Jan., 1915; priv. sec. to gov., Fiji, Mar., 1915; ag. 1st cls. clk., col. sec.'s office, and clk. to exec. and legis. coun., Jan., 1916; passed cadet, June, 1916; priv. sec., Oct., 1916; 2nd grade dist. comm., 15th Oct., 1916; ag. crown solr., July, 1917; assigned dist. of Savu Savu, Aug., 1917; granted leave to proceed on act. serv., June, 1918.

ROBERTS, CHARLES CLIFTON, B.A.—Ed., St. Paul's Schol. and Keble Coll., Oxford; called to the bar, Middle Temple, 1910; astt. atty-gen., Nyasaland Prot., Nov., 1919; ag. atty.-gen., May to Oct., 1920, Mar., 1921, to Jan., 1922 and from Feb. to Apr., 1924; senr. mag., Uganda, June, 1924; ag. atty.-gen., Sept., 1924.

ROBERTS, DAVID GWYN.—Cik., accounting dept., Cape Govt. rlws., 1902; passed Cape civ. serv. exam., 1st class, Nov., 1902; clk., col. sec.'s office, Jan., 1903; transf'd. to treasry., Sept., 1908; voluntarily retired from Cape civ. serv., Feb., 1909; clk., customs dept., Nyasaland Prot., 7th Oct., 1910; astt. traffic auditor, Gold Coast rlws., 24th Sept., 1913.

ROBERTS, GEORGE FURZ.—B. 1881; ed. Univ. Coll., London; telegraphist, G.P.O., Sept., 1897; 2nd div. clk., exchequer and audit dept., Apr., 1900; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Dec., 1905; off. astt. to gov't. agt., Uva Prov., Apr., 1907; pol. mag., Panadure, Jan., 1909; Jaffna, Dec., 1909; astt. gov't. agt., Hambantota, Nov., 1911; dist. judge, Nuwara Eliya, and commr. of re- quests and pol. mag., Nuwara Eliya-Hatton, May, 1912; pol. mag., Galle, Mar., 1915; pol. mag., Colombo, Mar., 1916; tea commr., Nov., 1918; controller of estate supplies, in addition to his own duties, May, 1919; comnr. of requests, Colombo, Nov., 1921; ag. astt. P.M.G., Mar., 1922; rubber contr., Oct., 1922.

ROBERTS, MAJOR GEORGE DOUGLAS.—B. 1869; ed. Chanonry House, Aberdeen; served in Anglo-Boer war, 1901-02; S. African constab., 1904-06; sub-inspr., Swaziland pol., 1907; adjt. training depot, England, 1914-18; inspr., 1918; staff offr., pol., 1923.
ROBERTS, JACOB THOMAS.—B. 1874; ed. at C.M.S. Collegiate schl., Lagos; clerical astt., qtrmr. off., Hauna force, 16th Sept., 1898; 6th cls. clk., 3rd Aug., 1899; astt. storekeeper, med. dept., 1st Jan., 1900; ag. med. storekeeper and warden, Lagos hosp., 4th Nov., 1903, to 3rd Jan., 1904; 4th cls. clk., med. dept., 1st Apr., 1904; 3rd cls. clk., audit off., 1st Feb., 1905; 2nd cls. clk. ditto, 1st Jan., 1907; 1st cls. clk., ditto, 1st Jan., 1908; in charge of audit off., Ebute Metta, 21st Jan. to 26th Feb., 1908; astt. chief clk., audit off., 1st Jan., 1911.

ROBERTS, JOHN EDWIN THEOPHILUS.—Ed. Mico Coll., Jamaica; head teacher, St. Mary’s Schl., St. Kitts; head teacher, Road Town Wes. Schl., Virgin Is.; clk. to comsnr., Virgin Is., Mar., 1917; ag. educnl. dist. offr., Oct., 1919-Feb., 1920; educnl. dist. offr., Mar., 1920; clk. to mag., and bailiff, sup. ct., Apr., 1921; comsnr. to admstr. oaths, July, 1921.

ROBERTS, PERCY HAMER.—Prison offr., Br. Guiana, 19th Nov., 1901; served penal settlmt., Massaruni, and at Essequebo and Georgetown county prisons; clerical astt., Georgetown and Essequebo prisons; gaoler, G. Coast, 5th Mar., 1911; keeper, James Fort prison, 1st June, 1911.

ROBERTS, THOMAS WEBB.—B. 1880; ed. Hertford Coll., Oxford; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1902; pol. mag., Matara, Aug., 1908; Panadura, Sept., 1906; dist. judge, Chilaw, Feb., 1909; ag. dist. judge, Batticaloa, May, 1912; comsnr. of requests, Colombo, Feb., 1914; astt. comsnr. of excise, Mar., 1917; excise comsnr., Aug., 1920.

ROBERTSON, COLIN CHARLES, M.F.—Probationary forest offr., O.F.S., Feb., 1903; studied forestry in Europe and at Yale Univ., 1905-07; astt. conservator of forests, O.F.S., 1907; dist. forest offr., and research offr., Pretoria, 1912; professional astt., 1917; on active service with S.A.H.A., Apr., 1917 to July, 1919; ag. conservator, forests, Eastern conservancy, 1919; Natal and Midland conservancies, 1920; resumed duties of prof. astt., Pretoria, Oct., 1920; conservator, forests, Oct., 1920.

ROBERTSON, GEORGE WATSON, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.)—Govt. pathologist, Cape Town and med. offr. in ch., govt. vaccine statn., Cape Town, 1921.

ROBERTSON, HON. GIDEON DECKER.—B. 1874; ed. pub. and high schl., Welland, Ontario; called to the senate, Canada, 1917; mem. of the P.C. for Canada, 1918; cabinet min. without portfolio; min. of labour in Union Govt., 7th Nov., 1918 to 29th Dec., 1921.

ROBERTSON, J. P.—Ed. Trinity Coll., Dublin; headmaster, govt. boys’ schl., Acora, G. Coast, 11th Apr., 1908; inspr. of schl., 1st Jan., 1911; provincial inspr. of schl., 1st Jan., 1915; lieut., G. Coast volunteers.

ROBERTSON, THOMAS ROBERT.—B. 1875; ed. Glenalmond, M.B., Ch.B., Edin.; formerly house surgeon and physician, Swansea hosp. and Victoria Park hosp. for chest diseases; civil surg., S. African Field Force, 1901-2 (medal and three clasps); astt. comsnr. and gen. med. offr., Salt Cay, Turks Is., 1905; dist. comsnr. and gen. med. offr., Caicos Is., 1905; gen. med. offr., Grand Turk, 1906.

ROBERTSON, WALTER BANNERMAN.—B. 1884; ed. at dist. schl., Marshfield, P. E. Island, high sheriff of Queen’s Co., 1896 to 1902; collr. of cust. for the port of Charlottetown, Apr., 1902.

ROBERTSON, W. C. F., C.M.G. (1919).—Ed. Trin. Coll., Dublin; exhibitioner, 1885 and 1887; classical scholar, 1888; classical moderator, 1889; inspr. of schl., G. Coast, 1898; director of edu., 1899; ag. comptroller of cust., 1899; comp. census rept., 1901; ag. sec. for native affars, June to 19th Nov., 1906; prov. commr., 20th Nov., 1906; sec. for native affars, 18th May, 1907; col. sec., 4th July to 25th Sept., 1908; chief col. sec., 22nd Jan., 1909; ag. col. sec., 19th deputy gov., Jan., 1910; ag. col. sec., Sept., 11th May to 15th June, 1911, 14th July, 1912; 5th Jan., 1912, 30th Oct. to 26th Dec., 1912; 7th Mar. to 21st Aug., 1913; dep. gov., 1912, and April-May, 1913; ag. gov., 1st May, 27th Aug., 1914; dep. gov., 28th Aug. to 6th Nov., 1914; col. sec., Gibraltar, 12th Feb., 1915; gov. and chief sec. to govt., Malta, May, 1915; offr. admtrg. govt., Malta, 12th June, 1915; 2nd July, 1920; gov.’s dep., 1st Oct., 1920; Lieut. Gov. by comsn. under constitution, 14th Apr., 1921; offr., admtrg. 16th May to 9th Sept., 1921 and from 25th Nov., 1921; 17th Aug., 1923; gov.’s dep., 17th-24th Feb., 1924.

ROBIN, MAJOR-GENERAL SIR WILLIAM, K.C.M.G. (1916), C.B. (1881); ed. privately and at Otago hig. schl.; N. Zealand volk. offr.; comd. squadn. N. Z. mtd. rifles, Queen Victoria’s diamond jubilee; comd. 1st N. Zealand contngt., S. Afr., 1901; comdt., Otago mil. din., 1902-07 (bec. sec. chief of gen. staff and 1st mil. mem. of def. defence, 1907-11 (col.); adjt. and qtrmr. gen., 1912; represented N. Zealand on Imperial War Off., 1912-13; comdt. and G.O.C., N.Z. mil. forces, 1914-19; maj.-gen., 1916.

ROBINSON, ALFRED FRANCIS.—Ed. Durham and Durham Schl.; served European War, 17; 6th K.A.R., E. Africa campaign, 1916; Uganda treas., 1911-13 (resigned); com. Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1919.

ROBINSON, AUBREY CHARLES.—B. 1875; Lancing Coll., and Hertford Coll., B.A.; called to the bar, Inner Temp., 1901; practised at the bar, Jamaica, 1912; comsnr., and judge of grand ct., Curaçao, Jan., 1913; compld. revised edition of Cayman Is. ROBINSON, FRANKLIN.—B. 1878; Durham Univ.; barrister, Inner Temp.; cadet, S. Stilts, Oct., 1902; ag. head of Coll., Malacca, Apr., 1903; demarcate Malacca, 4th Dec., 1903; passed final exam. RODD, A. J.—B. 1886; apptd., after exam., asst. library attendant, C.O., 11th Dec., 1905; library attendant, 18th Feb., 1911; supplementary clk., col. audit dept., Feb., 1914; on mil. serv. from 5th Aug., 1914.

RODEN, SIR ROBERT BLAIR, KT. BACH (1918).—B. 1860; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1902; clk., public library, Antigua, 1880; 2nd clk. to the gov., Leeward Is., 1881; acted on several occasions as ch. clk., and as clk. to the legis. and exec. couns., and as a dist. mag., Antigua; also acted as priv. sec. to different govrs., Leeward Is., in 1883, 1890, 1895 and 1896; mag., Nevis, 1890; mem. St. Kitts and Nevis legis. couns., 1891; mem., fed. leg. coun., Leeward Is., 1898-9; mag., Bridgetown, Barbados, 1903; acted on several occasions as judge, petty debt ct., Bridgetown, and judge of the ass't. ct. of appeal; visiting justice, Glendairy pris., 1904; ch. just., St. Vincent, 1912; admnstr. govt. of St. Vincent from Oct., 1912 to Feb., 1913, and for short periods in Apr., Aug., and Dec., 1913; also from Mar. to Nov., 1914; ch. just., Br. Honduras, Feb., 1915; chmn. of food control comttee., Jan., 1918; ret., 1921.

RODESSE, MAURICE.—B. 1871; Priv. sec. to several puisne judges and ch. justices, S. Sttlms., from 20th May, 1889; acted as dep. regir. or as sheriff and dep. regir., Singapore, on several occasions since 1893; confirmed as sheriff and dep. regir., 1st Jan., 1902; ag. offl. assignee in addition to own duties, Sept. to Oct., 1907; dep. regir. sup. ct., and sheriff in addition, Dec., 1908, and again Apr., 1914; ag. regir., sup. ct., Jan., 1909; hon. gen. sec., agr.-horticultural shows in addition, May to Aug., 1910; asst. supt. Indian immigr., May, 1912; ag. marshal, prize ct. in addition, Aug. 1914; in charge of regir. and sheriff's office, Dec., 1917.

RODRIGO, EDMUND.—B. 1889; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attached to Kurunegala Kachcheri, Mar., 1913; ag. pol. mag., Negombo, Nov., 1913; office asst. to gov't. agt., W. Prov., May, 1915; mun. mag., Colombo, Oct., 1915; pol. mag., Puttalam, July, 1917; office asst. to gov't. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Sept., 1918; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Apr., 1920; ditto, Matare, May, 1922; asst. comsrr., excise, Sept., 1924.

RODRIGUEZ, FAUSTIN ALBERT, M.B., C.M. (Edin.).—B. 1887; entd. med. ser., Trinidad, 1st May, 1904; dist. med. offr., 1st May, 1904.

RODWELL, SIR CECIL HUNTER, K.C.M.G. (1919), C.M.G. (1909).—Ed. Eton and King's Coll., Camb., B.A., 1897; serv. on staff of high comsrr. for S. Africa since Dec., 1900; Imperial sec., Mar., 1904; gov., Fiji, and high comsrr., W. Pacific, 8th Apr., 1918; assumed duty, 10th Oct., 1918.

ROGERS, ARTHUR WILLIAM, D. Sc., F.R.S.—B. 1872; ed. Clifton Coll. and Christ's Coll., Camb.; Harkness scholar, Camb.; geologist, geological comsrr., Cape of Good Hope, 1896; asst. dir., geological surv., Union of S. Africa, 1st Apr., 1912; dir. geological survey of Union of S. Africa, 1917.

ROGERS, RICHARD EDWARD ELMORE.—Govt. printer and comptroller of stationery, S. Australia, 1st June, 1910.

ROGERS, WALTER ERNEST.—B. 1864; ent. civ. serv., S. Australia, 9th Mar., 1882; 2nd clk., audit dept., 1st Feb., 1912; audr.-gen., S. Aust., 1923.

ROGERSON, WALTER JOHN LANCASHIRE, B.A., Cantab.—B. 1889; Cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attached to Kandy Kachcheri, Jan., 1913; ag. additional office asst., Anuradhapura...
Koch., Jan., 1914; ag. asst. govt. agt., Trincomalee, May, 1914; addtl. office asst. Anuradhapura, June, 1914; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Kandy, June, 1914; ag. asst. govt. agt., Matale, Sept., 1914; office asst. to govt. agt., Badulla, Sept., 1914; pol. mag., Matale, Jan., 1916; office asst. to govt. agt., Kandy, May, 1917; pol. mag., Avisawella, Jan., 1921; ditto, Kandy, Feb., 1921; dist. judge Kegalla, Sept., 1922; pol. mag., Colombo, July, 1923.

ROLSTON, CECIL MICHELL.—M.D., C.M., Univ. of Manitoba, Canada, 1895; L.R.C.P., Edin.; L.R.C.S., Edin.; L.R.F.P. and S., Glasgow, 1898; mem. Coll. of Phys. and Surgeons, 1903; F.R.I., pub. health, London; late civil surg., attached to R.A.M.C. during S.African war, 1900-1902; Queen's medal, 2 clasps; King's medal, 2 clasps; apptd. to Leeward Is. med. serv., 1903; med. offr., dist. "D," Dominica, and ag. med. offr. of pub. instit., 1903; dist. med. offr. of health, Vancouver B. Columbia, 1908; med. offr., dist. 8, Nevis, 1914; ag. mag., Nevis, May to June, 1915; med. offr., dist. 6, Nevis, Sept., 1915.

ROOKE, C. E.—Asst. traffic mnr., Uganda rly., 1914.

ROOS, J. DE V., B.A., LL.B.—B. 1869; advoc. of sup. ct., Cape Colony; ditto, S.A.R.; attorney, etc., of sup. ct. of S.A.R.; sworn translator in English, Dutch and Portuguese, sup. ct., Transvaal; Cape partly, service, 1893-7; ag. sec. of law dept., Transvaal, 1st Dec., 1908; ditto and ag. dir. prisons, Transvaal, 1st Jan., 1909; sec. to law dept., 1st May, 1909; re-admitted advoc., sup. ct., Transvaal, 28th June, 1909; dir., prisons, 1st July, 1909; sec. for just. and dir. prisons, Union of S. Africa, 1st Apr., 1912; ag. contr. and audr.-gen., 1st Aug., 1918; contr. and audr.-gen., 9th Dec., 1918; mem., American rly. acctng. offr.'s asm.; mem., joint comte. of the universities for professional exams.; mem., société de comptabilité de France.

ROOS, HON. TIELMAN J. DE V., K.C.—M.L.A. for divn. of Lichtenburg, Union of S. Africa since 1915; min. of just., 30th June, 1924.

ROOTS, NEVILLE, M.Inst.C.E.—Ed. Tonbridge Schol. and City and Guilds Engnr. Coll., S. Kensington; held various engnr. appts. in U.K., 1897-1904; inappr. engnr., P.W.D., Jamaica, 1908; asst. dir., P.W.D., 1914; ag.dir., Apr., 1920 to Sept., 1921; dep. dir., Apr., 1922.

ROPER, WILLIAM JAMES.—B. 1891; entd. C.A. office, 1907; seconded to Falkland Is., Aug., 1912; ag. priv. sec. to admtn. and clk. to couns., Aug., 1913; chf. clk. to col. sec., Jan., 1914; ag. local auditor, Nov., 1914; returned to C.A. office, 1915; served European war (M.G.C., France), 1916-1919; 1st cls. clk., Nyasaland, 15th Jan., 1920; ag. ch. clk., July to Dec., 1921; editor, Gazette, Oct., 1921 to Dec., 1922; ag. 2nd asst. sec. and clk. to exec. and leg. couns., Jan. to Nov., 1922.

ROSE, HON. HUGH EDWARD.—B. 1869; ed. at Jarvis St. Collegiate Inst., Univ. of Toronto; (B.A., 1891; LL.B., 1892), and Osgoode Hall; mem. of the firm of Faeken, Cowan, Chadwick and Rose; called to the bar, Ontario, 1894; K.C., 1908; judge of the sup. ct., Ontario, 4th Dec., 1916; examr. in law for some years for University of Toronto and the Law Socv. of Upper Canada.

ROSEBY, THOMAS ERNEST.—B. 1868; ed. at Sydney Univ.; M.A.; honourman in French and German; senr. clk., Royal Mint, Sydney, 1885-1896; called to the bar, New S. Wales, 1896; also to high ct., of Australia; called to the bar, Mid. Tem., 1912; crown proser., N.S. Wales and 1902-3; Brit. judge of joint ct. and judg. commr. for the New Hebrides, Nov., 1919; thanked by S. of S. for memoranda on land ss. 1910; co-author of the joint ct. civ., crims. and land registration procedure codes; pus. judge, sup. ct., Mauritius, Feb., 1917; chmn. govt. wages comm., 1919; chmn. of comte. advise on treatment of former enemy aliens; chmn., govt. scholarship grants comm.; chmn., fly. enquiry comm., 1925.

ROSS, ALEXANDER HOWARD.—B. 1880; Epsom Coll. and on H.M.S. "Worcester"; vis. of customs, Gold Coast, 1905; ag. mg. P.S., 1908 and 1909; ag. dist. commr. & travelling commr., 1908 and 1909 in Ashanty and Northern Territories; asst. dist. commr. Ashanty, 1910; ag. prov. commr., 1912 and 1913; dist. commr., 1913; dist. commr., 1914; prov. commr., Mar. to Oct., 1916; prov. criminal law, Tropical African Service Com. dist. commr., 1917-18; ag. prov. commr., May to Sept., 1919; ag. sec., native afr., May to 1919; prov. commr., Sierra Leone, May to 1919.

ROSS, CHARLES RICHARD.—C.I.E., P.O. bank, Cape, 1890; agric. dept., 1894; dist. acctnt., office of conservator of forests, Mass. Conservancy, Cape, 1895; dist. fores. George, Cape, 1897; Kokstad, Transkei; asst. conservator of forests, Transkeian conserv., 1907; transf. to King William's Town, 1911; conservator of forests, Eastern conservancy, 1st Apr., 1912; ditto, Western conservancy, 1916.

ROSS, EDWARD ANDREW.—B. 1896; ed. Gram. Schol. and Manchester Univ.; ag. serv., 1914-19; awarded M.C.; reclm. comm., 1921 with rank of capt.; cadet, F.I.; ag. asst. contr. of lab., May, 1921; nat. nymy. offr., clv., V., May, 1923; ag. dep. offr., Kuala Lumpur, Dec., 1923; ag. ass. offr., lands, Kinta, Mar., 1924.

ROSS, GEORGE ARCHIBALD PARK, M.D., LL.Edin., D.P.H. (Edin.); diploma, trop. med., Liverpool.—B. 1879; S. African W.C. Scouts, 1900-02; Anglo-Portuguese bndy. exp., Zambesia, 1904-5; native rebellion, Nam. trop. disease investig., 1906-10; gen. pathologist, Natal, 1911; asst. health offr., Umtata, Africa, statnd. in Natal, 1918; major, S. Afr. med. corps, in ch. sleeping sickness bure., ban. and sanitation offr., Natal, 1914-19.

ROSS, J. G. H.—Asst. dist. commr., E. Sept., 1919; ag. junr. asst. sec., Kenya Nov., 1919 to 26th Oct., 1919; ag. clk. of leg. couns., 12th Dec., 1919 to 14th Feb., 1920; editor, offl. Gazette, 6th Feb., 15th Mar., 1920.

ROSS, JAMES PAULL.—B. 1881; ed. at Watson's Coll. and Edin. Univ.; M.A.; signet; capt., 5th Batt. the Royal (Q.E.R.) T.; asst. dist. commr., G. Coas., Aug., 1913; ag. dist. commr., 1914, 1915 and 1917; junr. ass. col. sec., 8th Jan., 1919; asst. col. sec., Feb., 1918; dist. commr., 1919; ag. pol. mag., Coomassie, 12th Apr. to 5th Feb., 1920; ch. census offr. in adml. asst. col. sec., 1st Jan., 1921; pres., Accra Coun., May, 1921; ag. ch. regier. and sherif., July, 1921 to 22nd Oct., 1921; senr. asst. 15th Nov., 1921.

ROSS, JAMES SANDFORD.—B. 1884; Merchant Taylors Schol.; mil. serv., 1914; N.W. Frontier campaign, 1915; Salonica Force, 1916-19; asst. treas., Kenya, 1919.
ROSS, OSWALD F.—Ed. Malvern Coll. and Mus Coll., Cambridge; capt., N. Staffs. Regt., European War; served Dardanelles expdn., 1915; Mesopotamia, 1916; passed A.T.S. course, 1920; dist. commr., Gold Coast, 1920.

ROSS, WILLIAM ERNEST.—B. 1870; entd. civ. r., Trinidad, 26th Aug., 1890; ch. clk., surg. m's office, and sec. to bd. of health and quarantine authority, 1st Jan., 1912.

ROTH, WALTER E.—B.A. (Oxon), late Demy of agd. Coll.; M.R.C.S. (Eng.); L.R.C.P. (Lond.); mem. anthrop. societies of Berlin and Florence, and of anthrop. inst., Lond.; late ch. protector aborigines, Queensland; and Royal commr. to inquire into condition of natives of W. Aust.; ip. mag., dep. prot. of Indians, and govt. med. fr., Pomeroon River, B. Guiana, 8th Dec., 1906.

ROTITIMI, J. F. AMOSU.—Ed. Baptist elementary hl. and academy, Lagos; marine clk., Calabar, st., 1895; ast. regar. of ct., Calabar, June, 96; dep. regar. of ct., Jan., 1899; trav. supervisor of native ct., S. Nigeria Prot., Sept., 1901, Apr., 1907; ditto, E. Prov., S. Nigeria, Apr., 07; has recd. thanks of govt. for services in connection with reorganization of native courts, Nigeria, 1902-3.

ROUILLARD, JEAN EDMOND.—Ed. Roy. Coll., aur., and King Henry VIII.'s schl., Coventry; called to bar, Mid. Tem., 1891; licent. laws, Paris, 91; ag. dist. mag., Plaines Wilhelma, Maur., st., 1899; ag. Crown prov., Feb., 1900; Crown os., log. advr., pol. mag., etc., Seychelles, 4th pt., 1900; mag., Rodrigues, July, 1902; dist. stip. mag., Mauritius, 1913.

ROUTH, REGINALD LAMY.—B. 1856; ed. St. Mary's Hall, Southsea, and Cadet school; frigate, M.S." Conway"; extra master's certif., 1893; master of govt. vessels, Lagos, Apr., 1897; ast. marine supt., Lagos, Dec., 1902; ag. marine supt., ec., 1903, to June, 1904; comdr., H.M.C.S.Y. (vy.), S. Nigeria, June, 1906; sen. marine r., E. Prov., S. Nigeria, May, 1907.

ROWATT, HUGH HOWARD.—B. 1861; ed., Ottawa Coll. Inst., and St. Catherine's Affiliated coll.; entd. civ. serv., Can., 1887; as correspondent; clk., mining lands br., Mar., 1907; contrlr., mining lands, 1912; supt., 1920.

ROWE, MAJOR R. H., D.S.O., M.C.—B. 1883; Wellington Coll. and Royal Milly Acad., Woolwich; 2nd lieut., Royal Arty., 1902; served Bermuda and Jamaica, 1902-6; served with native infantry under Sir H. Trenchard in S. Nigeria, 07-10; Northern Hinterland expdn., 1907-8; Niger Cross River expdn., 1908-9; operations against Abini, 1909, and against Munchis, 1910; sent to survey of Nigeria, 1910; dep. dir., 1911; Nigeria Dshoneybdry. comsn., 1912; Cameroons, 14-16; ch. of admstv. staff, with major-gen. r C. Dobell, France, 1916-18; commanding witzer batty. and brig. major, 11th corps, Heavy tv., Russia (Murman coast), 1918; three times sent in desps.; surv.-gen., G. Coast, 1920.

ROWELL, THOMAS HUBERT.—Ck., loco. pt., I.M.R., Pretoria, Oct., 1900; acctg. brch., loco. supt.'s office, Jan., 1903; acctg. offr., mech. engrnr.'s dept., July, 1908; inpnr., audit. pt., S.A.R. and Harbrs., Oct., 1910; inpnr. it. coord. and audr. gen.'s dept., Union of S. Africa, May, 1911; inpnr., (rlys. and hbrs.) con. and audit dept., 1st July, 1916; senr. inpnr., Oct., 1922; ag. ch. inpnr., rlys. and harbrs., 1st Apr. to 11th Sept., 1924.

ROWLEY, FORTESECU WILLIAM.—B. 1874; Canterbury Univ. Coll.; entd. N.Z. dept. of labr., 1893; dep. chief inspr. of factories, 1907; chief clk. and dep. chief inspr., 1911; sec. of labr., chief inspr. of factories, reg'rs. of industrial unions, and supt. of workers' dwellings, 1914.

RUDDICK, JOHN ARCHIBALD, LL.D.—B.1862; dairy expert; ast. to dairy comsmr., Canada, 1891; prin. dairy schl., Kingston, Ont., 1896; dairy comsmr., New Zealand, 1898; ast. to comsmr. of agr., Can., 1900; dairy comsmr., Can., 1905; dairy and cold storage comsmr., Can., 1906; hon. LL.D. (Queen's Univ.), 1924.

RUGGLES, NEPEAN CLARKE, K.C., LL.B.—Barrister of sup. ct., Nova Scotia; Bachelor of Laws at Dalhousie Coll., Halifax, Canada, with honrs. 1891; called to the bar, Nova Scotia, with highest honours, 1891; K.C., Nova Scotia, Jan., 1911, served with the Canadian forces during S. African War; now on the reserve of officers. Canadian militia; public prosecutor at Barberton, Transvaal, 1902; ast. res. mag., 1903 to 1907; mag., dist. R.A., Dominica, Oct., 1909 to Dec., 1910; ag. mag., Roseau and regar., sup. ot. in addition on various occasions; took census of Dominica, 1911; mem., leg. coun., Dominica; mag., Grenada, 1915 to 1920; chmn., several comms. while in Grenada; atty.-gen., St. Vincent, Aug., 1920 to Apr., 1921; ag. ch. just. for short period; 1st cls. stip. mag., B. Guiana, Apr., 1921.

RUNDLE, GEN. SIR HENRY MACLEOD LESLIE, R.A.—B. 1856; G.C.B. (1911); G.C.M.G. (1914); G.C.V.O. (1911); K.C.B., 1898; K.C.M.G., 1901; D.S.O., 1897; ed. Roy. Mil. Acad., Woolwich; entd. R.A., 1876; maj.-gen., 1896; served in Zulu war, 1879; Boer war, 1881; Egyptian war, 1882; Nile expdn., 1884-5; Soudan Frontier field force, 1885-7; Soudan Frontier, 1889; Dongola expdn. force, 1896; adjt.-gen., Egyptian army; Khartoum expdn., 1898; comdg. S.E. Dist., 1898-9; dep. adjt.-gen. to the forces, 1899-1900; in comd. of div., Aldershot, 1900; lieut.-gen. on staff in comd. of 8th Div., S. African field force, 1900-1902; lieut.-gen. of Nthn. Comd., 1905-7; col. comdt., R.A., 1907; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Malta, 1909-1915.

RUSHER, JAMES.—B. 1876; entered C.O., Oct., 1893; apptd., after exam., library attendant, 1st July, 1896; promoted, after exam., under order-in-council of 1910, clk. of the 2nd div., 18th Feb., 1911; ast. sec. to colonial blue-books comtee., 1917-1918; seconded for serv. at oversea settlement office, Apr., 1920.

RUSHTON, CHARLES BERKELEY.—Ck., comsmr. of rlys. dept., W. Aust., Apr., 1896; ch. clk., July, 1896; ag. sec. to comsmr. of rlys., 23rd Aug., 1901; sec. to ditto, 18th Dec., 1901; sec. W. Australian London Agency, 3rd Nov., 1919.

RUSHTON, HERBERT HARVEY.—B.1876; acct., electric light dept., Gibraltar, 1897; ast. sec. and ast. acct., munic. authority, 1902; ch. acct. and ast. sec., 1903; sec. and finan. offr., 1908 (also man., pub. electricity and water supplies, mem., comtee. on exchange and currency); ast. ch. acct., Uganda Rly., E. Africa Prot., 1915; lieut., E.A. Forces, 1915; capt., 1916; ag. dep. ch. acct., Uganda Rly., 1916 to June, 1919; ag. ch. acct. to Dec., 1919 (also govt. rep., Nairobi munic. coun., 1918, mem., gen. manager's advisory comtee., 1919); dep. treas., Kenya Colony, 1920 and 1921; ag. treas., Aug., 1920 to Apr., 1921; mem., exec. and leg. couns. (also chmn., currency and other comtees.); col. treas., Fiji, 1922 (with charge of group of depts., cust., port and marine, transport, posts, telegraphs and telephones, govt. stores, and re-
turned soldiers' dairy sttlmt.); mem., exec. and leg. couns.; comsnr. of currency, mem., educon., mining and other bds.

RUSSELL, MAJOR-GEN. SIR ANDREW HAMILTON.—K.C.B. (1918); K.C.M.G. (1915).—B. 1868; held comsnr. as lieut. for 5 yrs. in Imperial Army; vol. offr., New Zealand, 1900; hon. A.D.C. to H.E. the Gov. of N.Z., 1911; brig.-gen., 1914; temp. major-gen., 1915; major-gen. in command of N.Z. Div., 1916; foreign decora. Order of Danilo (Montenegro), 1917.

RUSSELL, HON. BENJAMIN, K.C., M.A., D.C.L.—Ed. at Halifax gram. schl. and Mount Allison Univ.; called to the bar, 1872; for some years law adviser to legis. coun., Nova Scotia; elec. to H. of C., Canada, 1896; judge of supreme ct., Nova Scotia, 1904.

RUSSELL, THOMAS BROWNLEE.—B. 1873; ed. Pembroke Coll., Oxford, M.A.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1897; office asst. to govt. agt., E. Prov., Mar., 1899; pol. mag., Balapitiya, Nov., 1899; dist. judge, Tangalla, Aug., 1900; office asst. to govt. agt., N.C. Prov., Nov., 1901; Uva Prov., Nov., 1902; dist. judge, Batticaloa, July, 1903; office asst. to govt. agent, N. Prov., Nov., 1903; pol. mag., Jaffra, Jan., 1904; ag. dist. judge, Jaffra, Mar., 1904; pol. mag., Kandy, July, 1905; dist. judge, Kalutara, Dec., 1910; ag. dist. judge, Kurunegala, June, 1915; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Aug., 1915; acted on two occasions in 1915 and 1916 as addtl. agt. gov., E. Prov. in addition to his own duties; comsnr. of requests, Colombo, Mar., 1918; dist. judge, Galle, Nov., 1920; govt. agt., S. Prov., Feb., 1924.

RUSSELLI, WILLIAM ALISON.—B. 1875; ed. Rugby and Trin. Coll. Camb.; B.A., LL.B., honours, 1897; barrister-at-law, Inner Temp., 1900; equity bar, 1900-6; apptd. Crown advoc., pub. proscr., admstr.-gen., prin. regar. of docmts. regar. of companies, Uganda Prot., May, 1906; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., Jan., 1909; ag. chief sec. to govt., Aug., 1909, to Mar., 1910; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., Mar. to May, 1910; ag. chief sec. to govt., June, 1910 to May, 1911; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., June, 1911 to June, 1912; King's advoc., Cyprus, July, 1912; mem. of exec. and legis. couns., 1912; joint comsnr. under Reprint of Statutes Law, 1913; edition pubd., Feb., 1914; ch. just., Tanganyika Territory, 1924.

RUSSELL, WILLIAM EAST.—Joined Fiji police, 27th April, 1891; inspr. of imigrts., 1897; J.P., 1901; ag. comsnr., Colo N. and E., and stip. mag., Ra., 1902; ag. stip. mag., Ba., 1904; ag. stip. mag., Lautoka, 1905; ag. comsnr., Colo N. and E., July, 1905, to Jan., 1907; ag. comsnr. and stip. mag., Colo N. and E., 1908; comsnr. and stip. mag., Colo E., June, 1910; Colo N., Nov., 1910; 1st grade dist. comsnr., Apr., 1915.

RUTHERFORD, GEORGE JAMES, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Lond.—Ed. at Epsom Coll. and Middlesex Hosp.; asst. col. surg., G. Coast, 1897; on spec. serv. in Lagos during the Sarki expdn., 1897-98; sen. med. offr., G. Coast, 1907; sen. med. officer, S. Nigeria, 1907; prov. med. offr., Ashanti, 1910; asst. priv. civ. med. offr. and inspr. gen. of hospitals, Ceylon, 1911; Ceylon deleg. at "All India" sanitary confce., 1911-12; ag. priv. civ. med. offr., Ceylon, Oct. to Dec., 1912, Feb. to Dec., 1913, and from June to Aug., 1915; priv. civ. med. offr. and inspr. gen. of hosps., Aug., 1915; M.L.C.; sec. coll. advisory med. and sanry. comte. at C.O., 1924.

RUTHERFORD, CAPT. PETER WILLIAM, M.C. (1916), F.R.G.S.—B. 1894; ed. Brighton Coll.; 2nd lieut., W. Yorks Regt., 1914; lieut., 1915; seconded, Flying Corps, 1916; capt., 1917; ret. from army, 1919; asst. dist. comsnr., G. Co., 20th Sept., 1921.

RUXTON, CAPT. F. H., C.M.G. (1925); Gazetted Worcestershire Regt., 1895; seconded Royal Niger Constab., 1898-1899; served in Africa, 1900; prov. adminstr., N. Nigeria, 1901; lat. cls. res., Ist Oct., 1906.

RYAN, HUGH KAYE, M.A., LL.M., (Cantab).—Barrister-at-Law, Inner Temple; mem., Western Circuit; special pleader; author of several legal works; mag., B.K. Africa; joined Inns of Court O.T.C., 1914; served as adjutant; selected by mily. authorities for special work, 1917; seconded for serv., Royal Eng., 1918; joined directorate, L.W. and D. Office; ment. in desps. and awarded dist. (mily. divn.); asst. atty.-gen. Jamaica, 1919; atty.-gen., 1922; P.B.C., Cyprus, 1923.

RYCROFT, MAJ.-GEN. SIR WILLIAM ETTE, K.C.B. (1919), K.C.M.G. (1918), C.M.G. (1918), C.B. (1910).—B. 1861; ed. Etton and Sandringham; joined 71st H.L.I., 1879; served in Nile campaign (including desert march to Metemeh); awarded medal and clasp and bronze star; Etruscan Army, 1886-87; action of Serres (despatches, Medjideh); promoted into 7th Dragoons (Guzelyurt), 1888; staff coll., 1891-92; D.A.A.G., 1895-96; promoted into 11th Hussars, 1896; commanded 11th Hussars, 1904-8; staff, 1908-11; A.Q.M.G., Southern Command, 1911; service, N.W. Frontier of India, 1897-98; medal and clasp; D.A.A.G., Cairo, 1898-99; served in S. Africa on staff, 1899-1900 (despatches, 2 clasps); Somaliland, 1902-3 (despatches, medal and clasp); European War, 1914-18 (despatches); prom. maj.-gen., Knight of Grace, St. John of Jerusalem, Legion of Honour, Croix de Guerre, Order of White Eagle of Serbia, Redeemer of Greece, Star of Roumanie, Order of Merit (2nd cls.), retld. pay, 1920; N. Borneo, 1922.

SADLER, C.—Asst. gen. manager, p.r., Trinidad, 1st Dec., 1914.

SAINTSBURY, JOHN SEYMOUR.—Q.C.; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1906; 1st cls. in Procedure and Criminal Law, bar exam., 1906; certif. of honour from council of legal exam., Bar Final, 1906, and a prize of £50, from passed civ. ser. test exam., Barbados, 1882; numerical, col. sec.'s offr., 1883; in P.O., 7th clk., P.O., June, 1886; 4th clk., June, 1889; offr. of cust., Dec., 1890; prov. revr., Oct., 1905; ag. pol. mag., dist. July to Nov., 1906; ag. pol. mag., dist. June to Nov., 1911, and from Apr., 1912 to June, 1913; ag. judge, Bridgetown petty debt ct., June to 31st Oct., 1913; pol. mag. and petty distr. ct., dist. F., Sept., 1915; pol. distr. "E." 1919.

ST. JOHNSTON, LIEUT.-COL. THOMAS NALD, C.M.G. (1923) Barrister-at-law (Inner Temple); M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Lond., ed. Queen Elizabeth Coll., Guernsey and Chester Coll.; various appts. in home civ.; entered Fiji civ. ser., 1907; comsnr. Lau Is., 1909; seconded for European war; D.A.A.G., B.E.F., France; subsequently attached to (brevet) lieut.-col. and recd. thanks of S. C. col. sec., Falkland Is., Dec., 1918; ag. sec., Falkland Is., from Sept. 1919 to Apr., 1920; sec., Leeward Islds., Dec., 1919; assumed duty June, 1920; ag. gov., Leeward Is., 1920, ret. 1921 and in 1923; admstr. govt. of Anno
any occasions; author of "The Lau Islands, Fiji," "The Children of the Sun," "The Falkland Islands," "The Islanders of the Pacific," "South Sea Reminiscences," &c.

SALISBURY, THOMAS RONALD FPOULKES.—1882; served in Fiji, and under the condominium govt., New Hebrides; govt. agt., New Hebrides, 18th Mar., 1922.

SALMON, T. G. A.—Asst. dist. commr., A.P., Dec., 1913.

SAMBIDGE, GERALD CHURCHILL.—B. 1886; I. King Edward's Sch., Birmingham; served Nigeria Regt., 27th Mar., 1915; instr. in arts and afts., N. Provs., Nigeria, 1st Dec., 1920.

SAMPSON, HON. VICTOR, K.C.—Served for 10 years in Cape civil serv.; passed B.A. and LL.B. exams., and obtained first Chancellor's medal, ape Univ.; called to the bar, 1881; holder of special retainer to De Beers, 1898; and later, rector; returned to Cape parlmt., 1898; attorney-gen., 1904; ag. puisne judge, Eastern Dist., 1911-12; puisne judge, Eastern Dist., 13th July, 1915.

SAMUEL, Rt. Hon. Sir Herbert Louis, P.C., M.B.E. (1920), M.A.—B. 1870; ed. University Coll. Schi. and Balliol Coll., Oxford; P., Cleveland Divn., N. Riding, Yorks., 1902; parly. under sec., home dept., 1905-9; chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster (with a seat in cabinet), 1904-10 and 1915-16; P.M.G., 1910-15; pres. of the L.G.B., 1914-15; sec. state for home affairs, 1916; chmn. of the select comttee of house of commons on national expenditure, 1917-18; British sp. commr. to Belgium, 1919; high commr., Palestine, 1920.

SAMUEL, SILVERIO I., M.B.E. (1924).—Ed. at Gregory's Rom. Cath. gram. schl., Lagos; esqr. and copyt., educ. off., Oct., 1897; clk. to spr. of schls., Mar., 1899; sec. to commr. for hibtn. of schl. wks., 1902 and 1903; clk. and interpreter to trav. commr., Ilesha, interior dept., 1904; 3rd cl. clk., govt.'s off., Aug., 1904; nf. elk. to the gov. of Nigeria.

SANDESON, G. M.—M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., d. offr., Nyasaland, 1910; temp. major, Basafield Field Force, Aug., 1914; sanitation r., Nov., 1921.

SANDESON, JAMES.—Clk. to ch. just., Barbados, 1867; elk. to gen. bd. of health, Barbados, 1871, also elk. to quarantine bd. in 1880; solr., v., and proctor, Barbados, in 1873; was deleg. Barbados to quarantine confee. at Demerara in 1888; govt. dir. on bd. of Barbados rly. co. in 1891; manr. of probates, 1904; J.E., 1904.

SANDFORD, GEORGE RITCHIE, O.B.E. (1924). Asst. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Feb., 1915; v. sec. to gov., 1918; junr. asst. sec. and elk. of ins., Sept., 1922; ag. senr. asst. sec., Mar. to pt., 1923.

SANDS, SIR JAMES PATRICK, K.T. BACH. (1917). B. 1859; mem. H. of A., Bahamas, 1899-1916; leader for the govt., 1909-1916; M.E.C., co. 1901; pres. of leg. coun., 1916.

SANDS, WILLIAM H.—B. 1869 pub. schl. cher., Bahamas, 1889; Out Island commr. (h div.) and teacher, 1917.

SANDYS, MELVILL KEVERNE TRELLAWNY, M.A. (con.).—B. 1890; on milv. serv., Aug., 1914; elt., Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1919; attd., Ratmalna Kach., Nov., 1919; office asst. to govt. agt., W. Prov., Mar., 1922; ag. agt., govt. attam., Oct., to Dec., 1922; ag. asst. govt., Mullaitivu, July, 1923.

SANGER-DAVIES, ARTHUR ELPHINSTONE.—B. 1885; ed. Dover Coll., Coopers Hill and Oxford (Diploma of Forestry, 1907); asst. conservator, forests, grade II., F.M.S. forest dept., 1907; grade I., 1912; dep. conservator, forests, 1919.

SANSON, CHARLES HENRY.—B. 1886; ed. Plymouth and Monmouth Coll.; Barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1923; pol. probationer, 1905; ag. asst. commr. of pol., 1908; ag. regis. of criminals, Selangor, 1909; regis. of criminals, F.M.S. and S.S., 1910; asst. commr. of pol., Ipoh, 1911; adjt., F.M.S. pol., 1913-20; commr. of pol., Johore, 1921-24; ag. commr. of pol., F.M.S., 1924.

SARAVANAMUTTU, P.—B. 1894; B.A., Lond.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., local divn., Aug., 1919; attached to Colombo, Kach., Aug., 1919; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Kalutara, Feb., 1920; attd. to Matale Kach., June, 1920; addnl. dist. judge, Badulla, Mar., 1921; pol. mag., Dandagamuwa, Sept., 1921; ditto, Kurunegala, June, 1922; addnl. asst. govt. agt., Colombo, Mar., 1923.

SARGENT, CAPT. R. G., A.I.N.A., F.R.G.S.—Port offr., Kenya, Jan., 1917.

SARGENT, JOHN DENYS, B.A. (Oxon.), Dipl., Forestry, Oxford.—B. 1885; asst. conserv., forests, Ceylon, Dec., 1909; dep. conserv., grade II, Apr., 1917; grade I, May, 1919; conserv., Sept., 1921.

SARWAR, HAFIZ GHULAM.—Cadet, S. S., Sept., 1897; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, Jan. to June, 1900; and from Sept., 1900, to Nov., 1901; passed final exam., Chinese, July, 1900; 3rd mag., Sing., 29th Apr., 1902; ag. sheriff, deputy-regis., and asst. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902; dep. regis., sup. ct., Penang, Dec., 1906; asst. regis., sup. ct., Malacca, May, 1907; dep. regis., sup. ct., Penang, Apr., 1908; ag. regis., July, 1909; ag. dist. judge, May, 1915; ag. censor, Dec., 1915 to Jan., 1916; ag. offl. assignee, Penang, in addition, May, 1916; regis. and sheriff, sup. ct., Penang also asst. regis. of cos., Penang, Jan., 1917; offr., cl. II., Jan., 1919.

SAUNDERS, CHARLES JAMES, B.A.—B. 1868; ed. Merchant Taylors and St. John's Coll., Oxon.; cadet, S. S., 1891; passed final exam. in Chin., Feb., 1895; ag. 2nd asst. prot. of Chin., Feb., 1895; ag. 3rd mag., Sing., May, 1895; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Dec., 1896; ag. dist. offr., Penang, Mar., 1897; dist. offr., Malacca, May, 1897; ag. asst. prot. of Chin., Sing., Aug., 1897; ag. asst. prot. of Chin., and sup. of Ind. imigrn., Penang and munic. commr. for Penang, 1898; ag. asst. prot. of Chin., Sing., Aug., 1898, to Feb., 1899; also ag. 3rd mag., Sing., Sept., 1899; 2nd asst. prot. of Chin., Penang, Aug., 1898; ag. 2nd mag., Sing., May, 1900; ag. offl. assignee, S. S., Sept. to Dec., 1900, Jan., 1901, to Feb., 1906, and Feb., 1906; sheriff, dep. regis., supreme court, and asst. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902; munic. commr. for Penang, Oct., 1900, and Sept., 1903; also ag. prot. of Chin., Sing., Apr., 1904; also asst. sup. of Indian imigrn.; asst. prot. of Chin., Penang, May, 1904; ag. sec. for Chin. affairs, S. S. and F. M. S., Apr., 1907; ag. commr., ct. of requesta, Singapore, Jan., 1908; ag. dist. judge, Apr., 1908; sec. for Chinese affairs, S. S. and F. M. S., Feb., 1910; ag. offl. assignee, Mar., 1914; regis. of cos. and offl. assignee, Jan., 1915; pres., rent assessment bd., Sept., 1917.

SAUNDERS, SIR CHARLES JAMES RENAULT, K.C.M.G., 1906, C.M.G., 1896.—B. 1857; held various appts. in Natal civ. ser., 1876-87, when he ratified treaty with Queen of Amatongaland
SAUNDERS, JOHN C.—B. 1862; ed. pub. schls., and High Schl., Halifax, N.S.; Acadia Univ., Wolfville, N.S.; edit. pub. serv., 23rd Mar., 1882; transferred to finance dept., Ottawa, 1st July, 1887; asst. dep. min. of finance, 1st Jan., 1917; dep. min. of finance, 1st Apr., 1920.

SAUNDERS, REGINALD G.—Ed. at Tunbridge and Cheltenham Colls.; ag. 3rd asst. P.M.G., Ceylon, 13th Jan., 1898; ag. asst. collr. of cust., Trincomalee, Sept., 1898; office asst. to govt. agt., N. SETH, G. G., B.A., Barrister-at-Law (Certif. of Hon., 1910), K.C.—Calcutta; cadet, S.
