SMITH, RALPH SYDNEY.—B. 1875; entd. Navy, acctnt. branch, 15th July, 1892; asst. paymaster, 27th June, 1896; paymaster, 18th Jan., 1906; staff paymaster, 18th Jan., 1909; served in H.M.S. "Thetis" during Cretan troubles, 1898-99, and in blockading squadron at Delagoa Bay during S. African War, 1899-1900 (medal and gratuity); retired from Navy, 8th May, 1910; asst. res., N. Nigeria, 1st June, 1907.

SMITH, REGINALD MONTAGU BOSWORTH.—Sub-inspr., Basutoland mtd. pol., 1896; inspr., 1906; asst. comsrr., 1909; govt. sec., 1920; agt. dep. res. comsrr. for various periods in 1921, 1923 and 1924.

SMITH, SIDNEY W.—B. 1902; apptd., after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Oct., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

SMITH, STEPHEN HENRY, F. R. Aus., H.S.—B. 1865; ed. Grafton Superior Pub. Sch.; inspr. continuation schla., N.S. Wales, 13th June, 1912 to 29th Feb., 1920; asst. undersec., educn. dept., N.S.W., June, 1920; dir., educn., N.S.W., 1923.

SMITH, SIR WILLIAM FREDERICK HAYNES, K.C.M.G. (1890), C.M.G. (1887).—B. 1839; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., June, 1863; solr.-gen., Br. Guiana, Oct., 1865; atty.-gen., Oct., 1874; admstd. the govt., Apr. to Sept., 1884, and in 1887; gov., Leeward Is., Nov., 1888; gov., Bahamas, 1896; high oomntr., Cyprus, 1898-1904.

SMITH, WILLIAM HUMPHREY.—B. 1879; ed. Uppingham and Jesus Coll., Camb., Rustatschol., 1897; Abbott univ. schol., 1899; B.A., 1st cls., class. tripes, pt. I, 1901; 2nd cls. pt. II, history, 1902; clk., col. audit branch, exchequer and audit dept., 1st Dec., 1903; asst. audr., Nyassaland, 1st Oct., 1904; audr., N. Nigeria, 1st Feb., 1910; examr., exchequer and audit dept., 17th Aug., 1910; audr., Seychelles, 23rd Mar., 1911; 1st divn. clk. (2nd cls.), col. audit dept., 1st Oct., 1912; on mil. serv., 5th Aug., 1914; capt., K.O.Y.L.I., 29th Jan., 1915; wounded, 8th Mar., 1917; relinquished comsrr. owing to wounds, and returned to col. audit dept., 29th Sept., 1918; audr., Uganda, 29th Dec., 1923.

SMITH, WILLIAM RAMSAY.—D.Sc., M.D., M.S., Edin.; chmn. cent. bd. of health, coroner, vaccination offr. and inspr. of anatomy, S. Australia, 1899-1903; chrmn., cent. bd. of health, and coroner, 1903; author of several medical and scientific works.

SMITH-DORRIEN, GEN. SIR HORACE LOCKWOOD, G.C.B. (1913), G.C.M.G. (1915), D.S.O. (1886); grand off., legion of honour; A.D.C. gen. to the King, 1910-14.—B. 1858; served in Zulu war, 1879; Egyptian war, 1882; Soudan campaign, 1885; Soudan field force, 1885-6, 4th cls. Medjidie; 4th cls. Osmanisch, Chitral exped., 1895; N.W. Frontier, India, 1897-98; Tirah exped. force; Nile exped., 1898; S. African war, 1900-01; European war, 1914-15; adjt.-gen. in India, 1901-3; commdg. Quetta div. of army in India, 1903-7; commdg.-in-chief, Aldershot, 1907-12; commdg.-in-chief southern commd., 1912-14; commdg. 2nd army corps and 2nd British exped. force in France, 1914-15; commdg. E. African exped. force, 1915; gov., Gibraltar, 9th July, 1918; assumed govt., 7th Sept., 1918, ret., 1923.

SMITH-REWSSE, GROFFREY WHISTLER BRINGHAM.—B. 1878; ed. at Tonbridge Schl. and R. Mily. Coll., Sandhurst; R. Warwickshire Regt., 1898; 28th Madras Infy., 1900; Punjab Infy., Punjab Field Force, 1901; Can War, 1900; med., Fiji civ. serv., 1908; cn mag., Ellioe Is., Dec., 1908; dist. offr., Gilb and Ellioe Is., July, 1912; dist. comsrr. W. Pacific (Ellioe Is.), Jan., 1914; dist. of Tarawa, May, 1915; dep. comsrr. for W. P. Gilbert Is.), May, 1915 and Sept., 1922; agt. and consul., Tonga, Sept., 1916; ag. admin. Nauru, Nov., 1917 to June, 1921; 1st dist. of Gilbert and Ellioe Is. Col., July, 1929; reg. of marriages, Nov., 1922; ag. res. comsrr., New Hebrides, June, 1924; dep. comsrr., W. Pacific, (New Hebrides), June, 1924; comsrr., New Hebrides, July, 1924.

SMUTS, GEN. THE RIGHT HON. J. C. H. (1917), C.H., K.C.—B. 1870; ed. at Vrej Coll., Stellenbosch; B.A., Cape Univ.; Ebben scholar at Christ's Coll., Camb.; first in law tripos, 1894; barrister, Cape state-attorney, S. African Republic, 1898; with Boer forces during S. African war, and in comd. of Boer forces in Cape Col. during latter part of the campaign; mem. of comttee. of Het Volk; col. sec., Transvaal; mem. of Imp. Conf. on Naval and Air Defence, 1909; min. of finance and def. Union of S. Africa, 1912; min. of defense; in command of troops in E. Africa, 1916; of British war cabinet; represented S. Africa peace confere. at Paris, 1919; prime min. of min. of native affrs., Union of S. Africa, 1923; M.L.A. for Standerton, 1924.

SMYLY, SIR PHILIP CRAMPTON, K.T. (1906).—B. 1866; ed. at Trin. Coll., Dub.; LL.B.; called to the bar, King's Inns, Dub.; LL.D., 1891; called to the bar, Gray's Inn; Queen's advoc., S. Leone, 1898; atty.-gen., ch. just., S. Leone, 1901; ch. just., Gold Coast.

SMYTH, HERBERT WARINGTON, C.B. (1919).—B. 1867; ed. at Westmstr. and Inn Coll., Camb., M.A., L.L.M., F.G.S., F.R.S., M.I.M.M., barr-at-law; advoc. of min. Transvaal; unpaid asst. to mineral office of woods, 1891; sec., dept. of Siam, 1891; director-gen. of mines geological survey, Siam, 1896; sec., base Legation, 1897 (order of White Elephant 3rd cls.); Murchison award of R.G.S. in travels in Siam, 1898; sec. to mine exec. Transvaal, 1901; M.L.C., Transvaal, 1906; exec. coun. while ag. comsrr. of mines, 1906; for mines, 1907; ag. sec. for mines, Union of Africa, and comsrr. of mines, Natal, 1910; inspr. of factories, 1918; author of "Five Years in Siam," "Mast and Sail in Europe and papers on Indo-China, etc., etc.

SMYTH, JAMES LLOYD.—B. 1871; ser. R.I.C. from 1889 to 1897; transf. from sec. dept., Belfast, to Jamaica constab., Sept., 1897; ag. supt., M. and S. co. gral. Sept., 1897; Feb., 1901; asst. supt. of pol., Br. Hond., 1906; J.P. for colony; ag. supt. of pol., Sept., 26th Oct., 1906; via. just. to Coms. and dist. priz., Dec., 1906; ag. sup. of m. 4th Apr., 1907, to 3rd Mar., 1908; via. Belize pris., June, 1907; ag. dist. comsrr., Corozal, Dec., 1908, to Feb., 1909.

SNELGAR, HERBERT JOHN.—B. 1890; Christ's Hosp. and Kings Coll., London; dist. of educn., 1906; clk., C.A., 1910; clk. dept., E.A.P., 1912; ag. office supt., 1917-1919; land asst., 1919; sec., land tenure 1920; warden of mines, 1920; reg. of titles, 1922; asst. land offr., 1922.
SOLOMON, MICHAEL CLAUDE.—Copyist, ed. dept., Jamaica, Oct., 1885; 3rd cls. clk., 388; 2nd cls. clk., 1891; 1st cls. clk. and sec. int. bd. of health, 1908; ch. clk., 1920; sec. coman. on reorganisation of med. serv., 1920.

SOLOMON, HON. SIR WILLIAM HENRY, C.M.G. (1913), KT. BACH. (1907), M.A.—1852; ed. at S. African Coll., Cape Town and ambridge Univ.; called to the bar, Inner temple, 1876; raised to the bench, Kimberley, 1887; afterwards transferred to Eastern Districts court in same capacity; puisne judge sup. ct. Transvaal, Mar., 1902; ordinary judge of appeal to div. of sup. ct. of South Africa, May, 1910.

SOMASUNTHARAM, KANDIAR.—B. 1897; attd. Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1921; attd. alutara Kach., Dec., 1921; ditto, Kurunegala ach., Jan., 1922; ditto, Colombo Kach., Dec., 1922; off. astt. to rubber contr., Mar., 1923.

SOMMERVILLE, JAMES, O.B.E.—Ck., affic. dept., Cape, 20th Mar., 1897; ck., c.t. office, Cape, 1st Oct., 1898; ch. clk., admtr.'s fice, Transvaal, 1st Dec., 1900; sec. refugees d dept., 1st Nov., 1901; sec., Transvaal immigrn. lic., 1st Aug., 1903; ch. clk., lands dept., 1st July, 1904; under sec. for lands, Union of Africa, June, 1917; sec. for lands, 1st Apr., 1921.

SORZANO, LEONARDO JOSEPH.—B. 1863; attd. civ. serv., Trinidad, 26th Apr., 1882; b-recvr., sub-collr. of customs and postmr., obago, and harbrmr., 1st Apr., 1913; mag. garden Tobago, Jan., 1919.

SOUTHBOUROUGH, 1ST BARON (creat. 17), RT. HON. SIR FRANCIS JOHN STEPHENS OPWOOD, P.C. (1912), G.C.B. (1916), G.C.M.G. (908), K.C.B. (1901), K.C.M.G. (1906), C.B. (895), C.M.G. (893).—B. 1860; ed. at Louth by hon. W. W. Hopwood; admitted a solr., 1882; st law clk., B. of T., 1886-1888; astt. solr., 1888-92; priv. sec. to pres. of B. of T., 1892; sec. y. dept., 1892-1901; perm. sec., 1901; perm. indec.-sec. of S. for the colonies, 1907-1910; employed on different occasions upon offl. missions U.S.A., Canada, and Newfoundland; Brit. leg. to internat. rly. congress in London, 1895; d in Paris, 1900; hon. sec. to chmn. of select mte. of H. of C. on Jameson raid, 1897; sec. of London traffic coman., 1903; visited Africa as mem. of Transvaal and O.R.C. institutions coman., 1906; mem. of comans. on uals and waterways, 1906; and on ocean sights and shipping “rings,” 1906; accom. H.R.H. the Prince of Wales on his visit Quebec, 1908; mem. of Royal coman. on electoral reform, 1909; regar. of the Order of St. Michael and St. George, 1907-1909; sec. of the order, 1909-1911; accompanied H.R.H. the duke of Connaught on his visit to S. Africa in connection with the opening of the first parlmt. the Union of S. Africa, 1910; vice-chmn. of Development coman., 1910; specially apptd. act as under sec. of state for the colonies during the period of the Imperial Conf., 1911; additional civil lord of the Admiralty, Jan., 12; sec. to the Irish Convention, 1917.

SOUTHORN, WILFRID THOMAS.—B. 1879; Warwick schl. and Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford (A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1903; off. to govt. agt., N. Prov., Oct., 1904; N.C.OV., May, 1905; dist. judge, Tangalla, Apr., 1917; landing survr. customs, Colombo, July, 1909; int. govt. agt., Matale, Nov., 1911; priv. sec. to v., Aug., 1914; dep. collr. of customs and landing survr., Colombo, Sept., 1915; 2nd astt. col. sec., Dec., 1919; prin. astt. col. sec., July, 1920; prin. collr., cust. and food contr., Dec., 1923.

SOUZA, SIMON ISIDORO DE.—B. 1863; ed. at the R. Catholic gram. schl., Lagos; 1st despatch clk. and shorthand writer, col. sec.'s office, Lagos, June, 1895; acted as clk. of the legis. coun., 1900; regar. of correspondence, June, 1900; conf. clk. to gov. and clk. of leg. coun., July, 1901; ag. priv. sec. to gov., and clk. to exec. coun., Feb., 1902; in charge of Ibadan residency, Nov., 1903.

SPEARMAN, BARUGH, M.A., M.B., B.C. (Camb.), D.T.M. and H., certif., London Sch. of Trop. Medicine (with distinction)—B. 1877; med. offr., Uganda Prot., Sept., 1912; capt., Uganda med. serv., Sept., 1916; med. offr. of hith., Zanzibar, Nov., 1920; recd. thanks of ag. gov., Uganda, for services in connection with outbreak of plague at Jinja, Nov., 1914; ment. in desps., 1919; senr. med. offr. of health, Zanzibar, 1st Jan., 1922; ag. P.M.O., 30th June, 1922 to 13th Feb., 1923.

SPEED, SIR EDWIN ARMAY, KT. BACH. (1911).—M.A., LL.B.; B. 1869; ed. at Rugby, and Trin. Coll., Camb.; major scholar and senior exhibtr., Rugby schl.; scholar and prizeman of Trin. Coll., Camb.; 1st cls. class. tripes, 1890; 2nd cls. law tripes, Part I., 1891; called to the bar, Inner Temple, June, 1893; dist. comsr., G. Coast, 1899; atty.-gen., Lagos, 1900; edited a revised edition of Lagos laws, 1901; has acted on numerous occasions as ch. just. and also as col. sec., from Jan., 1906, to Mar., 1906; atty.-gen., S. Nigeria, May, 1906; edited revised edtn. of laws of S. Nigeria, 1907; ch. just., N. Nigeria, 1908; retired.

SPENCE, JOHN, R.A., LL.B. (Syd.)—Ent. pub. wks. dept., N.S. Wales, 1897; admitted to bar, 1909; ch. acct., P.W.D., 1918; senr. inspr., pub. serv. bd., 1919-22; in charge, govt. printing office re-organisation, 1922-23; under sec., treas., and dir. of finance, 1923.

SPENCER, CYRIL EDWARD.—B. 1873; entd. col. ser., Cyprus, 1st Mar., 1891; in secretariat from Apr., 1892, to May, 1893; also clk. to legis. coun., Mar., 1894, to May, 1898; priv. sec. to high comsr. on several occasions, 1898-1900; inspr., mil. pol., 1st May, 1898; ag. dist. comdt., July, 1900, to Jan., 1904; apptd. in comd. of diva. of pol., Jan., 1904; also gov. of pris. and astt. to dist. comsr., and dep. coroner; ag. dist. comsr., Apr. to Dec., 1900; passed in mod. Greek, higher standard, 1904; and in Turkish, lower standard, 1906; transf. to B. East Africa, as astt. dist. comsr., Nov., 1906; ag. sup., inland rev., Apr. to Oct., 1907; ag. dist. comsr., Mombasa, from July, 1907; dist. comsr., E.A.P., Apr., 1912; senr. astt. sec., secretariat, Jan., 1919; clk. of councils, Jan., 1919; ag. astt. chief sec., Jan., 1919; coman. of prisons, Oct., 1923.

SPILLER, JOHN WYATT, M.Inst.C.E.—B. 1878; ed. Wellington Schl. (Som.); served in engnr. dept., G.W.R., 1896 to 1910; joined engnr. dept., Crown Agents, 1910; services lent to Miny. of Munitions, 1916; tech. adviser to dir., Munitions Overseas Transport, 1917; returned to C.A., 1919; dep. ch. engnr., 1919; visited Ceylon, F.M.S. and S. Sultnta., 1920; ch. engnr. (designs), 1922; visited Br. Guiana and Trinidad, 1922.

SPROULE, PERCY JULIAN, B.A., Camb.—B. 1873; barrister-at-law (Mid. Tem.); cadet, S.S., Nov., 1895; ag. dep. regist., sup. ct., Penang, Mar., 1897; passed final in Malay, Mar., 1899; ag. 3rd
mag., Penang, June, 1899; dep. regisr., sup. ct., Penang, Sept., 1899; ag. ast. regisr. sup. ct., Penang, May, 1903; ag. 2nd mag., Sing., Sept., 1904; ag. dep. pub. pros., May, 1906; ag. solr.-gen., Penang, May-Aug., 1906; dep. pub. prosecutor, Sing., Aug., 1906; ag. solr.-gen., Penang, Mar., 1908; ag. regisr., supreme ct., Penang, Dec., 1908; ag. solr.-gen., July, 1909; solr.-gen., Apr., 1911; ag. judel. comsrr., F.M.S., Jan., 1912; solr.-gen., May and Oct., 1912; ag. temp. judge, sup. ct., July-Sept., 1912, and Nov., 1912; puisne judge, Dec., 1913; pres. toddy comsrr., Selangor, Oct., 1916; ag. ch. judel. comsrr., F.M.S., Mar., 1920; ag. ch. just., S. Stilmta., Oct., 1920; ag. seur. puisne judge, Feb.-Apr., 1921; ag. ch. just., S.S., 16th June, 1922; ag. ch. judel. comsrr., F.M.S., June, 1924.

SRESHTA, MAURICE SALVADOR.—B. 1873; B.A., Madras; Barrister-at-law; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1896; off. astt. to govt. agt., E. Prov., Jan., 1898; Sabaragamuwa, Dec., 1898; addl. pol. mag., Tangalla, Sept., 1900; pol. mag., Panadure, Dec., 1900; Avisawella, Dec., 1901; Galle, Sept., 1905; comsrr. of requests, Colombo, Nov., 1907; dist. judge, Jaffna, Jan., 1911; ditto, Negombo, Nov., 1915; ditto, Karunegala, Apr., 1920; ag. dist. judge, Kandy, May, 1921; ag. dist. judge, Colombo, Aug., 1921; dist. judge, Jaffna, Oct., 1921; regisr. gen., Apr., 1922; P.M.G., Feb., 1923.

STACK, WALTER TERENCE.—B.A., Trin. coll., Dublin; B. 1886; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., 29th Oct., 1910; attached to the Galle Kachcheri, 1st Dec., 1910; office astt. to govt. agt., Galle, March, 1912; pol. mag., Chilaw, May, 1913; pol. mag., Gampola, Feb., 1914; ag. pol. mag., Kandy, May, 1915; priv. sec. to gov. and extra astt. col. sec., Sept., 1915; astt. censor, Dec., 1916; censor, May, 1918; dist. judge, Negombo, Apr., 1920; astt. stiltmt. offr., Jan., 1922.

STACK, ALAN EDWARD, O.B.E. (1919).—B. 1878; entrd. navy, 1896; ret. as paymstr. comdr., 1919; served on Mediterranean, N. America and W. Indies, Cape, E. Indies, and Atlantic stations; sec. to rear-admiral commanding 3rd and 4th divs., Home Fleet, Portsmouth, 1910-11; sec., British naval mission to Turkey, Mar., 1912 to Sept., 1914; sec. to vice-admiral and senr. naval offr., Malta, Sept., 1914, to Oct., 1916; British sec. to confoc. of allied admirals, Malta, Mar., 1916; astt. sec. to provisional admstn., German E. Africa, Nov., 1916 to June, 1919; ag. sec., Feb.-June, 1919; astt. ch. sec. Tanganyika Territory, June, 1919; ag. ch. sec., Mar.-Aug., 1920, Feb.-Oct., 1922, Jan.-Dec., 1923 and from Apr., 1924; S. Africa medal; Coronation medal; Medjidie, 3rd cls.; chevalier, Legion of Honour; offr., Order of the Crown of Italy.

STALLWOOD, HERBERT ATHILL, L.R.I.R.A., M.R.San.Inst., F. Inst. of Arbitrators.—B. 1873; ch. draftsman, S. Stilmta., 12th Sept., 1906; architectural astt., 13th May, 1913; ag. astt. engrnr., 11th Aug., 1916; hon. sec., priority of indents comtee., 1st Jan., 1918; ag. exec. engrnr., 11th June, 1919; govt. architect, 22nd Mar., 1920.

STANFORD, COL. THE HON. SIR WALTER ERNEST MORTIMER, K.B.E. (1919), C.B. (1901), C.M.G. (1892), O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1860; mag.'s clk., Cape Col., 1863; mag., 1876; capt. of levies in Gcaleka war, 1877-8 (medal and clasp); mem. native laws and customs comsrr., 1880-2; comdt. in war of 1880-1 (med. and clasp); on special service to Pondoland, 1884; ch. mag. Griqualand E., 1885; negotiated treaty with Pondos, 1886; sec. nat. affairs dept., 1896; comd. fores. E. Griqualand, Boer War, 1899-1902 (dept. medics. and 2 clasps); ditto and ch. mag. Jv., 1904; mem. of S. African native affairs comsrr., Sept., 1903, to Jan. 1905; holds rank of comdt. in Cape colonial forces; ret., May, 1907; M.L. for Tembuland, 1908; mem. of S. Afric National Convention in connection with S. Afric Bill, 1909; mem. of senate, Union of Africa; dir., war recruiting, Union of S. Afric and comsrr. for returned soldiers, 1918-19.

STANLEY, HON. SIR ARTHUR LITTLE K.C.M.G. (1914).—B. 1875; ed. Oxford Un. (B.A.); called to the bar, Inner Temple; M.P. for Eddisbury div. of Cheshire, 1906; gov. of Victoria, 1914-20.

STANLEY, SIR HERBERT JAMES, K.C.M.G. (1924), C.M.G. (1913).—B. 1872; ed. at Eton, Balliol Coll., Oxford (B.A.); priv. sec. to min. resident at Dresden and Coburg, and vice-consul at Dresden, 1897-1901; astt. priv. to first Lord of the Admiralty, 1906-1908; priv. to Lord Pres. of the Coun., 1908-1910; priv. to Viscount Gladstone, gov. gen. of Umt S. Africa, 1910; sec. to gov.-gen., 1913; mem. comsrr., Southern and Northern Rhodesia, Apr., 1915; Imperial sec. and acctnt. uip comsrr. for S. Africa, 1918; first gr. m. commdr.-in-chief, N. Rhodesia, 1st Apr., 1918.

STANLEY, W. B., C.M.G. (1923), K.C.M.G. (1918).—Served with 1st Border w. occupation of Crete 1898; S. Africa, 1900 (medal and 4 clasps); 2nd lieut. India regt., 1900; lieut., 1901; ag. 3rd W. India regt., Gambia expedit., 1901 (medal and clasp); ag. trav. comsrr., Gambia, May and June, 1901; trav. comsrr., Gambia, 1901; A.D.C. and priv. sec. to ag. gov. (temp. Aug. to Oct., 1901; capt., 1902; passed out survey, schl. of mill. engineering, Chatham, resig. comsrr., 1906; capt., 3rd Yorks regt., qualified in native language; dist. comsrr., S. Leone, 1910; ag. col. sec., S. Leone, Nov., 1910 to May, 1919, Oct., 1919 to Jan., 1920; to 19th May, 1922; gov.'s dep. on several occas.

STANTON, AMBROSE THOMAS, M.D., Temp. M.R.C.P., Lond.; M.R.C.S., Eng.; M.C.F.S., Ont., D.T.M. and H., Camb., D.P.H., Lond.—B. 1875; senr. house surg., reg. demonstr., Lond. Schl. of Trop. Med., 1897; astt. at Inst. for Med. Research, F.M.S., bacteriologist, I.M.R., 1908; ag. dir., 1910; on sp. duty in Siam, Indo-China, Netherlands E. Indies, 1915-16; dir., govt. F.M.S., 1920; ag. P.M.O., F.M.S., Dec., 1920; author of "Etiology of Beri-Beri," "Malar Anophelines and their Larvae," "Malarial Oriental Region," "Distribution of Severe Fasciata in Far Eastern Ports," etc., etc.

STAPLEY, FRANK R.—B. 1893; mil. sec., Sept., 1914 to Dec., 1919; temp. clk., C.O., 1920; apptd. cler. offr., 4th July, 1922.

STARK, WALTER JOHN KIRKPATRICK.—B. 1887; ed. at Robert Gordon's Coll., Aberdeen and at Aberdeen Univ. (M.A.), 1908; ed. F.M.S., Nov., 1910; ag. astt. dist. offr., Klang, Mar.-Apr., 1911; ag. astt. dist. offr., Kuala Lumpur-May, 1911; ag. astt. dist. offr., Klang, May-July, 1912; passed cadet, Aug., 1912; ag. astt. as supt. of imgrts., Penang, Sept., 1912; ag. contr. of lab., Dec., 1912; ag. dist. offr., Jv., Mar., 1913; offr., cls. V., Dec., 1913; astt. of lab., Seremban, Apr., 1914; ag. mag. Seremban, in addn., Feb.-Mar., 1915; astt. comsrr. lab., Klang, Sept., 1915; ag. astt. dist.
lang, in addn., Dec., 1915 to Jan., 1916; ag. ep. contr. of lab., Sept., 1917 and June, 1918; ep. contr. of lab., Klang (offr., cls. IV.), Ist an., 1919; emigrn. agt., S.S. and F.M.S., oconada, Sept., 1920; ag. emigrn. agt., S.S. and M.S., Madras, 9th to 24th Oct., 1920; supt., ngrn. depot, Negapatam, 31st Mar., 1922; mag., Joh., 28th July, 1922; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1922; 1st mag., Kuala Lumpur, Mar., 1924.

STARNES, COETLAND.—B. 1864; served in W. rebellion, 1885, as ag. adjutant, 65th (ontreal); Inspn., R.N.W.M. Pol., 1st Mar., 1886; jutjant, 1891-97; supt., 1909; ast. comsmnr., 1st do., 1919.

STATEN, OSCAR WILLIAM—Ast. res. mag., eidelberg, Transvaal, 1902; ag. res. mag. id. res. mag., Barberton, 1902-11; res. mag. eidelberg, 1911-16; inspgr. mag., 1916-21; ch. ib. serv. inspnr., 1921.

STEAD, KINGSLEY WILLANS.—B. 1883; ed. King Edward’s, Birmingham; apptd., after compet. exam., ast. in impl. cust., Cardiff, ar., 1903; Harwich, Oct., 1906; ast. collr. of st., Larnaca, Cyprus, dep. harbrmr. and tide rveyor, Apr., 1908; collr. of cust. and excise, pr., 1910; passed prelim. exam. in modern reek, June, 1910; registr. of trade marks, June, 11; passed lower standard exam. in modern reek, June, 1912; ast. cable censor, Aug., 1914-pr., 1919; cable censor, May-July, 1919; publ. of enemy property, 1st Jan., 1919 to 31st ar., 1920; refugee comsmnr., Larnaca, May, 1919 Apr., 1920; registr. of patents, Aug., 1920; ch. llr. of cust. and excise, 1st Oct., 1921; inspr. of heries, 1921; Medaille de la Reconnaissance ancaise, 3rd cls., 1922; ag. comsmnr., Larnaca r various periods in 1922, 1923 and 1924; gisr. of companies, July, 1922; ch. supt., Port Larnaca, June, 1922; registr. of companies, ily, 1922; registr. of Cyprus ships, Jan., 1923; gisr. of Br. ships, Jan., 1923; dir., cust. and ade, Palestine, 7th July, 1924; ag. registr.-gen., th Aug. to 19th Dec., 1924.

STEAD, ROBERT J. C.—B. 1880; ast. gen. publicity agt., colonization dept., C.P.R.; 1913; n. publicity agt., colonization dept., C.P.R., 17; dir. publicity, dept. of immigr. and coloni. Ottawa, 1919; has written several books.

STEDMAN, HUGH JOHN HARRY.—Ed. at eymouth Coll.; articled to borough engrnr. and rv. of Dorchester, 1895 to 1898; ast. to same, 98 to 1903; on staff of superintending civil grn., H.M. Breakwater, Portland, 1903 to July, 05; ast. engrnr., P.W.D., E. Africa Prot., July, 1906.

STEEL, L. F.—B. 1879; on milly. serv., Sept., 14 to Mar., 1919; temp. clk., O.S.O., Feb., 20, apptd. after compet. exam., cler., offr., S.O., July, 1922.

STEELE, HENRY WILLIAM.—B. 1875; ed. enada Gram. Schl. and Dulwich Coll.; called the bar, Inner Temple, 26th Apr., 1899; mitted Grenada bar, 7th July, 1899; mag. ft. F., Dominica, 15th Jan., 1916; ag. mag. and pnr. gen. dist. E., Dominica, for various periods, 1917-20; ag. crown atty. and mem. of sc. and legis. coun., St. Christopher and Nevis, t. do., Dec., 1918; ag. crown atty. and mem. of exec. and legis. coun., Dominica, Feb.-Mar., 17, and July-Oct., 1920.

STEELE, WALTER MATTHEW.—B. 1868; served treasry., B. Guiana, 1884-1896; gov’t. lands pt., 1896-1904; treasry., S. Nigeria, July, 1904; ov. treasry., May, 1906; ast. treasry., Nigeria, n., 1914.

STEEL-MAITLAND, SIR A. H. D. R., BARBT. (creat. 1917)—B. 1876; ed. Rugby (scholar and exhibitioner); Balliol Coll., Oxford (classical scholar); Eldon scholar, 1899; 1st cls. class. mods., 1897; 1st cls. class. schlr., 1899; 1st cls. final law schls., 1900; sec., junr. treas. and pres., Oxford Univ. Socy.; special comsmnr. to royal comm. on Poor Laws, 1906-7; M.P. (C.) East Birmingham, since 1910; chrmn. of Unionist party organisation, 1911; partly. under-sec. of state for the colonies, 31st May, 1915; ditto, 11th Dec., 1916; additional under-sec., F.O., and additional partly.-sec., B. of T., in charge of the work of the dept. of overseas trade, 1917-1919; min. of lab., 7th Nov., 1924.

STEERE, CHAS. JAS. LKE.—B. 1868; probation clk., col. sec.’s off., W. Aust., Feb., 1885; jun. clk., Aug., 1886; ag. clk., gov’t. off., 1889-1890, clk. of legis. coun. and clk. of parlts., Dec., 1890, to June, 1901; clk. of leg. assmnr., June, 1901.

STEPHEN, GUY NEVILLE.—Ed. Paris, Mar- seilles, London; M.R.C.S., Eng., 1881; licentiate of medicine, France, 1882; ag. house surg., Lincoln co. hosp.; ditto, ast. med. offr., Middlesex co. asylum (Colney Hatch); surg. to the consulate of Norway and Sweden, Marseilles, 1881; surg. to the Br. Consulate and Seamen’s Home, Marseilles, 1882; dist. med. offr., Nicosia, Cyprus, 1883; med. offr., central prison, gen. and ophthalmic hosp.; med. offr. of health, Nicosia; pres. of the municipality, Nicosia, 1889; ag. ch. med. offr., 1886 and 1890; surg. to Smyrna Hosp., 1894.

STEPHENS, FRANCIS TRANT.—Served in S. African war, 1900-02; joined B.S.A. pol., Rhodesia, 1903; comsmnr., 1907; served with Rhodesian column in S.W. Africa and E. Africa, 1914-16; seconded to 1st K.A.R. for service in E. Africa, 1916-20; 4 times ment. in despe.; ch. comsmnr. pol. and ch. inspr. of prisons, Nyassaland Prot., July, 1920.

STEPHENS, JOHN EDWARD ROBERT.—B. 1869; ed. St. Olave’s Schl., York and Royal Univ. of Ireland; called to the bar, Middle Temp., 1894; mag., H.B.M. ct., Zanzibar, 4th Jan., 1912, and mag. of the ct. of H.H. the Sultan of Zanzibar, 2nd Feb., 1912; ag. ast. judge, 30th Aug., 1915 to 20th Apr., 1916; and from 26th Feb. to 5th Aug., 1918; editor-in-ch. of “The Manual of Naval Law and Court-martial procedure” (4th edtn.); ast. editor of 11th edtn. of “Addison on Contracts”; author of works on “Demur- rage,” “Freight,” “Charter parties,” etc.; contributor to the Encyclopaedia of the Laws of England, Journal of Comparative Legislation, etc.

STEPHENSON, SIR ALBERT EDWARD, K.C.M.G. (1921); C.M.G. (1914).—B. 1864; clk. E. and A. dept., Feb., 1884; local auditor, Lagos, Aug., 1888, also ag. local auditor, G. Coast, Dec., 1888, to Aug., 1889; returned to E. and A. dept., and apptd. to col. audit branch, Jan., 1891; clk. in charge of accs., May, 1893; ast. supt., Aug., 1897; apptd. sen. clk. on amalgamation of col. audit branch with E. and A. dept., 1st July, 1906; dir. of col. audit, C.O., 1910; mem. of financial investigation comte., Malta, 1912; major (ret.), 4th V.B. East Surrey Regt.; V.D. (1910).

STEPHENSON, JOHN EVRARD.—B. 1893; ed. at Winchester Coll. and Oxford; passed intermediate exam. in Lawa, London Univ., 1911; scholar, New Coll., Oxford, 1912; 1st cls. class. mods., 1914; called to the bar, 1923; on military service, 28th Aug., 1914, to 28th Feb., 1919; B.A. (war), 1919; tempy. 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 12th Sept.,
1919; apptd. under re-construction scheme, 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 12th Jan., 1920; ast. prin., lat Apr., 1920; ast. priv. sec. to S. of S., 18th June, 1920; ast. prin., 1st Mar., 1923.

STEVENS, HOPR.-Senr. copyist, Treasy, St. Kitts, 1920; ag. sup. rev. offr., 1921; ag. clk. and storekeeper, P.W.D., 1921; clk. and storekeeper, P.W.D., 1922.

STEVENS, WILLIAM OSWALD.—B. 1891; B.A., Oxon.; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1914; attached to Jaffna Kachcheri, Dec., 1914; addtl. pol. mag., Jaffna, in addition to his own duties, May, 1915; attached to Batticaloa Kachcheri, Oct., 1915; ag. office ast. to govt. agt., S., Prov., Nov., 1916; pol. mag., Matala, Aug., 1918; ditto, Avissawella, Jan., 1923; ditto, Kandy, Mar., 1923.

STEVENSON, CECIL YOUNG, M.I.C.E., A.M.I.Mech.E., F.B.Met.Soc.—B. 1886; ed. Queen's Coll., Belfast; lieut., R.E., 1910; ast. engr., P.W.D., E. Africa, Jan., 1913; served with B.E.F., France, Aug., 1914 to Sept., 1916; Indian Ex. Force and Aden Field Force, 1917-19; "Mona Star," ment. in despatches; exec. engr., German E. Africa, July, 1919; ag. dep. D.P.W. from Oct., 1923.

STEVENSON, SIR JAMES, BART., G.C.M.G. (1921).—B. 1873; dir. of area organization, miny. of munitions, 1915-17; vice-chmn., miny. of munitions advisory comtee., 1917; mem., cent. reconstruction comtee., mem., munitions council for ordnance and chmn., coun. comtee. on demobilization and reconstruction, 1918; mem. of army coun., 1919; survr.-gen. of supply, W.O., 1919-21; mem. of air council, 1919-21; vice-chmn. of advisory comtee. on civil aviation; personal commercial adviser to Mr. Churchill, 1921 and to the Duke of Devonshire, 1922.

STEVENSON, SIR MALCOLM, K.C.M.G. (1923), C.M.G. (1920).—B. 1878; ed. Trin. coll., Dublin (M.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1901; off. ast. to govt. agt., Ratnapura, Mar., 1902; Badulla, May, 1904; addl. ast. to govt. agt., N. Prov., and addl. dist. judge, &c., Mannar in connection with the Pearl Fishery, Feb., 1906; ast. govt. agt., Kegalla, Apr., 1906; Mannar, Aug., 1908; ast. land stlitm. offr., Feb., 1910; 2nd ast. col. sec., May, 1911; attached to col. sec.'s office for special duties, Oct., 1911; temporarily employed in C.O., Dec., 1912; priv. sec. to gov., Ceylon, Oct., 1913; ast. govt. agt., Matala, Aug., 1914; prin. ast. col. sec. and clk. to exec. comm., Sept., 1915; ch. sec. to govt., Cyprus, 14th May, 1917; admtd. govt., Nov., 1918 to 24th Aug., 1920; high commr., Cyprus, 25th Aug., 1920.

STEWARD, THOMAS ALFRED FRANK.—B. 1880; ed. privately; served in S. African war with Army Ser. Corps.; ch. clk. in staff office for payment of mil. receipts, O.R.C., 1902-1903; regis. of war claims, Kronstad and Heilbron districts, O.R.C., 1903-1904; clk., Swaziland adminstr., July, 1905; principal clk., Apl., 1910; also regis. and master of the special ct. of Swaziland and sheriff of Swaziland, Apl., 1907; passed Cape Univ. civ. ser. lower law exam., 1906; ast. commr., Umobomo dist., 1921.

STEWARD, AUGUSTUS GEORGE, M.D., F.R.C.S. (Edin.).—Med. supt., Durban hosp., 1922; dir., govt. cottage hosps., Natal, 1922.

STEWARD, HON. CHARLES.—B. 1868; el. by ast. to legis. ass., Alberta, g.e., 1909 and 1913; min. of mun. affrs., 4th May, 1913; re-el. at bye-el., 1913; min. of pub. wks., 28th Nov., 1913; re-el., g.e., 1913 and 1917; el. to H.C., 1921; min. of int., supt.-gen. of Indian affrs., and min. of mines in King adminstr., 29th Dec., 1921.

STEWART, DOUGLAS ROY.—B. 1886; Gordon's coll., Aberdeen; clk., native dept., Fiji, Apl., 1906; cadet, July, 1906; ag. ch. ch. native dept., Jan.-Dec., 1906; 1st ast. clk. in sec.'s office, June, 1909; passed cadet, Dec., 1909; stip. mag. of colony and ag. stip. mag. Nadroga and Colo West, and gov't. commrs.: Colo West, May, 1910; ag. ast. col. sec. on certain occasions, 1910-1915; 1st ast. clk., col. sec., Jan., 1911; ag. clk. to exec. and legis. coun., Jan. 1911 and July, 1913; priv. sec. to adminstr., Jan., 1912; 2nd ast. col. sec., Jan., 1912; mem., bld. examiners, Fijian language, Dec., 1913; ast. nat. commr. and gov't. commr., Rewa Prov., Nov., 1914; ag. ast. col. sec., Aug., 1915; ast. nat. nat. affairs, Jan., 1916; ag. ast. col. sec., July, 1916; 2nd lieut., Fiji defence force, Jan., 1917; hon. A.D.C. to ag. gov., Jan., 1918; 1st lieut., Fiji defence force, Aug., 1918; ag. dist. commr., Rewa, and prov. commr., Kai and Nalassari, 1918; ast. col. sec., 1917; ag. nat. nat. affairs, mem. of leg. coun., health, etc., 1920; ag. col. sec. and mem., nat. and legis. couns., May, 1920 and Apr., 1921; priv. ast. col. sec. and editor, native newspaper "Na Mata," May, 1921; ag. col. sec., 2nd ast., 1922 and 18th Jan., 1924; gov't. dep., Jun., 1924; Sept., 1924.

STEWART, HON. PERCY GERALD.—B. 1876; mem., H. of R., Commonwealth of Australia for Wimmers, Dec., 1919; min. of pub. works, Ryks., C. of A., 1923-24.

STEWART, MAJ.-GEN. SIR ROBERT MACGREGOR, K.C.B. (1902).—B. 1842; served in Hazara campaign, 1868; Afghan war, N.W. Soudan, 1885; A.D.C. to Queen Victoria in 1897; late commdr., R.A., southn. dist., Portmore, gov. of Bermuda, 1904-07.

STEWART, ROBT. PETER.—Exhibtnr., Quesn. Coll., B. Guiana; ed. at St. John's Coll., cam., ag. ast. mast., Queen's Coll., B. Guiana, 1895 and 1893-94; clk., immigr. dept., 1894; seconded to govt. secretariat, 1897-98, and 1900-02; passed govt. exam. in Hindustani, July, 1903; immigr. Dept., Dec., 1906; ag. sen. immigr. agt., 1909 and 1913; senr. immigr. agt., Feb., 1914; mem. bd. of examiners in Hindi, etc., 1914; immigr. agt.-gen., June, 1916.

STEWART, HON. WILLIAM DOWNEY, LL.B. 1878; ed. Otago High Sch., and Otago U., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. parl., 1914; min. of int., affrs., 1921 to 1923; min. of cust., 1921; min. of industries and commerce, 1923; served in France with N.Z. Rifle Brigade.

STEYN, J. R.—B. 1876; prin. C.N.O. at Lastron, O.F.S., 1904-5; vice-prin., 1905-22; prin., 1920-22; inspr. of schls., O.F.S., 1st ast., 1922.

STIEBEL, HERBERT CECIL, O.B.E. (1922).—B. 1876; Boer War, 1899-1902 (King's and Queen's meda.); Transvaal civ. serv., as nat. nat. commr., 1902; prot. of natives, 1907-14; Africa campaign, 1916; polit. dept., Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1916; dist. polit. offr., 1917; grade administrative offr., 1st Apr., 1920.

STIGAND, ALMAR GORDON.—Ed. Reg., 2nd clk. to res. commr. for Bech. Prov., Mafeking, 1898; 1st clk. and regis. to nat. commr., 1899; served in town guard during siege of Mafeking, Oct., 1899 to May, 1900; clk. and clk. to ast. commr., Gaberones, 1902; ast. Bech. Prov., 1903; ag. ast. commr., Jan., Feb., 1904; 4th Dec., 1905 to 28th Feb., 19
d 11th May, 1906 to 29th Aug., 1906; asst. s. mag. for Southern dist., Bechuanaland Prot.; th Jan., 1907; passed Cape civ. ser. lower law am., 1909; res. mag., N'gamiland, 1910; hon. spr., Bech. Prot. pol., 1914; awarded "1914-15" star for services as mily. intell. offr., German W. Africn Campaign; lieut. R.W. Kent Regt., 16; served B.E.F., France; attd., intell. I.E.R., m., Oct., 1917; ment. in despa.; temp. capt., n., 1919; mil. control offr., Italy to Nov., 19; capt., R.W. Kent Regt. R. of O., Mar., 23; awarded Murchison grant by R.G.S., May, 23 for surveys and map of N'gamiland; res. s., Kweneng dist., Jan., 1924.

STIRLING, SIR JOHN LANCOLLOT, K.C.M.G. (1899); KT. BAOF. (1902), O.B.E. (1918), B.A., A.B.—B. 1849; mem. legis. coun., S. Aust., 91; chief sec., 1899; pres., legis. coun., since 01.

STIRLING, JOHN WIGHTMAN.—B. 1885; med. r., Basutoland, 1912.

STOCKDALE, FRANK ARTHUR, M.A. (Cantab.), L.S.—B. 1883; ed. Wisbech and Magdalene ll. Camb.; Holmes exhibn., Mag. Coll., mb., 1901; B.A. (1st cls. Nat. Sc. Trip.) 1904; A.A. 1911; mycologist and lecturer in agric. science, Impl. dept. of agric. for the West dies, May, 1905; on special service to Trinidad connection with diseases of coconuts, 1906; lent. sec. to West Indian agricultural conferen ces, 1907 and 1908; asst. dir., dept. of science d agric., and govt. botanist, B. Guiana, Aug., 08; dep. chmn. of bd. of agric., B. Guiana, 09; mem. of agric. sch. comsn., 1909; mem. of banana comsn., 1910; on special service to Dutch Guiana in connection with banana industry, 1910; sec. of tobacco comtee., 11; comsnr. for Br. Guiana at Int. rubber hibn., London, 1911; dir. of agric., Mauritius, 12; vice-president, bd. of agric., 1913; mem. coun. of govt., 1913; regir., co-operative dist societies, July to Oct., 1913; mem. of bd. directors, Mauritius Institute, 1914; mem. of irrigation comtee., 1914; visited Rodrigues, 1914; dir., co-operative credit societies, dir. of rir., Ceylon, 1916; del. to Imp. Entomological unce., London, 1920; author of several rept. articles relating to trop. agr.; M.L.C.

STOCKS, ARTHUR HUMON.—B. 1889; ed. Bath Gram. Sch., Halifax and Oriel Coll., Oxford; B.A. (Oxon); war service, E. Africa, 17-18; passed progress exam. in Mende; asst. t. comsnr., Sierra Leone, 29th Apr., 1914; priv. ty. to ag. gov., 1916-17; dist. comsnr., 21st g., 1922.

STONE, ROBERT GEORGE.—Asst. paymaster, King's African rifles, E. Africa Prot., 1st June, 6; asst. dist. comsnr., E.A.P., Apr., 1911; t. comsnr., Apr., 1914.

STONE, THOMAS.—Sub-dist. commandant, S. African constab., 1901-8; King's S. African medal with five clasp; King's police medal, 1909; t. comsnr. of police, N. Nigeria, 1st Oct., 8.

TONOR, OSWALD FRANCIS GERARD.—B. 2; ed. Oscott and Stonyhurst; junr. offr., angor civ. ser., 17th Nov., 1890; ag. priv. sec. gov., S. Stlttns., Nov., 1890, to Jan., 1891; various posts in Selangor and Perak; ag. t. offr., Ulu Langat, 6th May, 1896; mag. ala Lumpur, 26th May, 1899; ag. dist. offr., Selangor, 6th July, 1900; ag. treas., Selangor, d Sept., 1901; ag. regir. of titles, 14th Mar., 2; dist. offr., Ulu Langat, 10th Mar., 1904; regir. of titles, 1st Jan., 1907; dist. offr., Batang Padang, 25th Mar., 1909; ag. sec. to res., Selangor, 25th Apr., 1912; sec. to res., Selangor, 1st Jan., 1914; ag. British res., Selangor (in addition), from 8th June, 1919; under sec., F.M.S., 24th July, 1919; ag. comsnr. of trade and cust., F.M.S., 7th Mar., 1921; ag. Br. res., Perak, 25th Apr., 1921; ag. Br. res., Selangor, 3rd Nov., 1921; Br. res., Selangor, 13th Dec., 1921; ag. ch. sec., govt. F.M.S. in addn., 21st Dec., 1921 to 10th Jan., 1922.

STORR-FOX, C., LL.D.—Asst. dist. comsnr., Kenya, May, 1920.

STOUT, THE RT. HON. SIR ROBERT, P.C. (1921), K.C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1844; admitted a barrister of sup. ct., N. Zealand; entered the prov. coun. of Otago, N.Z., 1872; prov. solv., 1873; elected to the gen. assem., 1875; atty.-gen., Mar., 1878, to June, 1879; min. of lands, etc., for imigr., 1878; pres. of Dunedin Freethought Soc.; prime min. and atty.-gen., and min. for educ., 1884-87; fellow and chancellor of N. Z. Univ.; chief justice of N.Z., 1899; mem. of coun. of Victoria Coll.

STRACHAN, JOHN.—B. 1877; ch. engr., lake development scheme, Colombo, Ceylon, Aug., 1911; asst. D.P.W., F.M.S., Dec., 1920; ag. D.P.W., F.M.S., Jan. to Sept., 1921; D.P.W., Ceylon, Aug., 1923.

STRACHEY, CHARLES, C.B. (1920).—B. 1862; apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd cl. jun. clk., F.O., 2nd Apr., 1885; 1st cl. jun. clk., 1st May, 1885; sec. Uganda rly. comtee., 10th Sept., 1986; 1st cl. clk., C.O., 20th Nov., 1889; prin. clk., 1st Jan., 1907; delegate on Anglo-German Boundary Conf. (Yola-Chad), Mar., 1906; ditto, Anglo-French (Niger-Chad), May, 1906; ditto, Anglo-German (Yola to sea), Oct., 1909; mem. W. African lands comtee., 1912; plenipotentiary at Brussels Internat. Liquor Conf., 1912; travelled in Nigeria, 1914; mem., Br. delegation, Paris Peace Confce., Jan. to Sept., 1919; Br. rep. on internat. comtees. for preparation of conventions on (1) African liquor traffic, (2) arms traffic, (3) revision of Berlin and Brussels Acts, signed at St. Germain, 10th Sept., 1919; asst. sec., 1st Apr., 1920; asst. under sec. of state, 12th Dec., 1924.

STRADBROKE, (3RD BARON OF) (cr. 1821).

GEORGE EDWARD JOHN MOWBRAY ROUS, BARON ROUS (cr. 1796), VISCOUNT DUNWICH (cr. 1821), C.B. (1904), C.V.O., A.D.C., D.L., J.P.—B. 1862; ed. Harrow and Cambridge; col., 1st Norfolk Royal Garrison Arty. Volunteers, 1888-90; col., 3rd (howitzer) brig., E. Anglian divn., R.F.A., 1908-17; col., 272nd brig., R.F.A., Jan. to Nov., 1917; gov., Victoria, 4th Oct., 1920.

STRAKER, MAJOR G. H., M.C., B.A. (Oxon).—Asst. dist. comsnr., Kenya, Oct., 1921.

STRANGE, WM. LUMISDEN, M.I.C.E.—B. 1857; served in P.W.D., Bombay, 1879 to 1901; under-sec., P.W.D., Govt. of India, July, 1901; suptg. engr., 2nd cl., Dec., 1906; seconded as dir. of irrigtn. and water supply, Transvaal, 25th Apr., 1903; author of "Indian Storage Reservoirs with Earth Dams"; recd. Telford premium, Inst.C.E., 1897.

STRATFORD, JAMES.—B. 1869; ed. St. Aidan's Coll., Grahamstown, Cape Colony and Exeter Coll., Oxford; M.A., B.C.L., Oxon; mem., Inner Temple; called to the bar, England, 1898; Transvaal, 1902; practised, Johannesburg; K.C., 1912; judge, sup. ct., Transvaal prov. divn., 1st Mar., 1921.

STRATHAIRN, DONALD BEITH.—B. 1884; ed. Edinburgh Univ.; passed law agent's exam.;
asst. dist. comanr., Gold Coast, 1912; dist. comanr., 1918; senr. asst. col. sec., 1921; clk. of couns., 1922; ag. ch. asst. col. sec., for various periods, 1922-24; ag. sec. for native affrs., 1924.

STRATHAIREN, GEORGE CECIL, M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.).—D.P.H.; certif. from London S.T.M.—Med. offr., Orange River Colony Burgher Camps, 1901-03; med. offr., E. Africa and Uganda Prots., 1903; senr. med. offr., Uganda, 1914; war serv. with rank of major, 1914-18; ch. med. offr., Fiji, 1920; mem., leg. couns., Fiji, 1920-22; senr. sanv. med. offr., Jamaica, 1922.

STREET, PHILIP WHISTLER.—Puise judge, N.S. Wales; judge in bankruptcy and probate jurisdictions, Feb., 1907.

STRICKLAND, SIR GERALD, COUNT DELLA CATINA, G.C.M.G. (1913), K.C.M.G. (1897), C.M.G. (1889).—B. 1861; ed. Oscott Coll., Birmingham; lieut. C.U.R.V.; and elected mem. coun. of govt., Malta, 1886; B.A. and LL.B., Trin. Coll., Camb., honours law tripes; attended col. conf., 1887, on behalf of Malta; called to the bar, Inn Temp., and pres. cholera coman., Malta, 1887; thanked by govt. for obtaining from Leo XIII. recognition of Imp. veto of appta. to See of Malta; unoffic. mem., ex. coun., and ag. asst. sec. to govt., 1888; vice-pres., bd. of health, pres., comitee of privileges, ch. sec. to govt., and major, Royal Malta militia, which he established, 1889; re-organized Malta rly., 1891; planned breakwater, 1894; pres., coun. of Malta univ., 1900; chmn., mil. and civ. drainage bd.; mem. comitee on Malta naval reserves; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Leeward Is., 1902; estab. central factories for sugar and cotton in Antigua, 1903; gov., Tasmania, 23rd July, 1904; read scientific papers as pres. of Royal Society, 1904; gov., W. Australia, 6th Apr., 1909; mem. of W. Aust. Inst. of engras.; gov., New South Wales, 25th Nov., 1912; assumed govt., 14th Mar., 1913; ex-officio gov. of Norfolk Is., 1913-14; codified the laws of Norfolk Is., and negotiated the transfer of the dependency to the Commonwealth; hon. col., 86th W. Australia Infantry Regt.; mem. of Inst. of local govt. engras., N.S. Wales; held dormant coman. to administer C. of A. in absence of gov.-gen.; retired, 1917.

STRINGER, HON. THOMAS WALTER.—B. 1855; ed. high schl., Christchurch, New Zealand; barrister and solr.; K.C., 1908; judge of the sup. ct., New Zealand, 1914.

STRONG, ARTHUR NEBBET.—B. 1890; M.A., Edin.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., 13th Dec., 1913; office asst. to govt. agt., Cent. Prov., Jan., 1914; addtl. pol. mag., Kandy, in addition to his own duties, Jan., 1914; ag. office assist. to govt. agt., Sabaragamuwa, Nov., 1914; addtl. pol. mag., Ratnapura, in addition to his own duties, Dec., 1914; addtl. comanr. of requests, Ratnapura, in addition to his own duties, May, 1915; on military duty, 1917; pol. mag., Kurunegala, Nov., 1919; landing survr., Colombo cust., Nov., 1920; dep. food contr. in addn., July, 1921; dist. judge, Nuwara Eliya, Feb., 1924.

STRONGE, HERBERT CECIL.—B. 1875; ed. Falmouth Schl., and Trin Coll., Dublin; prizes classics and English literature; B.A.; called to the bar, King's Inn, Dublin, 1900; joined N.E. circuit, 1901; stip. mag., Bahamas, 1911; ag. atty.-gen., 2nd July to 4th Aug., 1914, 3rd Sept. to 3rd Nov., 1914, and from May to Sept., 1915; also acted as chief just. in Jan., 1915; chief just. Tonga, 1917; ch. just., Leeward Is., 1925.

STUART, ALEX.—B. 1861; ed. St. Andrew's Univ.; regar. of impta. and expts., Singapore, Sept., 1890; tempy. attached to H.M. curn. and trade marks branch of the patent of London, 1897-8; comm. correspondent for S. and F.M.S. to intell. branch of B. of 1903.

STUART, HON. CHARLES ALLAN, B.A., LL.B.—B. 1864; ed. High schl., Strathroy, Ont.; and Toronto Univ.; called to the bar, Ont., 1896; called to the bar, N.W.T., 1898; first prov. legis., Alberta, 1906; judge supreme ct., N.W.T., 1906; judge of supreme ct., Alberta, 1907; chancellor of univ. of Albert, 1908.

STUART, WALTER LESLIE.—3rd assoc. judges, sup. ct., and clk. of arraigns, S. Australia, 1898; called to the bar, S. Australia, 1900; associate and clk. of arraigns, Nov., 1900; assoc. chief clk. of sup. ct., and clk. of arrn. Feb., 1908; also a solr. to lands titles office, master of sup. ct., regar. of probates, regar. admiralty, regar. of companies, trades and industrial and provident societies, and regar. of high ct. of Australia, Jan., 1914; acting in these offices from 1911.

STUBBS, SIR REGINALD EDWARD, K.C.I. (1919), C.M.G. (1914).—B. 1876; ed. Radcliffe Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford (exhibitions); classical mods., 1897; 1st cl. lit. hum., 1898; 1899; M.A. (1920); appld., after compet. exam., 2nd cl. clk., C.O., Jan., 1900; ag. clk. in May, 1907; 1st cls. clk., Dec., 1910; vice-Stiltna, F.M.S. and Hong Kong to inquire question of revision of civ. ser. salaries, mem. of West African lands comitee, 1912; sec., Ceylon, Jan., 1913; offr. administra. govt., Jan. to Oct., 1913; Dec., 1915 to 1916, and Mar. to Sept., 1918; gov., Hongk., 16th June, 1919; assumed govt., 30th June, 1919; joint editor of C.O. List, 1910-1912; "Lucas' Historical Geography of the East Colonies," vol. i., 2nd edition, 1906.

STUCKEY, REGINALD ROBERT.—A.L.A.; actuary, S. Australia, 1914; under treas.

STUPART, SIR ROBERT FREDERIC, K.T. (1914).—B. 1857; ed., priv. schl.; Upper Coll.; ent. Can. meteorological serv., Nov., 1891; for some years was sen. inspr. and protact. offr., Toronto observ.; in charge of ch. at Hudson's Straits, 1884-86; supt. and dir. meteorological serv. of Dom. and of magnetic observ., 28th Dec., 1894; fellow, Royal Soc., Can., pres., Royal Astron. Soc., Can., 1902-03; pres., Royal Can. Inst., 1906-07; mem. intern. meteorological comitee, 1907 and 1919; pres. George's Soc., Toronto, 1919-20.

STURGESS, GEORGE WILLIAM.—R.M.C.V.S.; govt. vet.surgeon, Ceylon, Mar., 1896.

STURMAN, LIEUT.-COL. EDWARD ALICE C.B.E. (1918)—Impl. ser., C.T.O., 1914; 1879; engineering branch, 1886; transf. to telegraph serv., 22nd Feb., 1889; telegraph construction, Apr., 1891; clk., inland mails br., 1st Dec., 1891; foreign mails branch, 1st Oct., 1892; prin. clk., staff branch, 1st July, 1897; attached to agt.-gen.'s office, Mar. to Sept., 1898; prin. clk., telegraph branch, 1st May, 1902; ag. clk., 1st Feb., 1908; ag. astt. sec., Jan. to 1910; ag. astt. under sec., posts and telegr. Union of S. Africa, 1910; 1st astt. under sec., 1st Apr., 1912; dir. of army postal serv., under-sec., 18th Dec., 1919; ag. P.M.G., Aug., 1920; P.M.G., 28th Oct., 1921.

STURROCK, ALFRED JOHN.—B. 1879; Geo. Watson's Coll., Edinburgh, and Edin. Univ., M.A. 1902 (hons. class.); cadet, F.M.
02; ag. 2nd asst. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, 1st July, 1903; passed cadet, 26th Oct., 1904; ag. dist. offr., Batang Padang, 17th Feb., 1906; dist. offr., Temerloh, 9th Nov., 1907; ag. asst. t. offr., Gopeng, 14th Mar., 1910; seconded for vice in Kelantan, 23rd Apr., 1910; judge, high, and ag. supt. of cust., 13th May, 1910; dist. r., Batu Mengkebang, 28th Dec., 1910; dist. r., Ulu Kelantan, 1st Jan., 1913; supernm. g., Ipoh, 5th Mar., 1915; dist. offr., Kuala Kajah, 28th Oct., 1915; supernm. offr., cls. II., Nov. 1919; dist. offr., Ulu Selangor, 1st July, 1921; chmn., sany. bd., Kinta, 6th July, 1922; ag. Fed. examr. in Malay, Apr., 1922; mn. rubber restric. comtee., Perak South in ln., Nov., 1922.

TURBROCK, JOHN CHRISTIAN RAMSAY, M.A. (on).—B. 1875; ed. Charterhouse and Balliol U., Oxford; tutor to H.H. the Kabaka of Ganda, Mar., 1905; dist. comnr., Uganda Prot., Aug., 1914; prov. comnr., June, 1921; ch. sec., June, 1924.

TUTCHBURY, SAMUEL.—B. 1882; supt. of mails, G.P.O., Singapore, Nov., 1909, and served different depts. of the P.O.; ag. senr. supt. mails, Singapore, Feb., 1913; supt. of mails, Penang, Jan., 1915; senr. supt. of mails, y, 1918; ag. supt. money order branch and huge bank, Jan., 1918; supt., grade I., Jan., 9; ag. acnt., G.P.O., May, 1919; supt. money branch and savings bank, Singapore, but td. to act as acnt., Singapore, 1st Jan., 1920; asst. P.M.G., 13th May, 1920; acntt., G.P.O., contd. to act as asst. P.M.G., 12th Sept., 1920; P.M.G., 1st Apr., 1921; ag. asst. P.M.G., h July, 1921; resumed duties as acntt., gapore, 1st Nov., 1921.

UDBURY, EDWIN RONALD, B.A. (Oxon.).—1897; on mily. serv., Jan., 1916; cadet, Ceylon serv., Aug., 1921; attd. to Kunegala Kach., t., 1921; attd. Nawara Eliya Kach., Nov., 1921.

UFFERN, T. H., M.B., B.Ch., B.A.O. (U.I.), Cert. of London, S.T.M.—Apptd. to A.M.S., S. Nigeria, Jan., 1909; served in aerons E.F., Oct., 1914 to Feb., 1915; ment. esp., May, 1916; tempy. capt. (general list), 1914 to July, 1915; senr. med. offr., ganyika Territory, Aug., 1920.

ULLIVAN, CHARLES ERIC EUGENE, B.A. (Lond.).—Asst. dist. comnr., Uganda Prot., 7th May, 1909; temp. capt., intell. dept., E. African ces., 1916; ag. 1st asst. sec., Uganda, Feb., 1; ag. asst. chief sec., July, 1918; ag. regis. of births, marriages and deaths, Sep., 1918.

UMMERS, BREW. LIEUT.-COL. GERALD BY, C.M.G. (1920).—B. 1880; East Africa (nialand), 1914-15; major, Indian Army from ; temp. col., 1919; dep. comnr. and offr. mdg. troope, Somaliland Prot., 1916; gov. commdr-in-chief, Somaliland Prot., 6th Sept., 1916.

JMMERS, WALTER LLOYD.—B. 1870; entd. n lands off., S. Aust., July, 1887; clk., agri. May, 1892; chief clk., July, 1902; ag. sec. to of agri., Feb., 1910; sec. to ditto, July, 1911; sec. to min. of industry and sec. to min. of ne, 1915.

JNNER, WILSON GEORGE HAROLD.—B. 1887; at Chigwell Sch.; Colonial Fellow of Surfs' Inst., 1916; asst. dist. comnr., Gold Coast, Aug., 1914.

JRIDGE, BREWSTER JOSEPH.—B. 1894; ed. Coll., and Downing Coll., Cambridge; served, N. Lancs. regt., 1914-17; asst. sec., ch. secs. office, Cyprus, 16th Mar., 1918; passed exam. in mod. Greek, Nov., 1918; ag. ch. ast. sec., Jan. to Apr., 1919; local comdt., police, Apr., 1919; ag. comnr., Larnaca, June, 1919; ag. A.D.C., July, 1920; ag. ast. sec., Oct., 1920; passed exam. in Turkish, Aug., 1922; ag. comnr., Aug., 1922; ag. ast. sec., Sept., 1922; ag. comnr., Dec., 1922 to Oct., 1923; comnr., Jan., 1924.

SURVEYER, HON. EDUARD FABRE.—B. 1875; ed., Ste. Marie Coll., McGill and Laval Univ.; called to bar, 1896; vice-pres., Jun. Bar Assoc., 1902-03; pres., 1903-04; mem. of coun. of Quebec bar, 1904-06; lectr., law, McGill Univ. since 1905; judge, superior ct., Quebec, 1st Jan., 1920; edr. of practice rept., Queb., since 1898; also of pocket eds. of civ. code and code of civ. procedure (the latter in both languages); pres., Can. Club, Montreal, 1909-10; vice-pres., l'alliance Francaise, Montreal.

SUTCLIFFE, MAJOR A. W., D.S.O., M.C., B.Sc. (Durham).—Asst. dist. comnr., Kenya, May, 1920.

SUTHERLAND, ALEXANDER CHARLES, M.A., M.C.E. (Melbourne Univ.), A.M.I.C.E. (Lond.).—B. 1869; asst. mine survr., govt. mining engr.'s office, Transvaal, 1902; mine survr., Transvaal, 1903; mine survr., Union of S. Africa, 1910.

SUTHERLAND, A. R.—M.A., Aberdeen Univ.; Science mast., Glen Urquhart H.G. schl., 1903-5; ast. mast., Campbelltown gram. schl., 1903-6; ast. mast., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, 1906; lecturer in biology, Hong Kong Coll. of med., 1909-1910; ag. ast. master, pol. schl., 1909 and 1912; headmaster, Victoria British schl., 1913; lieut., R.G.A., on active serv., 1914-19; ast. mast., cls. I., 1st Jan., 1920.

SUTHERLAND, GEORGE.—B. 1877; ast. man., Barbuda, Leeward Is., 1st Oct., 1908; ag. man. from 15th June, 1910.

SWAYNE, COL. SIR ERIC JOHN EAGLES, K.C.M.G. (1910), C.B. (mil.) (1904); grand offr. of order of the Crown of Italy (1905).—B. 1863; ed. at naval coll., Gosport; and abroad; R.M.C., Sandhurst, 1882; entd. Welsh regt., 1883; Bengal staff corps, 1884; adjut., 1888; capt., 1894; local lieut.-col., 1900; brevet lieut.-col., 1901; brevet-col., 1903; temp. brig.-gen., 1903-06; retired from army, 1906; served with Burma expdn., 1885-86 (medal with clasp); intell. offr., Hukong Valley reconnaissance; in command of advanced base exploration, Turong River and Sing Pho country, Nov., 1895, to Moh., 1896 (McGregor medal); exploration to Somaliland, Feb. to July, 1891 (thanked by resolution of Bombay govt., and appreciation by govt. of India); Gildessa affair on Abyssinian frontier, 1892 (commendation by resolution of Bombay govt.); engaged on delimitation of internat. frontier between French and British Somaliland, 1892; served for five years on intell. staff, India, as staff-capt. and D.A.Q.M.G.; apptd. 2nd-in-command, Uganda Rifles, on active serv. in Jubaland, E. Africa (medal with clasp); on active serv. in Uganda, 1899; selected to command Somaliland police force, 1900; raised and organised levies, and commanded expeditionary force in Somaliland, Nov., 1900; defeated and routed Mullah (ment. in desps., medal with clasp, brevet lt.-col., thanked by govt.); organised 6th Batt. Uganda Rifles, second expdn., 1901; again defeated Mullah (C.B., ment. in desps.); apptd. comnr., consul-gen. and comdr.-in-chief, Somaliland Prot., and judge of its high court, Apr., 1902; on special duty in Egypt, 1904; arranged evacua-
tion of Somaliland, and organised control of tribes; British deleg. to conference with Italian deleg. at Lyons in connection with agreement with Italy respecting Somaliland; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, British Honduras, 1906-13; spec. duty to Canada, with reference to Indian labour (thanked by govt. of India) 1908; spec. duty to Mexico, 1909.

SWEET-ESCOTT, Sir E.B., K.C.M.G. (1904), C.M.G. (1895).—B. 1857; ed. Somersetshire Coll., Bath, and at Balliol Coll., Oxon.; exhibitioner, Worcestershire Coll., Oxon., June, 1876; 2nd class classical mods., June, 1878; 3rd class in mod. hist. finals, June, 1880; B.A., July, 1880; M.A., 1881; classical prof. at the Roy. Coll., Mauritius, June, 1881; précis writer, col. sec.'s office, Feb., and 2nd asst. col. sec., Apr., 1886; ag. col. sec., 1889; ag. col. sec., Br. Honduras, Mar., 1893; admstd. the govt. of that col., Apr. to Nov., 1893; col. sec., Br. Honduras, 1894; admstd. govt., Apr. to Nov., 1895; again in 1897; ag. 1st class clk., C.O., Jan., 1898; admstr. of the Seychelles Is., Aug., 1899; assumed govt., 20th Nov., 1899; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Oct. 1903; gov., Br. Honduras, 15th Apr., 1904; gov., Leeward Is., 30th Jan., 1906; recd. coronation medal, 1911; gov., Fiji, and high commr., W. Pacific, 11th March, 1912; assumed govt., 25th July, 1912; ret., 1918; rep. of Fiji at Br. Empire Exhibn., 1924.

SWETTENHAM, Sir Frank Athelstan, G.C.M.G. (1909), K.C.M.G. (1897), C.H. (1917), C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1850; cadet, S. Stirling, July, 1870; passed final exam. in Malay, July, 1872; asst. collr. of land rev. for Penang and Prov. Wellesley, Aug., 1872; collr. of land rev., July, 1873; J.P. and mag. and commr., ct. of requests, Penang, May, 1874; sent on special missions to Perak in Jan., June, and July, 1874; sent to reside with the Sultan of Selangor, Aug., 1874; asst. res., Selangor, Dec., 1874; gazetted to act temporarily as res. of Selangor, 22nd Oct., 1875; took charge of the residency in Perak on the murder of the res., Nov., 1875; dep. commr., Perak, Nov., 1875; mentioned in despatches; asst. col. sec. for native states, Mar., 1876; asst. col. sec., July, 1881; Br. res., Selangor, Sept., 1882; commr. for S. S. and Malay States, Calcutta Exhibn., 1883-84; ag. Br. res., Perak, Mar., 1884, to Jan., 1886; exec. commr. for S. S. and Malay States, Col. and Ind. Exhibn., 1886; Br. res., Perak, 1889; res. gen., Malay States, Jan., 1896; admstd. govt. S. S., Feb., 1901; gov., 1901; ret. 1904; chmn. of royal comm. on Mauritius, 1909.

SWETTENHAM, Sir J. Alexander, K.C.M.G. (1898), C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1846; ed. Clare Coll., Camb.; scholarship, May, 1867; writer, Ceylon service, 1868; ag. pol. mag., Harrispattu, Feb., 1870; pol. mag., Kayta, Sept., 1870, continuing to act at Harrispattu; ag. asst. govt. agt., Galle, Dec., 1871; ag. landing and tide survr., Galle, June, 1872; asst collr. of customs, Jaffna, Oct., 1872, to continue to act at Galle; ag. dist. judge, Matara, Apr., 1873; 2nd asst. col. sec., and clk. of the legis. coun., 1876; rec. gen., Cyprus, 1883; audr. gen., Ceylon, 1891; col. sec., S. S., 1896; admstd. govt., June to Aug., 1895, from Mar. to Dec., 1898, and from Dec., 1899, to Feb., 1901; gov., Br. Guiana, 1901; gov., Jamaica, 14th July, 1904; resp., 1907.

SWETTENHAM, Lieut.-Col. James Parry, M.S.V.R.—B. 1875; ed. Shrewsbury and Bedford Grammar Schls.; Boer War, 49th Imperial Yeomanry (Montgomeryshire) 1899-1900 (Queen's med. with 3 bars); asst. engrnr., Gold Coast (Kumasi) Rly., 1901; asst. engrnr., P.W. Selangor, F.M.S., 1902; exec. engrnr., grade Pahang, F.M.S., 1907; 2nd lieut., M.S.V.R., 1911; capt., M.S.V.R., 1912; hon. A.D.C., S.S., and high commr., F.M.S., 1912; exec. engrnr., grade I, F.M.S., 1914; secy. for mily. serv. in the Great War; asst. to engrnr., 2nd Army Cent. Force; temp. ca. R.E., 1915; O.C., 201st Field Co., R.E.; major, R.E.; invalided from R.E.; "1914-15 Star," War and Victory med. commdt., M.S.V.R.; 1919; state engrnr., Negri Sembilan, 1919; asst. dir. of pub. wks., F.M.S., 1923; ag. D.P.W., F.M.S., 1923.

SWETTENHAM, Roger Francis Ross—1883; ed. privately, Bedford and Aston Rowant sttlm. offr., Negri Sembilan, June, 1906; asst. dist. offr., Coast, Negri Sembilan, 1908; ag. chmn. and sec., san. bd., Seremban, Negri Sembilan, Apr., 1909; ag. sec., Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Apr., 1910; asst. chandu monopoly, Selangor and Negri Sembilan, Nov., 1910; supervisor of cust., Kuala Laut in addn., Apr., 1911; seconded for mil. ser. (R.G.A. Cadet Sch.) Mar., 1918; 2nd R.G.A., Nov., 1918; supt., chandu monopoly, F.M.S., Jan., 1921; sec., standing new comte. on use of opium in Malaya, Jun., 1921; dep. chmn. and sec., ditto, Nov., 1924.

SWINBOURNE, Major Charles Arthur, O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1884; clk., audit dept., X.Y. govt. rly., May, 1900; lieut., Australian Rifles, Sept., 1906; passed with honours in topography and range-finding, Sydney, 1908; elk., prov. qtrmr., with rank of sub-insp., Fiji commr., Oct., 1909; capt., Commonwealth mil. ser., Jan., 1910; comdg. offr., Fiji cadet corp., Feb., 1911; mem. of bd. of survey, Sep., 1911; supervising offr., Fiji rly., Feb., 16th Apr., 1911; qualified rifle course, Sep., May, 1914; qualified (distinguished) marksmanship gun course, Hythe, June, 1914; attached to Loyal North Lancs. Regt., Mar.-Jun., 1915; accompanied Fiji 1st contingent to Eng., comdg. offr., 1st Jan., 1915; J.P., Sep., 1915; comdt. of Fiji Defence Force, rank of major, 30th Sept., 1916; A.D.C., 6th Oct., 1916; mentioned by Army Com. in services in connection with defence of Fiji, active service, July, 1917; temp. ca. Loyal North Lancs. Regt., 30th Aug., 1917; musketry offr., 3rd Batt., L.N.L. Regt., 25th Oct., 1918.

SWINDELL, Rev. Frank Guthrie (Oxon.).—Chap., Selangor, May, 1901; chap., Malacca, June, 1906; ag. col. sec., Singapore, Apr., 1907, to Jan., 1908; chap., Penang, 20th Dec., 1912; col. deacon, Singapore, 1st Nov., 1914; reg. deacon, Singapore, 13th Feb., 1915; archdeacon, Singapore, 2nd Feb., 1916; commissary, diocese of Singapore, 29th Sept., 1918; resigned reg. diocese, 3rd Feb., 1920; dep. reg. 1921.

SYDENHAM OF COMBE, Lord (1st Baron, 1913, U.K.).—Sir George Sydenham C.B., R.E., G.C.M.G. (1905), G.C.S.I. (1911), G.C.M.G. (1907), K.C.M.G. (1893), C.M.G. (1887).—B. entered R.E., 1868; capt., 1880; major served in Egypt, 1882 (medal and star); Suakin expdn., 1885, mentioned in despatch (clasp); sec. col. defence comte., 1885; secy. carriage factory, Woolwich, 1883; Victoria, 1901-1904; apptd. as one of a commission to advise as to the creation of a Board of
ministrative business of the War Office, Nov., 03; sec. to Imperial Defence comte, 1904; v. of Bombay, 1907-1913.

SYDNEY, LORD ARCHBISHOP OF MONTREAL CHARLES WRIGHT, B.A., M.A., D.D.—formerly curate of Kilworth-Beauchamp, 1885-88; Bradford, 1888-1893; lect., 1889-1893; war of Ulsteron, 1893-1896; St. George's, eds., 1896-1904; can. res. of Manchester cathedral, 1904-1909; rector of St. George's, ilme, Manchester, 1904-1909; chaplain to Bp. Manchester, 1904-1909; archdeacon of Man- Chester, 1909; consecrated Lord Archbishop of dney, 24th Aug., 1909; Primate of Australia, 10; author of "Thoughts on Modern Church life and Work."

SYKES, GEORGE ROGERS.—Cadet, S. bims., Nov., 1913; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, July, 14; attache censor's office, Singapore; passed exam. in Chinese, Dec., 1916; ag. ast. prot. Chinese, Singapore, Apr., 1917; ast. regis. ports and exports (war trade dept.) Singapore, ne, 1917; ag. ast. prot. of Chinese (in addition) nr., 1917; ceased to perform duties in war trade pt., ag. ast. prot. of Chinese, Singapore, Sept., 18; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, in addn., Dec., 19; ag. 2nd ast. prot. of Chinese, Singapore, n., 1920; supernumy. offr., cl. IV., Nov., 1920; ast. supt., govt. monopolies and ast. prot. of Chinese, Malacca, June, 1921.

SYMONT, SIR JOSIAH HENRY, K.C.M.G. (1901), C.—B. 1846; mem. of H. of Assem., S. Aus- tralia, 1881-1887; atty.-gen., 1881; Q.C., 1881; presentative to Aus. fed. conven., 1897-8, and rmn. of its judiciary comte.; pres. of fed. league S. Aust.; pres. of Commonwealth league; ar. for S. Aust., Commonwealth parlt., 01-1913; atty.-gen., C. of A., 1904-5; has ret. in politics.

SYMONTETTE, W. J.—B. 1878; pub. schl. teacher, 18th Apr., 1898; 4th divn. commr., June, 1921; ag. ch. clk., recvr. gen. in ass.'dept., 6th Nov., 1922; confirmed in appt., Feb., 1924.

SYMONS, CLAUDE TREVINE.—B. 1879; B.A., hon., F.R.G.S.; vice-principal, govt. training h., Ceylon, Aug., 1908; ast. govt. analyst ne., 1912; ag. govt. analyst, in addn. Dec., 16; govt. analyst, Sept., 1919; ag. regiar., med. l. in addn., May to Dec., 1922.

TACHE, JOSEPH DE LABROQUIERE.—B. 1858; St. Hyacinthe Sem. and Laval Univ.; notary blic, 1881; priv. sec. to Hon. J. A. Chapleau, emier of Quebec, 1880-82; priv. sec. to lieut.-v. Angers, 1887-92; proprietor and editor of "Le Courier," St. Hyacinthe, 1902-14; mem. prov. coun. of agric., 1890-91; unsuccessful candidate for H. of C., bye-elec. and g.e., 04; apptd. King's printer of Canada, Mar., 14; jt. libr. of parl., June, 1920.

TAGART, EDWARD SAMUEL BOURN.—B. 1877; Bath Coll. and Christ's Coll., Cambridge, A.; barrister-at-law; ast. collr., N.E. odesia, 11th Jan., 1901; ast. native commr., Apr., 1901; native commr., 1st Sept., 1902; mag., May, 1903; ast. mag., 15th May, 05; has acted as mag. on various occasions between Aug., 1905 and Mar., 1913; ast. legal viser, 1st Apr., 1913 to 16th June, 1915; ug., 18th June, 1915; ag. judge, high ct., 31st ur. to 23rd June, 1922; sec. for native affrs., th Apr., 1924; mem., exec. and leg. couns.; J.P.

TAINSH, LIKUT.-COL. JOSEPH RAMAY, B.E. (1924). V.D.—Offr., loco. dept., Indian r., 1896-1917; 2nd lieut., Volunteer Force, India, 1898; major, 1915; major, Indian Defence Force, 1916; capt. (temp. major), I.A.R.O., 2nd Apr., 1917; ch. mech. engr., Basra Light Rly., 3rd June, 1917; ag. asst. dir., works, Iraq, 4th July, 1917 to 13th Aug., 1917; ast. dir. of works, in charge of Basra Light Rly., 27th Sept., 1917; trans. to Rly. branch, R.E., 4th Oct., 1917; lieut.-col., 15th June, 1918; loco. supt., Basra divn. of rlys., Jan., 1919; dep. dir. rlys., Iraq, May, 1919; dep. loco. supt. combined system of rlys., Baghdad, June, 1919; demob. with rank of lieut.-col., 3rd Sept., 1919; loco. supt., combined system, Nov., 1919; ag. dir., rlys., 11th Dec., 1921.

TAIT, HUGH NIMMO.—B. 1888; ed. at Clifton and St. John's Coll., Camb.; 1st cls. Math. Tripos, Parts I. and II.; 1st cls. Nat. Science Tripos, Part I.; apptd. after compet. exam., elk., chief sec.'s office, Ireland, Oct., 1911 2nd cls. elk., C.O., Mar., 1912; ag. 1st class elk., 20th July, 1917; on mil. service from 27th Sept. to 9th Dec., 1918; sec. to Rhodesian Coman., 1919-20; prin., 1st Apr., 1920.

TAIT, ALFRED.—Supernumerary elk., Trini- dad, Mar., 1889; extra elk., savings bank dept., 1st Sept., 1890; 3rd elk., royal gaol off., 1st Jan., 1891; 3rd elk., educon. off., Apr., 1891; 3rd ast. elk. of the peace, Port-of-Spain, 1st June, 1891; 4th elk., col. sec.'s off., 12th July, 1892; 3rd elk. col. sec.'s off., 16th Aug., 1897; confd. and 2nd elk., col. sec.'s off., Feb., 1906; ag. ch. elk., col. sec.'s off., and elk. to leg. coun., Nov., 1896; June, 1897, to Nov., 1898; and Nov., 1900; ag. ast. col. sec., July to Oct., 1906; sec. to the col. coun.; priv. sec. to Govr. Sir F. Napier Broome; sec. to the municipal inquiry coman., 1896; clerical ast. to coman. apptd. to inquire into admn. of just. in Trinidad; sec. to industrial educon. coman.; priv. sec. to Sir H. E. H. Jerningham; ast. priv. sec. to Sir A. Moloney; priv. sec. to Mr. Hugh Clifford; priv. sec. to Sir H. M. Jackson; priv. sec. to Sir G. T. Carter; priv. sec. to Mr. S. W. Knagge; ag. ast. col. sec., Mar. to May, 1908; ag. ch. elk., May to Dec., 1908; ag. ast. col. sec., June to Oct., 1909; warden of Couva and Chaguannah, 1st Aug., 1915; warden, Caroni, Jan., 1919.

TAIT, HORACE VIBERT.—B. 1887; ed. at Harrison Coll., Barbados; Island scholar, 1906; 3rd cl. class B.A., 1909; M.A., 1917; educon. offr., educon. dept., B. Guiana, 1914; ag. 2nd ast. inspr. of schools, Oct., 1914, to Apr., 1915; June-Sept., 1915; July-Oct., 1916; ag. 3rd els. elk., educon. off., Jan.-Apr., 1917; ag. classical master, Queen's Coll., Apr.-July, 1917.

TALBOT, MAJ.-GEN. HON. SIR REGINALD ARTHUR JAMES.—K.C.B. (1902); C.B. (1886); b. 1841; ed. Harrow; formerly A.D.C. to Queen Victoria; M.P. for Stafford, 1869-74; serv. in Zulu War, 1879; Egyptian Campaign, 1882; Nile expedn., 1884-86; lt.-col. com. 1st Life Guards, 1886-88; mil. attache, Paris, 1889-95; comg. cavly. brig., Aldershof, 1896-99; comd. army of occupation, Egypt, 1899-1903; gov. of Victoria, Feb., 1904, to July, 1908.

TALMA, EDWY L.—B.A. Christ's Coll., Camb., 14th Wrangler, math. tripos, 1895; cadet, S. S., Nov., 1896; ag. ast. prot. imigts., Penang, Aug., 1897, to Mar., 1898; and from Oct., 1898 confirmed Jan., 1901; passed final exam. in Tamil, Feb., 1889; ag. ast. P.M.G., Penang, Apr., 1902; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, May, 1903; ag. 2nd ditto, Nov., 1903; ast. supt. of Indian imigts., in addition to other duties, Nov., 1903; dep. registr., sup. ct., Singapore, July, 1904; also ast. supt.
of Indian immigrts., Singapore, June, 1907; ag. regiar., sup. ct., Singapore, Oct. to Dec., 1908; promoted to Cla. III., Aug., 1911; passed final exam., coun. of legal ed. (cert. of honour, Inner Temple), Trinity, 1912; ag. 2nd mag., July, 1912; ag. dist. judge and 1st mag., May, 1913; ag. regiar., sup. ct., Mar., 1914; ag. tempy. dist. judge, Feb., 1915; ag. dist. judge, and 1st mag., Apr., 1916; ag. dist. judge, Dec., 1916; ag. 2nd mag., Feb., 1916; offr., cls. II., Mar., 1916; ag. collr., land rev., Mar., 1916; on sp. duty, Somerset House, May-Aug., 1917; temp. attached, war tax office, Penang, Oct., 1917; collr., war tax, Nov., 1917; collr., gen. war tax, Feb., 1918; ag. treas., May, 1920; coillr., gen., income tax, Singapore, 20th Nov., 1920; dep. treas., 'A,' 31st Jan., 1922.

TANNER, B.—Asst. mast., Diocesan schl., Hong Kong, 1898; asst. mast., Queen's Coll., 1900; sen. grade, 1901; normal mast., 1904-6 and from 1908; lecturer, technical institute, 1908-18; ag. 2nd mast., 1916; 2nd and normal mast., 1917; head mast., 1918.

TAPLIN, CAPT. B. B. M.—B. 1883; asst. dist. comsnr., G. Coast, 31st July, 1909; staff offr., H.Q.C.L.C., 1917; Capt., Chinese labour batt., 1917; staff capt., Weihaimei, 1917-18; capt., Chinese labour batt., 1918-19; dist. comsnr., Gold Coast, 23rd Feb., 1911; resumed duty, 1919.

TATE, FRANK, C.M.G. (1919). I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1863; dir. of educn., Victoria, Apl., 1902.

TATHAM, HON. FREDERIC SPENCER, D.S.O., V.D., K.C., Col., S. African Defence Force; hon. major, British Army.—B. 1865; ed. Bishop's Coll., Natal; deputy speaker, Natal parlmt., and chmn. ways and means, 1897-1907; called to the bar, 1886; served Basuto war, 1881; Boer war, 1899-1902; European war, 1915-1918 (five times ment. in desps., D.S.O.); judge of supreme ct. of S. Africa (Natal Prov. Divn.), 1918.
