TICE, W. G.—B. 1867; apptd., after exam., 3rd cl. mass., C.O., 19th Feb., 1900; 2nd cl., 1st Feb., 1902; King's messngr., 22nd May, 1907.

TICHBORNE, C. R. H., L.A.H. (Dub.)—Surgeon, S. African War, 1901-02; lieut., R.A.M.C., 1902-05; capt., R.A.M.C. (S.R.), 1905-11; O.C., 2nd D.D.C.O., R.A.M.C., Mill., 1903-07; capt., R.A.M.C., Aug., 1914 to June, 1918; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, June, 1918.

TILLEY, ALBERT.—B. 1878; Impl. serv., 1895-02; post off., exchequer and audit depts.; transferred to Transvaal serv., Mar., 1902; clk., audit off., Transvaal, 1902; senr. clk., 1909; ditto, audit off., Union of S. Africa, 1910; prin. clk., 1912; prov. audr. and local govt. inspr., Transvaal Prov., May, 1915.

TINDALL, BENJAMIN ARTHUR.—B. 1879; ed. Victoria Coll., Cape Prov.; B.A., LL.B.; called to bar, 1903; practised, Pretoria; K.C., 1919; presided, sp. ct., Swaziland, 1914; judge, sup. ct., Transvaal prov. divn., 1st Dec., 1922.

TISDALE, E. G. S.—Asst. dist. comsrr., E. Africa Prot., Oct., 1919.

TITCHENER, HENRY IAN HERRICK.—B. 1900; entd. C.O., Feb., 1916; apptd., after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., 24th Apr., 1918; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

TOLLAND, CAPT. JAMES PULTNEY, F.R.G.S.—B. 1879; ed. privately and Bradford Tech. Coll.; irrign. engr., Ceylon, 1903-06; asst. survr., Uganda, Nov., 1906; dist. survr., 1912; ag. dep. dir., surveys, several periods, 1910, 1913, 1916 and 1920; lieut., Uganda Vol. Res., Aug., 1914; adjt., Dec., 1914; lieut., 4th K.A.R., June, 1916; capt., K.A.R., July, 1918; intell. offr., Uganda, Aug., 1918; ag. land offr., dir. surveys, regist. of titles, comsrr. of mines, Aug.-Dec., 1920; mem., native land slmtlt. comtes., 1920; dep. dir., land survey and mines dept., Tanganyika Territory, Mar., 1921; ag. land offr., dir. of surveys and contr. of mines, in 1921, 1922, 1923 and 1924; land offr., dir. of surveys and contr. of mines, 15th Mar., 1924.

TOLMIE, ALEXANDER WILLIAM.—B. 1884; ed. Kincardine high schl., Toronto Univ.; apptd. to Canadian govt. exhibn. comsrr., 1908; Canadian govt. exhibn. comsrr., Aug., 1919.
TOLMIE, Roderick Finlayson.—B. 1858; ed.; coll. schl., Victoria, British Columbia; clk. in bank of B. Columbia (Cariboo agency) 1874, entd.; B.C. govt. serv., 1877; gen. sec. B.O. mine owners' assoc., 1899; re-entd. govt. serv. as dep. min. of mines, 1902.

TOLMIE, Hon. Simon Fraser.—B. 1867; ed.; Victoria High Schol., Ontario, and Vet. Coll., Toronto; farmer and breeder of live stock; pres., Dominion Holstein Breeders, B. Columbia Vet. Assoc., B. Columbia Holstein Breeders; chf. inspr. of health of animals branch, B. Columbia; B.C. representative on live stock comrn.; elec. to Canadian H. of C., g.e., 1917 and 1921; min. of agric. in fed. govt., Aug., 1919; resig. portfolio on defeat of admn., in g.e., Dec., 1921.

TOMKINSON, C.—Asst. dist. commr., E. Africa Prov., June, 1915; seconded as lieut., Carrier Corps.

TOMLINSON, GEORGE JOHN FREDERICK, B.A. (Oxon.), Barrister-at-law (Inner Temple).—Served in educn. dept., Transvaal, Feb., 1903, to Oct., 1904; asst. res., N. Nigeria, July, 1907; seconded to G. Coast as dir. of educn., Dec., 1909, to Dec., 1910; 3rd cls. res., N. Nigeria, 1st Apr., 1911; asst. sec., native affrs., Nigeria, 1st Jan., 1921.

TOMLINSON, Sir Thomas Symonds, Kt. Bach. (1926).—B.A. Trin. Coll., Camb.; B. 1877; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1901; town mag., Zanzibar, 5th May, 1907; asst. judge of H.B.M. ct. for Zanzibar, 2nd Jan., 1911; ag. judge, 23rd Feb. to 4th Nov., 1916; judge, 11th Oct., 1919; seconded as legal adviser of the civil admn. of the occupied terry. of Ger. E. Africa, Feb., 1918; ag. atty.-gen., Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1920 to July, 1921; 2nd cls., Order of the Brilliant Star, Zanzibar, 1923.

TONGE, Lieut. Comde. C.G., R.N.—B. 1878; ed. Fettes Coll., Edinburgh; naval transport offr., Aug. to Dec., 1914; lent for serv. in gunboats on Lake Nyassa, Jan., 1915; senr. naval offr., Lake Nyassa, and 1st offr., marine transport dept., June, 1919; Royal Naval Res. Offr.'s Decoration.

TOPPIN, CHARLES SAMUEL.—B. 1866; ed. at Diocesan schl., Waterford, Ireland; served as book keeper and acctnt. with W. Australian land co. (Great Southern rly.), 1887 to 1897; on taking over of line entd. govt. ser., as sub-acctnt., rly. dept., 1st Mar., 1897; asst. acctnt., 1st July, 1900; ag. ch. acctnt., 1st July, 1903; aud.-gen. for State of W. Aust., Feb., 1904; also dep. aud.-gen. for Commonwealth, Feb., 1904, to Jan., 1906.

TOOTHILL, FRANCIS JAMES.—Extra asst. to postmtr.-gen., Ceylon, 28th Oct., 1898; asst. inspr. of post offices, Jan., 1899; asst. sec., cent. irrigtn. bd., 15th Jan., 1900; sec., ditto, and office asst. to dir. of irrigtn., 15th May, 1900; asst. acctnt., gen. treasy., Jan., 1907; ag. financial asst. and acctnt., general treasy., Apr., 1911 to Mar., 1912, and Nov., 1915 to Mar., 1916; ag. paymr., Ceylon volr. force, Aug., 1914; ag. staff offr. in addition to his own duties, Apr., 1915; ag. financial asst. and acctnt., gen. treasy., Nov., 1915; 1st asst. acctnt., Apr., 1916; ag. finan. asst. and acctnt., Apr. to Nov., 1921.

TOUSSAINT, James Reginald.—B. 1879; ag. off. asst., Matara Kach, Ceylon, Jan., 1917; sec., Buddhist Temporalities ord. comrn., and extra off. asst. to dir. of educn., Nov., 1918; ag. off. asst. to col. auditor, Apr., 1919; apptd. to cls. V. of civ. serv., local divn., July, 1919; ag. asst. col. audr., Mar., 1920; ag. sec. to food contr., July, 1921; addnl. asst. comm. stamps, Sept., 1921.

TOWNER, H. V.—Mem. San. Inst. Ag mem. C.E.A.; asst. supt. of wks., S. Srilka, Mar., 1901; supt. of wks. and surveys, Malacca, Oct., 1904; ag. supt. of wks. and surve. Singapore, Apr. to Sept., 1902, and from Feb., 1904, to Mar., 1908; exec. engrn., Dec., 1908; dep. col. engrn., Penang, Jan., 1910; exec. engrn., Singapore, Mar., 1915; on ap. duty in Malacca on road reconstruction, Oct., 1916; ag. dep. engrn. and survr.-gen., Malacca, Feb., 1919; engrn., grade I., Malacca, Dec., 1919; dep. engrn., S. Srilka, Feb., 1921; ag. col. engrn., Mar., 1921.

TOWNSEND, W. H. M.—Ch. offr., Upp. rly. lake steamers, June, 1903; comdr., 1905.

TRAFFORD, H. H.—Asst. dist. commr., Africa Prot., Aug., 1913.

TRAFFORD, JOSEPH LOUIS.—B. 1888; Beaumont Coll.; asst. dist. commr., G. (18th Aug., 1914; ag. dist. commr., June, 1914; and from July, 1916 to July, 1917; asst. commr., 1914; ag. dist. commr. for two periods, 1915-20; ag. asst. col. sec., June to Dec., 1920; dist. commr., 1st Jan., 1921; ag. dist. sec., 11th Oct., 1922.

TRAILL, FRANCIS STUART FORBES.—Asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., 10th Oct., 1888; ed.; Apr., 1903; ag. prov. commr., 1916; 2nd commr., June, 1918.

TRATMAN, DAVID WM.—Ed. at Clifton schlr. of Univ. Coll., Oxford, 1900; B.A.; cadet, Hong Kong, Nov., 1904; passed cadet, 1907; ag. asst. land offr. in New Territories regir. of land ct., 1907; mem. of land d. & ag. pol. mag. in New Territories, 1907; ag. dist. offr., 1909; 2nd asst. regitr.-gen., 1910; supt. of imports and exports, 1910; asst. regitr.-gen., 1911; ag. dist. offr., N.T., 1912; head of sanitary dept., 1912; asst. dist. offr., N.T., (South), 1912; ch. asst. to sec. for land affairs, 1914; ag. dist. offr., N.T., 1915; mem. of sanitary dept., 1915; head of sanitary dept., 1917; ag. supt. of imports and exports, local priority authority, 1918; ag. col. rev., 1920 and 1922; dist. offr., N. Territory, 22 ag. col. treas., 1924.

TRAVERSI, ANTONIO THOMAS, F.I.A. (London), F.C.A.S. (New York).—B. 1871; insurance dept., N.Z. 1891-1907; actuary, fire societies dept., 1907-17; actuary and sec., tame provident fund, 1910-17; asst. actuary, insurance dept., 1917-22; actuary, 1922; com., 1923.

TREE, FRANCIS THOMAS, B.A., Durh., 1887; cadet, F.M.S., Dec., 1910; ag. dist. offr., Kuala Pilah, Jan., 1911; asst. dist. offr., Ipoh, June, 1911; 2nd lieut., R.G.A., Sep., Nov., 1915; lieut., Sept., 1916; std. R.E. research in poison gas, Mar., 1918; dist. offr., Langat, Sept., 1919; ag. dist. offr., Kuala May., 1920; ag. asst. servir., Batu Pahat, Jahore, Oct., 1922; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1922.

TREMLETZ, FREDERICK THOMAS GRAHAM, M.R.E. (1818).—B. 1881; ed. Denstone (Staffs); 2nd lieut., Jamaica Militia, 1921; 1903; attached Lancs. Fusiliers, 1903; sub-contab., Jamaica, 1903; ag. inspr., dist. offr., 1911; studied finger-print system, Scotland, 1908; J.P., 1909; inspr. of contab., Jamaica, 1912; supt., Spanish Town fire brigade, 1911; passed mil. schl. of instrn., Chelsea, 1912; com. to Mauritius pol., 1912; dep. inspr.-gen. of p.
uritius, 1916; capt. and adjt., Mauritius volr., 1916; capt. in army, 1917; raised and comd. Mauritius labour batt., 1917; ocmd. Mauritius r. force, Mar. to Dec., 1919; ag. inspr.-gen. of Mauritius, May, 1917, and Mar. to Dec., 1919; major, 1920; ag. inspr.-gen., supt., prisons &c., C.C. Mauritius Vol. Force, Feb. to Sept., 1922; asst. commr., pol. and prisons, Uganda, 1922.

FRENCH, ARTHUR DONALD LE POER, O.A.C. (c).—Senr. coffee offr., agrl. dept., Kenya, 1916.

ROTTEN, CECIL DOUGLAS.—B. 1886; ed. Lingling Coll.; joined B.S.A. Pol., Jan., 1906; asfd. to native affairs dept., Sept., 1907; passed native language and Cape civ. serv. law exam., 1910; nat. comm., Apl., 1911; J.P. for S. Rhodesia, May, 1911; asst. mag., Belingwe, Dec., 1911; to Mar., 1912; ch. clk. to native affairs, nat. comm., and asst. mag., Sebongwe, 1912; to Nov., 1913; asst. dist. commr., G. st., 18th Aug., 1914.

ROWBRIDGE, EDMUND.—B. 1881; ed. pub. school and high schls., Toronto, Ontario; asst. exec. coun., 1906; sec., Alberta coal commn., 1907; sec., Alberta pork commn., 1908; dep. prov. and regis. of companies, prov. of Alberta, 1909.

ROWELL, WM. JOHN.—B. 1864; M.L.N.A.; nr. and shipwright surv. and examnr. of nrs., Liverpool, Feb., 1898; inspr. under bd. agric., Dec., 1898; inspr. of marine surveys, 1898-1900; 16th Jan., 1903; on special ser. in land in connection with expropriation of ijong Pagar Dock Co., Ltd., July to Nov., 1909; on duty at C.O. and Bd. of Trade on draft merchant shipping ordnec., 1910, Apr., 1909, to 1910; war serv. recog. by S. of S., Apr., 1909; on ap. serv. in England in connection with designing of marine craft, 19th Sept., 1920; imd. duties, 21st June, 1921.

RUTER, SIR THEODORUS GUSTAFT, K.B.E. (4), C.M.G. (1918).—B. 1873; ed. Boys Pub. L. George; Normal Coll., Cape Town; Diocesan L. Rondebosch; entd. Cape civ. ser., 1st Dec., 1912; chief examr. of accts., 1896; lieut., Robert's se., 1899-1902 (medal and four clasps); asst. sec., Pretoria, 1st Apr., 1901; mem., spec. comm., Ermelo, 1st Dec., 1904; mag., Kimberley, Ist Apl., 1908; prov. sec., Transvaal, Julv., 1910; commr., S. African pol., 15th Apr., 1910; J.P., Union of S. Africa.

UBOKU-METZGER, ALBERT EMERIO, B.A., ed. in C.M.S. Gram. schl. and Fourah Bay L., Sierra Leone; gained Fourah Bay Coll. scholarship, Jan., 1877; grad. in June, 1880; first ols. hon. in theology, ham Univ., Dec., 1881; jun. cls. tutor, rah Bay Coll., 1881; entd. S. Leone civ., as extra clk., secretariat and treas., 1st Apr., 1885; gov'r.'s office, 1886; col. treas., 1887; ed as finan. clk. in the Yonni expedit. under Samuel Rowe, 1887; ch. clk., regis. gen.'s l., 1890; regis. of births and deaths, Free-pan dist., 1890; police clk. and clk. of ct. of tests, Freetown, Apr., 1896; ag. regis. gen., 1905, and 1907; asst. dist. commr., Ist Apr., 1908; app'ted. Crown prosecutor in the Sept. of the sup. ct. at Sherbro, Oct., 1908; is P. for the col.

UCKER, KRITH RAVENACROFT, F.I.A.A., cer. acctnt.—B. 1890; articled pupil to Messrs. row & Co., Glasgow, 1906-8; entd. engineering &c., office of crown agts. for the colonies, Mar., 1908; transfd. to col. audit dept., cent. office, June, 1913; asst. auditor, G. Coast, Sept., 1913; asst. audr., Nyasaland Prot., June, 1916; despatched Pretoria, on mily. audit duties, Oct., 1918 to Apr., 1919; served with Togoland Field Force, Aug.-Sept., 1914 (ment. in despatches); lieut., G. Coast Volrs., Apl., 1915; hon. temp. capt., Nyasaland Field Force, 1919; asst. auditor, Nyasaland Prot., June, 1916; ag. auditor, Apl., 1919 to Mar., 1920; ag. dep. treas., June, 1921; dep. treas., Dec., 1921; ag. treas., Apr., 1923; treas., 14th Jan., 1924.

TUCKER, LESLIE.—Ed. at Liverpool Collegiate Institn. and Univ. Coll., Liverpool; prelim. and inter. B.A.; 1st cls. scholarship; 1st cls. both years certif. exam.; parchment certif., 1897; head master, govt. boys' schl., St. Helena, 1904; head master, senior schl., St. Helena, 1905; hon. sec. and treas., govt. lace schl., 1908; supervisor of govt. schls., 1910; hon. sec., bd. of educn., 1911; govt. rep. on Hussey Charity bd. of educn., 1911; J.P. and coroner and mem., bd. of health, 1912; lieut., St. Helena Rifles, Sept., 1914 to Nov., 1916; lieut., R.A.S.C., Apr., 1917 to Nov., 1919; inspr. schls., Leeward Is., Feb., 1920; chmn., gen. purposes comtece., Antigua bd. of educn.; chmn., St. Kitts bd. of educn., 1922.

TUDHOPE, WILLIAM STEEL DYKES.—B. 1877; on staff of W. of Scotland Agric. Coll., 1901-07; dir. of agr., Gold Coast, Sept., 1907; ten months in Ceylon before assuming duty; del. of Gold Coast at Internat. Rubber Exhibn., Lond., June, 1911, and at Internat. Congress of Trop. Agr., Lond., June, 1914; on sp. mission to Ecuador, 1920.

TUDOR, SIR DANIEL THOMAS, KT. BACH. (1917), K.C.—B. 1866; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, Nov., 1890; eq. dr.; also practised on West. Circ.; atty.-gen. of Grenada and St. Vincent, July, 1903; K.C. of both colonies, May, 1908; acted as chief just., also as col. sec. of Grenada on several occasions; admnstr. govt. of St. Vincent, June, 1907, to Jan., 1908; and govt. of Grenada, May and June, 1908, and Mar. to May, 1910; comsnr. to consolidate and revise the Laws of Grenada, 1911; ag. legal asst., C.O., May to Oct., 1911; chief justice, Bahamas, Nov., 1911; pres. of discharged soldiers commn. of inquiry, Jan., 1918; ch. just., Gibraltar, 1922.

TUPPER, HON. SIR CHAS. HIBBERT, K.C.M.G. (1893).—B. 1855; son of late Sir C. Tupper, mem. of N.S. bar; grad. Harvard law schl.; mem., house of commons, Canada, 1882-1900; min. of marine and fisheries, 1883-1895; deleg. to Washington in connection with Behring Sea difficulty, 1890; Br. agt. for the arbitration with the U.S. on the Behring Sea question, 1892-3; min. of just., 1895; resig. 1896; mem. of priv. coun. for Canada.

TURBETT, IVAN JOLIFFE TUFNELL.—B. 1890; ed. Trinity Coll., Dublin; barrister-at-law, King's Inn, Dublin, 1913; cadet, Fiji, 1914; ag. dist. comsnr., 1915; ag. crown solr., 1916; ag. ch. pol. mag., 1917; pol. mag., Gambia, 1918; ag. legal adviser, 1919-22 and in 1924; ag. judge, sup. ct. on various occasions.

TURGEON, WILLIAM FERDINAND ALPHONSE, K.C., B.A.—B. 1877; ed. at New York city and Laval univ., Montreal; barrister; atty.-gen. of Sask., 23rd Sept., 1907; elec. to Sask. legis., 1907; re-elec., 1908, 1912 and 1917; atty.-gen. and prov. sec., 1915; judge, ct. of appeal, Sask., 14th Mar., 1921.
TURNBULL, Aubrey Marriott Dalway.—Ed. Bath Coll.; clk., treas., B.C. Africa, Jan., 1903; editor, B.C.A. Gazette, Nov., 1903, to Sept., 1906; 3rd cls. res., May, 1906; ag. regiar. of high ct., offi. recvr. and liquidator, May to Dec., 1908; ag. res. Mlanje dist., July, 1909, to Mar., 1910, and May to Nov., 1912; dist. mag., July, 1906; ag. supt. of native affairs and comml. intell. offr., May, 1910, to Mar., 1911; attached to deputy govrs' office for special duty, Sept., 1911, to Apl., 1912; ag. sec. to the administration, Nyasaland Prot., Dec., 1912; asst. ch. sec., Mar., 1914; mem. of native rising comrn., 1915; dist. pol. offr. in occupied territory in German E. Africa, July, 1916; adminis. offr., 1st grade, Tanganyika Territory, 1st Apr., 1920; hon. major, Nyasaland Field Force.

TURNER, Ernest Edgar.—B. 1880; clk., post office, Sheffield, 1894-1900; served in S. African war and in S. African constab. (medal and 5 clasps); depot sergt-major, R.N.W. mounted police, Canada, 1908-1916; coronation medal, 1911; lieut., Bahamas police and defence force, 1916; capt., 1917; major and offir. com. local forces, comdt. of police, provost marshal, and inspir. of prisons, June, 1919.

TURNER, Capt. H. W.—Port offr., E. Africa Prot., May, 1915.

TURNER, James Pogson.—B. 1871; clk., pub. library, St. Kitts, 1890; clk., regist.'s off., St. Kitts, 1897; comnrn. to administer oaths, St. Kitts, 1899; clk. to mag., dist. "C," St. Kitts, May to Oct., 1905; 1st clk., regist.'s off., Antigua, 3rd May, 1906; comnrn. to admin. oaths, Antigua, May, 1906; clk. to trustees, sup. ct. library, June, 1906; clk. to regist. of jt. stock companies, Nov., 1906; ag. regiar. and prov. marshal, Dominica, Oct., 1910, to Feb., 1912; ditto, Antigua, and ch. regiar., Leeward Is., 17th Feb. to 31st March, 1912, 26th Apl. to 20th Nov., 1914, and from 4th May to 6th Nov., 1915; dep. coroner, dists. "A" and "B" Antigua, Apl., 1916; dir. of P.O.G. fund, Jan., 1917; regiar. and prov. marshal, Antigua, and chief regiar., 1st Sept., 1917.

TURNER, Lewis James Barnettson.—B. 1885; ed. Edinburgh Univ. (M.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1908; off. asst. to govt. agt., N.W. Prov., Dec., 1909; pol. mag., Gampola, Nov., 1911; office asst. to govt. agt., S. Prov., May, 1913; asst. comnrn. of excise, Nov., 1913; asst. comnrn., S. Div., Jan., 1914; ditto, N.W. Div., Aug., 1916; asst. govt. agt., Kandy, in addition to his own duties, Oct., 1917; ag. asst. govt. agt., Trincomalee, Sept., 1918; asst. comnrn. of excise, N.W. divn., and asst. govt. agt., Kandy, Aug., 1919; ag. asst. govt. agt., Nuwara Eliya, Oct., 1919; supt. of census, July, 1920; dir. of statistics in admn., Sept., 1920.

TURNER, William.—Ed. at Abdn. and Edin. Univs.; M.A. (Abdn.), 1876; M.B. Edin., 1879; M.D., 1881; res. phy., roy. hosp. for sick chldn., Edin., 1879; non-res. phy., roy. infirmy., Edin., 1880; res. accoucheur, Glasgow maternity hosp., 1881; mem. roy. med. soc., Edin., fell. obstetrical soc., Edin.; asst. surg. civil hosp., Gibraltar, 1882; also surg. civ. prison, med. offr. lunatic asyl., and dist. med offr., 1882; pub. vaccinator, pd. surg., 1888; surg. to col. hosp., Oct., 1889.

TURTON, Neville Harry.—B. 1869; ed. at Merton Coll., Oxford; B.A. (hons.), 1911; M.A., 1915; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple; asst. auditor, S. Leone, 1912; ag. auditor, on four occasions; asst. to the atty.-gen., Uganda, 1921; 1st cls. mag. and judge, Kampala in admn.; atty.-gen., St. Vincent, June, 1924.

TWELLS, John.—Ed. at Jesus Coll., O (scholar); B.A., 1907; examr., E. and A. b. July, 1909; asst. auditor, S. Leone, Nov., 1 asst. auditor, E. Africa Prot., July, 1912; asst. mast., educn. dept., Kenya, 1919.

TWINING, T. C.—Asst. dist. commr., Ken Sept., 1921.

TWOSE, Lawrence Rendle.—B. 1891; clk., C.S.O., Antigua, 1915; clk. to mag., 1915; sec. to fire brig. comrn., 1916; hea. forces, 1916-19; ag. A.D.C. to gov., Leeward on occasion of visit of Prince of Wales, 1920; to commr., Montserrat, 1920; clk. of coun. coroner, educn. dist. offr., 1921.

TYLER, James Ernest.—Govt. prize Stltmbr., 1st July, 1906.

TYLER SMITH, H. A., A.M.I.M.E.—B. 1887; B.Sc. (Eng.) with cl. hons., civil engnr., Liverpool Univ.; 2nd lieut., R.E. (sp. res.) 1910; asst. en. P.W.D., Kenya, 1911; exec. engnr., 1911; R.E. (S.R.), 1917; D.P.W., Gambia, 1920.

TYRRELL, Francis Graeme.—B. 1876; Pembroke coll., Oxford (B.A.); cadet, civ. ser., Oct., 1900; ag. priv. sec. to H.E. governor, Aug., 1901; priv. sec. to H.E. admstg. the govt., Apr., 1902; off. ast. ins. agt., Cent. prov., Jan., 1903-Dec., 1904; asst. govt. agt., Nuwara Eliya, Oct., 1904; asst. supt. of pol., N.W. prov., Aug., 1906; cen. Mar., 1907; dist. judge, Badulla, Dec., 1909; asst. govt. agt., Matale, Feb., 1909; dep. of customs, Nov., 1911; on mil. duty, Jan., 1919; ag. govt. agt., N.C. Prov., Aug., 1919; prf. N.W. Prov., May, 1921.

TYSER, Sir C. R., KT. Bach. (1869)- Rugby and Trin. Coll., Camb., M.A.; called to bar, In. Tem., 1873; ast. comnrn. and leg. advat., Cyprus, 1880; gen., Leewarda, 1886-9; pres. dist. cr. in Cyprus, 1896; puisne judge, Cyprus, Jan., 1897; ch. just., 1906; ret., 1919; author of "Insurance Losses," 1894; wrote translation Omar Hilmi Effendi's Evkaf Law, 1899; the Mejellé, 1901.

TYSSEN, Francis Dashwood.—Ed. Melbourne Church of England Gram. sch., Trin. Coll., Melbourne Univ.; lieut. 2nd Horse, S. African War; inspr. of pol. R. Prot., May, 1905; ast. dist. supt. of pol., July, 1906; supt. of pol., 1910; ast. comnrn., Kenya, Apr., 1920; comnrn., pol., Nov., 1920.

UNWIN, Arthur Harold, D.Oc.—Furn. branch, dept. of interior, Canada, 1903-4; conservator and senr. conservator of forests, Nigeria, 1904-17; office of woods, timber and fuel dept., England, 1917-19; prin. forest offr., Cypr., 1921.

URQUHART, Charles Frederic Hildyard.—B. 1867; entd. Crown Agents, Jan., 1886; supt. of stock transfer offr., 1886; inscr. of inscribed stocks and head of stock dept., head of finance dept., 1st Jan., 1920.

USHER, Capt. C. G., M.C.—Ast. comnrn., Kenya, May, 1920.
SHER, WALTER WHITBREAD.—B. 1886; at Marist Bros. Coll., Uitenhage; clk., island, 1910; regir. and master, sp. ct. of island, and Sheriff, 1916; dep. astt. comrnr., bane, 1919; served in Anglo-Boer War, S.W. campaign, 1914-15 and Flanders, 1918.

ALINTINE, THOMAS HARCOUET AMBROSE, E. (1919). M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), H. (R.C.S. and R.C.P., Lond.)—B. 1865; Marlborough Coll. and St. Bartholomew's; dist. health offr., N.Z., 1901; astt. ch. th offr., 1902; inspr. gen. of hosps., 1907; health offr., 1909; dir., mily. hosps., 1915-19; gen. of pub. health, 1921.

ALLIPURAM, WILLIAM GEORGE.—B. 1888; col. mag., Trincomalee, Ceylon, Dec., 1917; d. to cls. V. of civ. ser., local divn., July, 1918; ag. office astt., Trincomalee Kachcheri, 1922.

ALPY, GEORGE COBBY.—B. 1877; ed. King's, Canterbury, and classical schlr., Christ's, Camb.; B.A., 2nd cls., classical tripes; cadet, ngor, F.M.S., Mar., 1901; passed final exam. antonese, Dec., 1903; ag. astt. dist. offr., Ulu gat, Jan., 1904; ditto, Klang, Apr., 1904; passed t., Oct., 1904; astt. prot. of Chinese, Jan., 1907, continued to act as astt. dist. offr., Klang; prot. of Chinese, Penak, May, 1911; ag. astt. assignee, Singapore, Jan., 1915; ag. astt. supt. nigra., in addition, Jan., 1917; supernumy., cls. III., S. Sttlmts., Jan., 1918; offr., cls. F.M.S., Nov., 1918; ag. regir. of coys. and astl assignee, Singapore, June-Oct., 1920 and 1924; ag. collr. gen., income tax, Singapore, Oct., 1921.

AN BUREN, VAN ROBERT HARRIS.—B. ; entered civ. serv., Trinidad, 2nd Sept., stip. mag., 3rd Dec., 1913.

ANDERKOEN, SUSAIPIILLAI MUDALIYAR J.P.—B. 1864; cls V., Ceylon civ. serv., 1921; office astt. to astt. prot. agt., Putta.

AN DER MEULEN, SIR FREDERICK A., KT., H.B. (1919); O.B.E. (1919).—B. 1875; ed. at ndell's Schl., Tiverton, and Keble Coll., B.A. (hons. in mod. hist.), 1896; M.A.; barrister-at-law, Gray's Inn, 1900; Westm. lit.; astt. dist. comrnr., Sierra Leone, 1907; gen., 1908; ag. atty.-gen. and also ag. puisne circuit judge on various occasions, 1908-1911; mag., Gambia, 1913; puisne judge, Nigeria, 1919.

AN DER RIET, FREDERICK JOHN WERNDLT, 1868; ed. Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch; B.A. (lit.), 1887; Cape civ. serv., 1887; LL.B., study, 1894; admitted to practice as advoc., ct., 1894; Transvaal, 1897; K.C., 1912; I., Union parlkt., Dec., 1912 to Feb., 1923; e., sup. ct., assigned to Eastern district's local Feb., 1923.

AN DER STERR, WILLEM CORNELIS.—secondary triangulation, Union of S. Africa, Aug., 1919; dir. trigonometrical survey, on of S. Africa, 1st Oct., 1920.

AN DE VELDE, MARCEL ARTHUR MAURICE, I. at Mt. St. Mary's Coll., Derbyshire; clk., audit branch, E. and A. dept., 29th May, 1900; yr. astt. audr., E. Africa Prot. and Uganda 9th Mar., 1903; astt. audr., Uganda Prot., 1903; astt. audr., E. Africa Prot. and ida rly., 1904; local audr., Uganda Prot., 16th 1909; audr., Uganda Prot., 1st May, 1910; , Kenys., Oct., 1923.

VAN HEERDEN, SENATOR THE HON. H. C., M.L.A.—Formerly chmn. of comtees.; min. of agric., Union of S. Africa 1913-19; pres. of the senate since 1921.

VAN REENEN, REENEN JACOB, B.A., C.E., Assoc. M. Amer. Soc. C.E., A.M.I.C.E.—Ed. at S.A. Coll., Cape Town; at graduation obtained Victoria scholarship, proceeded to Lehigh Univ.; astt. engrnr., irrigtn. dept., Cape Colony, Sept., 1909; ditto, Union of S. Africa; supt. of roads and local wks., O.F.S. Prov., May, 1912; mem. of Union Drought Investigation Coman., 1920-24; chmn., Draught Investigation Comen. of S.W. Africa, 1923-24.

VAN RYNEVELD, COL. SIR PIERRE HELPERUS ANDRIAS, K.B.E. (1920), D.S.O. (1918), M.C. (1916), B.A., B.Sc.—R. 1891; ed. Grey Coll. Sohl., Grey Univ. Coll., Bloemfontein, Imp. Coll., Univ. of London; 2nd lieut., 7th Loyal N. Lancs. Regt., Aug., 1914; lieut., R.F.C., Apr., 1915; detachment C.O., Senussi campaign, Egypt, 1915-16; flight comdr., Palestine, 1916; ditto, Salonika, 1916; squad. comdr., London night defences, 1916-17; squad. comdr., No. 17 squad., B.E.F., 1917; severely wounded; wing comdr., XI. (Army) Wing, 2nd Army, 1917-19; ditto, Army wing, Rhine army of occupation, 1919; ment. in desps. six times, "1914-15" Star, Brit. War med., Victory med., Order of the Nile, 4th cls., Croix de Chevalier, Legion d'Honneur, France, Croix d'Officier, Ordre Leopold avec Croix de Guerre, Belgium; S. African liaison offr., Air Miny., 1919-21; lient.-col. (temp. col.), Permanent Force Union Defence Forces, 1st Feb., 1920; dir. of air services, U.D.F., 1st Feb., 1920.

VAN SCHALKWIJK, JAN ZACHARIAS.—B.A.; inspr. of schls., O.F.S. Prov., Union of S. Africa, Nov., 1917.

VAN SCHALKWIJK, L. M. A. N., B.A. (Cape), Ph.D. (Amst.).—B. 1888; ed. Normal and S. African Coll., Cape Town, also in Holland and Germany; teacher, Cape Prov., seven years; organising inspr., Union dept. of educn., 1921.

VAN SOMEREN, ROBERT ABRAHAM LOGAN.—Ed. at Edin. Univ. and Royal Coll. of Surg., Edin.; M.B., Ch.B.; spec. univ. certif., Edin.; trop. diseases, and certif. of London Schl. of Trop. Med.; med. offr., E. Africa and Uganda Prots., 10th Oct., 1905.

VAN VELDEN, DIRK ELIZA.—B. 1869; ed. at Gymnasium and Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch; clk., auditor-gen.'s off., 1896; astt. sec., second volksraad, S. African Repub., 1896; sec. to ditto, 1899; sec. to Transvaal govt., Sept., 1900, to 1902; clk. astt. to legis. coun., Transvaal, 1907; clk. of the prov. coun., Transvaal, and clk. of the exec. comtee.; prov. sec., Transvaal Prov., 1918; author of "Peace Negotiations between Boer and Briton in South Africa."

VAN VELDEN, LIEUT.-COL. DIRK OVERGAUW, D.T.D., D.S.O. (1918).—B. 1879; served in Repub. Forces, S. African War, 1899-1902; Pretoria town commando and staff offr. on Gen. Botha's staff to Sept., 1901; prisoner of war at Bermuda, Sept., 1901; atty. of the sup. ct. of the Transvaal till 1914; capt., 10th Dismounted Rifles, Union Defence Forces, 1st July, 1913; called out for serv., 14th Aug., 1914, for sp. duty on eastern border, German S.W. Africa; transferred to Col. Mentz's staff, 18th Sept., 1914; ch. staff officer, Col. Mentz's column, 9th Oct., 1914; attd. perm. force (staff), U.D.F., for sp. duties, 14th Oct., 1914; temp. major, 9th Nov., 1914; subtenan.
major, 12th Jan., 1915; brig. major, 12th-27th Jan., 1915; dist. staff offr., Bloemfontein mil. dist. (temp.), 28th Jan. to 30th Sept., 1915; perm. commn., perm. force, U.D.F., as major, 1st Oct., 1915; D.A.A.G., defence headqrs., 1st Oct., 1915; temp. lieut.-col., 27th Mar., 1916; ag. adjutant gen., 26th Sept., 1916 to 3rd June, 1917; graded as asst. adj. gen., 4th June, 1917; served in German E. African campaign with Union of S. African Imp. Ser. contingent, 1917-18; liaison offr. and sp. serv. offr., with rank of lieut.-col. (graded as gen. staff offr., 1st grade), on staff of comdr.-in-chief, E. Africa, 25th June, 1917 to 31st Jan., 1918; ment. in desp.; asst. adjutant gen., defence headqrs., 18th Jan., 1918; dep. adjutant gen., 22nd May, 1918; brevet lieut.-col., 14th June, 1918; ag. adjutant gen., 14th Jan., 1920; lieut.-col. and apptd. adjut.-gen. U.D.F., 23rd Feb., 1921; med., Anglo-Boer Oorlog, 1899-02; 1914-15 Star, Br. War med., Victory med.

VAN ZIJL, HENDRIK STEFANUS, L.L.B. (Camb.), B.A., L.L.B. (Cape).—B. 1876; ed., Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch, and St. John's Coll., Cambridge; advoc., sup. ct., Cape Town, 1903; M.P., Cape of Good Hope, 1905-10; parly. draftman, Union of S. Africa, 1910-15; K.C., 1919; judge, sup. ct., Union of S. Africa, 1920.

VAN ZIJL, L. J., B.A.—B. 1887; ed. Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch; vice-prin., Boeshof, 1910; prin., Smithfield, 1914; prin., Ladybrand, 1919; inspir. of schls., Orange Free State, 1921.

VAREY, JAMES ARTHUR, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1879; apprentice, city engnr.'s office, Leeds, 1896; asst. engnr., ditto, 1900; ditto, waterwks. engnr.'s office, Leeds, 1905; irrigtn. engnr., irrigtn. dept., Ceylon, 1907; irrigtn. engnr., P.W.D., B. Guiana, 1913; dep. engnr., P.W.D., Ceylon, Feb., 1920.

VASSALL, HENRY HOLLAND.—B. 1887; ed. Bedford Grammar Schl. and Keble Coll., Oxford; asst. res., Nyasaland, 1911; res., 1919.

VASSALLO, S.—Ed. Malta Lyceum and Malta Univ.; M.D., 1913; govt. exhib. for science, 1906-1907; ditto, for medicine, 1909-1913; post-graduate work at Univ. Coll. Hosp. and London Hosp.; clinical asst., St. John's Hosp., W., and Royal Ear Hosp.; supernumerary med. offr., Leeward Is., 1914; med. offr., Uganda, 1919.

VATHIANATHAN, KANTHAH.—B. 1896; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., June, 1923; attd., Colombo kach., July, 1923; ditto Ratnapura kach., May, 1924; office asst. ditto, Sept., 1924.

VAUGHAN, JOHN ALFRED.—M. Inst. C.E., M.I. Mech. E., M. Amer. Soc., M.E.; B. 1865; engineer offr., R.N., 1887-1902; chief inspir. of machinery, mines dept., Transvaal, 12th Apr., 1901; ch. inspir. of machinery, mines and industries dept., Union of S. Africa, 1910; past pres., S.A. Inst. Engrs.

VAUGHAN, JOHN HENRY.—B. 1892; ed. Eastbourne Coll. and Corpus Christi Coll., Cambridge, B.A. (hist. tripes), 1914; served with H.M. Forces, 1914-21; M.C., Arras, 1917; asst. dist. commn., Zanzibar, 1921; priv. sec. to Br. res. and clk. of the coun., July, 1924.

VELACOTT, PHILIP NORTHCOOT, M.B. Lond. (hons. in for. and obst. med.), 1895; B.S., 1896; M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P. (Lond.), 1896; F.R.C.S. Constab., 6th June, 1902; transfd. to O.R.C. govt. serv. as res. med. offr., National hosp., Bloemfontein, 1st 1905; fellow of R. Inst. of pub. health; deleg. O.R.C. to 2nd Internat. Congress on Hygiene.

VENN, HARBY NORMAN.—West Arm service, 1895-1900; S. Africa, 1915; sec. for the Interior, 1st Dec., 1919.

VENNING, G. B.—1879; apptd. compet. exam., asst. clk., and assigned to govt. bd., May, 1899; after further exam., apptd. clk. of the 2nd div. of the corp. and assigned to W.O., 8th Jan., 1900; trans. C.O., 16th Apr., 1903; conf. clk., 1st Apr., 1904.

VENNING, JOHN HENRY.—B. 1857; Worthing Coll.; Matabele Rebellion, 1896; dist. admn., N.W. Nigeria, Sept., 1906.

VERGETTE, EDWARD DUDLEY.—B. 1857; King's Sch., Peterborough; admitted sup. et., England, 1903; asst. dist. sup. et., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1907; barrister sup. et., Sierra Leone, Nov., 1907; crown parser, Jan., 1913; ag. circuit judge and ag. judge, Sierra Leone, Nov., 1914 to Apr., ag. pol. mag. and regist.-gen., Sierra Leone, various periods, 1908 and 1916-19; pres. Cyprus, July, 1920.

VERNEY, FRANK ARTHUR.—B. 1874; Natal, 1901-08; priv. vet. offr., Basutoland.

VERNON, ROLAND VENABLES, C.B.—B. 1877; ed. at Clifton and Oxford; Balliol, 1895-9; 1st els. moda., 1897; Hertford schlr.; Craven schlr., 1897; exhib., 1899; 1st els. lit., hum., 1899; after compet. exam., clk. in sec. depts., rev., Nov., 1899; 2nd els. clk., C.O., 1900; sec. to Trinidad riot. comm., 1903; managing comm., of E.I.O.; asst. priv. to Lord Elgin, Jan., 1908; priv. sec. to tid., 16th Apr., 1908; reed., S. Lausanne for Turkish Peace Treaty, Nov. to ec., 1922 and June, 1923; transf., to permanent aff. of C.O. as ast. sec., Jan., 1924.

VERRY, CECIL TYRRELL.—B. 1886; ed. Mal- rn; clk., treas., Nyasaland, 1909; transf., st. admstr., 1909; res., 3rd grade, 1910; ag. D.C. to gov., 1915-18; temp. lieut., K.A.R., 16; res., 1918; admstr. offr., 1st grade, 31st July, 1923.

VERSCHAFELT, PAUL DEBRÉ NESTOR, L.B., F.I.A.N.Z.—B. 1887; grad. in law, Vic- toria Coll., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. pub. serv., 1904; ast. lib. serv. comntr., 1921; pub. serv. comntr., 1923.

VIDAL, M. R. R.—Ast. dist. comntr., E. Africa Prot., Dec., 1912.

VILJOEN, WILLEM JACOBUS, M.A., L.N.C., ill. D.—B. 1869; ed. at Normal Coll., Cape- town, Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch, and S. African Coll., Cape town; apptd. to staff, Normal Train- ing Coll., Cape town, 1889; after graduation studied at Univ. of Amsterdam, Leyden, Stras- burg, and in 1894 took degree of Phil. D. (in modern languages and comparative philology); ot., mod. languages and hist., Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch, 1895-1903; prof. of Dutch lang. and lit.) ditto, now Univ. of Stellenbosch, 03-10; elec. mem. of coun. of C. of G.H. Univ., 1897; mem., Maatschappij der Neder- landse, Leiden, 1900; rep. Cape Univ. at quin- centenary of Leipzig Univ., 1909; dir., educn., F.S.I., 1910-18; mem. and chmn., of Grey Univ. coll., coun., Bloemfontein, 1911-18; rep. Union S. Africa at Imp. Educn. D.C.L., Oxford, 1923; author of several standard wks. on Dutch language and simplified orthography.

VIMPANY, HAROLD RAVENSCROFT.—B. 1870; t., Baautoland, 1907; treas. clk., 1913; clk. to st. comntr., 1915; dir., indu. schl., 1916.

VINCENT, GEORGE ALVES, M.B., Ch.B.—1872; ast. med. supt., lunatic asylum, imidad, 16th Mar., 1901; supt., ditto, 1st d., 1909.

VINCENT, WILLIAM HENRY, L.M.S.S.A., nd.—B. 1886; ed. Colet Court, St. Paul’s schl., Mary’s Hosp., and London Univ.; dist. med. r., Fiji, 1915.

Africa, Nov., 1923.

VISSER, DANIEL HENDRIK, J.P.—B. 1877; entered Cape pub. serv., 23rd Mar., 1894; ast. mag. and ag. civil comntr., 1902-05; clk.-ast., Cape House of Assem., 8th Apr., 1907; clk.-ast., House of Assem., Union of S. Africa, Nov., 1910; clk., House of Assem., 1st Oct., 1920.

VLIELAND, CHARLES ARCHIBALD.—B. 1890; ed. Exeter Schl. and Balliol Coll., Oxford (schol.); int. cls. hon., nat. sci., 1911; cadet, F.M.S., 1914; ast. sec. to res., Selangor, 1917; 3rd ast. sec., fedl. secretariat, 1919; ast. dist. offr., 1929-21; sec. to res., Negri Sembilan, 1922.

VOLNEY, JOSEPH HENRY LOUIS.—B. 1876; entd. pub. ser., St. Lucia, Feb., 1892, as supernm. clk., post off., Feb., 1894; 4th clk., treasy., Apr., 1894; ag. 3rd clk., in 1895, 1896, and 1897; 3rd clk., treasy., Jan., 1898; ag. 2nd clk. and treasy. acctnt., May to Oct., 1898; ag. 2nd clk. and cashier, treasy., Aug., 1900, to Apr., 1901; 2nd clk., regiar’s off., Apr., 1901; ag. ch. clk., Aug. to Oct., 1901; ag. audit clk., Aug. to Nov., 1902, transf. on temporary duty to pub. wks. dept.; ch. clk., regiar’s dept., Apr., 1903; ag. regiar. on several occasions, 1908-1916; ag. mag., dist. Sttlnts., 1913; ag. atty.-gen., S. Sttlnts., 1919; ag. judicial comntr., F.M.S., 1919; ag. legal adviser, F.M.S., in addn., Mar., 1920; legal adviser (offr. cls. I.A.), June, 1920; ag. judl. comntr., F.M.S. in addn., June, 1920; ag. ch. sec. to govt., Oct., 1920; ag. Br. res., N. Sembilan, Mar.-Apr., 1921; ag. atty.-gen., S. Sttlnts., 10th Mar., 1922.

WADDEL, WILLIAM.—B. 1868; ed. Southland Boys’ High Schl., N.Z.; entd. N.Z. state advances dept., 1895; ast. supt., 1904; dep. supt., 1907; supt., 1922.

WADDINGTON, E. J., O.B.E. (1919).—Ast. dist. comntr., E.A.P., Dec., 1913; ag. prov. comntr., Jubaland, Nov., 1919; senr. ast. sec., secretariat, Kenya, Feb. to Sept., 1923; clk. or couns., Sept., 1923.

WADE, A. DE V.—Ed. Lancing Coll., exhibtn. and Keble Coll., Oxford; scholar; M.A.; ast. dist. comntr., E. Africa Prot., Mar., 1912.

WADE, CECIL HENRY, B.A. (hons.), 1909.—Ed. Lancing Coll. (exhibtn.) and Keble Coll., Oxford; 3rd grade res., Nyasaland, 5th Aug., 1911; ag. 1st ast. sec. (native affrs.), July, 1920; 1st ast. sec., June, 1921; examr. in Chinyanja language.

WADIA, SIYAX HIRJI.—B. 1890; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., May, 1915; attached to Jaffna Kachcheri, June, 1915; addtl. pol. mag., Jaffna, in addition to his own duties, Oct., 1915; ag. office ast. to govt. agt., N. (1913); B. 1866; excise and customs offr., St. Lucia, 1884; treasy. acctnt., 1890; ag. ch. clk., treasy., 1891; ag. ch. clk. and acctnt., St. Vincent, 1892; ag. treasy. acctnt., Grenada, 1892; ch. clk., audit office, Dec., 1893; ag. postmtr., 1896-6; ag. ch. of pol. and excise, 1897; 2nd audit clk., col. sec's offr., Br. WALKER, A.—Laboratory supt., E. Africa Prot., Oct., 1918.

WALKER, ARTHUR FRANCIS GREGORY, M.C.—B. 1884; asst. supt., prisons, Ceylon, Jan., 1910; inspr. gen., prisons, Feb., 1922.

WALKER, JAMES.—Ch. veterinary research offr., E. Africa Prot., June, 1918.

WALKER, ROBERT, B.A. (Dublin).—B. 1881; ed. Pietermaritzburg Coll., Natal, and Trinity Coll., Dublin; senr. exhib., 1902; class. schol., 1903; called to the bar, King's Inn, Dublin, 1905; mag., Uganda, 1915; ag. judge on various occasions, 1916-21; junior puisne judge, Tanganyika Territory, 1921.

WALKER, WILLIAM HENRY, C.M.G. (1913); I.S.O. (1912); B.A.—B. 1864, appd. 3rd clk., govr. genl.'s office, Canada, 1887; prov. to 2nd cls., 1892; 1st cls., 1893; ch. clk. of chf. clk., dept. of external affairs, 1899; under-seo., for external affairs, 1912.

WALL, JAMES HORNE DARRELL.—B. 1871; clk. and storekeeper, Holberton Instit., Ant., Nov., 1891; shortld. reporter to W. Ind. Coms., 1897; aud. def. force accts.; ag. ch. to aud.-gen., Leeward and fedrl. accts., 1899; also clk. to trade and income tax comm., Sept., 1899; ch. clk. to aud.-gen. and fedrl. accts., May, 1900; ag. treas. of Antigua and fedrls., May-Oct., 1909, and Aug., 1910; ag. insp. schl., Leeward Is., Apr., 1911, to Aug., 1911; also ag. treas. of Antigua, and fedrls., Mar.-Apr. and Aug.-Sept., 1912; ag. auditors, Leeward Is., May to Aug., and Oct.-Nov., auditor-gen., Tonga, Mar., 1915.

WALLACE, C. R., L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S. (Ireland).—Capt., R.A.M.C. (T.F.), 1915; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, June, 1916.

WALLACE, CAPT. DAVID EGAN, M.C.—B. 1892; ed. Harrow and Sandhurst; Life Guards, 1911; adjt., 1915-18; war res. of offrs.; served in France, 1914-18; was three times ment. in despatches; on staff attache, Washington, 1919; A.D.C. to gen., Canada, 1920; M.P. for Rugby, 1922; sec. to Mr. Amery as 1st Lord of the admiralty, 1922-3; M.P. for Hornsey, 1924; part sec. to Mr. Amery as S. of S. for the Colonies, 1924.

WALLACE, SIR LAWRENCE AUBERT (1918); C.M.G. 1910.—Acting admin. of Rhodesia, 15th May, 1907; ag. admin. of Rhodesia, Jan., 1909; admstr., Nor. Rhodesia, 1911; ret., 1921.

WALLACE, WILLIAM ARTHUR JAMES—1876; ed. privately and Brisbane Govt. Schl.; field surv. cadet, 1896-99; surv. office, Queensland, 1899-1904; surv. 1904-08; asst. supt., survs., F.M.S., 1908-1917-1919; ag. supt. of survs., 1916-17; supt. of survs., F.M.S., Mar., 1919.

WALLACE, WILLIAM THOMAS EWANS—capt., 4th batt., the King's regt.; served in African war, 1900-1902; supt. of telegraph construction party, S. Nigeria, 1903-5; asst. of telegraphs, E. Africa and Uganda Prot., Dec., 1905; asst. telegraph engr., and P.M.G., Uganda Prot., 1st Jan., 1913; P.M.G., Gold Coast, 12th Mar., 1913; P.M.G. on several occasions (temp. main command), 13th (Service) Batt. The Liverpool Regt., during leave, Sept.-Oct., 1916; censor, Accra, Dec., 1914 to Jan., 1916; served in military service, Palime, Toqoland, Feb., 1916; served on headquarters staff, min. of mun., Aug., 1916 to Jan., 1917.

WALSH, FRANK.—B. 1854; entered Wales civ. ser., legis. assem. dept., 1874; librarian, 1889; mem. internat. exchange club.

WALSH, GEOFFREY.—B. 1884; imm. serv., Apr., 1906; collr. of cust., Mombasa, 1913; seconded to occupied territory of E. Africa to organise cust. serv., with rank of capt., 1916-17; in charge of cust. dept. of area, German E. Africa, Jan. to July, 1917; comsnr., cust., Kenya and Uganda, Jan., 1918; comsnr., cust., Kenya and Uganda and leg. coun., Kenya, Apr., 1923.

WALSH, JOHN.—Ed. Rockwell Coll., Univ. of London (Scholar, Inter. B.A.); in dept. of special comsnr. of income tax.
COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.

VALTER, A., F.R.A.S.—Joined magnetic and meteorological dept., royal observatory, Greenwich, 1892; ast. director, Royal Alfred Observatory, Mauritius, Apr., 1897; statistical officer to Mauritius Royal comm., 1909; census assnr., Mauritius, 1911 and 1921; dir., Royal Red Observatory, May, 1911 to 1921; ag. ast. sec., Mauritius, Nov. to Dec., 1918; food, trade and export contr., Mar., 1920 to Jan., 1922; prot. of imgrts. and poor law commnr., Jan., 1922; mem. of coun. of govt., 1922; headed delegation to India for the re-opening of emigr. VALTER, ROBERT, C.M.G. WALTERS, JOHN RADLEY.—B.A. Cantab.—1888; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., 17th Nov., 1911; attached to Kandy Kachcheri, 15th Dec., 1911; attached to Galle Kachcheri, May, 1912; ag. pol. neg., Negombo, Nov., 1912; office ast., Galle Kachcheri, Nov., 1913; pol. mag., Gampola, July, 1915; ag. dist. judge, Badulla, July, 1917; pol. mag., Karunegala, Dec., 1920; astt. t. agt., Mullaitivu, Sept., 1921; dist. judge, Kandy Eliya, July, 1923; ast. govt. agt., galle, Feb., 1924.

WALTON, B. VALTON, HON. SIR EDGAR HARRIS, K.C.M.G. (1).—M.L.A., Cape, for Port Elizabeth, since 8, and in Union parlmt. since 1910; treas., Feb., 1904, to Feb., 1908; mem. of S. VALTON, GEORGE O'DONNELL.—B. 1871; triculated London Univ., 1891; called to the Middle Temple, 1893; practised at the bar, Barbados, 1894 to 1902; acted on several occasions as pol. mag. and judge of ast. ct. of appeal, Barbados; apptd. pol. mag., dist. WARD, C. E.—Ast. dist. commnr., E.A.P., 7th Aug., 1909; dist. commnr., Jan., 1918.

WARD, ESPIRE FRANCIS, M.D., B.Ch., B.A.O.—Ed. Epsom Coll. and Queen's Univ., Belfast; med. offr., W.A.M.S., Sierra Leone, 1912; trans., Gambia, 1918; trans., G. WARD, JOHN CORBET.—I.Y., S. Africa, 1900-02 (Queen's medal and 4 clasp, King's medal and 2 clasp); Transvaal civ. ser., 1902-04; dep. regt., E. Africa Prot., 1906; regt. of documents, 1906; staff offr., defence force, Kenya, Apr., 1920.

WARD, RIGHT HON. SIR JOSEPH GEORGE, Bart. (1911), P.C. (1907), K.C.M.G. (1901).—Mem., H. of R., N.Z., 1887-97 and 1899-1919; prime min., 1906-12; held the offices of col. sec., postmr.-gen., min. of telegraphs, rlya., cust., marine, finance, defence, lands, agric., industries and commerce and public health at various times between 1893-1912; min. of finance, postmr.-gen. and min. of tele. in national ministry, 1916-19; rep. WARD, LEONARD KEITH, B.A., B.E.—Ed. Sydney Gram. Schl. and Brisbane Gram. Schl.; entd. univ. of Sydney, 1897, as Queensland govt. exhibitioner, and graduated in arts, 1900, and in engineering, 1903; in service of Broken Hill Proprietary Mining Co., till Oct., 1903; lecturer in geology, mineralogy, petrology and mining geology, Kalgoorlie schl. of mines, W. Australia, 1903-7; ast. govt. geologist and inspr. of mines, Tasmania, 1907-11; govt. geologist, S. Australia, Jan., 1912; also dir. of dept. of mines.

WARD, WILFRED ARTHUR.—B. 1892; ed. privately and at Christ's Hosp.; served in France with Civil Service Rifles, 15th London Regt., as lance-corp.; 2nd lieut., 3rd Lancs. Fusiliers, May, 1915; seconded to Machine Gun Corps, and served with them in France, Salonica and Palestine; M.C. at taking of Jerusalem and promoted capt.; cadet, F.M.S., Mar., 1920; govt. rice agt., Batang Padang, Sept., 1920; ag. 2nd ast. dist. offr., Tapah, Mar., 1921; ag. ast. dist. offr., Batang Padang, May, 1921; passed cadet, Jan., 1922; ast. dist. offr., Krian, Mar., 1922; offr., cls. V., Nov., 1919; ag. dist. offr., Ulu Kelantan, Apr., 1923; offr., cls. IV., Nov., 1923.

WARDLE, D. S.—Temp. asst. treas., Kenya, June, 1920; acct., med. dept., Apr., 1921; asst. treas., July, 1923.

WARNER, OSWALD HORNBY.—B. 1891; ed. Rossall Schl. and Keble Coll., Oxford; lieut., South Staffordshire Regt.; asst. dist. commr., Ashanti, G. Coast, 29th Apr., 1914.

WARNER, BRODICK ASHTON.—B. 1888; ed. Winchester Coll.; asst. dist. commr., Uganda Prot., 1912; 1st grade administrative offr., 1923; late capt., 5th batt., City of London Regt. (T.F.); cant., Territorial Force Reserve.

WARREN, LIEUT.-GEN. SIR CHARLES, R.E., R.C.B., G.C.M.G. (1885), K.C.M.G. (1883), C.M.G. (1878).—B. 1840; ed. S., 1899-1900.

WARREN, EDGAR HERBERT.—Served with 28th I.Y., S. African war, 1902 (medal with 2 clasps); S. African constab. WARREN, PHILIP DAVID, C.M.G. (1908); Assoc. WARRINGTON, J. C.—B. 1887; educ. M. borough and Trin. Coll. Camb.; B.A. 1911; served in France with R.E. (Signals) 1914-1918; twice ment. in desps.; French Croix Guerre; asst. dist. commr., G. Coast, 1899.

WATERMEYER, ERNEST FREDERICK—1880; ed. WATERS, ALFRED JOHN, M.B.E. Gen. criminal code into English; editor "Martial Law in S.W. Africa," "The Laws of S.W. Afr. 1915-22."

WATKINS, OSCAR FERRIS, C.B.E., D.S.O. (1916).—Ed., Marlborough and Alice Oxford, B.A., M.A., 1910; served with Herefordshire Lt. Infy. (43rd) during S. Afric., Dec., 1899 to 1901 Queen's Med. and S. WATSON, ANDREW D.—B. 1882; ed. oem schl., Baddeley Acad., Dalhousie Univ., B.A.; ent. civ. serv., Canada, dept. of insurance, 1906; actuary, 1914; assoc., Inst. of Actuaries, 1909; Assoc., Actuarial Soc. of America, Fellow, 1919; Contrib. to the jnl. of the Inst. of Actuaries, and the transactions of the Actuarial Soc.

WATSON, DONALD FRANCIS.—B. 1863; clk., admstr.: office, Seychelles, 1899; dist. clk. and clk., med. dept., 1900; clk. to local clearing house, health, quarantine and cemetery comm., man., govt. pharmacy, 1901; ag. sup., local asylum, May to Oct., 1920; ag. treas., clk. customs, chmn., marine bd., and chmn. rendering comm., July, 1920 to Apr., 1921; clk. local clearing office, June, 1921; treas., port collr. of cust., commr. of income tax, nat. savings bank, regis. of shipping, Apr., 1922.

WATSON, ERNEST CHARLES.—B. 1874; Shrewsbury; called to the bar, Middle Temp., 1897; 3rd cls. res., N. Nigeria, July, 1921; atty.-gen., Sect. to Nov., 1924; atty.-gen., May, 1903; ag. ch. just., Mar. to Oct., 1906;
WATSON, HERBERT GORDON, I.S.O. VATT, SIR THOMAS, K.C.M.G. (1912); C.M.G. WATTS, BERTRAM T.—B. 1883; ed.
